About the job

Remote · Full time · US Eastern hours (9 AM to 6 PM ET)

ACE CPAs is launching a year round tax planning membership for profitable business owners, construction company owners, and high earning professionals paid in company stock. Our technical tax team builds the strategies. We need the person who sits with the client, explains each strategy in plain English, and makes sure it gets implemented before December 31.

About ACE CPAs

ACE CPAs is a tech enabled accounting and advisory firm headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina. We provide bookkeeping, tax preparation, tax planning, Quality of Earnings, and fractional CFO services to US businesses in construction, e-commerce, SaaS, healthcare, and professional services. Our team works remotely across the US and Pakistan, and we build our own AI tools to move faster.

About the role

You own the client side of every tax planning engagement, from the first onboarding call through monthly check-ins. You work alongside our technical tax team and a CPA who signs off on every recommendation. Twelve months in, success looks like a book of planning clients who understand their plan, implemented the agreed moves on time, and renew.

What you'll do

  • Run onboarding for new planning clients: kickoff calls, document collection (prior returns, financials, payroll reports, entity documents, equity grant statements), and setup in our systems.
  • Review each client's situation with the technical team and present the 2 to 3 strategies that apply, in language a business owner understands.
  • Own implementation: build each client's action list with deadlines (year end moves, estimated payments, payroll changes, retirement contributions) and follow up until every item is done.
  • Hold monthly check-ins covering S corporation reasonable compensation, estimated tax updates, cash flow, and new opportunities as the year changes.
  • Explain tax concepts on calls and by email: entity structure, reasonable compensation, QBI, retirement plans, accountable plans, depreciation, equity compensation (ISOs, NSOs, RSUs), and capital gains timing.
  • Send call summaries and client emails the same day, and keep our CRM and project boards current.
  • Spot when a client needs bookkeeping, payroll, or return preparation and hand them to the right team.

What's hard about this role

Most strategies must be in place before December 31, so November and December are intense. You will tell clients when a strategy does not fit them and explain why. We practice tax minimization within the law. Anyone looking for aggressive schemes will not fit here.

Required

  • 3+ years in US tax preparation, planning, or advisory covering individuals and pass through entities (Form 1040, 1120-S, 1065).
  • Client facing experience with US clients. You have led calls or meetings yourself, not only supported them.
  • Fluent, professional English, spoken and written. You will lead calls with US business owners from your first month.
  • Working knowledge of S corporation reasonable compensation, QBI, retirement plan options, Section 179 and bonus depreciation, and estimated tax safe harbors.
  • Full time availability on US Eastern hours.

Preferred

  • EA, CPA, or CA, or actively pursuing one.
  • Experience with high income individuals and equity compensation, including pre IPO liquidity events.
  • Construction or real estate clients.
  • A tax planning platform such as Corvee, Holistiplan, or Instead.
  • ProConnect or Drake, and QuickBooks Online.

jobs.excerpt: Darktrace is a global leader in AI-driven cybersecurity, helping organizations stay ahead of evolving threats every day.
jobs.description:
Darktrace is a global leader in AI-driven cybersecurity, helping organizations stay ahead of evolving threats every day.

Darktrace was built on a genuinely differentiated idea: that Adaptive AI could detect and respond to novel, real-time cyber threats. That approach matters more than ever in the era of AI. Today, our customers depend on us to stay ahead.

At Darktrace, we are energized by that responsibility. We work across teams and rally around a shared goal. We own outcomes end to end - step in, step up and see things through without waiting to be asked. We make decisions with urgency, say the hard thing, and hold each other to high standards with care and directness. We move first and learn fast anticipating where our customers are going next, continuously challenging ourselves.

We invest in the skills, learning and opportunities that help people deliver at the level their roles demand, and reward the aptitude and curiosity to grow beyond them.

Our Values: Own It | Win as One | Raise Our Bar | Move First. Learn Fast

Job Description:

We're building an internal newsroom at the forefront of AI and cybersecurity. Darktrace has proprietary data, threat research and experts who see attacks before the rest of the industry does. Your job is to dig into that material, find the story, and turn it into content people want to read, watch and share.


You'll write, script, shoot and edit for LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram and our editorial channels. You'll work with our threat researchers and Signal Labs, and you'll help ship flagship programs like the Darktrace Secure AI Index. When a major threat or industry story breaks, you'll help us respond fast and get it right.


You'll report to our Director of Editorial and Social, who is building a differentiated content engine that includes AI-powered ways of working. You'll help shape it from day one, with a real say in formats, channels and tools. You'll have access to original threat research that most content teams never see, and your work will be published under Darktrace's name within your first month. We invest in learning and reward curiosity that grows beyond the role.


Key Responsibilities

  • Find the story in the data. Dig into research, threat intelligence and expert conversations. Pull out the finding, the surprise or the point of view that matters, and make it clear to a non-expert.
  • Join the newsroom. Help turn around rapid response content when a breach, vulnerability or industry story breaks. Speed matters, and accuracy matters more.
  • Make content built for each platform. Write blogs and articles. Script and produce short-form video. Create social content for LinkedIn, YouTube and Instagram that fits each channel instead of being copy-pasted across them.
  • Support flagship programs. Help turn research and recurring insights, like the Secure AI Index, into content series that show how cybersecurity and AI are changing.
  • Work with experts and executives. Interview researchers, analysts and senior leaders. Draw out their expertise and help it sound like them, only sharper.
  • Use AI well. Test and apply AI tools across research, drafting, repurposing and distribution. Keep the quality bar high and the judgment human.
  • Learn what lands. Read the numbers, work out why a post or video worked, and use that to make the next one better.
  • Keep stories moving. Manage several projects and contributors at once, and get work from idea to published.

Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years in content, journalism, social, comms or agency work. Strong internships, freelance work and personal projects count.
  • Clear writing, and you edit your own work hard.
  • You know how content spreads on LinkedIn, YouTube and Instagram, and you can explain why one post worked and another didn't.
  • You can script, shoot and edit short-form video. You don't need to be a full-time producer, but you should be comfortable on both sides of the camera.
  • You already use AI tools to research, write or repurpose content, and you have opinions about where they help and where they don't.
  • You like digging into data, and you won't stop until the story is right and the facts hold up.
  • You're curious about cybersecurity and AI, or willing to become so quickly. Experience in either is a plus, not a requirement.
  • You're confident talking to senior people, and you step up without waiting to be asked.

Benefits:

  • 100% medical, dental and vision insurance, plus dependents

  • Paid parental leave

  • Pet insurance Discount

  • Life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401(k)

  • Employee Assistance Program

As a growing business strengthening its governance and controls, this role plays a part in supporting high standards of integrity and accountability.

Darktrace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Darktrace is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact your Talent Partner.


Employment with Darktrace is at-will, meaning either the employee or Darktrace may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, except where prohibited by law or governed by a separate written agreement.

iCOMAT is an advanced manufacturing company that invented Rapid Tow Shearing (RTS) - the only proven technology for producing defect-free curved-fiber composite parts at industrial scale. The U.S Sales Manager will lead U.S. growth for ICOMAT’s advanced composite manufacturing technologies, specifically Rapid Tow Shearing (RTS). This role blends engineering fluency with strategic business development, supporting capture efforts across aerospace, defense, and space markets. You will serve as the technical-commercial interface between U.S. customers and ICOMAT’s engineering, operations, and leadership teams in both the United States and the United Kingdom.

· Guide customers through the adoption of RTS technology, including design allowables, process qualification, and integration into existing production workflows.

Proposal Development & Program Support

· Coordinate with engineering, operations, and leadership to ensure proposals meet customer requirements and internal capability constraints.

· Support program kickoff, execution, and customer reporting for awarded contracts.

What do we need from you?

Required Qualifications

· 5+ years of experience in aerospace/defense business development with a strong knowledge of the industry and current market trends

· Existing working relationships with engineering and procurement teams at strategic aerospace and defense customers.

· Strong understanding of composite structures, automated fiber placement, or advanced manufacturing technologies.

Working Pattern and Location

The order is listed as remote. The supplied job profile describes night shifts as mainly home-based, with occasional travel to disaster recovery sites or other Camden locations for meetings. Training or meetings outside normal working hours may be required with notice.

The Emergency Telephone Service operates on a rota covering 6pm–8am weekdays, Saturdays, Sundays and bank holidays. The profile also includes a standby rota, predominantly covering nights when a scheduled colleague is unavailable. The exact assignment rota and any out-of-hours, standby or call-out enhancements need confirmation; no additional amount is included in the advertised PAYE rate.

Job Overview

Act as the first point of contact for Camden residents requiring out-of-hours council assistance. Assess urgent and complex enquiries, resolve issues where possible, coordinate emergency contractors and escalate appropriately to the Emergency Management Team. Deliver a responsive, professional service across telephone, email and social media channels in line with the Contact Camden quality framework.

Important – Please Read Carefully

Local authority out-of-hours emergency support experience and a Basic DBS are required. Interviews will focus on experience in out-of-hours local government call centres, emergency repairs, noise complaints and related services. You must be able to assess urgency, exercise sound judgement and follow escalation procedures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Respond to emergency service requests, assess residents' needs and urgency, and coordinate responses within written procedures and guidelines.
  • Arrange emergency contractor attendance, prioritise urgent trade jobs and coordinate caretaker pre-inspections or Noise and Pollution Officer investigations where appropriate.
  • Resolve enquiries at first contact where possible and manage complex casework with minimal supervision.
  • Escalate service failures and serious incidents to the Emergency Management Team and ensure effective handovers.
  • Use authorised arrangements to book taxis or commission repairs through third-party contracts with Duty Manager approval.
  • Maintain accurate resident details, emergency information, database entries and document records.
  • Take ownership of customer service outcomes and work with council teams, contractors, emergency services and voluntary organisations.

  • Periodically test and operate disaster recovery systems with the Emergency Management Team.
  • Participate in the standby rota and cover shifts as required under the agreed arrangements.
  • Work flexibly across service areas and contact channels, contribute service-improvement ideas and projects, and support less experienced Customer Services Officers.
  • Follow council health and safety, IT security, data protection and other policies and procedures.

jobs.excerpt: Jouw vak, volledig online Als klinisch psycholoog behandel je volwassenen vanaf 18 jaar met onder andere angststoornissen, depressieve klachten en trauma- en stressgerelateerde problematiek.
jobs.description:
Jouw vak, volledig online

Als klinisch psycholoog behandel je volwassenen vanaf 18 jaar met onder andere angststoornissen, depressieve klachten en trauma- en stressgerelateerde problematiek. Je werkt binnen kortdurende, intensieve behandeltrajecten met een gemiddelde duur van drie maanden.

Je voert specialistische diagnostiek uit, stelt behandelindicaties en behandelt cliënten met evidence-based methoden, waaronder cognitieve gedragstherapie (CGT) en EMDR. Daarnaast is er ruimte voor online diagnostiek, zoals classificerend onderzoek bij ADHD, autisme en persoonlijkheidsproblematiek.

Als regiebehandelaar kijk je verder dan de afzonderlijke behandelgesprekken. Je bewaakt de samenhang van het behandeltraject, ondersteunt collega's bij complexe casuïstiek en draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van het specialistische behandelaanbod.

Concreet betekent dit dat je:

  • specialistische diagnostiek uitvoert en behandelindicaties stelt;

  • zelfstandig psychologische behandelingen uitvoert, onder andere met CGT en EMDR;

  • als regiebehandelaar de voortgang, samenhang en kwaliteit van behandeltrajecten bewaakt;

  • supervisie geeft aan psychologen en psychologen in opleiding;

  • consultaties verzorgt en collega's adviseert bij complexe behandelinhoudelijke vraagstukken;

  • deelneemt aan multidisciplinaire overleggen en behandelplanevaluaties;

  • bijdraagt aan de ontwikkeling van specialistische online diagnostiek en behandelmethodieken.

Zelfstandig betekent niet alleen

Je maakt deel uit van een multidisciplinair team met onder anderen psychologen, cognitief gedragstherapeutisch werkers, verpleegkundigen, ervaringsdeskundigen en psychiaters.

Bij complexe casuïstiek werk je nauw samen met andere behandelaren. Tijdens behandelplanevaluaties bespreek je samen met het behandelteam én de cliënt welke resultaten zijn bereikt, wat aandacht vraagt en of bijstelling van de behandeling nodig is.

Ook supervisie en werkbegeleiding zijn belangrijke onderdelen van het werk. Je ondersteunt collega's in hun professionele ontwikkeling en draagt bij aan een werkomgeving waarin behandelaren kennis delen en kritisch blijven kijken naar hun eigen handelen.

De samenwerking is inhoudelijk gericht. Je stemt af wanneer dat iets toevoegt aan de behandeling, zonder onnodige overlegstructuren.

Zo ziet werken bij GGz Online eruit

GGz Online is de digitale poli van GGz Centraal en biedt specialistische geestelijke gezondheidszorg volledig online. Ook de samenwerking tussen collega's is digitaal georganiseerd.

Je werkt vanuit een professionele thuiswerkplek en hebt veel regie over je agenda en caseload. Op een werkdag combineer je bijvoorbeeld behandelgesprekken met online diagnostiek, supervisie of overleg over complexe casuïstiek.

Cliënten volgen hun behandeling vanuit hun eigen vertrouwde omgeving. Dat kan het makkelijker maken om persoonlijke onderwerpen te bespreken en behandelinterventies direct te verbinden aan het dagelijks leven.

GGz Online biedt op werkdagen behandelingen tussen 08.00 en 20.00 uur. Binnen deze werkomgeving is ruimte voor scholing, vakinhoudelijke verdieping en het verder ontwikkelen van digitaal behandelen.

Hoe ervaart een collega het werken bij GGz Online?

Klinisch neuropsycholoog Inge Siebe vertelt over haar ervaringen met online behandelen, de samenwerking met collega's en de ruimte om haar vak uit te oefenen. Lees het verhaal van Inge.

Past deze manier van werken bij jou?

Als klinisch psycholoog werk je zelfstandig en neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor complexe behandeltrajecten. Je kunt diagnostische en behandelinhoudelijke afwegingen goed onderbouwen en voelt je prettig in een digitale behandelomgeving.

Je vindt het belangrijk om collega's te begeleiden, kennis te delen en samen te werken aan de kwaliteit van zorg. Daarbij kun je ook via beeldbellen een goede behandelrelatie opbouwen en onderhouden.

Requirements

Dit heb je nodig

Voor deze functie heb je:

  • een afgeronde opleiding tot klinisch psycholoog en een geldige BIG-registratie.

  • ervaring met specialistische diagnostiek, complexe behandelingen en regiebehandelaarschap.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Position: Controller

Location: Remote (India)

Shift: US Shift (4pm to 1.30am IST)

Company: CredibleCFO LLC

Employment Type: Full-Time

About CredibleCFO

CredibleCFO is a cloud accounting and finance firm serving small and medium-sized businesses across the United States. We provide bookkeeping, accounting, financial reporting, CFO advisory, tax support, and business process improvement services using modern cloud accounting platforms.

We are weaving AI into how we deliver bookkeeping, accounting and financial reporting, and we expect our finance leaders to work that way too: using AI tools daily, and knowing exactly where their own judgment still has to sit on top.

We are looking for an experienced Controller to oversee financial operations for multiple US-based clients, lead accounting teams, ensure financial accuracy, and provide strategic financial insights that help our clients grow their businesses.

Position Summary

The Controller will be responsible for managing the complete accounting function for a portfolio of US clients. This role requires strong knowledge of US GAAP, financial reporting, month-end close processes, internal controls, cash flow management, budgeting, and team leadership.

Day to day the role owns accounts payable, accounts receivable and the general ledger for that portfolio. A significant share of the work sits with consumer packaged goods and food & beverage brands selling through retail distributors and wholesale channels, where purchase-order driven billing, EDI, deductions, chargebacks and inventory movement are part of normal operations.

The ideal candidate should be capable of acting as a trusted finance partner to business owners while ensuring timely and accurate financial information.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Management & Reporting
  • Oversee the complete accounting cycle for assigned US clients.
  • Review and approve journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end close activities.
  • Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
  • Ensure compliance with US GAAP and client-specific reporting requirements.
  • Analyze financial performance and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Monitor key financial metrics and KPIs.

Accounts Payable (AP)
  • Own the end-to-end procure-to-pay cycle: bill intake, GL coding, approval routing and payment runs.
  • Manage AP workflows in Bill.com and keep them reconciled to the general ledger in QuickBooks Online.
  • Review and escalate overdue bills, and obtain and reconcile vendor statements where balances disagree.
  • Maintain the vendor master, including W-9 collection at onboarding and annual 1099 preparation and review.
  • Review AP aging, accrue unvouchered liabilities at period end and resolve unmatched receipts.

Accounts Receivable (AR)
  • Own the end-to-end order-to-cash cycle across wholesale and retail-distributor channels.
  • Raise customer invoices against purchase orders, including EDI-driven billing through distributor portals such as SPS Commerce, plus advance ship notice and invoice flows.
  • Issue credit memos for shortships, deductions and chargebacks, and research the underlying cause with the operations team.
  • Apply customer receipts accurately and keep unapplied cash at zero.
  • Produce the weekly AR aging report, drive collections follow-up, and report DSO and collection risk to the client.

General Ledger & Reconciliations
  • Own the general ledger: chart of accounts maintenance, recurring and adjusting journal entries, and reclassifications.
  • Clear bank and credit card feeds on a weekly cadence and complete monthly bank and credit card reconciliations.
  • Post accrual, prepaid, deferred revenue and inventory adjustment entries with supporting workpapers.
  • Reconcile the AP, AR and inventory subledgers to the general ledger every period.
  • Maintain the month-end close checklist and the evidence trail behind every balance sheet account.

Month-End & Year-End Close
  • Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing processes.
  • Ensure all accounts are reconciled accurately and on time.
  • Review accruals, prepaid expenses, fixed assets, and depreciation schedules.
  • Maintain supporting schedules and workpapers.

Budgeting & Forecasting
  • Assist clients with budgeting and financial forecasting.
  • Develop cash flow projections and financial models.
  • Monitor budget variances and provide explanations and recommendations.
  • Support strategic planning and business decision-making.

Internal Controls & Compliance
  • Design and maintain effective internal controls.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting policies and procedures.
  • Support audit preparation and coordinate with external auditors.
  • Assist with tax preparers and compliance requirements.

Client Management
  • Serve as the primary finance contact for assigned clients.
  • Conduct regular financial review meetings with business owners.
  • Present financial reports and business insights.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and automation.

Team Leadership
  • Lead and mentor accounting managers, senior accountants, and bookkeeping staff.
  • Review work performed by team members.
  • Allocate workload and manage team productivity.
  • Ensure deliverables meet quality standards and deadlines.
  • Train and develop team members on accounting best practices.

Systems & Technology
  • Utilize cloud accounting platforms including:
    • QuickBooks Online
    • Xero
    • Zoho Books
    • Odoo
  • Work in AP, AR and commerce tooling such as:
    • Bill.com
    • EDI and retail-distributor portals (e.g. SPS Commerce)
    • Distributor and 3PL order-entry portals
  • Drive automation and process improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate accounting records and documentation.

AI & Automation
  • Use AI tools as part of daily close and review work: document and receipt extraction, transaction categorization, reconciliation assistance, variance commentary and first-draft reporting.
  • Review AI-assisted output with professional skepticism. Every number that reaches a client must be traceable to source, whatever produced the first draft.
  • Own the controls around AI-assisted work: what may be automated, what must stay human-reviewed, and the evidence trail that proves which was which.
  • Identify the manual, repetitive parts of AP, AR and close work that should become automations, and specify them clearly enough to be built.
  • Partner with our AI and automation team to pilot, test and roll out tooling across the client portfolio, and measure the hours it actually saves.
  • Coach the accounting team on using AI tools well, including where they must not be used.

Required Qualifications

Education
  • Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA, CMA, ACCA, or equivalent qualification.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

Experience
  • 5+ years of accounting and finance experience.
  • 2+ years in a Controller, Finance Manager, or Senior Accounting Manager role.
  • Experience handling US-based clients is mandatory.
  • Experience working in an accounting firm or outsourced accounting environment preferred.

Technical Skills
  • Strong understanding of:
    • US GAAP
    • Financial Reporting
    • Budgeting & Forecasting
    • Cash Flow Management
    • Internal Controls
    • Revenue Recognition
    • Accounts Payable and procure-to-pay
    • Accounts Receivable, order-to-cash and collections
    • General Ledger and reconciliations
    • Deductions, chargebacks and shortship resolution
    • Inventory accounting
    • W-9 and 1099 compliance
    • Financial Analysis
  • Advanced Excel skills.
  • Experience with QuickBooks Online is mandatory.
  • Hands-on experience with Bill.com or a comparable AP automation platform.
  • Hands-on use of AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) in real accounting work, plus the judgment to know which output needs verifying before it reaches a client.
  • Experience with Xero, Zoho Books, or Odoo is preferred.

Soft Skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to interact directly with US clients.
  • Strong leadership and team management skills.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Genuine curiosity about new tools and a willingness to change how the work gets done.
  • Ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Professional and client-focused approach.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  • Timely completion of month-end close.
  • Days sales outstanding (DSO) and collection effectiveness.
  • AP aging and on-time vendor payment.
  • Unapplied cash and subledger-to-GL reconciliation variances.
  • Manual hours removed through automation and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Accuracy of financial reports.
  • Client satisfaction and retention.
  • Budget vs actual variance management.
  • Team productivity and utilization.
  • Quality review scores.
  • On-time delivery of client engagements.
  • Reduction in accounting errors and rework.

Compensation

Salary: Based on experience and qualifications

Benefits
  • Work-from-home opportunity
  • Exposure to US businesses across multiple industries
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Performance-based incentives
  • Professional development and training

Preferred Candidate Profile
  • CA or CPA qualified.
  • Has already used AI tools to change how an accounting process runs, not just experimented with them.
  • Experience managing a team of 5+ members.
  • Strong client-facing experience with US businesses.
  • Comfortable leading financial review meetings with business owners.
  • Experience in outsourced accounting firms serving US clients.
  • Ability to independently manage a portfolio of multiple clients and act as a virtual Controller.

Company: Seamless.AI

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer

Why this role exists

Seamless.AI has the best B2B contact and company data on the market and the most powerful AI sales automation software. Now we want it everywhere our buyers already work…sales tools, marketing tools, data tools, CRMs, AI SDR platforms, and more.

Your job is simple to say and hard to do: get Seamless.AI natively built into these platforms. Sometimes that's an OEM or white-label deal. Sometimes it's a live workflow integration. Sometimes it's a marketplace listing. Whatever gets us embedded and generating more revenue… you make it happen.

This is a hunter role. You find the partners, build the relationship, negotiate the deal, and drive it to a shipped integration that makes money. We’re here to support the deal structure and the prioritization of accounts to go after, but you are the expert prospector, hunter and farmer to make it a reality.

What you'll do

  • Land native, OEM, and white-label deals that put Seamless.AI data inside partner platforms.
  • Negotiate live workflow integrations with the tools our customers already use.
  • Get us listed in all the important CRM, Sales, Marketing, and Top marketplaces (and others that matter).
  • Own the full partner cycle: find them, pitch them, negotiate terms, and get the integration live with dev.
  • Work hand-in-hand with product and engineering to scope and ship each build.
  • Track and grow the revenue that flows through every partner.

What success looks like in 12 months

You will be measured on two things:

1.Revenue sourced — pipeline and revenue driven through those partners.

2.Integrations shipped — real, live integrations in market.

We want both. Shipped without revenue isn't a win. Revenue without new integrations isn't either.

What we're looking for

  • 5–8 years in channel sales, partner sales, API Sales, or OEM business development. You're a proven closer.
  • A track record of getting your product built into other platforms.
  • Strong API and integration savvy. You don't need to write the code, but you need to speak the language of engineers and product teams, scope what's possible, and move a technical deal forward.
  • Sharp negotiation skills. You'll structure rev-share, OEM, and partnership terms.
  • Comfort in a fast-moving, high-output environment. You ship.
  • Willing to travel to partners when it moves a deal.

Deal ownership

You source and negotiate every deal. Final terms get a quick sign-off from the CRO and CEO — so you'll bring us clean, well-structured deals ready to approve.

Priorities, in order

1.Native, OEM, and white-label integrations (the deepest ones).

2.Live workflow integrations as a partner.

3.Marketplace listings (HubSpot, Salesforce app stores, etc.).

Compensation

●Competitive base salary.

●Commission on partner-sourced revenue.

●Bonus on integrations shipped.

You get paid for both sides of the job: building the integrations and driving the revenue.

This Work from Home role serves as a primary point of contact for patient imaging needs within a high-volume contact center environment, requiring efficiency, strong critical thinking, and attention to detail while managing complex, high touch interactions and adhering to healthcare protocols.

The Radiology Scheduler is a key contributor within the Contact Center, combining advanced customer service skills with subject matter knowledge of radiology workflows, medical terminology, and multiple scheduling systems. The role requires ongoing training and cross training to build and maintain proficiency and accuracy across all radiology modalities, systems, and client specific workflows, while demonstrating understanding of and compliance with contact center performance metrics (including adherence, quality, attendance, and service levels) and maintaining all quality, performance, and privacy standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle complex patient interactions requiring independent reasoning, prioritization, and problem solving within defined workflows and escalation guidelines.
  • Schedule, confirm, cancel, and reschedule radiology appointments across multiple modalities, including but not limited to:
  • Mammography / Breast Imaging
  • MRI
  • CT
  • Ultrasound
  • DEXA
  • Fluoroscopy
  • Other related imaging services
  • Accurately document all patient interactions, updates, and outcomes simultaneously in designated CRM and scheduling systems.
  • Serve as a knowledge resource for patients by addressing questions related to imaging procedures, preparation instructions, provider orders, and general radiology information.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, empathy, and accuracy in all interactions, including those involving sensitive medical or insurance information.
  • Confirm and document insurance information according to established guidelines and client protocols.
  • Review and validate imaging orders and recommendations; coordinate with providers and clinical partners as needed.

Training & Development

  • Participate in initial, ongoing, and refresher training programs.
  • Engage in continued training and cross training to increase proficiency and accuracy in scheduling across all radiology modalities, systems, and client workflows.

  • Maintain competency in multiple systems and tools used to support patient scheduling and documentation.

jobs.description:
About Mars Security

Mars Security is an early-stage cybersecurity company building a new category of security technology, backed by deep hands-on experience from offensive security, threat intelligence, and security operations.

We're building a platform that lets security teams run continuous threat hunting and detection engineering across their existing stack. Most SOCs cannot tell you which active campaigns their environment would catch today. Mars closes that gap.

Founded by experienced operators, backed by world-class investors, and working with design partners across financial services, healthcare, pharma, and industrial security. We're building a team of people who thrive on ownership, ambiguity, and impact.

About the Role

Mars Security is looking for a Threat Hunter who hunts because they cannot help it. Not because someone filed a ticket. This role sits at the intersection of detection engineering, threat intelligence, and adversary research. You will run real hunts against real environments, build detection logic that closes actual gaps, and feed what you find back into the platform. You will work directly with founders and directly with customers. What you discover shapes the product.

If your instinct when you see a security stack is to figure out what it would miss, you should be talking to us.

What You'll Do

  • Run threat hunts across customer environments using SIEM, EDR, cloud, identity and etc.
  • Research adversary infrastructure, tactics, and tooling to stay ahead of what customers are actually facing
  • Build and validate detection rules and hunt queries grounded in real attacker TTPs and active campaigns
  • Develop and maintain detection content across multiple platforms and data sources
  • Analyze large datasets to surface anomalies, behavioral patterns, and attack indicators that automated systems miss
  • Contribute to the platform by identifying what good hunting and detection engineering looks like at scale

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years Hands-on threat hunting experience
  • Detection engineering experience: you've written rules that caught real attacks, not just passed tests
  • Strong data analysis skills - comfortable querying and interpreting telemetry at volume
  • Solid understanding of attacker TTPs, adversary tradecraft, and how campaigns operate end to end
  • Offensive security knowledge: you understand how attacks are built, not just what they look like in logs
  • Familiarity with infrastructure: networking, identity, cloud, endpoint. You know where attackers hide because you know how the plumbing works
  • Python proficiency for scripting, automation, and analysis
  • A pattern of self-directed learning. This field moves fast. You move faster.
  • Malware analysis, threat intelligence, or red team background is a strong plus
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Strong customer-facing skills and ability to build trusted relationships with customers
  • Team player with strong collaboration and communication skills

Why Mars Security

  • Ground-floor opportunity at a well-funded, fast-growing cybersecurity company
  • Direct access to founders and meaningful influence on the product roadmap
  • Deep exposure to adversary research and real-world detection engineering at scale
  • Work alongside a team built from offensive security and threat intelligence practitioners

jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote (priority regions: South Africa, Latin America, Europe)
Hours: US business hours (EST/PST), the same hours as the team you'll lead
Engagement Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor
English: C1/C2, non-negotiable

🚀 The Vision: Building the Operating System for Product Creation

Since 2013, THE/STUDIO has been building the definitive operating system for product creation. We are combining modern SaaS technology with custom manufacturing to make producing physical goods as seamless, fast, and scalable as launching software.

We operate two core platforms: Customize Now(our best-in-class, on-demand manufacturing platform) and Source Anything (our new SaaS product that enables customers to seamlessly work with global factories beyond our own network).

We are a profitable, previously Silicon Valley-backed, fully remote company, and we are not just looking to improve manufacturing, we are looking for a visionary operator to help us truly revolutionize the global supply chain.

💻 The Role

You'll run the day-to-day of our Customize Now inbound sales team. You own the team's monthly revenue and order targets, coach the reps to get better every week, and make sure every lead gets a fast response and every deal is tracked properly in the CRM.

You report to the Head of GTM. This is a player-coach role: you'll be in the deals, on the calls and in the pipeline with your team, not managing from a dashboard.

Why This Role Is Exciting:

  • Direct Access to Leadership: You will have the opportunity to work directly with our CEO and executive team, giving you high visibility, direct mentorship, and a seat at the table.

  • Product & Strategic Influence: We operate with flat hierarchies. Your daily insights from the ground level will directly shape our product roadmap, workflows, and company strategy.

  • Rapid Scale & Career Trajectory: We are growing rapidly. Joining us right now means high autonomy, minimal red tape, and massive room for personal and professional acceleration.

🎯 What You’ll Do

  • Revenue and targets: Own the team’s monthly revenue and order targets. Know where the number stands every day and act early when it’s off track.

  • Lead management and conversion: Make sure inbound leads are answered fast, qualified properly and moved through the pipeline. Improve lead-to-order conversion.

  • Coaching: Run regular 1:1s, call reviews and deal reviews. Give reps specific, practical feedback that lifts their numbers.

  • Performance management: Set clear expectations, track rep KPIs and have the difficult conversations when someone is below the bar.

  • Pipeline and forecast: Keep a clean, accurate pipeline and give leadership a reliable weekly and monthly forecast.

  • Process and CRM discipline: Build and enforce a simple, repeatable sales process. Every lead, call and deal is logged and up to date.

  • Commercial excellence: Grow average order value through upsell and cross-sell, apply pricing and discount rules consistently, and protect margin.

  • Cross-functional work: Work with Marketing on lead quality, and with Operations, Production and Customer Success so customers get what was sold, on time.

📈 What Success Looks Like

  • First 90 days: You know every rep, every metric and the full sales process. Speed-to-lead and CRM hygiene are visibly better, and you have a clear plan to lift conversion.

  • 6 months: The team hits its monthly targets consistently. You run a steady weekly rhythm of 1:1s, pipeline reviews and forecasts.

  • 12 months: Team revenue, conversion and average order value are up. Reps are measurably stronger and the process runs without you chasing it.

💡 The Profile We’re Looking For (Our Core Pillars)

Our Founder/CEO defines our top performers by three distinct traits. If this describes how you operate, you will thrive here:

  1. Raw Intelligence & Problem-Solving: High processing power, business acumen, and logical reasoning. You can think on your feet, connect complex ideas, and break down ambiguous problems quickly.

  2. "Give a Shit" Energy (Extreme Ownership): You take 100% accountability for your domain and outcomes. You don't make excuses or blame external factors. You look inward, find solutions, and push across the finish line.

  3. Rapid Adaptation & Radical Candor: You embrace blunt, constructive feedback and pivot instantly without ego. You excel in a fast-moving environment where you need to act with urgency without waiting for hand-holding.

Requirements:

  • Team leadership: You have led a sales team (inside, inbound or transactional B2B) that was accountable for revenue targets.

  • Track record: You can show your team hitting its targets, with real numbers: team size, target and attainment.

  • Commercial sense: You understand conversion rates, average order value, pipeline, forecasting and margin, and how they connect.

  • Data-driven: You use CRM data and reports to spot problems and decide what to change.

  • Hands-on coaching: You coach reps on live calls and deals, and you can hold difficult performance conversations.

  • Execution at volume: You can keep a high-volume inbound operation running smoothly day after day.

  • Hours: You can work US business hours (EST/PST) consistently.

  • Communication: Exceptional, professional-level English proficiency (C1/C2) with clear, concise, and articulate communication skills.

  • Independent Contractor Mindset: Highly disciplined, self-motivated, and comfortable operating as a full-time, dedicated independent contractor in a 100% remote setting.

  • Remote Infrastructure: Reliable setup including a fast computer, noise-canceling headset, and a rock-solid, stable internet connection.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in e-commerce, custom manufacturing, sourcing, promotional products or transactional B2B

  • Experience leading a high-volume inbound sales team

  • HubSpot or Salesforce, plus sales automation tools

  • Built upsell, cross-sell or repeat-purchase programs

  • Scaled or managed a fully remote sales team

This is not the right role if you've never managed reps, can't share your team's numbers, or prefer to manage only from reports without getting involved in deals.

💰 Compensation & Terms

  • Flexible & Competitive: We offer competitive, outcome-driven compensation packages tailored to the candidate's level of impact.

  • Engagement Type: Full-time, exclusive independent contractor role.

🔎 Our Hiring Process

  1. Application: IMPORTANT! Please submit your resume/CV in English and answer all application questions.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: Your sales leadership track record, how you coach and how you use data.

  3. Case Study: A practical exercise based on a real sales team scenario.

  4. Final Interview: Conversation with leadership.

  5. Reference Check: Verification of past performance with former managers.

Note that every role is different, so the process may vary depending on the requirements of the role. Please note that due to the volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide feedback to all applications.

THE/STUDIO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture free from discrimination.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: Senior Marketing Manager SwimOutlet. com | Reimagine the Future of Marketing Fully Remote (Toronto, Canada) · Full-Time We're not looking for someone to follow the marketing playbook.
jobs.description:
Senior Marketing Manager

SwimOutlet.com | Reimagine the Future of Marketing

Fully Remote (Toronto, Canada) · Full-Time

We're not looking for someone to follow the marketing playbook. We're looking for someone who's ready to rewrite it.

At SwimOutlet, we're doing things a little differently.

We believe great marketing isn't about creating more content. It's about creating content that makes people feel something, connects them with what they love, and inspires them to take action.

And we believe AI is about to change everything. Not just how quickly we create, but what we're capable of creating.

We're looking for someone who blends the imagination of a storyteller, the instincts of a marketer, the curiosity of an inventor, and the analytical mind of a strategist.

A creative rebel. A storyteller. A builder. An experimenter.

Someone who sees possibilities where others see processes. Someone who is as excited about creating authentic content on a pool deck as they are about building an AI agent that transforms how marketing gets done.

If that sounds like you, we'd love to meet you.

The Opportunity: Build What Comes Next

SwimOutlet is the largest online specialty retailer for swimming and water sports in the United States.

We serve competitive swimmers, parents, coaches, teams, fitness enthusiasts, and everyone who loves being in the water.

We have incredible brands, passionate customers, authentic stories to tell, and an opportunity to rethink how we connect with our community.

That's where you come in.

As our Senior Marketing Manager, you'll help shape the future of marketing across SwimOutlet, Sporti, team sales, and our broader family of brands.

But we're not asking you to simply manage campaigns, maintain a content calendar, or follow what's trending on social media.

We're inviting you to imagine what marketing could become.

What if our community of swimmers, coaches, and ambassadors became our most powerful creative engine?

What if a single authentic story could inspire an entire campaign across organic social, paid media, email, and the shopping experience?

What if AI agents could identify emerging trends, uncover creative opportunities, accelerate content production, and help us continuously improve our marketing?

What if we could spend less time on repetitive marketing tasks and more time creating things that genuinely inspire people?

What if our customers didn't just shop with us but felt like they were part of something bigger?

These are the possibilities we want you to help explore.

Your Superpower: Creativity Meets Intelligence

We love big ideas. But we love turning them into reality even more.

We're looking for someone who wants to discover what's next, build it, learn from it, and make it better.

This is a hands-on role for someone who doesn't just direct the work but genuinely enjoys doing it.

  • Create content that authentically connects with the swimming community. Bring your firsthand knowledge of competitive swimming to the pool deck. Leverage your access to swimmers, coaches, teams, ambassadors, and creators to imagine, shoot, direct, and source compelling social-first content. Understand the culture, language, rituals, challenges, and aspirations of swimmers in ways that someone outside the sport might miss.
  • Create content people actually want to watch. Imagine, shoot, direct, and source authentic social-first content that connects with our swimming community. Experiment with short-form video, storytelling, user-generated content, motion, and emerging creative formats.
  • Turn our community into a creative force. Build and evolve our ambassador, influencer, and creator programs into a meaningful source of authentic stories, compelling content, engagement, and measurable results.
  • Put AI and agents to work. Build intelligent, multi-step workflows that transform content production, campaign creative, landing pages, on-site experiences, and internal marketing tools. Explore what's possible beyond a single prompt.
  • Make creativity measurable. Understand why certain hooks, messages, stories, and formats outperform others. Translate metrics such as click-through rates, hook rates, hold rates, CPM, and engagement into smarter creative decisions.
  • Experiment relentlessly. Challenge assumptions, test creative concepts, explore new angles, recognize creative fatigue, and continuously improve through structured experimentation and A/B testing.
  • Automate the ordinary so we can create the extraordinary. Partner with our retention and CRM teams to automate repetitive marketing work, accelerate email and SMS creative production, and build reusable workflows that give our teams more time to innovate.
  • Connect storytelling with commerce. Collaborate with Paid Media, Buying, Creative, Retention, Product, Technology, brand partners, and vendors to bring compelling ideas to life across the customer journey.
  • Build things that scale. Create systems, workflows, content libraries, playbooks, and processes that make great marketing repeatable without making it predictable.
  • Own your ideas from imagination to execution. Take responsibility for projects from the initial concept through production, launch, measurement, and continuous improvement.

You'll have the freedom to question, explore, create, and build, and the responsibility to turn imagination into results.

We're not looking for someone who simply knows how to use AI.

We're looking for someone who understands how to build with it.

What You Bring

We believe exceptional talent doesn't always follow a traditional career path. What matters is what you've learned, what you've built, and what you're capable of doing next.

You're a creative thinker, a hands-on builder, and a results-driven marketer who understands the power of authentic storytelling, intelligent technology, and meaningful customer connections.

You also know competitive swimming from the inside. A competitive swimming background or direct, firsthand experience within the competitive swimming community is required. You understand the culture, the athlete experience, and the unique needs and aspirations of swimmers, coaches, teams, and swim families. You have established connections within the swimming community and direct access to pool decks, swimmers, coaches, ambassadors, and creators, enabling you to regularly source and produce authentic, compelling content.

You bring:

  • Experience in DTC, retail, e-commerce, or consumer brand marketing, with real examples of campaigns and creative work you've brought to life.
  • A passion for storytelling and an instinct for what makes content compelling across organic and paid social channels.
  • Hands-on experience shooting, directing, sourcing, and producing authentic social and video content.
  • Demonstrated experience building agentic AI workflows that solve real problems, improve processes, and unlock new marketing capabilities.
  • An analytical mindset and the ability to transform creative performance data into actionable insights, smarter decisions, and measurable results.
  • Strong creative and brand judgment, with the confidence to challenge conventional thinking while maintaining brand authenticity.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to independently own projects, navigate competing priorities, collaborate across teams, and turn ideas into results.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to translate your vision into actionable creative briefs, shot lists, workflows, and recommendations.

Experience building and scaling ambassador or influencer programs, managing creative partners, and developing high-performing paid social creative is especially valuable.

You don't need to know every AI tool. Technology will continue to evolve, and so will the possibilities.

What matters is your curiosity, imagination, resourcefulness, and demonstrated ability to learn, build, experiment, and adapt.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just understand marketing but deeply understands the community we're marketing to — and can turn that knowledge into authentic storytelling, meaningful relationships, innovative experiences, and measurable business results.

What Success Looks Like

A year from now, we want more than a busier marketing calendar or a larger social media following.

We want authentic, compelling content that connects with our customers and drives measurable results.

A thriving community of ambassadors and creators who help tell our story in ways we couldn't tell it ourselves.

A consistent pipeline of creative ideas that fuels organic social, paid media, and customer engagement.

AI agents and intelligent workflows that eliminate repetitive work, accelerate production, and unlock entirely new marketing capabilities.

Creative experimentation that leads to stronger performance, deeper customer connections, and smarter decisions.

A marketing team empowered to spend more time imagining what's possible and less time managing manual processes.

And innovations we couldn't have imagined before you joined us.

What You'll Have: The Freedom to Create What's Next

This isn't a role where you'll be handed a playbook and asked to follow it.

You'll have:

  • Direct access to leadership. Report directly to our Chief Marketing Officer, with the opportunity to influence the future of marketing across SwimOutlet and our family of brands.
  • An environment where AI is already part of how we build. You won't be starting from a blank page. You'll improve what's working, challenge what's possible, and build what comes next.
  • No unnecessary layers. We value great ideas, open conversations, intellectual curiosity, and people who challenge conventional thinking.
  • Intense collaboration. Work alongside Paid Media, Retention, CRM, Buying, Creative, Product, Technology, and external partners. Big ideas don't happen in silos.
  • The freedom to experiment. Test bold ideas, learn quickly, challenge assumptions, and discover better ways of connecting with our customers.
  • A community worth creating for. Work with passionate athletes, coaches, teams, families, and people who genuinely love being in the water.
  • The flexibility to work remotely. Work from the United States or Canada, with opportunities to create content on location and collaborate with our teams and partners.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits. U.S. annual base salary of up to $130,000, with final compensation based on experience, skills, and qualifications. Compensation and benefits for Canadian employees are based on their employment location.

What we won't have?

Endless meetings about meetings.

Content created simply to fill a calendar.

AI initiatives that never move beyond a presentation.

Creative decisions based entirely on assumptions rather than curiosity, experimentation, and evidence.

Or a culture where "that's how we've always done it" is considered a good answer.

We believe extraordinary things happen when curious minds, bold ideas, emerging technology, and talented people come together.

Bring your imagination. Bring your intellect. Bring your creative energy. Bring your willingness to challenge what's possible.

We'll bring the opportunity to build something extraordinary.

One Last Thing...

If you've ever looked at a marketing campaign and thought, "There has to be a more interesting way to tell this story," we want to hear from you.

If you've created content that surprised people, challenged expectations, or delivered remarkable results, we want to see it.

If you've built an AI workflow that made you rethink how marketing could be done, show us.

And if you're the kind of person who sees a new technology and immediately starts imagining what you could build with it, we're especially interested.

You might be exactly who we're looking for.

How to Apply: Show Us How You Think

No resume. No CV. No cover letter.

Just you, your ideas, your creations, and a glimpse into how your mind works.

We believe the most interesting people don't always fit neatly onto a CV.

We'd rather see your imagination, creative judgment, marketing instincts, and ability to turn ideas into something remarkable.

So we're doing things a little differently.

Record three short videos (3–5 minutes each).

Use Loom, Zoom, your phone, or whatever works best for you. You can share your screen, walk us through existing work, or demonstrate something you've built.

No fancy presentation necessary. We're interested in your thinking, your creativity, and your ability to execute.

Video 1: Show Us Your Marketing Superpower

Great marketing starts with seeing something others might miss.

Show us examples of marketing content or creative campaigns you've personally helped bring to life.

We'd love to see an example of social or video content you've shot, directed, or sourced, along with an example of paid social or performance creative you've developed or improved. These can be part of the same campaign.

Walk us through:

  • The opportunity: What customer insight, challenge, or opportunity inspired your work? Who were you trying to reach, and why?
  • Your creative thinking: How did you decide on the story, message, hook, format, and creative direction? What made your approach different?
  • Your contribution: What did you personally create, build, direct, or improve? Show us the actual work.
  • The results: How did you measure success? What did the data or customer response tell you? What worked, and what didn't?
  • Your imagination: Looking at SwimOutlet and our swimming community, what's one marketing opportunity you would be excited to explore? How might you approach it differently?

We're not asking you to create a new campaign for us.

We want to understand how you connect creativity, consumer behavior, storytelling, and performance.

Show us what you've built. Tell us what you've learned. Inspire us with what you see as possible.

Video 2: Show Us Your AI Superpower

Show us an agentic AI workflow you've personally built that changed how something gets done.

It could be a content production system, a creative testing workflow, a campaign automation, an intelligent research tool, a landing page generator, an internal marketing tool, or something entirely unexpected.

By agentic AI, we mean a workflow in which AI carries out multiple steps using tools, information, or data to accomplish a goal, rather than simply responding to a single prompt.

Share your screen and walk us through:

  • The challenge: What problem, inefficiency, or opportunity inspired you to build it?
  • Your creation: What did you build, and why did you choose that approach?
  • How it works: What information goes in? What tools or agents are involved? What happens behind the scenes? What comes out?
  • Your creative contribution: What decisions, original thinking, and expertise did you bring that AI couldn't provide on its own?
  • The impact: What did it replace or improve? Did it save time, improve quality, accelerate production, or create a capability that didn't previously exist?
  • What's next: What did you learn? How would you improve it, scale it, or apply the same thinking to another marketing challenge?

Video 3: Show Us Your Swimming Superpower

Your connection to swimming: Tell us about your firsthand experience with competitive swimming and your connection to the swimming community. What do you understand about swimmers, coaches, and swim culture that a marketer outside the sport might overlook? How would you leverage your access to pool decks, athletes, ambassadors, and creators to produce authentic, differentiated content for SwimOutlet?

This is your opportunity to show us that you don't just understand marketing — you understand the people we're marketing to.

Your workflow doesn't need to be a polished, enterprise-level system. A working prototype, personal project, or experiment is welcome.

What matters is that you've actually built something and can demonstrate how it works.

We want to see how you think with AI, not simply what AI can generate for you.

A Few Things to Know

We're not judging the production quality of your application videos, your presentation style, or whether you've mastered every AI tool.

We're interested in your creativity, marketing judgment, technical curiosity, analytical thinking, and ability to turn ideas into action.

Please only share work and information you are authorized to disclose. You may anonymize examples, use demonstration data, or describe results without revealing confidential employer information.

You don't need permission to think differently here.

You don't need to have every answer.

And you definitely don't need to tell us what you think we want to hear.

Show us what excites you.

Show us what you've built.

Show us what you believe could be possible.

We're ready to be inspired.

Come make some waves with us.

SwimOutlet.com | Part of Spiraledge, Inc.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Career Services Advisor is responsible for effectively and strategically providing ongoing career development and employability coaching to active students and alumni through course presentations, workshops, one-on-one coaching sessions, and professional assessments. The Career Services Advisor works directly with the Director of Career Services, other Career Services staff members, and other campus departments, to continually assess student progress throughout the entirety of the program.

Additionally, the Career Services Advisor will schedule and conduct virtual mock interviews, contact unplaced graduates weekly, provide resume writing assistance, provide job search guidance to graduates, and assist with events such as career fairs and Program Advisory Committee meetings. The Career Services Advisor is responsible for timely and accurate documentation in CampusVue/CampusNexus of all active students, graduates, and employer communication. In addition, the Career Services Advisor will be responsible for tracking all unplaced graduates including the graduate’s employment criteria needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct outreach efforts to ensure ongoing communication with students and graduates

  • Provide guidance to students and graduates and always maintain a high level of professional standards

  • Coordinate and conduct scheduled resume preparation, interview techniques, job search/research, and other professional development sessions

  • Collect graduate employment qualifications and criteria to determine the employment assistance path required to be successfully placed

  • Provide availability and opportunities to conduct One-on-One coaching sessions with students and graduates

  • Assist in proactive job search efforts by providing job leads, resources and online application assistance to generate employment opportunities

  • Conduct community and employer outreach to identify viable employment opportunities for students and graduates within their chosen field

  • Support the team’s efforts in completing Employment Verification documents and accurate data entry of all information

  • Maintain organization of student records and processes necessary to ensure compliance with regulatory and accreditation agencies

  • Document in CampusVue all correspondence between the department and student/graduate/employers

  • Maintain strictest confidentiality with school information, including but not limited to, regulatory information, student accounts, balances and payment history, exposure to personal information including names, addresses, phone numbers, birthdays, and Social Security numbers

  • Participate and plan ongoing student engagement activities

  • Participate in various school events as required

  • Other duties as assigned by management

Experience and Education Required

  • Associate’s degree in Business, Human Resources, Communication or a related field from an academic institution accredited by a regional or national accrediting agency that is recognized by the Department of Education, or comparable related work experience

  • 1 year work experience in recruiting, staffing, human resources, counseling or business

  • Work experience in developing community connections

  • Proficiency working with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook

  • Excellent organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills

  • Strong commitment to customer service and public presentation skills

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate with internal and external customers and teammates

Experience and Education Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Communications or a related field from an academic institution accredited by a regional or national accrediting agency that is recognized by the Department of Education

  • 1 year experience in career / employability training

  • 1 year experience in staffing or career placement

  • 1 year of call center experience

  • 1 year of interviewing experience

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. FEDlogic is a people-first benefits navigation company dedicated to helping individuals and families navigate the complex landscape of federal and state benefits. Title: Clinical Liaison and Account Executive (RN, NP or PA)

Location: Remote; candidates within 2-3 hours of Winston-Salem, NC preferred

Employment Type: Full Time

Reports To: Chief Operating Officer

FEDlogic:

FEDlogic is a people-first benefits navigation company dedicated to helping individuals and families navigate the complex landscape of federal and state benefits. As the only vendor in the country providing unbiased education and advocacy on all federal and state benefits, FEDlogic stands out in its mission to ensure no one misses out on the benefits they are entitled to.

We partner with employers to help their employees and families understand and access federal and state programs. Our experts provide confidential, unbiased guidance that lowers healthcare costs, reduces financial stress, and improves well-being. By bridging the gap between government programs and workplace benefits, FEDlogic delivers meaningful impact for employees while helping employers manage risk, reduce costs, and strengthen their benefits offering.

Position Overview:
FEDlogic is looking for an experienced clinician (a registered nurse, nurse practitioner, physician assistant or other licensed clinician) who wants to put a deep clinical background to work in a new way. This is not a clinical practice role. It is a client-facing account executive role in which clinical knowledge is the advantage.

You will be FEDlogic's clinical translator: the person who reads a member's medical picture, understands the providers and claims behind it, and explains in plain language what it means for federal and state benefits. You will partner with our Connecting with Care team and case managers to better serve the individuals and families we support, and you will be the team's go-to resource for clinical review and interpretation.

You will start by supporting existing accounts alongside our client teams, and we will grow you into managing accounts of your own.

Key Responsibilities:

Account Management

  • Build relationships with employers, HR leaders and benefits advisors, and serve as a trusted contact on assigned accounts.
  • Bring clinical insight to stewardship meetings, renewals and new-business conversations that shows the value FEDlogic delivers to members and plans.
  • Present results to clients and advisors, including summaries, trends and de-identified case examples.
  • Grow into full ownership of a portfolio of client accounts, including engagement, retention and expansion.

Clinical Review and Interpretation

  • Serve as FEDlogic's go-to resource for clinical review, helping our experts understand how a member's conditions, prognosis and functional limitations bear on potential eligibility for Medicare, Medicaid, SSDI, ESRD Medicare and similar programs.
  • Read claims history and claim codes (ICD-10, CPT and HCPCS) and translate them into a clear picture of the member's situation.
  • Recognize clinical patterns that commonly signal program eligibility, such as dialysis or transplant, NICU stays, complex pediatric conditions, disabilities and long-term care needs.

Data and Member Identification

  • Interpret reporting from FEDlogic's data partners, such as Innovu, Cedar Gate and Vital Incite, to identify members who may benefit from FEDlogic and to help client teams increase engagement.
  • Help build and refine the clinical criteria, code sets and review workflows that make member identification consistent and repeatable.
  • Handle protected health information in line with HIPAA, FEDlogic policy and each client's business associate agreement.

Collaboration with Connecting with Care and Case Managers

  • Work with the Connecting with Care team to understand members' needs and improve how FEDlogic serves the individuals and families we support.
  • Partner with case managers to coordinate support for members with complex medical situations.
  • Train FEDlogic team members on common conditions, terminology and the clinical factors that drive program eligibility.
  • Keep HubSpot records and case notes current so internal teams have a reliable source of truth.

Scope of Role

This is a non-clinical role. It does not involve diagnosis, treatment, prescribing or direct patient care, and it does not make eligibility determinations, which rest with the administering agencies. Its purpose is to apply clinical knowledge so that FEDlogic's team, clients and advisors can guide families well.

Required Qualifications:

  • Active, unrestricted license as a Registered Nurse or higher, such as a Nurse Practitioner, Physician Assistant or other advanced practice clinician. Physicians are welcome to apply.
  • [3–5] years of hands-on clinical experience working with patients, families and providers.
  • Working knowledge of medical claims and claim codes, and the ability to read medical records, diagnoses and treatment plans.
  • Strong communication skills with non-clinical audiences, including the ability to explain complex medical and benefits topics simply to HR leaders, advisors and internal teams.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and the handling of protected health information.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and comfort learning systems such as HubSpot and analytics platforms.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Clinical background in the NICU or neonatal care, pediatrics, or care for people with disabilities.
  • Experience in case management, care management, utilization review or a payer setting.
  • Knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, SSDI and ESRD eligibility rules.
  • Experience with healthcare analytics platforms such as Innovu, Cedar Gate or Vital Incite.
  • Experience in employee benefits, insurance or client-facing account management.

Skills and Competencies:

  • Clinical judgment: reviews a claims history and quickly sees what it means for the member.
  • Clinical translation: turns medical detail into clear, practical guidance for people without a clinical background.
  • Relationship building: earns the trust of clients, advisors and colleagues and follows through.
  • Analytical thinking: uses data to find patterns, test assumptions and recommend action.
  • Communication: confident writer and presenter with internal teams, employers and advisors.
  • Discretion: handles sensitive health information with care and confidentiality.
  • Collaboration: works across Connecting with Care, Service, Client Success and Client Development and keeps everyone informed.

What we Offer:

  • Flexible remote work environment
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) plus all federal holidays off
  • Comprehensive benefits package with health, dental, vision insurance group term life, short term disability, long term disability and voluntary life plans. Numerous supplemental plans to assist employees.
  • Paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave benefits.
  • Cancer Experts Now - supplemental plan
  • 401(k) retirement plan with matching contributions.
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment.
  • Opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing company dedicated to making a difference in the lives of families.

Travel:

  • Up to 25% travel per year for client meetings, stewardship meetings and conferences.

Velera is the nation’s premier payments credit union service organization (CUSO) and an integrated fintech solutions provider. The company serves more than 4,000 financial institutions throughout North America, operating with velocity to help our clients keep pace with the rapid momentum of change and fuel growth in the new era of financial services. Our purpose: We accelerate partners’ success through innovative financial technology solutions and inspired service.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a talented Strategic Consultant who will provide specialized strategic consulting services to financial services executives to assist them in offering competitive products, services, solutions and experiences that will optimize their growth, financial returns, operational efficiency and member/customer satisfaction.The individual delivers strategic solutions, financial services expertise and strategies that financial institutions can leverage to achieve their business goals, capitalize on opportunities and solve problems.This is be done via thought leadership, data-driven analysis, articulating past experience, and delivering creative strategic recommendations.

Day in the Life:

  • Lead and execute­ consulting engagements across the Velera client ecosystem, from initiation to conclusion.
  • Interact efficiently, proactively and responsively with staff and senior/executive leaders, both internally and externally.
  • Develop recommendations and influence senior/executive leaders to make appropriate business and investment decisions based on those recommendations. Recognize unique differences in management philosophy and culture of each client.
  • Exercise discretion & sound judgement and interact effectively/professionally with all levels of personnel, clients and vendor partners.
  • Lead comprehensive research and analysis of client product/service or operational performance covering aspects of specialty consulting area of expertise – including product design, pricing, marketing, sales effectiveness, account management, operations, risk management, P&L performance, benchmarking, analytics, digital and mobile solutions, marketplace infrastructure, third-party software interfaces, etc.
  • Generate analyses / outputs as needed to analyze and benchmark potential product and portfolio management opportunities to improve growth, revenue, efficiency and profitability.
  • Provide direction to internal teams with respect to all faces of area of specialized consulting expertise.
  • Responsibility for all aspects of each engagement including, but not limited to: negotiating scope, terms and price through a Statement of Work, data collection, analysis, client meetings, presentation preparation & delivery and post-mortem survey analysis.
  • Maintain in-depth knowledge of trends and developments within the financial services industry.
  • Deliver on thought leadership opportunities through blogs, white papers, speaking engagements, digital media (e.g., video, website and social media) and other outlets.
  • Provide strategic expertise internally for division and corporate projects and strategic client sales and retention efforts, as needed.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Statistics or equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Master’s degree preferred.

  • Seven (7) years of experience in professional roles involving strategic consultation, strategy development, guidance, education or providing strategic recommendations for improvement, directed toward financial institution executives.

  • Seven (7) years of direct departmental and/or product line P&L responsibility in a bank or credit union including financial forecasting, budget development & accountability, product delivery & enhancements and marketing.

About Velera

At Velera, inclusion isn’t an initiative – it’s how we work. Guided by a people‑helping‑people philosophy, we cultivate a culture where every employee feels valued, respected and empowered to do their best work. We’re committed to building a diverse workforce and fostering meaningful connection across our teams. Through a remote‑first, flexible environment, we prioritize psychological safety, wellbeing and belonging so individuals and teams can collaborate to thrive. Together, we’re shaping a new era of secure, innovative solutions for the clients and communities we serve. Learn more about what it’s like to work at Velera.
