jobs.description:
When joining PerkinElmer, you select an experienced and trusted leader in scientific solutions, with the support of a global service network and distribution centers, providing the right solution, at the right time, to meet critical customer needs. With over an 80+ year legacy of advancing science and a mission of innovating for a healthier world, our dedicated team collaborates closely with commercial, government, academic and healthcare customers to deliver our broad portfolio of analytical solutions, and OneSource services.

Job Title

Data Analyst


Location(s)

India - Remote

Job Description

We are looking for OneSource Data Analyst to ensure customer and PerkinElmer data is complete, accurate, and accessible. The Data Analyst duties include collaborating with other data professionals to extract data figures, creating reports based on their findings, and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) to determine business initiatives’ success.

Job Responsibilities:

    • Interpret data, analyze results using statistical techniques and provide ongoing reports.
    • Use data collection systems, data analytics and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and quality.
    • Acquire data from primary or secondary data sources and maintain databases/data systems.
    • Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets.
    • Filter and “clean” data by reviewing computer reports, printouts, and performance indicators to locate and correct code problems.
    • Work with management to prioritize business and information needs.
    • Locate and define new process improvement opportunities.

Basic Qualifications:

    • Technical expertise regarding data models, data mining and segmentation techniques, data cleaning.
    • Knowledge of and experience with reporting packages, databases (SQL etc), ETL frameworks.
    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
    • Adept at queries, report writing and presenting findings.
    • Very good English – minimum B2/C1 level (written & spoken).

Preferred Qualifications & Experience:

    • Proven working experience as a Data Analyst or Business Data Analyst.
    • Experience with Data Visualization Software, preferably Power BI.
    • Proficient in use of SAP or similar ERP systems.
    • Experience in ETL or other similar software.
    • Previous experience in a service organization.
    • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
    • Proven operational ability to visualize, identify steps and implement processes.
    • Exhibits strong bias for action and a results orientation, tackling tough problems with firm deadlines and championing positive change.

jobs.description:
Champions Do More

JOB PURPOSE: The ATE – Remote Service Technician Lead provides day-to-day technical guidance and operational support to Remote Service Technicians to ensure the timely and effective delivery of vehicle diagnostic and technical support services. Serving as a primary technical resource, this role assists with complex service requests, troubleshooting, and promoting consistent service quality and productivity.

This position partners closely with the Manager of Remote Service to identify operational trends, communicate technician feedback, recommend process improvements, and support overall operational effectiveness. The role also collaborates with internal teams to enhance technical processes, service capabilities, and the customer experience. This is a non-supervisory position that provides technical leadership and guidance without direct people management responsibilities.

Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day technical guidance, support, and assistance to Remote Service Technicians, promoting consistent service quality, productivity, and adherence to established processes.
  • Serve as a technical resource for complex diagnostic and programming issues, assisting technicians with troubleshooting, problem resolution, and service-related escalations.
  • Provide expert technical advice and perform vehicle diagnostic and technical support services for technicians and customers through telephone and supported equipment.
  • Monitor day-to-day service activity and identify recurring technical issues, workflow challenges, and opportunities to improve service delivery and operational efficiency.
  • Communicate technician feedback, performance observations, operational trends, and recommendations for improvement to the Manager of Remote Service.
  • Support technician onboarding, knowledge sharing, and ongoing technical development by providing guidance, training, and assistance with established procedures and best practices.
  • Consistently meet or exceed established productivity and service quality benchmarks while supporting timely and efficient resolution of service requests.
  • Maintain a high level of customer satisfaction by communicating effectively, addressing service concerns, and resolving issues promptly and professionally.
  • Accurately document services performed, technical resolutions, and customer interactions in designated systems.
  • Promote first-time resolution of service requests by collaborating with technicians to identify effective diagnostic and technical solutions.
  • Assist the Manager of Remote Service with technician scheduling and workload coordination by providing input on service demand, customer trends, and operational needs.
  • Collaborate with technicians, software development teams, and other internal stakeholders to identify opportunities to enhance products, systems, processes, and service capabilities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • 2+ years of experience in automotive diagnostics, vehicle repair, remote technical support, or a related technical field, including experience with automotive diagnostic scanning tools.
  • Strong knowledge of automotive diagnostic procedures, troubleshooting techniques, and vehicle systems.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance, share knowledge, and support the development of other technicians.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365.
  • Strong customer service skills with the ability to address and resolve technical and service-related concerns.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical information clearly to technicians and customers.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • OE/Dealer-level diagnostic and programming experience.
  • Experience with pre- and post-repair vehicle scanning and OEM diagnostic tools.
  • Relevant industry certifications, including ASE, I-CAR, MECP, ALLDATA or equivalent technical credentials.
  • Experience or education in collision repair or automotive technology.
  • Previous experience providing technical guidance, training, or peer support in an automotive service environment.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish is a plus.

Benefits

The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements and annual updates:

  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Group Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance
  • 401k Retirement Plan with match
  • Referral Bonus (“Cash From Crash”)
  • 5 Paid Holidays

We are committed to providing competitive compensation for this role. The actual offer will be based on various factors, including but not limited to: job related knowledge, skills, experience, relevant certifications and qualifications.

 

The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

Assistant Director, Student Success

Office of Student Success

Grade 2.1, Exempt

Location: Remote


University of Maryland Global Campus (UMGC) seeks an Assistant Director, Student Success in the Office of Student Affairs. Reporting to the Director of Student Success, the Assistant Director will be responsible for closely collaborating with the Director to provide hiring, training, supervision and coaching up to 12 Success Coaches. The Success Coach empowers students on their UMGC journey by listening, guiding, motivating, and celebrating the student’s success from the point of enrollment through graduation. Intentional, targeting outreach allows the Success Coach to co-create with the student an academic plan, provide the right resources at the right time, connect them to the University community and motivate them to achieve their goals. Success Coaches will provide concierge level support to an assigned population of students through multi-channel student engagement including inbound and outbound calls, texts, virtual advising appointments, and emails to students to ensure they are on a path to successfully matriculate to their desired credential. The Assistant Director is responsible for the overall success of the team under their leadership including training and development of Success Coaches, adherence to early academic outreach, case management, and the successful matriculation of qualified new and returning students. Other areas of responsibility include quality assurance, performance management, workforce management, and business process design and implementation.


SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE:

  • Facilitate training and skill development of new Success Coaches with the training team as well as current team members by conducting role plays, mock calls, live shadowing, observations of recorded calls and effective team meetings
  • Demonstrate the delivery of consistent, constructive and performance enhancing coaching feedback based on observations conducted and by conducting and documenting regular assessments that provide specific, affirmative feedback on quality and knowledge of institution, program, administrative and admissions policies.
  • Conduct monthly performance coaching sessions with each direct report to develop a nimble and collaborative team that nurtures trust, accountability, and a shared vision for outstanding service to new and returning students from the point of application through graduation through inbound and outbound calls, SMS, chat, virtual advising appointments, and emails to students to ensure they are on a path to successfully matriculate to their desired credential
  • Develop, communicate, and execute operational strategies to set and achieve team and unit goals on a daily, weekly, monthly basis to ensure new and returning student growth targets are met
  • Develop the team to provide best-in-class service using a consultative approach
  • Manage daily operations by tracking workforce metrics such as call volumes, phone queues, service levels, task completion, schedule adherence and other workforce metrics and taking action to address performance gaps, prioritize work or adjusting staff scheduling, as needed
  • Provide input and feedback on both strategic and operational projects and their impact on the day-to-day operations of front-line staff activities and the student population
  • Collaborate with Director to execute outreach activities and stitch in campaigns in support of student retention and re-engagement, on-boarding, student success and successful student matriculation to their desired credential so that enrollment growth and retention targets are met
  • Handle calls from students who wish to speak to a supervisor for any reason at any time without hesitation.
  • Seek to provide same day resolution for any escalated issue with a commitment to uncovering unspoken needs and eliminating both real and perceived barriers for every student in every situation
  • Maintain a consistent, positive, and motivating presence to champion organizational and departmental change to enhance student service and team performance
  • Motivate, develop, and recognize team members in order to develop succession planning, empower team members to take on special projects, improve employee engagement and reduce regrettable turnover
  • Actively participates in virtual phone screening and interviewing to ensure effective hiring and selection of new team members
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned

DUTY STATEMENTS:

  • Employees that live within 50 miles of the University are required to work university commencement
  • Employees are required to work some evening and weekend hours
  • Employees may be required to work certain holiday hours based on business need

REQUIREMENTS FOR 100% REMOTE ROLE:

  • Equipment shall be provided by the successful hire.
  • UMGC will provide necessary office supplies, a laptop, monitor, and headset.
  • Network communication to non-public UMGC online information technology services and data shall be made only using the UMGC Virtual Private Network (VPN) to ensure data is transmitted through encrypted channels and proper authentication.
  • All computing equipment that is used, whether purchased by UMGC or the individual, must be connected to broadband internet through an Ethernet connection.
  • All computing equipment that is used must be connected to broadband internet with upload and download speeds of at least 25MBPS. You must also hardwire your laptop to the router through an ethernet connection.
  • Candidates may not perform personal business during scheduled work hours except for non-work time, such as scheduled breaks.

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • At least one year of successful leadership or at least one year of demonstrated proficiency in guidance, instruction, direction to a group or project within a service delivery organization or contact center
  • The selected candidate must have the ability to prioritize and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment while motivating others
  • Candidate must possess superior organizational and communication skills including the development of presentations and business proposals. In addition, the candidate must demonstrate: a strong understanding of management and leadership characteristics, the ability to successfully lead a diverse team
  • Candidate must be extremely well organized and analytical with an ability to work well under pressure
  • Must be flexible and agile in responding to evolving business priorities

PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Master’s degree from a regionally accredited institution of higher learning
  • Successful track record of leading teams with a collaborative leadership style; ability to coach, mentor, and develop others
  • Experience working with military or veteran personnel, preferably in a higher education environment
  • Proven track record of leveraging data and metrics to meet or exceed business goals and objectives
  • Experience in the areas of enrollment management, student recruitment, and quality assurance
  • Experience leveraging CRM, contact center, and other enterprise-wide business technologies is also preferred

All submissions should include a cover letter and resume.

The University of Maryland Global Campus (UMGC) is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal and state laws regarding nondiscrimination. UMGC is committed to a policy of equal opportunity for all persons and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, age, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, disability, religion, ancestry, political affiliation or veteran status in employment, educational programs and activities, and admissions.

Workplace Accommodations:

The University of Maryland Global Campus Global Campus (UMGC) is committed to creating and maintaining a welcoming and inclusive working environment for people of all abilities. UMGC is dedicated to the principle that no qualified individual with a disability shall, based on disability, be excluded from participation in or be denied the benefits of the services, programs, or activities of the University, or be subjected to discrimination. For information about UMGC’s Reasonable Workplace Accommodation Policy or to request an accommodation, applicants/candidates can contact Employee Accommodations via email .

Benefits Package Highlights:

  • Generous Time Off: Enjoy 22 days of paid vacation, 15 days of sick leave, 3 personal days, and 16 paid holidays (17 during general election years). For part-time employees, time off rates will be prorated based on the number of hours worked.

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Access to health care, medical with vision, dental, and prescription plans for both individuals and families, effective from the 1st of the month following your hire date.

  • Flexible Spending Accounts: Available for medical and dependent care expenses.

  • Retirement Plans: Choose between the Optional Retirement Program (ORP) or the Maryland State Retirement and Pension System (MSRPS).

  • Supplemental Retirement Plans: include 401(k), 403(b), 457(b), and various Roth options. The university does not provide matching funds.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

We Care Solar is an award-winning U.S. nonprofit organization dedicated to strengthening health care and education in under-resourced countries by improving access to clean, reliable electricity. Since 2010, We Care Solar has designed and delivered compact, durable solar electric systems to energy-deficient health centers and schools, replacing candles and kerosene lanterns with bright, efficient LED lights and power for essential devices.

Solar for Healthcare: We Care Solar has worked with more than 75 partners across 50 countries, installing reliable solar power at more than 10,000 health facilities, supporting more than 23 million mothers and newborns to date. The We Care Solar Suitcase® is a compact solar electric system for medical lighting, mobile communication, and essential medical devices. Our Light Every Birth initiative is transforming maternal health care at the national level in select countries in Africa.

Solar for Education: Our hands-on STEM education program empowers students to learn about solar as a solution to local and global energy access challenges while gaining skills in engineering, electricity, and problem-solving, while assembling specialized Solar Suitcase Learning Kits. We Share Solar’s largest programs are in the United States, notably Minnesota, California, Illinois, and Florida. We have run STEM education programs in East Africa with a goal of expanding this program to African countries aligned with our Light Every Birth programming.

We Care Solar’s work has earned global recognition for advancing reliable solar electricity in healthcare and education. Recent honors include selection as an awardee of Pivotal Ventures’ 2025 Action for Women’s Health, as well as the Lifetime Achievement Award from the Africa Solar Industry Association for co-founder Dr. Laura Stachel. The organization is also a recipient of the Zayed Sustainability Prize and the UNFCCC Momentum for Change Award, and has been featured by leading global media, including The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, CNN, and BBC World News.

We are a mission-focused organization and team that likes to have fun while doing serious work. Our team includes global staff from seven of our priority countries in Africa and U.S.-based staff across seven states. Many of our team members have been with We Care Solar for more than five years. We are extremely committed to providing a positive and flexible work environment (virtually and in-person) while ensuring that we are able to deliver cost-effective programs with high impact.

About the Opportunity:

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on People leader to help strengthen and scale our People function. This role will play a key part in advancing People priorities, building and improving core systems and processes, and partnering with leaders across the organization to support performance and a strong employee experience.

As the first People leader in this role, you will have the opportunity to shape and implement the foundational people practices while building on existing efforts. This is an ideal role for someone who thrives in evolving environments, enjoys creating structure and improving systems, and can balance thoughtful planning with practical, day-to-day execution.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States, reporting to the Managing Director. The role works in close partnership with the Director of Operations, ensuring organizational and operational alignment while maintaining a distinct focus outside of the core Operations team.

Responsibilities:

People Strategy & Infrastructure

  • Conduct a current-state assessment of HR systems, policies, and organizational needs
  • Define and execute a cohesive People strategy that strengthens systems, policies, and processes while enabling scalable and effective organizational growth
  • Establish data-driven practices to evaluate effectiveness and improve People programs

Workforce Planning & Talent Lifecycle

  • Build on and evolve existing talent systems across hiring, onboarding, and performance management to create a more aligned, scalable, and effective framework
  • Lead workforce planning and organizational design efforts in partnership with leadership
  • Build and manage processes that strengthen accountability, performance, and team effectiveness

People Operations & Total Rewards

  • Oversee day-to-day People Operations, systems, and platforms to ensure efficiency and a strong employee experience
  • Manage benefits and insurance programs, including vendor coordination and employee support
  • Ensure smooth execution of core People Operations across the employee lifecycle

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Establish a proactive compliance and risk management framework that ensures adherence to applicable laws and minimizes organizational exposure across the employee lifecycle
  • Maintain compliant People policies, practices, and documentation
  • Ensure adherence to applicable employment laws and regulations across multiple U.S. and international geographies
  • Proactively identify and mitigate people-related risks
  • Provide sound judgment and leadership on employee relations and sensitive matters

Culture, Employee Experience & Engagement

  • Foster and strengthen a positive, inclusive, and collaborative culture
  • Lead employee engagement and learning initiatives, building on existing efforts
  • Design and continuously improve the employee experience in alignment with mission and values
  • Partner with department leaders and senior leadership to embed values into everyday practices, leadership behaviors, decisions, and team dynamics

Key Qualifications:

  • Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business, or related field

Location: Cape Town, South Africa
Employment Type: 12-Month Fixed-Term Contract
Working Arrangement: Fully Remote

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior Software Engineer to develop and enhance software applications and intelligent engineering systems across a variety of technically challenging projects.

This role combines full-stack software development, Python backend services, AWS cloud infrastructure and systems integration, with opportunities to work on real-time video, computer vision and AI-enabled applications.

You will be responsible for taking software solutions from initial concept and rapid prototyping through to proof of concept, MVP development and production deployment.

Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, including software engineers, data scientists and technical specialists, you will contribute to the development of scalable, reliable and maintainable software solutions.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, working across different technologies and taking ownership of projects from development through to delivery.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a technically strong, versatile and solutions-driven Senior Software Engineer who is comfortable working across the full software development lifecycle.

You should enjoy building software that solves real-world problems, rather than simply developing features in isolation. The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable developing frontend applications, building backend services, working with cloud infrastructure and integrating different technologies.

You will thrive in this role if you are proactive, adaptable and capable of making sound technical decisions independently. You should also have a strong sense of ownership, excellent attention to detail and a practical approach to balancing development speed with software quality, security and maintainability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of end-to-end software development, from initial requirements and prototyping through to the delivery of robust, production-ready solutions.
  • Collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to understand business and operational requirements, define priorities and translate these into practical development tasks.
  • Design and implement scalable software architectures, considering performance, security, cost, reliability and long-term maintainability.
  • Develop and maintain full-stack applications, including frontend interfaces, backend services, APIs and data integrations.
  • Build and integrate software solutions with external applications, data workflows and connected systems.
  • Develop, test, debug and deploy software applications, ensuring reliability and performance in real-world environments.
  • Investigate technical issues, troubleshoot system failures and implement improvements to optimise application performance.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical documentation and the development of reusable software components.
  • Support and mentor other developers where appropriate, promoting best practices and high-quality engineering standards.
  • Communicate project progress, technical decisions and potential risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Work independently, respond to feedback and take accountability for the quality and successful delivery of software solutions.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with Python and Django, including developing maintainable applications, backend services and APIs.
  • Proven production experience with React, TypeScript and Node.js, including modern frontend development and JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Practical experience with PyQt for developing desktop or engineering-focused applications.
  • Experience working with AWS, including application hosting, configuration, monitoring and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency with Docker and containerised application development.
  • Strong understanding of modern software development practices, including Git, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines and code reviews.
  • Experience designing and implementing scalable software architectures and integrating different systems and technologies.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to resolve complex technical challenges.
  • Ability to work independently, manage technical priorities and take ownership of software delivery.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with multidisciplinary and remote teams.

Advantageous Skills & Experience

  • Experience with video streaming, encoding and computer vision technologies, including RTSP, FFmpeg, OpenCV, PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Exposure to object detection, image classification, multi-object tracking, state machines or real-time decision-making systems.
  • Experience integrating software with cameras, sensors, PTZ equipment, ONVIF, hardware SDKs or embedded systems.
  • Knowledge of Linux environments, infrastructure as code, observability, edge deployment or GPU acceleration.
  • Experience with performance-sensitive development using C++ or C#.
  • Understanding of user-centred interface design, accessible data visualisation and modern design systems.
  • Experience collaborating with UI/UX designers to develop intuitive and functional applications.
  • Exposure to simulation or virtual environments, including Unreal Engine 5 (UE5), for prototyping or technical validation.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics or a closely related technical field from a recognised university.
  • Significant professional experience in software engineering, ideally within a senior development or technical delivery role.
  • Proven experience delivering software applications from initial development through to production deployment.
  • Based in Cape Town, South Africa, or willing to relocate.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with international teams and stakeholders.
  • Available for a 12-month fixed-term contract.

jobs.excerpt: Overview At SCA Health, we believe health care is about people – the patients we serve, the physicians we support and the teammates who push us forward.
jobs.description:
Overview

At SCA Health, we believe health care is about people – the patients we serve, the physicians we support and the teammates who push us forward. Behind every successful facility, procedure or innovation is a team of 15,000+ professionals working together, learning from each other and living out the mission, vision and values that define our organization.

As part of Optum, SCA Health is redefining specialty care by developing more accessible, patient-centered practice solutions for a network of more than 370 ambulatory surgical centers, over 400 specialty physician practice clinics and numerous labs and surgical hospitals. Our work spans a broad spectrum of services, all designed to support physicians, health systems and employers in delivering efficient, value-based care to patients without compromising quality or autonomy.

What sets SCA Health apart isn’t just what we do, it’s how we do it. Each decision we make is rooted in seven core values:

  • Clinical quality
  • Integrity
  • Service excellence
  • Teamwork
  • Accountability
  • Continuous improvement
  • Inclusion

Our values aren’t empty words – they inform our attitudes, actions and culture. At SCA Health, your work directly impacts patients, physicians and communities. Here, you’ll find opportunities to build your career alongside a team that values your expertise, invests in your success, and shares a common mission to care for patients, serve physicians and improve health care in America.

At SCA Health, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your health, well-being, and financial future. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k plan with company match, paid time off, life and disability insurance, and more. Please visit, to learn more about our benefits.

Your ideas should inspire change. If you join our team, they will.


Responsibilities

SCA Health is modernizing the technology platforms and engineering practices that support care delivery, enterprise operations and growth across a large, distributed specialty-care network. The VP, Platform & Engineering is the executive leader accountable for turning that ambition into reliable, secure and scalable digital capability.
Reporting directly to the CIO, this role replaces the legacy Enterprise Application Services leadership model with an integrated Platform & Engineering function. The mandate spans custom application engineering, enterprise application platforms, integration and API delivery, quality engineering, DevSecOps, platform reliability and the modernization of the application estate. The role will create a consistent engineering operating model across internal teams and strategic partners, while strengthening SCA Health ownership of architecture execution, delivery outcomes and service performance.
This is an enterprise transformation role leading established teams and platforms. The mandate is to modernize the application estate, automate the software delivery lifecycle, embed AI across engineering and support, strengthen platform ownership and improve reliability while sustaining the clinical and operational services on which SCA Health depends. The leader will accelerate change without compromising operational continuity, clinical workflows, security, or regulatory obligations.
Success requires a leader who can transform mature teams and inherited platforms, connect product priorities to engineering execution, and convert modernization, automation and AI ambitions into measurable improvements in speed, quality, reliability, cost and business value. The leader must work effectively within SCA Health’s hybrid operating model with Optum and build durable partnerships with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Product, Data & AI and business leaders.

Core Accountabilities

  • Facilitate data integration between legacy patient accounting system and supply ordering system to allow calculation of cost per case
  • Engineering Strategy & Operating Model. Define and execute the multi-year platform and engineering strategy. Establish one operating model for intake, architecture readiness, capacity planning, delivery, release management, reliability, lifecycle management and measurable value realization across SCA and partner teams.
  • Application Engineering & Modernization. Lead the design, development, modernization, and support of custom applications. Embed human-centered design and modern UX/UI practices into application engineering to create intuitive, consistent experiences that reduce friction for teammates and other users. Reduce technical debt, improve interoperability and move the estate toward cloud-native, API-driven and supportable patterns, with explicit decisions to invest, modernize, replace, consolidate or retire.
  • Platform Simplification & Rationalization. Continuously simplify the technology estate by reducing duplication, unnecessary customization, redundant platforms, unsupported technologies and complex integration patterns. Drive standardization, consolidation and reuse wherever practical while balancing business flexibility, speed and long-term maintainability.
  • Enterprise Application Platforms. Own engineering, lifecycle and support outcomes for shared enterprise application platforms including PeopleSoft, ServiceNow, Salesforce, SharePoint, HST, integration services and custom-developed applications. Ensure platforms remain business-aligned, secure, reliable, supportable, upgradeable and financially sustainable, with clear accountability for technical roadmaps, platform and application support, engineering delivery, technical debt and service performance.
  • Cloud Engineering & Migration. Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Cloud Operations & Engineering to deliver SCA Health's cloud strategy for the application portfolio. Own application readiness for migration and modernization, including application dependency mapping, refactor/re-platform decisions, testing and performance validation, and business cutover and recovery coordination. Cloud Operations & Engineering owns the cloud platform, landing zones, infrastructure as code, environment automation and cloud operations.
  • Integration, APIs & Interoperability. Build a governed integration engineering capability aligned to enterprise architecture standards. Increase reuse, reduce point-to-point complexity and enable dependable exchange across clinical, operational, financial and partner ecosystems using appropriate API, event, file and healthcare interoperability patterns.
  • DevSecOps, AI-Enabled Engineering & Developer Experience. Own secure software delivery practices for application engineering teams, including source control standards, build and release practices, automated code quality and security scanning, test automation within pipelines, and engineering documentation. Partner with Cloud Operations & Engineering, which owns the shared CI/CD and DevSecOps tooling platforms and environment provisioning, and with Cybersecurity on control requirements. Create an effective, compliant developer experience and lead the responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering capabilities including coding assistants, code generation and review, intelligent testing, documentation automation, engineering copilots and agent-based workflows. In partnership with Data & AI and Cybersecurity, evaluate and govern enterprise tools and platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI/ChatGPT and Anthropic Claude, as well as future approved capabilities, with appropriate security, privacy, intellectual property, regulatory and human-oversight controls.
  • Quality Engineering & Test Automation. Make quality an embedded engineering responsibility. Expand automated functional, regression, performance, security and resilience testing; define production-readiness gates; and ensure releases are validated against real workflows, representative volumes and critical dependencies.
  • Platform Reliability, Support & Service Ownership. Establish end-to-end technical ownership for critical platforms and applications across engineering, platform and application support, reliability and service performance. Define service tiers, SLOs, observability, incident and problem management, capacity management, disaster recovery and corrective-action follow-through. Ensure platforms operate within established enterprise standards for product lifecycle, patching, vulnerability remediation, identity and access management, data retention, privacy and protection of regulated data, including HIPAA/PHI requirements, in partnership with Cybersecurity, Data & AI, Privacy and Infrastructure. Ensure support models provide clear escalation paths, effective knowledge management and accountability for recurring issues while shifting the organization from reactive support to engineered reliability.
  • Portfolio, Financial & Vendor Accountability. Own the Platform & Engineering portfolio, workforce and budget. Establish disciplined governance across SCA Health's extensive portfolio of third-party software and technology services, including performance, service levels, cost, lifecycle, risk, renewals and rationalization. Create transparent unit-cost, capacity, delivery and vendor-performance views; make disciplined build, buy and partner decisions; and hold internal and external teams accountable for outcomes, not activity. Partner with Product on vendor decisions affecting product strategy, capabilities and user experience. Drive strong financial stewardship through technology rationalization, vendor optimization, workforce planning, cloud-consumption management, licensing optimization and total cost of ownership reduction.
  • Talent, Culture & Capability Building. Build and develop a high-performing, globally distributed engineering organization. Establish a strategic workforce model that deliberately balances teammates, contractors, onshore and offshore capabilities to provide the right skills, capacity, cost structure and access to talent required to accelerate business value. Establish clear career paths, modern engineering expectations, succession depth, and a culture of accountability, learning, simplicity, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years in software engineering, enterprise applications or platform technology, including 5+ years leading at VP or equivalent enterprise scope.
  • Demonstrated success transforming an established platform and engineering organization in a complex, distributed enterprise, including modernization, automation, operating-model change and adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices.
  • Leadership experience across custom application development, enterprise SaaS/platform engineering, integration, DevSecOps, quality engineering and production support.
  • Proven record modernizing legacy applications and migrating workloads to public cloud while protecting availability, performance, security and business continuity.
  • Experience establishing measurable engineering performance, service reliability and portfolio governance using outcome, flow, quality, risk and cost metrics.
  • Proven experience leading and optimizing blended technology workforces across teammates, contractors, onshore and offshore delivery partners, software and platform vendors, and specialized service providers, balancing capability, cost, speed, scalability, service performance and knowledge retention.
  • Healthcare technology experience, including HIPAA-regulated environments, clinical or revenue-cycle workflows, and high-availability operational systems.
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder leadership skills, including the ability to explain architectural trade-offs, delivery risk and investment choices in clear business terms.

Preferred Experience:

  • Ambulatory surgery, specialty practice, acute care or other multi-site care-delivery experience.
  • Enterprise platform experience with ServiceNow, Salesforce, Microsoft 365/SharePoint, PeopleSoft, custom-developed applications, and comparable ERP, CRM, workflow, healthcare and collaboration platforms.
  • Modern Microsoft/Azure engineering experience, including cloud application platforms, containers or serverless services, infrastructure as code and automated delivery pipelines.
  • Healthcare integration experience with HL7 v2, FHIR R4, APIs, interface engines and clinical/financial data exchange.
  • Experience rationalizing a large application portfolio using lifecycle, business criticality, technical health, cost and risk data.
  • Experience leading large-scale application rationalization, platform consolidation, technology simplification and cost-optimization initiatives while improving business outcomes and service reliability.
  • Experience leading acquisition integration and separating or integrating platforms in complex partnership or joint-venture environments.
  • Demonstrated success evaluating, deploying, scaling and governing enterprise AI engineering tools and platforms, such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI/ChatGPT, Anthropic Claude, code-generation assistants, intelligent testing platforms and AI-enabled operational tooling, with measurable adoption, productivity, quality or service improvements and appropriate governance for security, privacy, intellectual property and regulatory risk. • Experience operating in a highly matrixed organization where platform ownership, standards, funding and execution authority span multiple enterprises.

Technical Depth Expected:

  • Modern engineering. Architectural fluency across APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, modular monoliths, modern web frameworks, automated testing and secure software supply chains.
  • Cloud and platform engineering. Working knowledge of Azure application and integration services, containers, serverless patterns, infrastructure as code, environment automation, observability and resilience engineering.
  • Enterprise Platforms & Application Engineering. Ability to govern configuration versus customization, upgrades, technical debt, integrations and service ownership across major SaaS platforms and custom-developed applications.
  • AI-Enabled Engineering. Working knowledge of AI-assisted software development, intelligent testing, engineering copilots, agent-based automation, AI-enabled application support, prompt and context engineering, model and tool governance, and the operational controls required for responsible enterprise adoption. Maintains sufficient market fluency to assess Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI/ChatGPT, Anthropic Claude and emerging alternatives without creating dependence on a single vendor or model.
  • DevSecOps. Strong command of source control, CI/CD, policy-as-code, software composition analysis, secrets and identity, release controls, developer tooling and engineering telemetry.
  • Reliability and operations. Experience with service tiers, SLOs/SLIs, monitoring, incident and problem management, performance engineering, capacity, backup, recovery and operational readiness.
  • Engineering economics. Ability to connect architecture and delivery choices to total cost of ownership, capacity, consumption, licensing, vendor spend and measurable business value.

Leadership Profile:

  • Balances transformation urgency with operational discipline — modernizes inherited teams and platforms aggressively without destabilizing care delivery or business operations.
  • Creates clarity from ambiguity — defines ownership, decision rights, standards and measurable outcomes where legacy boundaries are unclear.
  • Biases toward simplicity. Continuously challenges organizational and technical complexity. Prefers scalable, supportable and economically efficient solutions over unnecessary customization, fragmentation or technology proliferation.
  • Partners authentically with Product — challenges constructively, protects engineering sustainability and remains accountable for delivery commitments.
  • Works effectively across organizational boundaries — manages Optum dependencies and vendor relationships without outsourcing SCA Health accountability.
  • Makes technical debt, risk, capacity and trade-offs visible early; does not rely on heroics or allow surprises to become the operating model.
  • Builds an engineering culture grounded in quality, security, reliability, simplicity, learning and direct feedback.
  • Equally credible with engineers, clinicians, operators and executives; translates technical complexity into decisions and business consequences.
  • Attracts and develops strong leaders and technical talent, builds succession depth and creates a career destination for engineers at SCA Health.

Measures of Success:

  • Improved reliability, maintainability and recoverability of critical enterprise platforms and custom-developed applications, with service ownership and operating measures established for the highest-priority services.
  • Faster, more predictable delivery through increased automation, improved flow, stronger quality, fewer escaped defects and less unplanned work.
  • Measurable reduction in application portfolio complexity, technical debt, duplicated capability, unsupported technology, unnecessary customization, manual processes and point-to-point integration risk, with a corresponding reduction in total cost of ownership.
  • Cloud migration and modernization milestones achieved with validated performance, security, dependency and recovery outcomes.
  • Measurable adoption and value realization from AI-assisted engineering and intelligent operations, with transparent reporting on productivity, quality, risk, cost and teammate adoption.
  • Improved financial transparency and engineering economics through visibility into platform costs, cloud consumption, licensing, vendor spend, delivery costs and realized business value.
  • Improved teammate and user experience through consistent human-centered design and UX/UI practices, with measurable reductions in friction across priority applications and workflows.
  • Improved vendor and technology-services performance through stronger governance, rationalization, service-level accountability, lifecycle management and cost optimization.
  • A more flexible and economically efficient engineering workforce model that improves access to critical skills and capacity while strengthening delivery speed and knowledge retention.
  • A durable partnership model across Product, Architecture, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Optum and business stakeholders.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About Monte Carlo Monte Carlo is the agent trust platform that autonomously observes, fixes, and continuously improves agents and the data that powers them — so enterprises can scale trust at the speed of AI.
jobs.description:
About Monte Carlo

Monte Carlo is the agent trust platform that autonomously observes, fixes, and continuously improves agents and the data that powers them — so enterprises can scale trust at the speed of AI. Bayes, our AI teammate, does the work: detecting, triaging, troubleshooting, and fixing issues in AI agents and the data powering them. The result is self-improving agents that get better with every fix instead of drifting. More than 400 enterprises, including Amazon, PepsiCo, CNN, Nasdaq, and JetBlue, rely on Monte Carlo. Learn more at montecarlo.ai.

The Role

We're building the products that tell enterprises whether their AI agents can be trusted — and we need someone who works end to end, from an ambiguous problem statement through research, prototyping, and production. You'd get the problem, not the spec: research the approaches, prototype, prove what works, build it, and integrate it into the platform alongside our engineering and data science teams. This role exists because agent observability moved from roadmap to revenue faster than anyone predicted, and the work is now on the critical path.

What You'll Do

  • Take an open problem end-to-end — from research and prototyping through production, killing what doesn't work before it becomes someone's roadmap
  • Design and ship agent-powered features — root-cause analysis, incident triage, monitor generation — and integrate them into the platform with our engineering team
  • Build the eval infrastructure that makes those features safe to change: golden datasets, regression suites, offline and online scoring, and the judgment calls about what "good" means
  • Own retrieval and context pipelines over customer metadata, lineage, and query history, and instrument agent behavior in production — traces, failure taxonomies, cost and latency budgets — to close the loop on quality
  • Partner with data science on detection quality and experiment design, and with PM on what an agent should do versus what it merely can do
  • Set the technical bar for how we build with LLMs — patterns, guardrails, and the internal tooling other engineers reuse

What We're Looking For

  • You've built agents in production with real users. Not integrated a framework. Not worked on a team that had one. Built them — agents with real autonomy and internal loops, where the model uses tools and decides what to do next without a human in the middle, and you kept them running once real users showed up. RAG with a wrapper doesn't count. Neither does a set of MCP tools point at an API.
  • You've run evals and monitored agents after launch. Agents are non-deterministic, so normal tests don't work on them. You've owned an eval framework — golden datasets, regression suites, offline and online scoring — not a folder of one-off scripts. And you've watched agents in production, not just in dev.
  • Python, plus an ML or data science background. Python is your daily language and you're solid on the backend, though you don't need to be a distributed systems specialist. You understand models well enough to reason about how they behave — you're not an application engineer calling someone else's API.
  • 3+ years in ML, data science, or software engineering — at companies that ship quickly. Startups, AI-native teams, or high-growth product companies where the release cadence is measured in weeks, not quarters. If all of your experience sits inside large, process-heavy organizations with the platform already built for you, this seat will be a hard adjustment.
  • You work from a problem, not a spec. Handed an ambiguous problem statement, you design the experiment, build the smallest version to test it, and take what works into production.
  • You use AI tools every day. Claude or its equivalents are part of how you write code and do research, not something you tried once. This is backend and model layer work, by the way — no frontend.
  • You'd rather ship than polish. Most of this work needs a good answer quickly, not a perfect one eventually. You can tell which problems are the exception and deserve real depth — and you'll say no to the version that demos well and falls apart in production.
  • Nice to have: statistics and hypothesis testing, applied rather than theoretical. Building and maintaining MCP servers. Experience in the data and cloud space — Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, Airflow.

This Is Not For You If

  • Your AI work is retrieval with a wrapper, or MCP tools pointed at an API — nothing that decides and acts on its own
  • Your LLM experience is prototypes, notebooks, and demos that never carried production traffic
  • You need a fully specified problem before you start, or you're uncomfortable with the ambiguity of a category being invented in real time

Why Monte Carlo

  • We created the data observability category, and we're doing it again with agent trust — you'll build where the market is forming, not where it's settled
  • Series D, $236M raised, backed by Accel, Redpoint, Notable Capital, ICONIQ Growth, and Salesforce Ventures
  • Customers include HubSpot, Fox, Nasdaq, Toast, and Mercado Libre — your work ships to enterprises with real stakes
  • Snowflake Partner of the Year and a verified connector in Anthropic's Claude AI directory
  • Remote-first by design since day one, and recognized as a Best Workplace for it
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and a remote-first environment.

jobs.title: Product Testing Lead
jobs.excerpt: At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality.
jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

We pair journalism with original research: every “best of” list we publish sits on a dataset our own team has collected, scored and can defend line by line.

The Data Research and Product Testing teams own that evidence base. We decide what gets measured, how it gets weighted, and whether a claim survives scrutiny. It is the difference between an opinion piece and a recommendation a reader can act on.

About the Role

You will stand up and run Forbes Advisor's product testing function in the US: two testers reporting to you and a protocol library that is currently being developed across teams. The function tests Health categories hands-on, commissions third-party lab work where a claim cannot be settled by testing alone, runs selective Finserv product testing, and also covers a wide set of SMB and related digital products and services. Its output feeds directly into the Data Research scoring models.

What you'll own as the lead

  • Develop and manage the protocol library: what gets tested, how, to what tolerance, and what invalidates a run. Version-control it and make it reproducible by someone who was not there.
  • Line manage the two Product Testers: objectives, feedback, growth, workload and performance.
  • Own the supplier relationships, including the recommendation on what we buy outright and what we are willing to accept from a manufacturer.
  • Own the third-party lab relationships: select the labs, scope the assay panels, agree turnaround and hold them to it. This is how we get the evidence we cannot generate ourselves.
  • Interpret complex lab data and interrogate it rather than file it. Ask the awkward questions, push back when a result looks thin, and satisfy yourself that the lab has understood what we actually need rather than only what we literally asked for.
  • Own the chain-of-custody and blind-submission policy, so that a lab result still stands up when a manufacturer disputes it.
  • Operate the editorial independence policy in practice. You are the person who says no when a supplied unit comes with conditions attached.
  • Own the testing calendar against the editorial roadmap, and be honest about throughput rather than promising everything.
  • Partner with the Senior Data Research Analysts so that test scores enter the scoring models correctly, including how to resolve a hands-on result that contradicts the published specification.

The hands-on work you'll still do

  • Run hands-on tests to a written protocol and record the results in a structured, comparable form.
  • Help design those protocols: decide what to measure, how to measure it repeatably, and what would make a result invalid.
  • Run selective Finserv product testing yourself, on budgeting apps and similar, where living with the product tells you considerably more than the feature list does.
  • Own the sample pipeline for your categories: sourcing, receipt, logging, retention, return and disposal.
  • Document testing as you go, so the editorial team can show readers the work rather than assert it.
  • Feed test scores into the Data Research scoring models, and flag loudly when a hands-on result contradicts what the spec sheet claims.
  • Re-test on a defined cadence so published verdicts do not quietly go stale as products and plans change.
  • Write findings up clearly enough for an editor to build an article on, and stand behind them as the person who ran the test. Telling a story in a way the Edit team can use the information is vital.
  • Bring a journalistic eye to what the results are actually saying. The strongest findings are usually the uncomfortable ones: that a category is largely nonsense, that the premium option is no better than something half the price, that readers are being sold a problem they do not have. Spot those angles and take them to editorial rather than waiting to be asked.
  • Keep the testing log auditable: who tested what, when, on which version or plan tier, under what conditions.

What the function covers

  • Some examples rather than the full list. The set is considerably wider than this, and it moves.
  • Health, hands-on: medical alert systems and hearing aids.
  • Health, by third-party lab: supplement assays for label-claim potency, contaminants and banned substances, plus accuracy validation against reference instruments where we cannot measure it ourselves.
  • Finserv, selectively: budgeting apps and similar, where the experience of using the product is the thing worth reporting.
  • Digital services: SMB software including accounting, payroll, CRM and website builders; tax software; banking and investing apps; insurance quote journeys; telehealth and therapy platforms.

About you

  • Around 10 years in product testing, QA, consumer reviews, lab operations or a comparable evidence-generating function, with ownership of test methodology across a meaningful part of it.
  • 3+ years managing testers or a comparable team. You will be managing two people from day one, and we expect you to raise the standard of their work rather than simply allocate it.
  • Demonstrable experience building test plans and test strategies from nothing, rather than executing someone else's. We will ask you to walk us through one in detail.
  • Experience setting up something that did not exist before. This is a build and a job at the same time: you will be testing from day one while designing the function around it, not disappearing for six months to write process.
  • A clear view of how to make a test repeatable across two different testers working in two different places. That is the central methodological problem of this function.
  • The judgement to open a new category well: what it takes to test properly, what instruments it needs, and when the honest answer is that we should not cover it yet.
  • Experience commissioning third-party lab work: scoping an assay, reading a certificate of analysis, and knowing the difference between a result that is significant and one that sits inside the method's margin of error.
  • A journalistic instinct for which findings are worth publishing, and the confidence to argue for them with editors who did not commission them.
  • Comfortable holding an independence line with commercial colleagues, politely and repeatedly.
  • Rigorous by instinct. You control variables without being told to, and you notice when a result is too good to be true.
  • Confident in Excel: you will be building and filling structured scoring sheets every week.
  • You can write. Findings that nobody can read do not help an editor.
  • Genuinely detail-obsessed: you investigate the outlier before you publish it, not after a reader emails in.
  • Comfortable saying a product is bad, in writing, with evidence, when the commercial wind is blowing the other way.

Nice to have

  • Prior work in a testing lab, QA function, consumer reviews outlet or product team.
  • Comfort with measurement instrumentation: sound meters, power meters, thermal probes, timers.
  • Photography or video skills good enough that the images are publishable.

Overview

Ogletree Deakins’ Knowledge and Innovation (“K&I”) department has an opportunity for a highly skilled and motivated Manager to join the K&I Premium Services team. K&I Premium Services provides operational, data, technology, and program management support to attorney teams and clients across a portfolio of large scale client programs. As a Manager, you will lead a team within an assigned program workstream and play a critical role in overseeing and optimizing operations, process, projects and program initiatives. This position will use tools and technologies with an eye toward innovative, data focused and process driven solutions that supply value to our clients.

This position will work closely with shareholders, attorney teams, members of the K&I team, our IT Department and other administrative departments.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with team members to establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics.
  • Monitor workstream performance using case, ticket, and task data from systems such as Salesforce and Smartsheet, and report on volume, trends, and bottlenecks.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of analysts, program specialists, operational staff and/or data support staff.
  • Develop and implement effective employee management strategies, including performance evaluation, training and development programs, and conflict resolution to enhance workforce productivity and satisfaction.
  • Identify areas for process optimization and improvement. Implement solutions to enhance departmental efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Delegates with clarity, assigning work based on skills and capacity while holding team members accountable for results.
  • Adapts quickly when priorities change, rebalancing workload and keeping the team and stakeholders aligned.
  • Provide input on staffing and capacity, including workload analysis that supports headcount planning.
  • Facilitate effective meetings by preparing agendas, coordinating schedules, and ensuring productive discussions. Capture accurate, comprehensive meeting notes, action items, and decisions, and distribute them promptly to relevant stakeholders.
  • Track department action items/tasks and follow up, ensuring accountability and timely completion of action items and deliverable deadlines
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation of processes, procedures, and project milestones. Ensure that resources are clear, organized and easily accessible and usable by the team.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, attorneys, and other stakeholders to define program requirements, gather necessary resources, and foster effective communication throughout all program initiatives.
  • Identify potential risks and develop strategies to mitigate them, ensuring that program initiatives are delivered within scope, on time, and within budget.
  • Protect client confidentiality and privileged information, and escalate matters that require attorney or Senior Manager judgment.
  • Support change management for new tools, process changes, and program launches, including training, communication, and tracking of adoption.
  • Monitor program functions and deliverables, track key metrics, and prepare regular status reports to update the Senior Manager and/or stakeholders on milestones, accomplishments, and challenges.

    • Participates in hiring, onboarding, and training of team members

Qualifications

  • Ability to exercise good business judgment and make well reasoned independent decisions.
  • 3+ years working in professional services, preferably a law firm.
  • Accountable, self driven, highly motivated, and innovative.
  • Problem solving mentality, experience using internal and/or external resources, conflict resolution and follow through.
  • Ability to manage time effectively to meet critical deadlines.
  • Ability to remain calm under pressure.
  • Familiarity with Project Management techniques as well as completing and interpreting project related documentation.

Technical Experience:

  • Proficient in Microsoft applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint, and the document management system.
  • Experience with Salesforce or a comparable case management or CRM platform, including building reports and dashboards.
  • Familiarity with Power BI or similar reporting tools, and with workflow automation tools such as Power Automate, preferred.
  • Exceptional computer and technical skills with a demonstrated aptitude for learning new technologies quickly.
  • Experience with or knowledge of Smartsheet, iManage, and other systems commonly used in law firms strongly preferred.

General:

  • Analytical: Excellent critical thinking, organizational, analytical, problem solving, and technical skills with the ability to manage and coordinate multiple work streams simultaneously.
  • Research: Gathers data, analyzes information, and recommends solutions skillfully.

jobs.description:
Overview

SENIOR LOGISTICIAN (EOIR 2026-26533):

Bowhead seeks a Senior Logistician to join our team at the Naval Surface Warfare Center – Crane Division (NSWC-Crane). The Logistician will provide support for current Electro-Optic Infrared (EO/IR) projects and assist in managing Innovation efforts across Crane. This position offers remote work availability, with occasional on-site visits as needed. The Logistician must have exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills, and must be an expert user of Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook. Proficiency in Microsoft Access is also crucial for reviewing feasibility and implementing recommendations.

Responsibilities

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in US Navy logistics and naval provisioning, demonstrating a comprehensive understanding of maritime supply chain networks, fleet readiness, and lifecycle asset management. You will be responsible for orchestrating the end-to-end requisition, distribution, and replenishment of critical parts, ordnance, and materiel across surface, subsurface, or aviation platforms in strict accordance with Naval Supply Systems Command (NAVSUP) directives. A successful track record of maximizing operational availability, managing vendor timelines, and maintaining absolute inventory accuracy within maritime and joint-service systems is essential. We are looking for a high-performing professional who can navigate complex maritime logistics constraints to ensure naval forces are rapidly and securely equipped to sustain mission capability.

Essential functions will include:

  • Establish and assist in the planning, developing, coordinating, defending and executing all aspects of the PEO/PMs’ Life Cycle Logistics support under the processes of DoD acquisition and sustainment.
  • Participate in the research, comment, review, editing and publication of project documentation deliverables (e.g. Technical Reference Manuals, Procedures, System Operation & Maintenance Manuals, Training System Support Documentation) in accordance with Data Item Descriptions, Technical Manual Contract Requirements (TMCR), and/or S1000D XML specifications.
  • Familiar with Model Based Product Support (MBPS) and Technical Data Manager (TDM) roles/responsibilities including document number assignment.
  • Collects, compiles, analyzes, investigates, researches, or applies logistics, maintenance, acquisition, or financial data and information.
  • Develops, modifies, prepares, or validates documentation in relation to automated logistics or maintenance data reporting systems, and management information systems.
  • Facilitate, plan and support meetings required for the management and execution of Innovation efforts
  • Establish priorities, research, and provide analysis reports, provide synopses of meetings and develop/deliver presentations.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in related field with fifteen (15) years of experience providing logistics support at the Program Office level. Experience should be relevant to the DoD acquisition process including providing full product life cycle support guidance to the business / program office.
  • Desired expertise in earned value management, resource management, and quantification/analysis of risk
  • Advanced level skills in Microsoft Office software suite - Word, Excel, Outlook, Access, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of employees and outside contacts.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and good judgment with the ability to work alone or as part of a team.

Target salary range for this position is $90,000 to $120,000 annually based on qualifications and experience

Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to stand, sit and walk for prolonged amounts of time
  • Must be able to twist, bend and squat periodically
  • Must be able to lift 15 to 25 pounds

SECURITY CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS: Must be able to obtain a security clearance at the Secret level, however candidates with an active Secret clearance are highly encouraged to apply. US Citizenship is a requirement for Secret clearance at this location.

Please note that the salary information is a general guideline only. Bowhead considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, as well as, market and business considerations when extending an offer.
