jobs.excerpt: Overview LMI is seeking HCD Assessment Practitioners to support a prospective VA OSP operational improvement program, contingent upon contract award.
jobs.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking HCD Assessment Practitioners to support a prospective VA OSP operational improvement program, contingent upon contract award. These remote positions apply human-centered discovery methods and a government-approved assessment rubric to understand grantee capacity, implementation maturity, and barriers to effective delivery.

Working under the HCD / Magnify™ Lead, practitioners will facilitate discovery sessions, analyze organizational evidence, conduct initial and recurring assessments, and document findings that inform capacity improvement pathways. Rubric and assessment-framework development will be coordinated with designated subcontractor specialists; this role focuses on consistent field application and feedback on the approved tools.

This full-time practitioner works with fellow assessment staff and designated specialists. Strong candidates pair empathetic, structured discovery with reliable qualitative analysis, traceability, and practical recommendations for program leadership.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct human-centered discovery through interviews, document review, workshops, journey maps, and workflow mapping with VA OSP-designated participants.
  • Apply government-approved assessment domains, evidence rules, maturity criteria, and rubrics consistently across assigned grantees.
  • Review program narratives, workforce information, processes, data-collection practices, outreach activities, and other relevant grantee evidence.
  • Document strengths, implementation gaps, operational constraints, data limitations, and recommended capacity-building priorities.
  • Facilitate structured consensus discussions and validate preliminary findings with authorized stakeholders.
  • Maintain assessment notes, evidence trails, decision points, and rationale sufficient for repeatable reviews and quality assurance.
  • Translate assessment outcomes into clear inputs for individual capacity improvement plans and portfolio-wide learning.
  • Support periodic reassessment and verification of whether recommended actions improved the targeted implementation conditions.
  • Coordinate with the Magnify lead and designated framework/rubric specialists on tool usability, evidence interpretation, and controlled updates.
  • Partner with business analysts, evaluation and public-health specialists, and data staff to integrate findings across workstreams.
  • Observe approved privacy, accessibility, secure-information-handling, and respectful stakeholder-engagement practices.
  • Prepare tailored interview guides, discussion protocols, document checklists, and evidence logs for assigned VA-approved assessment engagements.
  • Use disciplined note-taking and qualitative coding to identify recurring patterns while preserving differences among participant experiences and organizational contexts.
  • Document the evidence supporting each maturity observation, clearly identify missing or contradictory information, and flag items requiring specialist review.
  • Facilitate respectful, accessible virtual discovery sessions with staff and community partners; use trauma-informed communication appropriate for sensitive public-health topics.
  • Contribute concise assessment narratives, illustrative workflow maps, and practical improvement recommendations that can be reviewed and reassessed over time.
  • Report observed rubric ambiguities and user-experience issues to the Magnify lead and designated subcontractor framework specialists without unilaterally changing approved criteria.
  • Tailor approved discovery instruments to each assignment while preserving the common assessment domains, consistent evidence standards, and comparability requirements established by the lead.
  • Identify the specific operational interactions behind observed friction, including role handoffs, onboarding steps, reporting burden, referral workflows, and points where staff need additional guidance.
  • Produce structured synthesis artifacts such as affinity maps, stakeholder needs statements, annotated workflows, and concise evidence summaries that enable peer review and traceability.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in design research, human factors, social sciences, public administration, organizational development, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of applied human-centered design, user research, qualitative assessment, service design, or process-improvement experience.
  • Experience facilitating stakeholder interviews and workshops, developing workflow maps, and synthesizing documentary or qualitative evidence.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply structured assessment rubrics consistently and support defensible, traceable findings.
  • Strong writing skills, attention to evidence quality, and the ability to communicate implementation gaps without reducing complex organizations to simplistic scores.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and collaborative qualitative research or process-mapping tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound professional judgment, and ability to work effectively with federal stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust suitability determination; must meet applicable federal/VA background, security, privacy, training, and system-access requirements.
  • Working knowledge of qualitative research planning, semi-structured interviewing, stakeholder mapping, thematic coding, and synthesis of mixed documentary evidence.
  • Hands-on skill with journey mapping, service blueprints or workflow visualization, virtual facilitation, and structured evidence repositories.
  • Ability to distinguish direct observations from inference and apply rubric guidance consistently across varied organizations and programs.
  • Familiarity with accessible digital facilitation, privacy-conscious interview notes, and quality checks for documentation shared with federal stakeholders.
  • Practical ability to plan and document research sessions consistently, including stakeholder-specific guides, careful notes, synthesis tags, and defensible links between evidence and conclusions.
  • Experience adapting virtual facilitation for participants with different familiarity with digital tools and varied organizational capacity, while maintaining respectful and inclusive engagement.

Desired:

  • Experience performing capacity, maturity, readiness, or organizational assessments across diverse grantee or service-delivery settings.
  • Highly desirable: Prior stakeholder research or assessment delivery on VA OSP/VHA, Veteran-serving, or comparable VA programs.
  • Highly desirable: Hands-on grantee management support, including grant-recipient interviews, evidence collection, self-assessment facilitation, and assessment documentation.
  • Familiarity with HSI, Magnify™/HPA methods, implementation science, or continuous-improvement frameworks.
  • Experience facilitating remote groups and documenting Section 508-conscious assessment materials.
  • Certified Usability Analyst (CUA), an established UX research certificate, Lean Six Sigma Yellow/Green Belt, or comparable methodological training.
  • Experience using approved qualitative analysis and collaboration tools such as NVivo, Dovetail, Miro, Mural, or similar platforms.
  • Experience supporting evaluation readiness, implementation-maturity assessment, or public-health improvement while maintaining clear boundaries from clinical care.
  • Training in ethical applied research, qualitative coding, trauma-informed engagement, accessibility-aware facilitation, or participatory service design.
  • Exposure to evaluating whether process improvements changed employee or grantee experience, information flow, or the usability of operational tools.

Target Salary Range: $88,000 - $125,000

Disclaimer:

Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Lesley University's Department of Liberal Arts seeks a highly qualified adjunct faculty member to teach: CHIST 3322 — Black in America: Then Spring 2027 Term I; This course is taught remotely and asynchronously.


Course Description

The African American experience spans over four hundred years. For centuries, people of African descent in the United States have worked to help the nation realize its ideals of freedom and democracy, particularly since these ideals have been tied to their own status as free citizens. This course examines the shifting meanings of "freedom" and "democracy" for African Americans from the establishment of European colonies and the transatlantic slave trade to the present day in the age of Black Lives Matter. Topics covered include: slavery; the Civil War and Reconstruction; Jim Crow politics; the Great Migration; diaspora, nationalism, and internationalism; the long black freedom struggle and movements for civil rights; radicalism, feminist organizing, and Black Power; ghettoization and the prison industrial complex; and contemporary black politics since 1970.

A successful candidate will have:

  • PhD or terminal degree (required)

Given an evolving national context and the rapid change in the demographic profile of our country, the University has made a significant commitment to addressing and enhancing its campus climate and diversity capabilities as an institution.

At Lesley University we strive for a supportive and equitable environment where people -- regardless of race, ethnicity, color, sex, physical ability, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, neurodiversity, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, veteran or military status, membership in uniformed services, and all other categories protected by applicable state and federal laws -- can participate equally and fully as their true selves in all aspects of university life. jobs.excerpt: Watchtower Security is the nation's leading provider of all-inclusive, fully managed video surveillance solutions, exclusively dedicated to the multifamily housing industry.
jobs.description:
Watchtower Security is the nation's leading provider of all-inclusive, fully managed video surveillance solutions, exclusively dedicated to the multifamily housing industry. For over two decades, we have partnered with property management groups across the nation, empowering them to provide peace of mind to their communities.

As a rapidly growing and dynamic organization, we pride ourselves on a fast-paced, collaborative environment where innovation, critical thinking, and a commitment to excellence drive our success. We are seeking passionate individuals eager to contribute to a team that values strong communication, attention to detail, and a shared dedication to making a tangible difference in multi-family communities.

Watchtower Security LLC is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to a respectful and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application process and employment, as required by law. Please contact Human Resources to request assistance.

We are actively seeking a results-oriented Regional Sales Manager to drive new client acquisition and expand market share within a designated territory. This role is pivotal in identifying new opportunities, nurturing prospective clients, and managing the entire sales lifecycle from initial engagement and property assessment to proposal delivery and closing new business. The ideal candidate will be a proactive self-starter with a proven ability to build strong relationships, navigate complex sales processes, and represent Watchtower Security as an industry leader. This position requires significant travel, active participation in trade shows, and involvement with relevant industry associations.

This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship. Watchtower Security LLC does not sponsor applicants for work visas.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Sales Generation & Management:
    • Proactively identify, source, and develop new leads through prospecting, networking, and strategic outreach initiatives.
    • Execute comprehensive sales strategies using various methods (in-person meetings, virtual presentations, demonstrations) to achieve and exceed sales targets consistently.
    • Conduct thorough property assessments, both virtually and on-site, to understand client needs and propose tailored surveillance solutions.
    • Develop and deliver compelling proposals and presentations to prospective clients, effectively articulating Watchtower Security's value proposition.
    • Manage the full sales cycle from initial contact and negotiation to contract close.
  • Territory & Relationship Management:
    • Travel extensively within the assigned region for client meetings and strategic relationship building.
    • Actively represent Watchtower Security at trade shows, Apartment Association events, and other key industry functions, including after-hours participation. This includes engaging with attendees, presenting solutions, generating qualified leads, and fostering strategic partnerships.
    • Foster and maintain strong relationships with key community stakeholders, including law enforcement, property managers, and apartment associations, to support community safety initiatives and drive brand awareness.
    • Serve as a primary point of contact for client inquiries, interpreting concerns and collaborating with internal departments to ensure timely and effective resolutions.
  • CRM & Reporting:
    • Accurately enter, track, and maintain all lead and client information within the CRM system (ConnectWise).
    • Provide consistent and meaningful client and prospect communication via email and other channels.
    • Submit weekly sales performance reports and forecasts to the sales leadership team.
  • Professional Development:
    • Engage in ongoing sales training, technical education, and continuous development of industry knowledge to remain a trusted advisor.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Experience & Education:
    • 3-5 years of proven business-to-business sales experience, preferably within the multifamily housing or security/technology industry.
    • Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting and exceeding sales targets.
    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent applicable professional experience preferred.
  • Sales & Communication Expertise:
    • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex solutions clearly and persuasively.
    • Strong negotiation and closing skills, built on a foundation of trust, transparency, and ethical business practices.
    • Analytical skills with the ability to interpret market data and client needs to formulate strategic sales approaches.
  • Technical & Tools Proficiency:
    • Proficiency with CRM software (ConnectWise experience is a significant plus).
    • Competency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace.

Working Conditions & Expectations:

  • Ability to travel significantly within the assigned territory.
  • Flexibility for after-hours attendance at industry events and client functions.
  • Standard business hours, with additional time necessary as required to meet business objectives.

For this position, Watchtower Security will review your motor vehicle driving record. If you express interest in and are considered for this position, you’ll be asked to authorize our review of that record.

jobs.excerpt: We are knowmad mood!  Somos una compañía líder en transformación digital, en constante evolución y a la vanguardia de la tecnología.
jobs.description:
We are knowmad mood!

Somos una compañía líder en transformación digital, en constante evolución y a la vanguardia de la tecnología.

Formado por más de 3.000 personas creativas, digitales e innovadoras conectadas a un propósito y capaces de generar conexiones con personas de todo el mundo. Un equipo responsable, flexible y con alta capacidad de adaptación a las necesidades de nuestros clientes y del mercado, a la vez que proporciona valor, visión, creatividad, expertise, profesionalidad y pasión por la tecnología en cada proyecto.

Los valores que marcan nuestro rumbo y nos guían hacia la excelencia son la colaboración, la innovación, el compromiso, la diversión y la conﬁanza.

Únete a nuestro equipo como 💻AI ARCHITECT 💻 para un importante cliente del sector bancario.

¿Cuál será tu misión en el proyecto?

Diseñar y evolucionar la plataforma de IA corporativa como producto que habilite a los equipos a construir, desplegar y operar capacidades de IA y sistemas agénticos de forma autónoma, segura y trazable, sobre el ecosistema híbrido de la entidad. El ámbito cubre la capa de acceso y mediación a modelos, el gobierno de su uso y su coste, la integración de la IA en el ciclo de vida del desarrollo mediante entornos de ejecución agénticos (harness) y el diseño de los controles que hacen ese uso auditable y conforme al marco regulatorio. El rol abarca tanto el diseño como la construcción de la plataforma y acompaña el producto a lo largo de toda su vida.

Requisitos mínimos

• Experiencia en roles de arquitectura técnica, habitualmente a partir de 5 años en su dominio de especialización.

• Experiencia demostrada y profunda en al menos uno de los entornos del ecosistema corporativo: on-prem (Kubernetes on-prem, VMware) o cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP), con comprensión del modelo híbrido.

• Diseño e implantación de plataformas de IA de autoservicio: mediación de acceso a modelos (AI gateway), credenciales, enrutado, cuotas y control de coste.

• Arquitectura de sistemas agénticos: orquestación, gestión de contexto, integración de herramientas (MCP, function calling) y patrones RAG.

• Harness engineering: diseño del entorno de ejecución de los agentes (contexto, herramientas, aislamiento, permisos y verificación) para que su resultado sea repetible y revisable.

• Gobierno de modelos: ciclo de vida de modelos aprobados, criterios de selección, evaluación de calidad y trazabilidad del uso.

• Seguridad específica de IA: prompt injection, fuga de datos y aislamiento de la ejecución de agentes.

• Observabilidad y control de coste sobre el uso de modelos y agentes.

• Integración de la IA en el SSDLC: pipelines CI/CD, IaC y ejecución de agentes en Kubernetes.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

  • Horario flexible ⏰: horario flexible entrada 8.30h salida 18h con viernes intensivo de 8h a 15h y en verano (julio y agosto) intensivo de 8h a 15h

  • Vacaciones 🌴: 22 días de vacaciones + 2 días de libre disposición, además de los días 24 y 31 de diciembre libres.

  • Contrato indefinido 📄: Desde el primer día, con opción de 12 o 14 pagas.

  • Retribución flexible 💳: Tarjeta restaurante, cheque guardería, seguro médico, formación y otros beneficios con ventajas fiscales.

  • Club de ventajas 🎁: Descuentos en tecnología, ocio y formación.

  • Formación continua 📚: Acceso a Udemy Business, cursos de idiomas, certificaciones oficiales y formación técnica.

  • Plan de carrera 🚀: Acompañamiento para crecer, especializarte o asumir nuevos retos.

  • Conciliación +VIDA 👨 👩 👧 👦: Asistencia personal y familiar 24/7.

  • Ambiente inclusivo 🌍: Entorno diverso y multicultural.

  • Eventos sociales 🎮: Actividades para conectar con el equipo.

jobs.excerpt: Overview The Global Program Manager is responsible for the operational and administrative functions of the global programs supported by Premium Services, meaning all programs outside the United States and Canada, including Europe and other global locations.
jobs.description:
Overview

The Global Program Manager is responsible for the operational and administrative functions of the global programs supported by Premium Services, meaning all programs outside the United States and Canada, including Europe and other global locations. This is an individual contributor position and does not manage direct reports. The position supports the Firm’s internal legal teams, the external client, and partner firms, and serves as their primary operational point of contact for the programs.

The Global Program Manager collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to provide subject matter expertise on program and process improvement, and drives efforts to improve and standardize program development and project delivery for the global programs. Premium Services provides operational, data, technology, and program management support to the shareholder, client and attorney teams. This position works closely with Premium Services managers, senior managers, and project management, as well as the Firm’s IT and other administrative departments.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and drive the execution of global program services and offerings outside the United States and Canada, including new projects and client solutions, ensuring a prioritized approach.
  • Own day-to-day delivery for each assigned program across countries and time zones, tracking deadlines, dependencies, and deliverables through completion.
  • Serve as primary liaison and point of contact for administrative, reporting, invoicing and other needs from internal legal teams, partner firms, local Ogletree teams, program management, and the client.
  • Support partner firms with onboarding, reporting, and administrative requirements, and keep them informed of program expectations and changes.
  • Respond to client inquiries regarding credentials and general program and administrative or operational information.
  • Monitor program performance using case, ticket, and task data from systems such as Salesforce and Smartsheet, and report on volume, trends, and bottlenecks.
  • Prepare regular status and metrics reports for internal legal teams, the client, and Premium Services leadership, tailored to the audience.
  • Proactively assess and propose process improvements to existing services and offerings.
  • Think out of the box to develop new tools, processes, or procedures.
  • Recommend and participate in developing and documenting standardized practices, procedures, and tools to be maintained or implemented uniformly for the EU and global programs.
  • Create and maintain standard operating procedures, process guides, and job aids for the global programs, and keep them current, organized, and easy for the team to use.
  • Facilitate training webinars, and produce client communications including direct email campaigns and newsletters, making sure they are accurate, timely, and reviewed by the appropriate people before release.
  • Assist in opening adverse matters and retainer matters across all programs.
  • Assist in billing functions as required, including tracking and reconciling program billing data in Smartsheet and similar tools.
  • Identify risks and issues early, protect client confidentiality and privileged information, and escalate matters that require attorney or Premium Services leadership judgment.
  • Support change management for new tools, process changes, and program launches, including training, communication, and tracking of adoption.
  • Share leading practices and cross-train with other Premium Services team members.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Specific Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience managing programs and projects in a law firm, professional services organization, consulting firm, or related area.
  • Experience working with internal and external stakeholders, including partner organizations, across locations and time zones.
  • Experience collaborating and influencing stakeholders at various levels.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; ability to present to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to exercise good business judgment and make well reasoned independent decisions.
  • Ability to manage time effectively to meet critical deadlines.
  • Familiarity with project management techniques as well as completing and interpreting project related documentation.
  • Experience supporting matter intake, billing, or client reporting processes preferred.

Technical Experience

  • Proficient in Microsoft applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint, and the document management system.
  • Experience with or knowledge of Salesforce or a comparable case management or CRM platform, including building reports and dashboards, required.
  • Experience with Smartsheet, data analytics tools, required.
  • Experience with Mailchimp, LMS, and VMS preferred.
  • Familiarity with Power BI or similar reporting tools, and with workflow automation tools such as Power Automate, required.
  • Exceptional computer and technical skills with a demonstrated aptitude for learning new technologies quickly.

General Experience

  • Candidate should possess excellent critical thinking skills, strong analytical and problem solving skills, and enjoy working in a team oriented, fast paced environment.
  • Problem Solving Skills: Gathers data, analyzes information, and recommends solutions skillfully
  • Communication: Listens actively and seeks clarification, when needed. Responds to inquiries quickly, with professionalism and tact. Writes clearly and informatively. Edits work for errors.
  • Customer Service: High level of responsiveness; must be able to respond quickly and effectively to questions and requests from all levels, both internally and externally.
  • Independence: Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a cross functional team. Ability to self-start and take the appropriate initiative daily. Self motivated and independent, able to work with a minimum of supervision.
  • Attention to detail: Ability to pay close attention to detail, occasionally for prolonged periods of time and under restrictive deadlines, and complete assignments logically and accurately
  • Team Player: Proactive mindset with strong communication and moderation skills to align internal and external stakeholders.
  • Global mindset: Works effectively with colleagues, partner firms, and clients across countries, languages, and time zones.
  • Initiative: Takes independent actions and reasonable risks; Asks for and offers help when needed.
  • Dependability: Follows through on commitments. Willing to commit to additional hours, when necessary, to reach Firm objectives.
  • Responsibility: Good steward of the Firm’s systems, data and information, ability to maintain confidentiality. Embraces diversity and inclusion of thought.
  • Analytical: Strong organizational, analytical, problem solving, and technical skills with the ability to manage and coordinate multiple work streams simultaneously.

jobs.excerpt: #RunwiththePack At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk.
jobs.description:
#RunwiththePack


At Arctic Wolf, we’re on a mission to end cyber risk.


We are a global leader in security operations, helping organizations stay resilient against evolving cyber threats through industry-leading security operations, threat intelligence, and a people-first approach to cybersecurity.


More than 3,000 Pack members across the world work together every day to protect our customers and empower security teams with new levels of speed, accuracy, and intelligence at scale. What sets us apart is our relentless focus on our customers, innovation at scale, and a collaborative culture where talented people can do meaningful work that truly makes a difference.


We’re constantly looking for talented people to join the Pack and help us take our performance to the next level.

About the Position:

The Principal Incident Response Forensic Analyst is the most technically adept member of the Digital Forensics and Incident Response (“DFIR”) team. This individual is responsible for engaging in the most complex intrusion cases, furthering the team’s technical capabilities through identification of novel analysis techniques and subsequent documentation, development of internal DFIR tools and capabilities, and mentorship of junior analysts in technical matters. The principal understands the nuances of working with both clients and external legal counsel and is expected to be able to lead engagements from start to finish.


Primary Responsibilities and Duties

Technical Competencies

  • Conduct and/or manage incident response investigations for organizations that have suffered an attack from targeted threats, such as Advanced Persistent Threats, Organized Crime, and politically motivated groups, or from commodity threats such as ransomware groups.
  • Perform host forensic analysis on Windows, Linux, and Mac OS based systems.
  • Perform network analysis using a variety of tools and log sources to include firewall logs, NetFlow, and logs generated from a variety of network intrusions detection/prevention tools.
  • Conduct forensic acquisition and analysis from Azure, Amazon Web Services (“AWS”), and Google Cloud Platform (“GCP”) environments.
  • Leverage applicable tooling to contain and eradicate a threat actor’s presence from a client’s network when responding to live intrusion events.
  • Understand the capabilities of malicious binaries and scripts through static analysis, dynamic analysis, and reverse engineering efforts.
  • Make tactical and strategic recommendations for compromised client organizations.

Communication and Client Management

  • Communicate both executive and detailed level findings in verbal and written form; Present technical findings in a manner that assists external legal counsel in understanding potential regulatory implications.
  • Communicate all items relevant to the engagement to include recovery plans, findings implications, and threat actor negotiations, in a manner that deescalates situations and presents a coherent strategy moving forward.
  • Scope and lead new cases when needed.

Leadership and Initiatives

  • Spearhead the development and documentation of new tools and analysis techniques; Stays current with developments within the DFIR field.
  • Partner with internal teams to publish blogs regarding threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (“TTP), vulnerabilities,
  • Mentor junior analysts on all technical matters
  • Provide thought leadership and conduct research within the DFIR field that drives business initiatives.

General

  • Participate in weekday escalation and weekend/holiday on call schedules.
  • Conduct audits and peer review of incident reports.
  • Fosters information sharing and collaboration.
  • Work with Arctic Wolf teams to collaborate on threat intelligence and threat research

Key Skills

  • Analysis of disparate forensic artifacts
  • Ability to draw sound conclusions despite gaps or ambiguity with evidence
  • Written and verbal communication
  • Team mentorship and knowledge sharing
  • Minimum Qualifications
  • Five or more years professional experience with digital forensics and incident response or other similar cybersecurity roles
  • Ability to respond to inquiries and work beyond normal business hours, as needed
  • Expert knowledge of host-based forensic, network analysis, and data breach response
  • Expert knowledge of current attack vectors and trends in cybersecurity
  • Ability to identify indicators of compromise (“IOC”) from newly released exploits that have little to no community documentation
  • Malware analysis and reverse engineering
  • Capture and analysis of system memory and other volatile artifacts
  • Expert knowledge of IR and forensic tools, such as Magnet Axiom, Encase, FTK, X-Ways, SIFT, and other open-source forensic tools
  • Expert level experience with commercial Endpoint Detection and Response (“EDR”), network monitoring, and Security Information and Event Management (“SIEM”) tools

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Security, Digital Forensics, Computer Science, or other related field
  • Certifications: GCFA, GCFE, ACE, EnCE, or similar training and certification
  • Prior experience presenting at industry conferences and events
  • Prior experience developing scripts and tools to analyze data

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and providing reasonable accommodations, appropriate support throughout the hiring process and employment, in accordance with applicable local laws. If you require support or adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact .

On Camera Policy

  • To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews.
  • Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers.
  • We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

Benefits


All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including:


  • Equity for all employees
  • Flexible time off and paid volunteer days
  • 401(k) contribution and matching
  • Training and career development programs
  • Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services
  • Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services
  • Fertility support and paid parental leave

Security Requirements 

At Arctic Wolf, protecting our people, customers, and data is fundamental to how we operate. All employees are expected to uphold our commitment to security, privacy, and compliance by following internal information security policies, standards, and controls designed to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of business, customer, employee, and other confidential information and to support compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Depending on the role and where permitted by applicable law, employment may be subject to background verification and additional regulatory, security, or compliance requirements, including obligations related to data protection and export control laws, and authorization requirements where applicable.

Base Salary

The base salary range for this job family is 86,000 to 269,700 USD annually. This range reflects the base pay the company reasonably expects to offer for this position, aligned to the broader job family base pay structure. Actual base pay may vary based on skills, experience, and location, including job family level. In addition to base pay, Arctic Wolf offers variable incentive compensation, new hire equity grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Applications Engineer

About the Role

We are looking for an Applications Engineer to serve as a primary technical resource for customers, helping them understand how Krevera's products and solutions apply to their specific use cases and challenges.

This role sits at the intersection of technical depth and customer communication. You’ll work with customers, sales, product, and engineering teams to translate requirements into technically sound application recommendations, support product evaluations and proof-of-concept work, guide customer onboarding and implementation, and help build clear technical documentation.

What You’ll Own

Technical Application Support

  • Serve as the primary technical resource for customers.
  • Help customers understand how Krevera's products and solutions apply to their specific use cases and challenges.
  • Understand customer environments and map Krevera's products to their needs.

Solution Design & Scoping

  • Work with customers and internal teams to translate requirements into clear, technically sound application recommendations and configurations.
  • Support customers in identifying appropriate solutions for their technical requirements.

Pre-Sales & Post-Sales Engagement

  • Partner with sales and product teams during customer evaluations.
  • Support product demonstrations and proof-of-concept work that builds confidence in Krevera's solutions.
  • Support customers throughout both pre-sales and post-sales engagements.

Customer Onboarding & Implementation Guidance

  • Guide customers through initial setup and deployment.
  • Help ensure customers get up and running correctly and efficiently.

Documentation & Knowledge Building

  • Create and maintain application notes, technical guides, and FAQs.
  • Develop customer-facing written materials that help customers self-serve.
  • Help internal teams communicate product capabilities clearly.

Feedback Loop to Product

  • Capture recurring customer questions, pain points, and feature requests.
  • Relay customer feedback to Krevera's product and engineering teams.
  • Help inform the product roadmap through insights gathered from customer engagements.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Demonstrated experience in an applications engineering, field applications, or systems engineering role, ideally within a technical product company.
  • Strong foundational knowledge in the relevant engineering domain.
  • Ability to understand customer environments and map Krevera's products to their needs.
  • Comfort working at the intersection of technical depth and customer communication.
  • Ability to explain complex concepts clearly to both engineers and non-engineers.
  • Experience supporting or collaborating with sales teams during pre-sales and proof-of-concept cycles.
  • Ability to produce clear technical documentation, application notes, or customer-facing written materials.
  • Based in the United States, with availability to engage during standard US business hours.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You own problems end-to-end: when a customer question comes in, you follow it through to a real answer rather than passing it around.
  • You communicate proactively, keeping customers and internal teammates informed without needing to be prompted.
  • You are comfortable sitting at the edge of what you know and learning on the job, asking good questions, and building expertise quickly in unfamiliar territory.
  • You bring a low-ego, collaborative approach to working across technical and commercial teams.
  • You adapt your communication style to whoever you are working with.

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers receive clear, technically sound guidance for their specific applications and challenges.
  • Customer evaluations, product demonstrations, and proof-of-concept work are well supported.
  • Customers are guided through setup and deployment effectively.
  • Technical documentation helps customers self-serve and reduces repeat questions.
  • Recurring customer feedback, pain points, and feature requests are clearly communicated to product and engineering teams.
  • Customers and internal teams have clear communication throughout active engagements.

Typical Day

Your day moves between customer-facing work and internal collaboration. In the morning you might be on a call with a customer working through a specific application question, then spend time preparing a technical summary for the sales team ahead of a product evaluation later in the week.

You respond to inbound technical inquiries, contribute to documentation that reduces repeat questions, and check in with Krevera's engineering and product teams to stay current on product updates and flag what you are hearing from the field.

The rhythm is a mix of scheduled calls and self-directed work, requiring you to manage your own time and prioritize clearly across active customer engagements.

jobs.description:
The Tidal Financial Group is a leading ETF investment technology platform dedicated to creating, operating, and growing ETFs. We combine expertise and innovative partnership approaches to offer comprehensive, value-generating ETF solutions.

Our platform offers best-in-class strategic guidance, product planning, trust and fund services, legal support, operations support, marketing and research, and sales and distribution services.

About the role

  • Tidal Financial Group is seeking a Backend Software Engineer to build and maintain the trading applications that power our ETF platform. This is a backend-focused role, centered on designing reliable, high-performance systems in C# and .NET 10 that support traders and operations teams.
  • You’ll work closely with frontend, data, and DevOps teams—collaborating on requirements, aligning on interfaces, and helping ensure systems work seamlessly end-to-end. This role plays an important part in delivering tools that are accurate, responsive, and dependable for real-world financial decision-making.
  • We’re looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, communicates clearly, and values building simple, well-designed systems. The ideal candidate brings strong .NET experience along with an interest in financial markets and trading workflows.

What you'll do

  • Design and develop backend services, APIs, and real-time systems for internal trading applications and external-facing client platforms in C# / .NET 10, with a focus on reliability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Build and maintain integrations with Bloomberg using REST, FIX, and Pub/Sub APIs to support trading operations, market data, and transaction reporting workflows.
  • Implement real-time data delivery using SignalR and messaging patterns using Redis for caching, queueing, and pub/sub messaging.
  • Design and query relational data models using Entity Framework Core, LINQ, and PostgreSQL (AWS Aurora), while collaborating with the Data team on shared data needs, including Snowflake.
  • Implement and maintain application security, including SSO for internal applications and appropriate authentication/authorization patterns (OAuth2, OpenID Connect) for external-facing platforms.
  • Partner closely with frontend, data, and DevOps teams to define API contracts, align on requirements, and deliver solutions collaboratively and efficiently.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions, code reviews, and engineering standards, with an emphasis on clarity, simplicity, and long-term scalability.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of backend software engineering experience with a strong focus on C# and modern .NET (.NET 6+, ideally .NET 10).
  • Deep proficiency in the .NET ecosystem, including Entity Framework Core, LINQ, SignalR, and related libraries.
  • Strong experience with PostgreSQL and relational data modeling; comfortable writing and optimizing complex SQL queries.
  • Experience building and securing both internal and external-facing APIs, including SSO integration (Microsoft Entra / Azure AD) and external authentication patterns (OAuth2, OpenID Connect).
  • Experience with Redis for caching, queueing, and pub/sub messaging patterns.
  • Familiarity with gRPC, or openness to adopting it as part of the stack.
  • Proficiency with Git/GitHub and modern development workflows (pull requests, code review, branching strategies).
  • Comfortable using JetBrains Rider or equivalent professional .NET tooling.
  • Experience working in Agile environments, with a collaborative, team-first approach to planning and delivery.
  • Strong communicator who can work effectively across teams, bringing clarity to technical decisions and aligning stakeholders without requiring close oversight.
  • Self-directed and accountable, with the ability to manage priorities and follow through in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Bloomberg integrations using REST, FIX, and Pub/Sub APIs
  • Familiarity with ETF lifecycle concepts—basket creation, order management, NAV calculation, holdings reconciliation, and trade workflows
  • Awareness of AWS compute and infrastructure (ECS/EC2, Lambda, CloudWatch)
  • Familiarity with Snowflake as a data platform
  • Exposure to Next.js or modern frontend frameworks (helpful for cross-team collaboration)
  • Understanding of compliance frameworks such as SOC2
  • Curiosity about financial markets and trading systems, with an interest in how technology supports real-time decision-making

Job Description:

As the Assets Reliability and Process Engineer, you will own the asset reliability strategy across the Americas Retail and Fleet portfolio, focused on improving asset performance and reducing recurring failures over time. You will set reliability and preventive-maintenance priorities, translate portfolio insights into targeted interventions, and connect technical findings to Maintenance, suppliers and Construction & Projects. The role focuses on systemic reliability improvement rather than day-to-day maintenance execution or routine break-fix activity.


Key Accountabilities:


  • Lead the Americas asset reliability strategy and operating framework across Retail and Fleet, defining asset-class priorities and long-term reliability objectives.
  • Define and govern common reliability standards and methods for in-market and BTC teams, including asset criticality, preventive and predictive maintenance optimisation, root-cause analysis, defect elimination and reliability improvement.
  • Lead and develop the Americas Reliability Engineering team, setting priorities, performance expectations and technical-development requirements.
  • Receive and act on BTC portfolio analytics to translate into in-market interventions, equipment selection and capital decisions.
  • Provide technical assurance over reliability practices and outputs, ensuring consistent adoption of agreed standards and driving closure of material quality or capability gaps.
  • Identify and prioritise systemic reliability improvements using asset-performance data, repeat-failure patterns and BTC-generated insights to determine where strategies or interventions should change.
  • Mobilise the appropriate response to reliability findings through Maintenance, suppliers, equipment changes, targeted studies or capital programmes, while execution remains with the relevant delivery owner.
  • Embed reliability and maintainability into asset-lifecycle decisions, ensuring equipment selection, replacement and construction decisions incorporate lessons from portfolio performance.
  • Establish and monitor portfolio reliability performance, assessing whether interventions improve uptime and reduce recurring failures and ensuring learning is reapplied across markets and asset classes.

Requirements:


  • + 10 years of relevant engineering experience, with significant experience in asset reliability, maintenance strategy or equipment-performance improvement.
  • Bachelor's / Master’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Industrial or another relevant Engineering field; CMRP, Chartered Engineer / Professional Engineer or equivalent reliability / engineering accreditation is desirable.
  • Deep knowledge of reliability engineering and maintenance strategy, including preventive/predictive maintenance, repeat-failure elimination and asset-performance improvement.
  • Broad technical understanding across multiple equipment and asset classes, with the ability to diagnose systemic rather than isolated reliability issues.
  • Strong experience using failure data, maintenance history and engineering analysis to identify root causes and define practical interventions.
  • Demonstrated capability applying reliability techniques such as RCA, FMEA, RCM, criticality analysis and PM optimisation.
  • Ability to translate technical findings into maintenance, supplier, equipment-selection or capital-investment actions and influence teams that own execution.

The Senior Business Development & Key Account Manager - EMEA is responsible for winning and growing medium to large, multi-site customers for Tec4med's real-time condition monitoring solutions across EMEA. The role is primarily focused on new business: building qualified pipeline, leading consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing. Once won, the role-holder owns these accounts long term, expanding usage across sites, lanes and products, while continuing to develop new business pipeline.


The position will be responsible for growing our EMEA territory for Tec4med. The role requires a very hands-on approach and an end-to-end ownership of the sales cycle, including lead generation and cold calling.

  • End users / shippers - pharmaceutical, biotech, cell & gene therapy and other owners of highvalue, temperature-sensitive product who acquire the technology directly or specify it to their chosen logistics partners.

  • Channel partners - logistics service providers, packaging and asset-pool providers who resell, integrate or white-label Tec4med within their own offering, with joint go-to-market to their end customers.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES (include but are not limited to)


  • Generate new business and establish strong relationships with clients in the EMEA region, focusing on medium to large, multi-site accounts in the target segments.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline in HubSpot that meets agreed coverage targets, and forecast accurately.
  • Lead consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles  engaging quality / validation, supply chain, logistics, procurement, IT / security and commercial stakeholders - from discovery through business case, pilot / qualification and contract.

  • Collaborate with inside sales support to provide accurate quotes and order processing.

  • Own won accounts long term: develop account plans for key accounts, drive roll-out across sites, lanes and products, and grow recurring revenue.
  • Develop logistics service providers as customers and channel partners, including joint go-tomarket activity with their end customers.
  • Work with Cryoport Systems, MVE and CRYOGENE colleagues on joint opportunities, while building an independent Tec4Med pipeline.
  • Work with Customer Success / Validation colleagues to support customer qualification, onboarding and adoption.
  • Represent the company at trade shows to increase visibility and generate leads.
  • Contribute to developing and executing sales strategies for regional growth.
  • Support marketing efforts by aligning campaigns with customer needs and feedback.
  • Collect and provide valuable customer feedback to drive product and service improvements.
  • Ensure compliance with the companys Quality Management System and processes.

    • New logos won (medium to large, multi-site accounts).
    • Order intake and new annual recurring revenue against target.
    • Qualified pipeline value and coverage against target.
    • Account growth / net revenue retention on owned accounts.
    • Balance of new-business and existing-account revenue.
    • Forecast accuracy and CRM discipline (HubSpot).

COMPETENCIES & PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES


  • Strong technical sales and business development experience in complex, solution-based B2B sales
  • Established credibility and network in temperature-controlled, high-value supply chains; e.g. packaging, condition monitoring, specialty transport or life-science logistics
  • Consultative, multi-stakeholder selling capability; comfortable engaging from operational level to C-suite
  • Hunter mindset, with the discipline to develop and grow accounts over the long term

  • Proactive with excellent communication and negotiation skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks
  • Client-focused with the ability to understand customer needs
  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and adaptable

QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS


  • Master's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Life Sciences or Economics, or equivalent professional experience
  • Typically 8+ years in B2B technical / solution sales, including at least 5 years in temperature controlled or high-value life-science supply chains
  • Proven record of winning and growing multi-site, multi-year contracts with medium to large customers
  • Experience in technical sales and business development practices
  • Proficiency with CRM tools (HubSpot preferred)
  • Experience in cold calling and video calling techniques
  • Desirable: training in Miller Heiman (Strategic Selling / Large Account Management) or a comparable sales methodology

jobs.description:
This role is remote, and you must work Eastern time hours. New York is preferred. Candidates on West Coast or Central time are not a fit.

We are helping a venture backed Series A AI startup hire AI engineers. The company builds custom AI systems that carry approved, high stakes work across the systems a large regulated enterprise already uses, including older private systems.

Each deployment is a tailored version of the core platform, run end to end inside the customer's own environment, because data in these industries cannot leave the customer's infrastructure. The customer's policies decide what the system can do. When a judgment call is needed, the work goes back to a person with the evidence already assembled. Every run leaves an audit trail. Operating data stays with that customer and is not shared. The company can run on the customer's chosen foundation model, and it keeps control of its own model stack, including its own compute.

The company works like an applied research lab that cares most about getting models into production and solving customer problems. The team has strong research backgrounds. Many of the research and engineering people have worked together before, including at a previous company the founders built. It has closed large enterprise deals with major financial institutions and is growing quickly. The core engineering team is overseas, and the US team overlaps with it on Eastern time. The structure is flat, and engineers own their work end to end. A New York office is being set up.

What you will do

  • Own the technical build of a customized version of the company's AI platform for a major enterprise customer, from architecture to deployment.
  • Adapt and extend the core platform for the customer's environment, and merge customer specific work back into the main product.
  • Work every day with the core engineering team abroad, overlapping on Eastern time.
  • Own production deployments, integrations and the reliability of large language model systems in a regulated enterprise environment.
  • Build back end and full stack features in Python: APIs, integrations and deployments for AI powered products.
  • Serve as a go to technical contact for the customer's engineering stakeholders. Expect about 20 percent of your time to be customer facing.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive fixes end to end with a high degree of independence.
  • Help shape how the US engineering team works as it grows.

What you need

  • 6 to 12 years in back end or AI engineering, building and deploying large language model systems in production.
  • Your last 2 to 3 years as an engineer at a high growth, venture backed Series A through Series D AI startup shipping product to enterprise customers.
  • Large language model or agentic workflows you built and shipped that run in production for external customers. Internal tools and prototypes do not count.
  • Strong software architecture and system design, and the ability to own technical delivery end to end.
  • Back end or full stack software engineering in Python.
  • A degree in computer science or a related field.
  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers or their technical teams, ideally in banking or another regulated industry.
  • You live on the US East Coast and work Eastern time hours.

Nice to have

  • Cloud, Kubernetes, CI/CD and observability tooling.

What this search is not

  • Candidates with more than 12 years of experience are not a fit for this role.
  • Candidates coming from Big Tech, a large bank, a large enterprise, a consulting firm, venture capital or asset management are not a fit, even with AI titles.
  • Data scientists, machine learning engineers, data engineers and SRE or DevOps profiles whose main work is not software engineering are not a fit.
  • Research or academic AI experience without production deployments is not a fit.
  • Recent history of several stints of about a year or less, without a clear reason, is not a fit.
  • Candidates on West Coast or Central time are not a fit.

Location

  • Remote, with New York preferred. A New York office is being set up.
  • Eastern time hours only.
  • Visa transfers can be considered.
  • Full time, direct hire role. Equity is part of the offer.

jobs.title: Revenue Cycle Coding Edit Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Job Summary and Responsibilities As our Revenue Cycle Coding Edit Specialist, you will be a vital contributor to our revenue integrity and financial health.
jobs.description:
Job Summary and Responsibilities

As our Revenue Cycle Coding Edit Specialist, you will be a vital contributor to our revenue integrity and financial health. You'll focus on the critical task of inpatient record abstraction and precise medical coding, directly impacting data retrieval, analytics, reimbursement accuracy, and healthcare research. This remote opportunity is ideal for a dedicated professional eager to apply their expertise in HIM operations, navigating complex coding scenarios to optimize our revenue cycle management.

Every day you will assign diagnostic and procedure codes using a designated coding and abstracting system and industry-standard encoder software. You'll meticulously review and abstract information from inpatient records, demonstrating adept navigation across various Electronic Medical Records (EMRs) from multiple facilities. A significant part of your role will involve identifying and resolving potential coding edits and discrepancies to ensure claim accuracy and compliance, consistently meeting stringent quality and productivity coding standards.

To be successful in this role, you will possess established intermediate-level coding experience with a strong emphasis on inpatient coding guidelines and revenue cycle best practices. You must be a highly organized self-starter with exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to work autonomously in a remote setting. Proficiency with various technical applications and EMR systems, sharp attention to detail, and a commitment to data quality are paramount for excelling in this critical financial coding and compliance-focused position.

  • Accurately assigns codes from the current ICD classification systems for inpatient accounts, creates MS-DRG/APR-DRG assignments while adhering to coding guidelines, regulations and compliance plan
  • Abstract additional data elements as identified by enterprise, such as administrative codes
  • Review medical documentation and health information within various electronic medical or health systems to address coding claim edits and other requests from other departments, such as Patient Financial Services, in a timely manner ensuring DNFC KPI metrics are met
  • Must be able to code all service lines of inpatient and outpatient accounts
  • Ability to communicate effectively, stay organized, and demonstrate effective time management skills
  • Adhere to the ethical standards of coding as established by AAPC and/or AHIMA

Job Requirements

Required

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Must hold one (1) of the following certifications: CCS, RHIT, or RHIA
  • Inpatient Coding Expertise: Two plus (2+) years of recent inpatient medical coding experience in a hospital or large multi-facility setting
  • Complex Case Experience: Proven ability to code complex conditions and procedures, ideally in a Level I/II trauma center or teaching hospital (e.g., cardiovascular, neurosurgery, orthopedics, NICU)
  • Remote Work Proficiency: Demonstrated experience working effectively in a remote environment
  • Technical Acumen: Proficient with various encoder (e.g., Optum eCAC, Solventum) and EMR systems (e.g., Epic, Cerner, Meditech)

Preferred

  • Associate's degree in HIM/HIT
  • Clinical Documentation Improvement Professional (CDIP) certification
  • Four to six (4-6) years recent inpatient medical coding experience (hospital, large multi-facility organization, etc.)
  • Bachelor’s degree or Bachelor's degree in HIM or related field

Where You’ll Work

Inspired by faith. Driven by innovation. Powered by humankindness. CommonSpirit Health is building a healthier future for all through its integrated health services. As one of the nation’s largest nonprofit Catholic healthcare organizations, CommonSpirit Health delivers more than 20 million patient encounters annually through more than 2,300 clinics, care sites and 137 hospital-based locations, in addition to its home-based services and virtual care offerings. CommonSpirit has more than 157,000 employees, 45,000 nurses and 25,000 physicians and advanced practice providers across 24 states and contributes more than $4.2 billion annually in charity care, community benefits and unreimbursed government programs. Together with our patients, physicians, partners, and communities, we are creating a more just, equitable, and innovative healthcare delivery system.

jobs.title: Lead LA Supervisor, Oversight of LA Supervisors
jobs.excerpt: Our Story TopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation.
jobs.description:
Our Story

TopDog Law is a nationally scaling personal injury firm that owns the client experience end to end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We've grown 2-3x year over year for three years running, and we're now building the operations, systems, and teams to scale without sacrificing quality or culture. We're fully remote, and we value ownership, open communication, and speed. If you want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel at home here.

The Opportunity

The Lead Supervisor leads the Claims Verification (CV) Department at Topdog Law and oversees all CV Supervisors, who in turn lead the Claims Verification Specialists and Legal Assistants (LAs) on their state teams. The role owns the quality, speed, and consistency of how claims are verified, how clients are contacted, and how claims are handed off to the legal team across every state Topdog Law serves.

The Lead Supervisor builds the department's processes, trains and develops its leaders, and holds the team accountable to clear standards for client communication, insurance coverage analysis, turndown documentation, and case handoffs. This is a hands-on leadership role with a warm, team-first approach: Supervisors are coached, supported, and held accountable so their teams do the same.

What You Will Own

Leading and Developing Supervisors

  • Hold regular one-on-ones and end-of-week (EOW) check-ins with Supervisors and Leads, giving feedback on wins, challenges, and metrics.
  • Build a close, cooperative relationship with the state-specific CV Supervisors and Leads, and support them in every aspect, from work metrics to conflicts with teammates, with ongoing monitoring and guidance.
  • Coach Supervisors to coach their own teams, and help with difficult issues, escalations, and personnel conversations.
  • Coach Supervisors on creating an out-of-compliance game plan for their teams, and follow up to make sure the plan is carried out and brought to completion.
  • Identify and develop future leaders, including recommending and evaluating candidates for promotion to Lead and Supervisor.
  • Set clear expectations for accountability, and hold Supervisors to them consistently.

State Team Oversight

  • Oversee the day-to-day performance of each state team so claims move through Claims Verification on time, including new claims, claims in the Turn Down phase, and personal caseloads.
  • Make sure clients are contacted promptly and that contact cadence is kept, since consistent client communication is a core standard.
  • Make sure new claims are triaged on time and that tasks and claims are assigned and routed to the right person, including CAT and Commercial claims.
  • Support the move to a State Integrated model, so Specialists and Legal Assistants know where their accountability starts and stops and where it hands off to Case Managers.
  • Understand and prepare lists of the state-specific nuances that are not consistent across the firm, and keep a working knowledge of them.

Quality, Compliance, and Audits

  • Audit work for quality and compliance, such as turndown documentation, Q and A, handoffs, and expense and invoice entry for third-party research (such as Red Folder results), and correct issues that appear across states.
  • Coordinate projects across the department and follow up as needed on auditing, so findings are corrected and closed out.
  • Run reports on statutes of limitations (SOL) so no claim is at risk of expiring, and follow up with the owner of any claim that is approaching its SOL.
  • Review police reports, insurance coverage, and policy questions as an escalation resource for the team.
  • Make sure handoffs to Case Managers and Attorneys are complete, accurate, and consistent.

Process, Training, and Communication

  • Build, document, and maintain department SOPs, checklists, and training materials, such as duplicate file handling, reassigning previously terminated claims, and handoff checklists.
  • Lead trainings and workshops, and prepare the team for new tools, systems, and process changes, including rollouts and integrations.
  • Send regular team communications, such as weekly announcements, recognition, and reminders, to keep the team motivated, informed, and aligned.
  • Use dashboards and reports to track performance, and review the numbers with Supervisors and Leadership.
  • Brainstorm on an ongoing basis with Supervisors and Leadership to find time-saving improvements, and put them into effect across the department.

Cross-Team Partnership

  • Partner with Case Managers, Attorneys, Intake, Learning and Development, and peer managers to resolve issues, escalate when needed, and keep handoffs smooth.
  • Implement surveys across the CV Department, its Leaders, and the other departments that work hand in hand with LA and CV, to make sure the team understands the changes and feels heard, and act on the feedback.
  • Report team performance, risks, and results to the Director and Leadership, and share information from Leadership back to the team.

What You Bring

Required:

  • Extensive legal operations experience, ideally 10 or more years, with a track record of building departments, implementing procedures, and leading teams.
  • Previous experience managing managers or supervisors, ideally in a multi-state personal injury environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of insurance coverage, claims, and the personal injury intake and case handoff process.
  • Experience with case management software (such as Filevine), dashboards, and reporting.
  • Experience designing and delivering training, SOPs, and process documentation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Core Competencies

  • Leadership and coaching: Warm, team-first leadership that invests in developing others while holding them accountable.
  • Accountability: Sets clear standards and follows through, with an emphasis on consistency and cadence.
  • Process thinking: Builds clear, repeatable systems and documents them.
  • Communication: Keeps a large, multi-state team informed, motivated, and aligned.
  • Problem solving: Handles escalations, difficult conversations, and cross-team issues with good judgment.
  • Data literacy: Uses dashboards and metrics to spot trends and guide coaching.
  • Adaptability: Leads the team through change, such as new tools, integrations, and structure changes.

How Success Is Measured

  • State and department performance against the Claims Verification goals shown on the department dashboards, such as turndown rate, verified cases, and time to process.
  • Timely handling of new claims and Turn Down claims, with few claims out of compliance or over SLA.
  • Consistent client contact cadence across all teams.
  • Quality of handoffs and documentation, based on audits and feedback from Case Managers and Attorneys.
  • Growth, retention, and engagement of Supervisors, Leads, and Specialists, including promotion readiness.
  • Successful rollout of new processes, tools, and training across states.

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"
  • Committed: You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

What We Offer

  • Base Salary: $80,000 - $90,000, commensurate with experience
  • Our job postings reflect the compensation range for the specific market and location of each role. Ranges vary by geography based on local market rates and cost of labor.
  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with company match, HSA, life insurance, disability coverage, paid time off, and parental leave.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are an equal opportunity employer. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to age, race, color, national origin, religion, sex, disability, sexual orientation, gender identification, or being a qualified disabled veteran or qualified veteran of the Vietnam era or any other category protected by Federal or State law.

DISCLAIMER: This is a full-time employee position. It is not open to independent contractor or consulting arrangements. Compensation is determined by the location where the work is performed and is subject to applicable local law.

These tools assess job-related qualifications and characteristics—such as work experience, education, and skills relevant to the position as described in the job posting—based on information you provide in your application materials (e.g., resume, application responses, and other submitted materials, if any).

All adverse decisions affecting your candidacy are reviewed by a human member of our Talent Acquisition team before being finalized. AI does not make the final decision on your candidacy.
