jobs.title: Sr. Pipe Stress Engineer
jobs.excerpt: What You'll Be Doing Job Scope: Generally responsible for supervision and technical direction over a team of engineers and designers when functioning as a lead engineer.
jobs.description:
What You'll Be Doing

Job Scope: Generally responsible for supervision and technical direction over a team of engineers and designers when functioning as a lead engineer. As lead engineer, responsibilities include total delivery of the mechanical deliverables and services on time, within performance budget and meeting quality expectations. Duties may include performing advanced engineering work serving as a technical specialist for complex engineering assignments. Work at this level requires extensive progressive experience in mechanical engineering and involves utilization of project controls for cost, schedule and quality of projects. This work will be performed under minimal supervision.

Primary responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

  • Familiarity with and utilizing department design and drafting standards.

  • Familiarity with project scope, specifications and design criteria upon assignment to a project task team.

  • On-site assistance during startup.

  • Accomplishing engineering activities such as stress analysis, construction specifications, material procurement specifications, calculations and piping estimates.

  • Developing conceptual layouts and cost studies as necessary to determine the simplest, most efficient approach to solving engineering tasks at hand.

  • Producing estimate level preliminary designs and material take-offs suitable for the level of the estimate being performed on a project.

  • Producing detail design calculations and sketches for materials of construction associated with the project. Calculations produced will be neatly prepared and organized for efficient checking by others and efficient use by drafters/designers for preparing drawings and as a deliverable when required.

  • Assisting the drafting group in resolving routine layout and detailing problems. Responsibilities include provision of sufficient sketches and details necessary for completion of engineering drawings.

  • Consulting with design leaders from other disciplines to ensure the smooth flow of vital information necessary for the scheduled completion of the project.

  • Reviewing and checking vendor drawings and other discipline drawings for mechanical input.

  • Producing designs with efficient use of construction materials with an overall emphasis on ease of construction and completed product meeting the expectations of the client.

  • Checking calculations made by other engineers to ensure accuracy, conformance to codes, specifications, design criteria and conformance to good engineering practice.

  • Advising the senior engineer concerning design or scope changes, which have been identified.

  • Assisting other engineers in developing and assembling scopes, drawings and specifications into a “package”, enabling mechanical purchase inquiries to be issued for procurement of equipment, materials or subcontract pricing.

  • Developing construction specifications.

  • Reviewing fabrication drawings and other construction submittals for conformance to engineering drawings and specifications.

  • Performing fieldwork necessary to gather field data, check tie-ins and provide construction support.

  • Provide technical guidance to less experienced drafting and engineering personnel in the department.

  • Knowledgeable of the discipline specific methods, practices and techniques required to engineer, design and construct process and manufacturing projects.

  • Applying advanced engineering techniques and analysis to complex designs.

  • Recognize and communicate scope and design changes promptly.

  • Provide technical guidance to less experienced drafting and engineering personnel in the department.

  • Coordinate work activities with other staff members and discipline leads.

  • Applying advanced engineering techniques and analysis to complex designs.

  • Estimating and scheduling professional service hours and assessing the progress and quality of mechanical work.

  • Complete understanding of the skills and experience required to perform engineering and design functions.

  • Ability to identify and develop work sharing packages for interoffice execution support. Provide leadership to ensure communication and execution of work within scope, schedule and budget.

Ideal Background

Education: Bachelor or Master of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering from an accredited university is required.

Registration: Professional Engineering registration is highly preferred.

Experience: This position requires 15 or more years of relevant industrial experience in mechanical engineering.

  • Knowledge of design standards and codes.

  • Knowledge, application and specification of piping materials.

  • Development of piping material and material procurement specifications.

  • Knowledge of good design practices for sizing all piping systems.

  • Sizing of compressible fluid piping systems.

  • Flexibility and stress analysis of all piping systems.

  • Specify criteria for and select piping specialty items.

  • Design of complex process and utility piping systems.

  • Knowledge of manual valve sizing, use and application.

  • Knowledge of application of piping supports and restraints.

  • Identification of need, application and specification of safety valves and devices to maintain the mechanical integrity of piping systems.

  • Identification of need, application and specification of steam traps and liquid drainers.

  • Estimating piping related construction quantities from conceptual documents.

  • Knowledge of other disciplines deliverable development to ensure coordination of design efforts.

  • Knowledge and understanding of schedule constraints and information requirements for the production of all mechanical deliverables.

  • Ability to accurately estimate completion of assigned tasks.

  • Able to develop a construction cost estimate, a detailed engineering schedule and a man-hour budget for a small project or an area for a larger project.

  • Able to determine construction material quantities.

  • Knowledge and application of company engineering design and CAD drafting standards.

  • Ability to lead a team to deliver on commitments.

  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.

  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.

  • Excellent presentation skills.

  • Virtual team skills and relationships are developed, and able to provide interoffice execution leadership and support.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit, stand, or walk for long periods of time.

Hargrove Culture

We work to create an environment founded on trust, personal integrity, and a “team mentality” so that each person understands the value of their contributions both on a project and company-wide level. We know that each person on our team contributes to the success of our company by pairing expertise and passion to meet and exceed the needs of the clients we serve across the globe.

Our safety culture protects and promotes the well-being of every person who works with us and every person touched by our work.

As a 100% Teammate owned company, we proudly offer a comprehensive benefits package including, paid holidays, personal paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, 401(k), and other benefits to eligible Teammates.

Equal Opportunity Employment Statement

Hargrove is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, national origin, religion, age, sex (including gender, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sexual identity, marital or family status), disability, military service or obligations, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Hargrove is a drug-free workplace.

The selected candidate must be authorized to work in the United States.

If you are looking for a place where your creativity, knowledge and expertise will be appreciated and rewarded in a team of passionate, intelligent, and fun teammates, we encourage you to apply.

Salary: $120,000 – $140,000 / year

jobs.title: Solutions Architect II (Cloud & Generative AI)
jobs.excerpt: About Ellucian Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students.
jobs.description:
About Ellucian

Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best-in-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.


About the Opportunity

We are seeking a technically accomplished, intellectually curious, consulting-oriented Solutions Architect II who combines software industry expertise with the ability to solve complex institutional challenges through modern SaaS platforms, enterprise data, intelligent automation, and AI-driven experiences.

This is not a traditional implementation-scoping role. Our Solution Architects are trusted technology advisors, creative problem-solvers, and hands-on solution designers who help institutions envision what is possible, challenge conventional thinking, and translate ambitious outcomes into pragmatic, scalable solutions.

You will work at the intersection of enterprise architecture, technical consulting, AI innovation, and business transformation. You should be equally comfortable leading an executive discovery workshop, whiteboarding an integration architecture, building an AI-enabled proof of concept, and shaping a commercially viable transformation roadmap.

Where You Will Make An Impact

Outcome-Based Consulting & Strategic Discovery

  • Advise institutional executives, business stakeholders, and technology leaders on strategic priorities, operating challenges, and transformation opportunities.
  • Lead discovery using design thinking, human-centered design, structured problem-solving, journey mapping, and current-/future-state analysis.
  • Reframe ambiguous requirements into measurable outcomes, business capabilities, solution hypotheses, and prioritized opportunities.
  • Connect technology recommendations to student experience, operational efficiency, institutional agility, adoption, and value realization.

Modern Cloud & Enterprise Solution Architecture

  • Design secure, scalable, resilient SaaS and cloud solutions across applications, APIs, integration, identity, data, security, and operations.
  • Apply API-first, event-driven, modular, composable, and distributed-system design patterns; articulate architectural tradeoffs and technical risks.
  • Produce end-to-end architecture diagrams, integration approaches, technical designs, implementation strategies, and delivery roadmaps.
  • Partner with engineering, product, security, and delivery teams to validate feasibility, architectural integrity, and operational readiness.

AI Building, Prototyping & Applied Innovation

  • Rapidly turn ideas into working demonstrations, technical prototypes, and proofs of concept using APIs, scripting, low-code tools, and AI-assisted development.
  • Identify and architect valuable use cases for generative AI, intelligent agents, workflow automation, and AI-enabled institutional experiences.
  • Apply patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, agent orchestration, and enterprise data grounding where appropriate.
  • Evaluate AI solutions for business value, data readiness, reliability, privacy, security, responsible AI, human oversight, and production readiness.

Technical & Commercial Solution Consulting

  • Own the services solutioning workstream from discovery through proposal development and transition to delivery, ensuring alignment between customer objectives, solution design, and implementation approach.
  • Develop solution recommendations, Statements of Work (SOWs), estimates, timelines, staffing models, and supporting proposal artifacts that define scope, deliverables, assumptions, dependencies, and expected outcomes.
  • Partner with Sales, Delivery, Product, Engineering, and Finance teams to validate feasibility, pricing, resource requirements, and delivery readiness while driving cross-functional solution reviews.
  • Present and defend proposed solutions with customer stakeholders, respond to RFPs, facilitate scope discussions and tradeoff decisions, and support a successful sales-to-delivery handoff.

Product Thinking, Design & Practice Leadership

  • Use product discovery, personas, workflow analysis, prototyping, and iterative validation to design experiences around real user needs.
  • Advocate configuration-first, reusable, extensible solutions and challenge complexity that does not create differentiated value.
  • Build reusable reference architectures, technical accelerators, consulting methods, and feedback loops that raise quality and shorten time to value.
  • Promote technical curiosity, experimentation, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration across Ellucian.

What You Will Bring

Core Technical & Architectural Competencies

  • 5+ years of experience in solution architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, enterprise application architecture, or cloud solution design, including ownership of complex customer-facing solutions.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS, cloud-native services, distributed systems, APIs, integration, data architecture, application security, and modern software design.
  • Experience designing solutions on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud, with working knowledge of REST APIs, event-driven integration, authentication, and authorization.
  • Ability to explain architecture diagrams, system interactions, tradeoffs, scalability, resilience, maintainability, security, and total cost of ownership.
  • Hands-on technical fluency to explore APIs, read or adapt code, build lightweight prototypes, and work credibly with engineers; familiarity with source control, CI/CD, automation, and testing.AI & Emerging Technology Competencies
  • Practical understanding of generative AI, large language models, AI agents, intelligent automation, and enterprise AI architectures.
  • Experience experimenting with or building AI-enabled applications, workflows, prototypes, or demonstrations.
  • Familiarity with prompting, RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool integration, agentic workflows, evaluation, and AI-assisted development.
  • Judgment to assess AI use cases against value, feasibility, limitations, privacy, security, and operational risk.

Consulting, Design Thinking & Business Acumen

  • Experience leading consultative discovery and workshops, structuring ambiguous problems, and translating needs into actionable strategies.
  • Ability to apply design thinking, capability analysis, value-stream mapping, human-centered design, and outcome-based consulting.
  • Executive-level communication, technical storytelling, stakeholder influence, and constructive challenge of assumptions.
  • Commercial awareness and experience with solution recommendations, transformation roadmaps, technical proposals, and delivery economics.
  • Demonstrated experience producing customer-facing services proposals, SOWs, scope definitions, implementation estimates, and resource plans, with the ability to defend assumptions and commercial tradeoffs.
  • Working knowledge of estimation techniques, delivery governance, risk management, change control, and sales-to-delivery transition practices.

Mindset & Ways of Working

  • Builder mindset: Turns ideas into practical solutions, rapidly validating concepts through analysis, prototyping, and collaboration.
  • Consulting orientation: Focuses on understanding business challenges, desired outcomes, and customer priorities before recommending technology.
  • Architectural judgment: Balances business value, simplicity, scalability, risk, and implementation feasibility when designing solutions.
  • Curiosity and continuous learning: Embraces new ideas, seeks feedback, stays current on industry trends, and shares knowledge with others.
  • Ownership and influence: Takes accountability for customer outcomes, builds trust through expertise and collaboration, and drives results through influence rather than authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Higher education technology experience across SIS, ERP, Finance, HR, CRM, learning platforms, and institutional data ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with Ellucian or comparable enterprise platforms such as Microsoft, Workday, Oracle, or Salesforce.
  • Experience in technology consulting, systems integration, enterprise software, SaaS modernization, or digital transformation.
  • Relevant cloud/architecture credentials and exposure to enterprise AI platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, or Amazon Bedrock.

What Success Looks Like

  • Earn trust with executives and engineering teams through strategic insight and technical depth.
  • Discover transformation opportunities beyond stated requirements and align designs to measurable institutional outcomes.
  • Deliver technically sound, commercially viable architectures and rapidly validate innovative approaches, including AI-enabled solutions.
  • Improve solution differentiation, delivery readiness, reusable IP, and time to value while raising Ellucian’s architecture and consulting standards.
  • Produce accurate, compelling, and delivery-ready proposals and SOWs with clear scope, credible estimates, transparent assumptions, and strong cross-functional alignment.

What makes #Ellucianlife

  • Comprehensive health coverage: medical, dental, and vision
  • Flexible time off
  • Thrive Flex Lifestyle Account (LSA) that allows you to contribute towards your health, financial or learning interests
  • 401k w/ match & BrightPlan - to help you save for the future
  • Parental Leave
  • 5 charitable days to support the community that supports us
  • Telemedicine
  • Wellness
    • Headspace Care (mental health)
    • Wellbeats (virtual fitness classes)
  • RethinkCare & Wellthy– caregiver support
  • Diversity and inclusion programs which provide access to internal employee resource groups
  • Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
  • We Foster a learning culture with:
    • Education Assistance Program
    • Professional development opportunities
    • LinkedIn Learning

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we'd love for you to be a part of it as our Senior Data Scientist with the Insurance Pricing team.

As a Data Scientist on our team, you will build and deploy models that support homeowners insurance pricing and a broader set of business decisions across Porch, including profitability, retention, and customer lifetime value. While GLM-based pricing is an important part of this role, you will apply a wide range of data science techniques — from statistical modeling and machine learning to experimentation, geospatial analysis, and generative AI — to problems across underwriting, pricing, and marketing.

You’ll work closely with actuarial, product, and engineering teams to translate Porch’s unique property data into a durable competitive advantage. This is an ideal role for a data scientist who wants to grow their skills across a variety of problems, learn from experienced colleagues, and drive measurable business value.

What You Will Do As A Senior Data Scientist, Insurance Pricing

  • Follow and contribute to team modeling standards and best practices, including code quality, documentation, and reproducibility.

  • Build and validate GLM-based models (frequency, severity, and loss cost) that support homeowners insurance pricing.
  • Build machine learning models (GBMs, neural networks, etc.) that drive underwriting accuracy, competitive positioning, and profitability.
  • Develop ensemble models predicting insured-level profitability, customer retention, and conversion, including customer lifetime value (LTV) models to prioritize marketing and underwriting strategies.
  • Incorporate non-traditional data sources — aerial imagery, satellite data, government records, building permits — to quantify localized risk and inform pricing and underwriting decisions.

  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., BigQuery, GCP) and MLOps practices such as model training pipelines, versioning, and monitoring.

jobs.excerpt: Responsibilities As a key Associate in the Nuclear Power Group (NPG), you will have the opportunity to aid, participate and coordinate engineers and other professionals involved in support of License Renewal (LR) / Subsequent License Renewal (SLR) license extension, and post-approval implementation activities across the U.
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

As a key Associate in the Nuclear Power Group (NPG), you will have the opportunity to aid, participate and coordinate engineers and other professionals involved in support of License Renewal (LR) / Subsequent License Renewal (SLR) license extension, and post-approval implementation activities across the U.S. nuclear power fleet.

S&L is seeking an experienced License Renewal (LR) / Subsequent License Renewal (SLR) professional to support license extension and post-approval implementation activities across the U.S. nuclear power fleet. This role focuses on turning LR/SLR commitments and aging management program (AMP) requirements into practical, field-executable inspection and implementation plans. It can also include performing visual inspections (e.g., VT-1/VT-2 or similar).

The ideal candidate brings experience with LR/SLR application and implementation and an optional combination of nuclear engineering programs, field trade experience (e.g., operations or maintenance), work management/scheduling, NRC submittals and/or inspections, and can bridge between technical aging management requirements, work management systems, and field execution.

Key Responsibilities

License renewal & aging management implementation

  • Support LR/SLR implementation activities such as procedure changes, preventive maintenance (PM) basis and frequency development, work order (WO) development and review, and nuclear program basis document updates.
  • Roadmap required inspections and aging management activities to comply with NRC regulations, LR/SLR commitments, and applicable AMPs.
  • Define and help maintain sample populations and inspection scopes (e.g., one-time inspections, selective leaching, tank inspections) and ensure results are traceable to LR/SLR commitments and program requirements.

Work Management & Coordination Responsibilities

  • Use work management and planning systems (e.g., WOs, PMs, work items) to identify and capture LR/SLR opportunities in both online and outage scopes.
  • Screen and analyze large WO and PM lists (often thousands of line items) to identify high-value inspection opportunities based on system, component, material, and environment.
  • Coordinate with schedulers, planners, and field organizations to embed aging management needs into realistic work sequences and outage plans.

Engineering basis, documentation & configuration control

  • Develop and maintain engineering program basis documentation, including AMP basis, PM basis, and supporting technical justifications.
  • Perform data validation, engineering change tracking, and configuration control for LR/SLR-related documents and commitments.
  • Support NRC commitment tracking and closure, including preparing or reviewing technical responses, inspection packages, and closure documentation.

Stakeholder engagement & SME coordination

  • Interact with clients and NRC in a technical expert role, clearly explaining aging management strategies, inspection plans, and results.
  • Work closely with mechanical, electrical, and structural SMEs, program owners, and field leads to refine scopes, aging mechanisms, and documentation expectations.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, technology-forward thinking, and cross-functional collaboration across engineering, planning, and implementation teams.

Regulatory awareness & operating experience

  • Maintain awareness of changes in LR/SLR and aging management regulations, guidance, and industry operating experience.
  • Incorporate relevant NUREGs, NEI guidance, and industry OE into program basis documents, implementation strategies, and inspection plans.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential Skills

  • An associate’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 10 or more years of experience in the design and analysis of nuclear, industrial, or DOE facilities.
  • Proven experience managing and/or participating in multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Experience in managing medium-to-large critical projects.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience in providing guidance, mentoring, and training to staff engineers
  • Licensed Operator for a Utility
  • Experience delivering accurate, high-quality technical documentation in a highly regulated environment (nuclear, DOE, or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with engineering documentation systems, nuclear QA/QC protocols, and configuration management processes.
  • Strong systems thinking skills, with the ability to balance innovation with compliance, safety, and traceability.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with work management systems (e.g., work orders, PMs, planning tools) and to align technical requirements with implementable work packages and schedules.
  • Proven capability to collaborate with SMEs and field organizations, using drawings, histories, prior WOs, and data to converge on practical implementation solutions.

Preferred Experience

License renewal, SLR, and aging management

  • Prior involvement in license renewal, subsequent license renewal, or nuclear aging management programs, including development or implementation of AMPs, one-time inspections, or selective leaching programs.
  • Experience with NRC, INPO, or DOE regulations, and participation in NRC audits or inspections (e.g., Inspection Procedure 71003 or similar).
  • Familiarity with key nuclear industry LR/SLR documents such as NUREG‑1800, NUREG‑1801, NEI 95‑10, NUREG‑2191, NUREG‑2192, NUREG‑2221, NEI 17‑01, and/or NUREG‑1555.
  • Participation and/or familiarity with the Nuclear Energy Institute (NEI) License Renewal Task Force or similar industry working groups.

Background experience

  • Strong practical understanding of mechanical systems and components (pumps, valves, strainers, tanks, heat exchangers, piping) and how work is actually performed on them in the field.
  • Ability to connect materials and environments to aging mechanisms (e.g., loss of material, pitting, erosion, selective leaching, coating degradation) and to define what inspections need to observe and document.
  • Background in one or more of the following: mechanical maintenance/engineering, system engineering, NDE/inspection, chemistry/corrosion engineering, or field construction/trades (e.g., piping, welding, valve maintenance) that provides credibility with craft and insight into how design, procedures, and work orders translate into physical work.
  • Several years in a nuclear work management / outage or online planning, system engineering, or maintenance engineering role, preferably with exposure to LR/SLR implementation or aging management programs.
  • Prior hands-on or close-support experience with plant modification or maintenance on mechanical systems (e.g., as a maintenance engineer, system engineer, field engineer, NDE/inspection engineer, or craft/trades lead) in a nuclear or similarly regulated environment.
  • Experience working in cross-functional project teams (engineering, programs, planning, field, and external consultants) to deliver complex, multi-outage implementation scopes.

Technology & Innovation

Sargent & Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work. We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology-assisted tools. Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description.

About Sargent & Lundy

At Sargent & Lundy, we care about the health and well-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award-winning benefits. Our dedication to employee satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Award for compensation and benefits in 2022, 2023, and 2024.

Health & WellnessFinancial BenefitsWork-Life Balance

Compensation Range

Transparency Statement

The total compensation package for eligible positions will include a base salary or an hourly rate and a comprehensive benefits package, reflecting our commitment to rewarding performance and supporting the overall well-being of our employees. Individuals may also be eligible to participate in our yearly discretionary bonus.

About This Business Unit

Join Sargent & Lundy's Nuclear Power Group and be part of a team driving the future of clean, carbon-free energy. Since 1954, we’ve been a trusted leader in nuclear engineering, design, and licensing, with expertise spanning small modular reactors (SMRs), advanced reactor technology (ART), and first-of-a-kind commercial reactor restart projects. Our work supports life extensions and digital modernization of existing nuclear plants, coal-to-nuclear conversion initiatives with the Department of State, and international nuclear new-build projects. With a commitment to safety, innovation, and sustainability, we provide cutting-edge solutions that power communities worldwide while reducing emissions. Shape the future of global energy with us!

A bit more about this role:


As a Community Guide, you will play a vital role in helping members overcome barriers to social, financial, and healthcare access. When challenges like food insecurity, unstable housing, or utility costs arise, cross-functional teams refer members to us for comprehensive support. As a Community Guide, you will connect members with financial assistance and social services in a single, supportive conversation. Reporting to a Community Guide Supervisor, you will use consultative problem-solving and growing expertise in state and federal programs to help members navigate complex systems and improve their health. This role is ideal for those dedicated to assisting members as they navigate complex healthcare networks, community initiatives, and support resources.


Your responsibilities and impact will include:

  • Outreach to members via phone and SMS to build connections, share helpful programs, navigate any hesitation, and discover underlying needs to find the right solutions.
  • Assist eligible members with applying for and enrolling in financial assistance and social support programs, while connecting them with community services to ensure their overall needs are met.
  • Guide members through application renewals and clarify complex paperwork or benefit updates to maintain or regain their coverage.
  • Utilize internal resource directories to quickly connect members with key services (but not limited to) such as transportation, food and utility assistance, and medication savings.
  • Hit team goals and quality metrics while handling both outbound outreach and incoming member callbacks with care.
  • Step in quickly when urgent situations arise, following safety protocols and escalating complex cases (like APS referrals and behavioral health concerns) promptly.
  • Maintain accurate notes and keep up with quality standards, even when call volumes are high.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, medical staff, and community partners to share insights and suggest process improvements.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 2+ years of customer- or member-facing experience in a high-volume call center environment focused on consultative problem-solving.
  • Clear, empathetic communication, with the ability to influence decisions, navigate resistance, de-escalate frustrated callers, and handle emotionally sensitive conversations.
  • Strong, independent judgment to navigate multi-step challenges creatively, address core barriers, and escalate complex issues appropriately.
  • Great organizational skills with a keen eye for detail, easily juggling multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A growth mindset: you seek feedback, learn new tools (including AI) quickly, and adapt as programs and policies change.

jobs.description:
Viatris Pharmaceuticals S.L.

Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases.

We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making.

Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases.

Our impact is evident in the awards and accolades we are achieving as an employer of choice and on behalf of our patients worldwide.

Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how Global CMS Optimizely Platform Manager role will make an impact:

Optimizely is becoming Viatris' global content management platform, supporting more than 260 commercial websites and integrating with DAM, SFID, analytics platforms, and multiple third-party services and APIs.


The Global CMS Optimizely Platform Manager will provide the hands-on platform expertise required to support the CMS foundation build and multi-year website migration, working closely with OCE Product Management, Optimizely, implementation partners, IT, architecture, and business teams.


The role will support the technical execution of the foundation, integrations, migration, testing, rollout, and issue resolution, while ensuring that scalability, reuse, automation, and self-service are embedded into the platform from the beginning. As the platform matures, the role will continue to drive platform optimization, reusable capabilities, integration management, and self-service enablement across markets.

Key responsibilities for this role include:


Understand:

  • Understand business requirements across markets and translate them into technical solutions within the Optimizely CMS ecosystem.
  • Align and communicate with global/regional/country stakeholders, such as marketing, IT, and architecture, to define technical needs, prioritize work, and plan integration and migration activities.
  • Act as the technical bridge between business requirements, architecture, and development, serving as a point of contact for platform-related technical inquiries.
  • Evaluate the platform's integration landscape, including DAM, SFID, SFMC, analytics platforms, and 20+ third-party service APIs, to identify risks, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
  • CI/CD pipelines and cloud deployment activities for the DXP (Digital Experience Platform), including environment management, release processes, and monitoring across development, staging, and production.

Design and Improve:

  • Partner with Optimizely architecture and product teams to define and design the technical approach for the CMS Foundation Build and Migration Project on Optimizely CMS, including the migration path from legacy platforms to a composable, API-first architecture.
  • Work with cross-functional business and technical teams to define integration requirements, technical architecture, and a build roadmap that keeps the headless CMS scalable and flexible as the platform grows.
  • Design the content modeling approach (content types, components/blocks, atomic content, brand design systems, page templates, and taxonomies) needed to support 260+ sites across multiple languages, markets, and business lines within a single headless CMS instance.
  • Define the technical SEO(Search Engine Optimization) and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) foundation for the platform, including structured data/schema markup, AI-promoted metadata governance, URL and redirect strategy, and content signals that improve visibility in both traditional search and AI-driven answer engines.
  • Define the technical approach for personalization and experimentation (e.g., Optimizely Web/Feature Experimentation) so that content and campaigns can be targeted and tested reliably across markets.
  • Define content governance guardrails, permissions, workflows, publishing rules, and reusable templates that keep 260+ sites consistent while allowing local market flexibility.
  • Identify and scope Opal AI-driven use cases, such as GEO-informed content creation and optimization, that turn business ideas into working solutions using Python, GraphQL, and APIs.

Execution:

  • Drive the platform-level execution of the CMS foundation build and website migration, working with implementation partners and internal teams across requirements, configuration, migration, validation, testing, cutover, and rollout.
  • Build and maintain integrations between the CMS and DAM, SFID, consent management, and analytics platforms, as well as third-party service APIs, using GraphQL and RESTful APIs for content delivery.
  • Implement and maintain technical SEO and GEO best practices across the platform, including structured data, sitemaps, page performance and Core Web Vitals, and content structuring that supports discoverability by both search engines and AI/LLM-based answer engines.
  • Configure and support personalization and A/B testing capabilities on the platform, working with marketing and content teams to enable targeted, tested experiences across markets.
  • Enforce content governance standards such as templates, publishing workflows, permissions, and reusable components to keep the platform consistent and maintainable on a scale.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across the CMS platform and its integrations, working with engineering, architecture, and vendor teams to drive timely resolution.
  • Build and support Opal AI-driven solutions and use cases for content creation, optimization, and other AI-driven engagement capabilities.
  • Design and evolve a self-service operating model, govern component libraries, and documentation, and training that lets local market and business teams build, publish, and manage content independently without compromising platform integrity.

Optimization and Continuous Improvement:

  • Develop a deep understanding of platform performance, integration reliability, and technical debt to inform continuous improvement.
  • Define technical standards, integration patterns, and reusable practices that support consistent scaling of integrations, automation, and AI-enabled capabilities across markets.
  • Document technical solutions and platform capabilities and share learnings across global teams to support ongoing platform maturity.

The minimum qualifications for this role are:

  • An Experienced Technical Solution Owner: You have hands-on development or build experience with Optimizely CMS and/or Episerver CMS, and have led technical delivery for complex, multi-site web platforms.
  • A Problem Solver: You love solving problems and have close attention to detail, are confident in troubleshooting technical issues across a platform and its integrations, and in managing multiple, competing priorities simultaneously
  • Integration Experience: You understand RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and integration layers between different systems such as DAM, SFID, consent management, and analytics platforms, and know how to design integrations that ensure seamless, reliable data flow.
  • Development Skills: You have practical experience with Python, GraphQL, and API-based development, and are comfortable building working solutions rather than only specifying requirements.
  • Headless CMS Architecture: You have working knowledge of headless/composable CMS architecture (API-first content delivery, decoupled front ends, content modeling with reusable components and blocks) and can evaluate trade-offs to keep a platform scalable and flexible as it grows.
  • CMS Migration Experience: You have hands-on experience migrating websites from a legacy or monolithic CMS (e.g., Sitecore, WordPress, or similar) to a modern platform such as Optimizely, including content and URL migration, redirect mapping, template/component rebuild, and phased or multi-site cutover planning.
  • Technical SEO & GEO Experience: You understand technical SEO fundamentals (structured data/schema markup, metadata, site performance, Core Web Vitals, sitemaps, crawlability) as well as emerging GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) practices for improving content visibility and citation in AI-driven search and answer engines.
  • Content Governance: You understand content governance practices, including publishing workflows, permissions, and reusable templates/components, and know how to balance global consistency with local market autonomy on a scale.
  • AI-Enabled Capabilities: You have familiarity with AI-driven content tools or platforms (e.g., Opal AI or similar) and are excited to build AI-driven use cases for content creation, optimization, and engagement.
  • Translate Requirements to Solutions: You can translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate effectively with both business stakeholders and development teams.
  • Assess Technical Recommendations: You can independently assess and challenge technical recommendations from implementation partners and vendors, ensuring solutions remain aligned with Viatris' scalability, reuse, maintainability, and self-service objectives.

At Viatris, we are dedicated to building a truly diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t fully align with every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Our financial services client is seeking an experienced, autonomous Senior Bookkeeper to manage day-to-day transactional accounting, ledger reconciliations, monthly payroll, and routine statutory compliance across an allocated client portfolio. This is a fully remote role, approximately 30 hours per month.

This role manages routine financial operations up to the Trial Balance stage. The contractor determines their daily workflow to meet agreed monthly milestones and statutory deadlines, while maintaining consistent daytime reachability for ad-hoc client queries.

2. Core Responsibilities & Deliverables
  • Transactional Accounting & Ledger Maintenance:
    • Day-to-day processing and accurate allocation of supplier invoices, customer billings, and payments.
    • Maintaining and reconciling debtors (accounts receivable) and creditors (accounts payable) ledgers.
    • Investigating and resolving general ledger discrepancies prior to monthly closure.
  • Monthly Reconciliations:
    • Performing monthly bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations against source documentation.
  • Payroll Processing & Statutory EMP Returns:
    • Monthly payroll administration and reconciliation.
    • Preparing and submitting monthly EMP201 declarations (PAYE, UIF, SDL) via SARS eFiling prior to the monthly statutory cut-off.
    • Assisting with biannual and annual EMP501 reconciliation records.
  • VAT Compliance:
    • Collation of valid tax invoices and input VAT schedules.
    • Reconciling and submitting monthly/bi-monthly VAT201 returns in compliance with SARS timelines.
  • Management Accounts & Reporting:
    • Maintaining fixed asset registers and monthly depreciation schedules.
    • Compiling accurate monthly management reports up to the Trial Balance.

3. Scope Demarcations (Inclusions & Exclusions)
  • Annual Financial Statements (AFS) Excluded: The candidate is not required to compile, audit, or sign off on final Annual Financial Statements (AFS).
  • Tax Knowledge (Added Benefit): Practical working knowledge of South African tax principles and SARS compliance (e.g. VAT and PAYE handling) is an added advantage, while corporate income tax sign-offs (ITR14/IRP6) remain handled by the practice principal.

4. Working Arrangement, Schedule & Availability
  • Workload & Hours: Estimated at approximately 30 hours per month, billed strictly against delivered milestones and verified task logs.
  • Daytime Availability & Response SLA: While the contractor enjoys schedule autonomy over when tasks are executed, the candidate must be accessible throughout the standard workday (Monday to Friday, 08:30 – 16:30) to attend to ad-hoc communications, urgent operational queries, and client discussions, maintaining an agreed response turnaround within 2 to 4 business hours.

5. Candidate Requirements & Attributes
  • Qualifications: Relevant accounting or bookkeeping qualification (Diploma, Degree, or ICB Senior Bookkeeper).
  • Experience: Minimum 3+ years of practical, hands-on senior bookkeeping experience in an accounting firm or multi-client environment.
  • Technical Skills: Solid command of South African accounting standards, VAT rules, and payroll statutory submissions (EMP201). Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and cloud platforms (QuickBooks Online preferred).
  • Soft Skills: High reliability, disciplined self-management, meticulous accuracy, and prompt, professional client communication.

jobs.description:
Aerospike is the real-time database for mission-critical use cases and workloads, including machine learning, generative, and agentic AI. Aerospike powers millions of transactions per second with millisecond latency, at a fraction of the total cost of ownership compared to other databases.

Global leaders, including Adobe, Airtel, Barclays, Criteo, DBS Bank, Experian, Grab, HDFC Bank, PayPal, Sony Interactive Entertainment, The Trade Desk, and Wayfair, rely on Aerospike for customer 360, fraud detection, real-time bidding, profile stores, recommendation engines, and other use cases.

At Aerospike, we dream big and deliver even bigger. Our mission is to unleash the power of the world’s real-time data with a database built for infinite scale, speed, and sustainability.

If you're ready to shape the future of data, join us.

We are seeking a Director of Developer Infrastructure to define the strategic vision and scale our global developer productivity organization. You will lead an engineering organization spanning developer infrastructure, functional test automation, non-functional/performance test automation, and release engineering.

In this role, your mandate is to architect and deliver a holistic, self-service CI/CD platform that empowers our engineers to independently move code from architecture through preview environments, rigorous automated testing, and release.

Because we build high-throughput, low-latency database technologies and cloud-managed database services (Aerospike Cloud / DBaaS), testing isn't just about functional correctness—it requires automated performance benchmarking, stress validation, automated data loading, and ephemeral multi-node cluster provisioning. We are looking for an engineering leader who prioritizes software delivery, developer enablement, and release acceleration over traditional site operations.

Core Responsibilities

  • Strategic Engineering Leadership: Build, mentor, and scale a multi-team engineering organization across developer infrastructure, functional test automation frameworks, and deep performance/load testing.
  • Self-Service CI/CD & Developer Platform: Design, scale, and maintain an end-to-end self-service delivery pipeline that enables developers to package, stage, test, and deploy features independently without infrastructure handoffs.
  • Cluster Orchestration & Ephemeral Environments: Build tooling for automated multi-node cluster configuration, test environment staging, and ephemeral preview environments, enabling seamless developer verification and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Automated Data Seeding & Workload Simulation: Oversee pipelines for automated test data generation, dataset loading, and distributed workload simulation to stress-test database features and APIs under real-world conditions.
  • Deep Performance & Non-Functional Testing (NFT): Partner with test leads to deeply integrate non-functional automated testing (latency profiling, throughput benchmarks, longevity testing, fault injection) directly into the delivery lifecycle.
  • DBaaS & Cloud Staging Tooling: Support artifact build and deployment pipelines targeting public cloud infrastructure, container platforms (Kubernetes), and managed database-as-a-service offerings.
  • Developer Experience (DevEx): Continuously measure and improve developer feedback loops, build times, test suite parallelization, and deployment safety across our distributed codebases.

Qualifications

  • Leadership Experience: 12+ years in software engineering, release engineering, or developer infrastructure, with 5+ years managing engineering managers and teams across infrastructure, tooling, and automated quality disciplines.
  • Self-Service Platform Mindset: Proven track record of designing internal developer platforms (IDP) and automated release pipelines modeled after modern self-service engineering cultures (e.g., Netflix, Meta, Uber, Spotify, GitLab).
  • Distributed Systems / Database Context: Familiarity with the operational demands of complex backend infrastructure, distributed data systems, or Database-as-a-Service (DBaaS) platforms.
  • Modern Tooling & Orchestration: Strong background in CI/CD pipeline automation, artifact management, container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Advanced Test Automation & Performance Expertise: Hands-on experience scaling automated testing ecosystems, with particular emphasis on non-functional testing (load testing, performance regression analysis, resource contention profiling).
  • Software-Driven Approach: Deep empathy for the software development life cycle (SDLC). You approach developer tooling as a product and view automation through a software engineering lens rather than pure production operations or live-site monitoring.

Target Keyword Profile

  • Core Domains: Developer Infrastructure, DevEx (Developer Experience), Internal Developer Platform (IDP), CI/CD, SDLC, Release Engineering.
  • Database & Systems Tooling: Multi-Node Cluster Configuration, Database-as-a-Service (DBaaS), Automated Data Ingestion/Seeding, Workload Generators.
  • Testing & Quality: Functional Test Automation, Non-Functional Test Automation (NFT), Latency & Throughput Benchmarking, Performance Regression Testing, Ephemeral Staging Environments.

Aerospike is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to an environment free from discrimination based on race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

To keep our recruitment pipeline as high-performance as our database, Aerospike uses AI-driven tools to streamline resume reviews, scheduling, and communication. While we love smart tech, we value human connection even more. AI helps us optimize the process, but real people make 100% of the actual hiring decisions.

The analyst will be the operational backbone of our ISO/IEC 27001 (ISMS) and ISO/IEC 42001 (AIMS) programs and SOC 2 reporting as well as our Public Sector Auditing program such as CMMC and GovRAMP, working closely with Engineering, IT, DevOps, and business teams to demonstrate compliance.

  • Workflow & Queue Management

    • Keep GRC documentation and evidence repositories organized and audit-ready
  • Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM)

  • Hands-on experience supporting multiple types of external audits (e.g.,ISO/IEC 27001, GovRAMP, CMMC and SOC 2), including evidence collection and auditor coordination

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage many recurring deadlines across multiple control owners
  • Comfortable following up with stakeholders across Engineering, IT, and the business and holding them to agreed timelines
  • Strong written communication skills; able to translate technical findings into clear risk statements
  • Sufficient working knowledge of AWS and Azure security concepts (IAM, network segmentation, encryption, logging) to understand control evidence and audit findings
  • Preferred certifications: CISA, or progress toward it; CompTIA Security+, Network+; CRISC, CISSP Associate, CCSK; Fundamentals-level AWS or Azure certification

We are seeking skilled, English-speaking Freelance AV Quality Control Technicians for upcoming projects with one of the world’s largest streaming platforms. Operating at the level of a Master AV QC Technician, you will ensure promotional marketing creative – including trailers, teasers, TV spots, and social cutdowns (each up to ~3 minutes in duration), as well as finishing/localization-source files – meets strict client delivery specs and studio quality standards.

You’ll

  1. Execute multi-pass watch-downs (including frame-by-frame reviews in 4K) and discrete 5.1 and stereo listen-downs of AV assets and finishing files.

  2. Review and refine automated compliance reports.

  3. Inspect After Effects graphic collects and associated finishing files.

  4. Log and document all technical and creative issues clearly for the finishing team. Your focus is strictly on identification and reporting – you will not be responsible for fixing the files.

  5. This is a project-based freelance opportunity with a variable workload depending on release schedules and volume.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Native speaker of English.

  • Based in

    • the US / Canadian West Coast or

    • Australia

  • 3+ years of professional AV QC Technician experience.

  • A sharp eye for video-specific defects to the pixel level (e.g. dead pixels, camera or lens aberrations, watermarks and other finishing errors, etc.)

  • Proven experience performing frame-by-frame picture inspection at native resolution.

  • Strong judgment to separate real, verifiable defects from false positives.

  • Strong grasp of video and audio standards, including codecs, color space, frame rates, channel configuration, loudness (LKFS), true peak (dBTP), and AV sync verification.

  • Hands-on experience conducting discrete 5.1 surround listen-downs and channel mapping verification.

  • Demonstrated working experience in Premiere Pro and After Effects, including scopes and loudness metering in Premiere, and opening and inspecting collected After Effects projects (comps, fonts, plug-ins, linked media).

RATES

We pay a flat rate that varies depending on the asset type. These flat rates average out to between $44 per hour across a full title. We’ll share a detailed breakdown with you.

We settle invoices through Wise or by bank transfer at the end of the month following the month of the invoice.

Dit doen wij ook voor inwoners van Schiedam. Men krijgt in het eigen huis ondersteuning op het gebied van welzijn en zorg. Samen met de cliënt en mantelzorger borgen we dat men zo lang mogelijk op een fijne manier actief thuis kan blijven wonen.

Requirements

Dit ga je doen als Regisseur

Je begeleidt cliënten en hun naasten bij complexe situaties waarin meerdere vormen van zorg en ondersteuning samenkomen. Vanuit jouw rol zorg je voor samenhang, duidelijke regie en een passende inzet van zorg en netwerk.

Concreet betekent dat:

  • Opstellen en bijstellen van zorgplannen op basis van klinisch redeneren en de ontwikkeling van de cliënt.

  • Regie voeren over complexe zorgsituaties en coördineren van de inzet van zorg en ondersteuning.

  • Begeleiden van cliënten en hun netwerk, met aandacht voor zelfregie en kwaliteit van leven.

  • Afstemmen met huisartsen, behandelaren en andere ketenpartners in de wijk.

  • Instrueren en ondersteunen van collega’s en bijdragen aan professionele werkwijzen binnen het team.

Wat je van ons mag verwachten

  • Salaris volgens cao VVT, FWG 50: € 3.592,96 - € 4.822,50 (o.b.v. 36 uur per week).

  • Direct een vast contract voor 24 uur per week.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding, 8% vakantietoeslag en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Mogelijkheid om gebruik te maken van het meerkeuzesysteem, zoals extra verlof of een fietsregeling.

  • Toegang tot o.a. HeyCoach, budgetcoach en DigiCoach voor jouw ontwikkeling.

  • Bij Careyn krijg je meer dan de arbeidsvoorwaarden uit de cao VVT. Meer weten? Bekijk onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Wat jij meebrengt

  • Hbo‑werk‑ en denkniveau en een voor de functie relevante opleiding.

  • Kennis van indicatiestelling en ervaring met coördineren van zorg in de wijk.

  • Affiniteit met complexe zorgvragen, waaronder dementie.

  • Vermogen om zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen en overzicht te houden.

  • Een verbindende houding en overtuigingskracht in samenwerking met cliënten en professionals.

Om de veiligheid van onze cliënten en medewerkers te waarborgen, is voor alle medewerkers die bij Careyn in dienst komen een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) vereist. Bij gelijke geschiktheid krijgen interne sollicitanten voorrang ten opzichte van externe kandidaten.

Overview

The Medical Policy Director (MPD) is a key member of the Go To Market team. Along with the Client Engagement Leader, Client Medical Director (CMD), the MPD co-captains the team serving the Prospective Payment Management (PPM) client team at the health plan. The MPDs role is to serve as a coding and medical payment policy subject matter expert (SME), with the assistance of a CMD. The MPD is responsible for directing the Medical Policy Committee (joint committee with health plan MD, coding experts, and payment integrity). The MPD will develop a relationship with the client, review their data, select medical policy to present, serve as SME for clinical and coding expertise, and back-end support for Cotiviti’s and the client’s Medical Directors. The MPD will evolve as the trusted advisor for the Health Plan in terms of medical payment policy.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a knowledgebase expert regarding the Cotiviti Medical Policy library.
  • Gain an understanding of each client’s unique lines of business, medical policy standards and system configuration strategy to inform optimization opportunities.
  • Analyze client data and identify new medical policy opportunities for presentation including valuation and validation of editing.
  • Examine and select specific claim examples to utilize in a presentation to the client to support the understanding of the new medical policy.
  • Prepare various documents and presentation materials for use during internal payment policy committee meetings and/or client meetings.
  • Review all documents and coordinate reviews with the CMD to evaluate and validate the editing and financial impact.
  • Confidently perform client policy presentations to highlight the facts of each rule, the data that supports the policy recommendation, the impact to claims processing, and the associated value.
  • Successfully advocate for the adoption of new medical policies by clients to optimize the value Cotiviti offers.
  • Participate in client meetings as required as a medical policy subject matter expert.
  • Coordinate with the internal client team to ensure that all requested follow-up items are delivered to the client.
  • Inspire trust and credibility with clients.
  • Communicate effectively across various organizational levels and members of the internal and external client teams.
  • Assist in identifying opportunities for other Cotiviti product solutions.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and the requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field or equivalent.
  • Professional coder certification required (CPC, CPC-A, CCA, CCS, or CCS-P), RHIT or RHIA certification a plus.
  • Minimum of 7-10 years of work experience, preferably in sales, customer service or client management.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in claim payment adjudication, medical payment/policy editing applying Medicare, Medicaid, ICD, CPT, HCPCS and other specialty society guidelines preferred.
  • Health plan, managed care or health insurance experience preferred.
  • Exceptional presentation, interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills.
  • Superior organizational skills with the ability to work in a fast-faced environment, prioritize, and manage multiple competing deadlines with minimal direction.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to think strategically.
  • Ability to analyze complex data and synthesize it for general consumption.
  • Demonstrated strategy and analytical thinking skills, with the ability to effectively communicate conclusions and recommendations to diverse audiences.
  • Excellent computer skills in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook are a must.
  • Willingness/availability to travel 10-20% is required.

Mental Requirements:

  • Communicating with others to exchange information.
  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned.
  • Ability to work with a high volume of transactions in a timely manner and meet deadlines.
  • Must be able to perform daily functions with little or no direct supervision.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

  • This remote role can be located anywhere in the continental US.
  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
  • No adverse environmental conditions are expected.

Base compensation ranges from $123,000 to $148,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

About Ellucian

Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best-in-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.


About the Opportunity

At Ellucian, we're transforming how higher education experiences technology, helping colleges and universities modernize their operations, improve institutional outcomes, and realize the full value of innovation through our expanding portfolio of SaaS and AI-enabled solutions.
As a Solutions Specialist – Student Success & Curriculum within our Solution Sales Organization, you will play a critical role in accelerating adoption and revenue growth across Ellucian's Student Success and Curriculum capabilities.
Combining deep expertise in higher education academic operations, curriculum management, student advising, degree planning, and student success with commercial acumen and consultative selling skills, you will help institutions improve academic program agility, streamline governance processes, strengthen proactive advising, and improve student retention and completion outcomes.
This is a commercially focused, quota-bearing role with three core accountabilities: winning opportunities within Student Success and Curriculum, proactively building pipeline, and maintaining a close, structured partnership with Product Management.
Working across regions alongside our sales teams, you will engage academic and institutional leaders, translate complex challenges into meaningful solution strategies, and demonstrate how connected, data-informed capabilities can improve the student experience and institutional performance.

Where You Will Make an Impact

Win Opportunities Within Student Success & Curriculum
  • Drive revenue growth across Ellucian's Student Success and Curriculum capabilities, serving as a recognized thought leader in curriculum management, academic operations, student advising, degree planning, and student success.
  • Partner closely with sales teams to qualify, develop, and advance opportunities, providing specialist expertise to accelerate deal progression and improve win rates.
  • Lead capability-specific discovery conversations to understand institutional challenges in curriculum planning, academic governance, advising, degree progression, retention, and completion.
  • Independently deliver engaging, business-focused solution demonstrations and customer showcases connecting Ellucian's capabilities to practical institutional use cases.
  • Engage executive, academic, and student success stakeholders with compelling value narratives, competitive differentiation, and a clear vision for institutional improvement.
  • Shape opportunity strategy, solution positioning, competitive responses, and executive engagement plans in collaboration with sales teams.
Build and Develop Student Success & Curriculum Pipeline
  • Proactively identify, create, and develop qualified pipeline opportunities across Student Success and Curriculum, supporting sustainable revenue growth.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, and go-to-market teams to identify whitespace opportunities, unmet academic needs, and opportunities to expand solution adoption.
  • Develop targeted sales plays, value propositions, and engagement strategies that address curriculum modernization, academic planning, advising, and student outcomes.
  • Leverage institutional priorities, higher education trends, competitive intelligence, and customer relationships to identify cross-sell and expansion opportunities.
  • Contribute to campaigns, webinars, executive briefings, industry events, and customer forums to generate demand.
  • Monitor pipeline performance, qualification, conversion, and deal velocity, collaborating with sales teams to prioritize high-value opportunities.
Maintain Strategic Alignment with Product Management
  • Establish close, structured partnerships with Student Success and Curriculum Product Management, engaging at least monthly to maintain consistent, two-way communication.
  • Share actionable field insights, including customer needs, competitive intelligence, product gaps, common objections, and emerging academic and student success requirements.
  • Stay informed of product strategy, roadmap priorities, planned enhancements, and release timelines.
  • Translate product innovation into compelling customer value propositions, differentiated positioning, and effective sales messaging.
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Marketing to refine solution messaging, strengthen sales enablement, and support go-to-market execution.
  • Maintain deep knowledge of Student Success and Curriculum capabilities, use cases, integrations, and their relationship to Ellucian's broader SaaS and AI portfolio.

What You Will Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS sales, solution sales, specialist selling, or consultative sales within higher education or technology providers.
  • Recognized expertise in higher education curriculum management, academic operations, student advising, degree planning, or student success, with the credibility to influence senior institutional stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of institutional challenges surrounding curriculum governance, academic planning, student retention, degree progression, and completion.
  • Demonstrated success developing and winning sales opportunities, building qualified pipeline, and contributing to revenue growth.
  • Strong commercial acumen and experience navigating complex enterprise sales cycles and influencing institutional buying decisions.
  • Experience delivering engaging, business-focused solution demonstrations and executive presentations.
  • Strong executive presence, communication, and storytelling skills, with the ability to engage academic leaders, student success executives, and senior institutional stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating with Product Management to share customer insights, understand product roadmaps, and strengthen sales positioning.
  • Ability to work effectively within a matrixed, geographically distributed organization.
  • A proactive, results-oriented approach to opportunity development, pipeline generation, and continuous learning.
