jobs.excerpt: About Circle Cardiovascular Imaging: Circle’s vision is to enable healthier Lives through better imaging by transforming cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MR) and other advanced imaging technologies to improve Cardiovascular Care.
jobs.description:
About Circle Cardiovascular Imaging:

Circle’s vision is to enable healthier Lives through better imaging by transforming cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MR) and other advanced imaging technologies to improve Cardiovascular Care. Circle Cardiovascular’s 'cvi42' is the Cardiac MR market leader imaging processing software.

Circle Cardiovascular Imaging (Circle) designs, builds, and implements the best-in-class cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance Imaging solutions. At the heart of everything we do is our unrelenting drive to continually offer better solutions for healthcare providers that improve healthcare outcomes. This fuels our creativity, informs our decisions and it is the reason we are passionate about our work and most importantly why we are successful. We are careful stewards of resources focused on optimizing both customer and investor value. We strive to make Circle a place where employees are highly valued, engaged, and have opportunities for professional development. Our roots are medical and digital, our passion is contagious, and our people are amongst the best.

Position Overview:

The Account Sales Executive (ASE) for the Outpatient Imaging & Physician Office Market is a specialized, quota-carrying role dedicated 100% to the US outpatient segment: independent and freestanding imaging centers (IDTFs), hospital-affiliated outpatient imaging, and private cardiology and physician practices. These accounts are independent businesses that must generate revenue, win physician referrals, and protect margin, so the segment is economically very different from the hospital market. The ASE sells the same Circle platforms as our geography-based ASEs (CMR, CCT, SHD, and EP) but wins by speaking the buyer’s language: reimbursement, referral growth, throughput, differentiation, and return on investment. The ideal candidate pairs genuine cardiovascular imaging fluency with real business acumen, understands how an imaging center or cardiology practice is paid and who its customers are, and can show how Circle’s applications, especially coronary CTA with AI-based plaque quantification, unlock new billable service lines and a measurable financial case for adoption. The role is measured on sales results.

Understanding the Outpatient Customer: Economics & Value Positioning

Success depends on understanding how these accounts run as businesses and how Circle creates financial value for them. The ASE must be fluent in, and able to sell against, the realities of the segment:

  • How they get paid. Freestanding centers and office-based practices are largely fee-for-service, billing per study under the Medicare Physician Fee Schedule and commercial equivalents, generally at lower rates than the hospital OPPS setting. The ASE must understand technical, professional, and global billing and how reimbursement shapes what a center can afford and where it makes money.
  • New billable service lines. Coronary CTA (CCTA) with AI-based quantitative plaque analysis now carries established CPT codes and Medicare payment, so Circle becomes a source of incremental revenue rather than pure cost. The ASE must be able to build the per-study and annual revenue case.
  • Who their customers are. Unlike a hospital, the outpatient center’s customer is the referring physician who sends patients, and for cardiology practices their own panel. Referral capture and retention is the lifeblood of the business, and the ASE must position Circle to win and keep referrers through faster, more advanced reporting.
  • How they compete. Centers compete with the local hospital and each other on turnaround, service, advanced capability, and referring-physician experience. The ASE must turn Circle’s advanced cardiac imaging into a competitive advantage for the account.
  • Return on investment. The ASE must independently build a credible ROI case covering incremental reimbursement, new volume, throughput and read-time gains, payback period, and downstream referral value, and present it to an owner or administrator who thinks like a business owner.
  • Ownership and buying models. The segment ranges from single physician-owners who decide quickly to practice administrators, MSOs, multi-site imaging groups, and private-equity-backed platforms that buy centrally. The ASE must find the real economic decision-maker and run both fast single-site deals and structured multi-site agreements.

General Responsibilities:

  • Own a US outpatient territory of imaging centers, IDTFs, and private cardiology and physician practices, prospecting and closing new business while expanding Circle across CMR, CCT, SHD, and EP, with a strong emphasis on CCTA-driven opportunities.
  • Lead the full sales cycle, engaging physician-owners, practice administrators, lead cardiologists and radiologists, and platform or MSO executives, and bringing in Circle’s Clinical Application Specialist (CAS) team for deeper technical and workflow discovery.
  • Build and present the financial and clinical business case, quantifying incremental reimbursement, new billable service lines (CCTA plaque analysis), throughput, and ROI, tailored to each account’s economics and reimbursement setting.
  • Help accounts stand up and grow advanced cardiac service lines, positioning Circle as the enabler of new revenue and a tool to win and retain referring physicians.
  • Map and engage the outpatient decision-making unit (owner, practice or office manager, billing and operations, referring physicians, and IT) and navigate single-site, multi-site, and PE or MSO buying structures to secure contracts.
  • Deliver pre-sales demonstrations online, at congresses, and on-site, covering the core aspects of Circle’s applications, and partner with the CAS team for in-depth, workflow-specific demonstrations.
  • Work with the Marketing Demand Generation Manager to align outreach with marketing programs and generate pipeline in the segment, and provide regular forecasts and market feedback to sales management.
  • Achieve and exceed sales targets, continuously building product, clinical, and reimbursement knowledge and staying current with CPT coding, Medicare payment changes, competitor activity, and consolidation and private-equity dynamics.

Required Skills/Experience:

  • Proven track record in a quota-carrying sales role, ideally selling into outpatient imaging centers, IDTFs, or private physician and cardiology practices; medical device, imaging, or healthcare software sales strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of US outpatient reimbursement (Medicare Physician Fee Schedule versus hospital OPPS; technical, professional, and global billing; CPT coding; the economics of fee-for-service imaging), or the clear ability to learn and sell it quickly.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to independently build and present an ROI and revenue case to physician-owners and administrators who think like business owners.
  • Understanding of referral-driven practice economics, including how centers and cardiology offices attract and retain referring physicians, and how to position Circle to strengthen that base.
  • Cardiovascular imaging fluency, ideally as a technologist, clinical applications specialist, or vendor representative, with the credibility to independently lead a conversation on CCTA, plaque analysis, and core Circle workflows.
  • Ability to navigate diverse buying structures, from single physician-owners and administrators to multi-site groups, MSOs, and PE-backed platforms, running both fast single-site deals and structured multi-site agreements.
  • Strong negotiation and closing instincts, and strong presentation and communication skills, articulating clinical value and business impact to clinical, non-clinical, and business-owner audiences.

Educational Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare, bio-engineering, IT, or a related area; equivalent experience as an imaging technologist, a clinical or vendor specialist in cardiovascular imaging, or in outpatient imaging sales will also be considered.

About the Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation and vacation
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • Employee Wellness Program
  • Professional development and tuition reimbursement program
  • Gratifying internal recognition/kudos programs
  • Annual salary review – based on company and individual performance
  • Fun, inclusive, ego-free environment where diversity and individual thoughts are encouraged and valued

Upon joining Circle CVI, you will be welcomed into a collaborative and supportive company with uncompromising values on quality, innovation, culture, and customer service. Join us in changing the medical technology world and submit your application below!

Job Description Summary

As part of the GE HealthCare MR organization, the USCAN MR Clinical AI Sales Specialist – icobrain will be responsible for driving growth and adoption of icobrain across the U.S. market.

This role combines new business development with strategic account engagement and close collaboration across the broader GE HealthCare MR commercial organization. The successful candidate will develop new opportunities while leveraging GE HealthCare's established customer relationships, MR installed base, and commercial teams to expand the adoption of icobrain within health systems, academic medical centers, imaging organizations, and neurology-focused practices.

The role will also partner closely with the Customer Success team to support existing customers, including renewals and the transition of legacy icometrix agreements to GE HealthCare contracts.

This is a primarily remote sales role, with most customer engagement, prospecting, presentations, demonstrations, and opportunity development conducted virtually through phone and Microsoft Teams. In-person engagement will also be an important part of the role at strategic customer meetings, conferences, and other industry events.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong commercial mindset, an interest in MR and clinical AI, and the ability to work effectively within a highly collaborative, matrixed organization.

Job Description

  • Drive icobrain growth: Develop and execute a regional sales strategy to achieve orders and revenue goals while expanding icobrain adoption across key accounts and market segments.
  • Develop new opportunities: Identify, qualify, and advance new icobrain opportunities through direct customer engagement, targeted prospecting, and collaboration with GE HealthCare MR sales teams.
  • Leverage the broader GE HealthCare organization: Partner closely with MR Account Managers, Imaging Account Executives, clinical teams, product specialists, and other commercial stakeholders to identify opportunities within existing GE HealthCare accounts and the MR installed base.
  • Excel in a virtual and in-person selling environment: Proactively engage customers and prospects through phone, Microsoft Teams, email, and other virtual channels. Effectively develop relationships, deliver presentations and demonstrations, and advance opportunities remotely, while also actively engaging customers and prospects at conferences, industry meetings, and other in-person events.
  • Engage clinical and executive stakeholders: Build relationships with radiologists, neuroradiologists, neurologists, imaging leaders, IT stakeholders, administrators, and other decision makers involved in the evaluation and adoption of clinical AI solutions.
  • Serve as an icobrain subject matter expert: Develop a strong understanding of icobrain's clinical applications, workflows, and customer value and effectively communicate that value to clinical, technical, and business audiences.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description The Enterprise Climate and Resource Resilience Manager leads Agilent’s enterprise climate and resource portfolio, translating climate commitments, energy, water, waste, emissions data, resource risks, and business priorities into an integrated strategy, accountable workstreams, investment choices, and measurable performance.
jobs.description:
Job Description


The Enterprise Climate and Resource Resilience Manager leads Agilent’s enterprise climate and resource portfolio, translating climate commitments, energy, water, waste, emissions data, resource risks, and business priorities into an integrated strategy, accountable workstreams, investment choices, and measurable performance. The role provides the strategic alignment and enterprise coordination needed across key functions, while preserving accountability within the functions that own implementation.

The Manager leads development and implementation of Agilent’s climate and resource resilience strategy, target governance, transition planning, climate risk and resilience integration, enterprise emissions performance framework across Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3, and the strategic direction for energy, water, and waste. The role leads the process to evaluate, develop, validate, and operationalize future commitments in these areas, ensuring that any proposed goals are supported by credible baselines, investment pathways, functional ownership, and feasible implementation plans.

The role leads the transition from consultant-supported climate analysis to a durable internal capability, including methodologies, forecasting, governance, decision support, technology requirements, and assurance readiness. Working across WPS/EHS, Procurement, Finance, Reporting, ERM, IT, Legal, Strategy, and Sustainability, the Manager converts climate and resource priorities into investment-ready roadmaps, clear accountability, and coordinated execution.

Key Responsibilities:

Enterprise Climate Strategy and Governance:

  • Lead development and implementation of Agilent’s enterprise climate and resource resilience strategy, roadmap, governance model, and performance framework.
  • Lead enterprise climate target governance, including target interpretation, trajectory analysis, forecasting, performance reviews, corrective action recommendations, and preparation for future target validation or review.
  • Establish clear ownership, decision rights, milestones, escalation pathways, and performance measures across operational emissions, purchased energy, supply chain emissions, logistics, travel, commuting, climate risk, and other material categories.
  • Partner with the Reporting Manager to assess and interpret emerging climate-related regulations, disclosure requirements, and market expectations, including California SB 253 and SB 261, CSRD, ISSB, potential SEC climate requirements, and relevant country-specific carbon regulations.
  • Evaluate business impacts, implementation requirements, data readiness, control implications, accountable owners, and strategic response options, and provide decision-ready recommendations to leadership.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Finance, Reporting and Disclosure, ERM, WPS/EHS, Procurement, and business teams to translate regulatory developments into integrated readiness plans while preserving functional accountability for compliance execution.
  • Advise the Global Head of Sustainability and executive leaders on climate priorities, investment choices, material risks, performance gaps, and enterprise tradeoffs.
  • Represent Agilent, or prepare appropriate leaders and subject matter experts, in selected customer, investor, industry, and external climate engagements.

Climate Transition and Resource Resilience:

  • Lead development and maintenance of Agilent’s Climate Transition Plan, integrating the decarbonization roadmap with climate risk and resilience, governance, financial planning, capital priorities, supply chain actions, product considerations, and business strategy.
  • Partner with WPS/EHS, Procurement, Finance, Strategy, ERM, and business leaders to identify, evaluate, prioritize, and sequence emissions reduction, climate adaptation, and resource resilience opportunities.
  • Integrate climate risk and resilience findings into enterprise risk management, capital planning, operational planning, supplier strategies, and relevant business decisions.
  • Develop decision-ready business cases with Strategy and Finance, including cost, emissions impact, risk reduction, customer relevance, feasibility, timing, dependencies, and accountable owners.
  • Evaluate and recommend enterprise decision-support approaches, including internal carbon pricing and climate-adjusted investment frameworks, to inform capital allocation and portfolio prioritization.
  • Partner with Strategy, Commercial, Product Management, and Product Sustainability to identify climate-related business opportunities, customer requirements, competitive differentiators, and growth opportunities arising from the low-carbon transition.
  • Integrate climate and resource resilience considerations into long-range financial planning, capital planning, and enterprise investment prioritization processes.
  • Monitor external developments in climate science, standards, policy, energy markets, and corporate practice, and translate relevant changes into practical recommendations.

Energy, Water, Waste, and Resource Strategy:

  • Lead development of Agilent’s enterprise strategies and roadmaps for energy, water, waste, and related resource resilience priorities, translating current targets into accountable plans, investment choices, and measurable performance.
  • Assess the maturity, performance, business relevance, regulatory context, and feasibility of existing energy, water, and waste targets, and recommend whether Agilent should maintain, revise, expand, or establish new commitments.
  • Lead the process to develop and validate any proposed commitments, including baseline quality, definitions, boundaries, methodologies, target ambition, investment requirements, operating ownership, controls, assurance needs, and implementation pathways.
  • Partner with WPS/EHS, Finance, Strategy, Procurement, Operations, and site leaders to identify and prioritize resource efficiency, renewable energy, water stewardship, waste prevention, diversion, circularity, and resilience opportunities.
  • Establish enterprise performance frameworks for energy, water, and waste, including standard definitions, data requirements, ownership, forecasting, progress reviews, and escalation of material gaps.
  • Develop business cases and recommendations for priority investments, pilots, technology, external partnerships, and operating capabilities needed to deliver approved resource commitments.

Emissions Performance, Data, and Technology:

  • Lead development of the enterprise requirements and integrated performance view for Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3, while source data, calculations, controls, and approvals remain with the accountable functions.
  • Govern climate methodologies, assumptions, emissions factors, estimation rules, data quality expectations, change controls, decision logs, forecasting approaches, and documentation standards.
  • Establish the approach for location-based and market-based Scope 2 reporting, including renewable energy certificates, virtual power purchase agreements, contractual instruments, and related evidence and controls.
  • Coordinate enterprise inventory planning, management review, assurance readiness, year-over-year analysis, and reconciliation of climate information used for targets, planning, and disclosure.
  • Serve as the business owner for enterprise climate technology requirements and partner with IT/Data on architecture, integration, security, platform selection, implementation, and long-term administration.
  • Develop climate analytics that identify emissions drivers, performance gaps, reduction opportunities, scenarios, and decision-relevant insights.

Enterprise Execution and Capability Building:

Our client sells subscription software to property managers. It has an iOS and Android app for field capture, a web dashboard for reports, tenant self-inspections and work orders. It grows through direct sales, referrals and partnerships, and it connects to the systems customers already use.

The CEO founded the company in California in 2014. It also turns voice notes into inspection reports with AI. The team is fully remote, and the engineering manager works from Uruguay.

Your Role

As Senior Software Engineer, you'll own features on the product engineering team, from the first product conversation through release and what happens in production afterwards. The seat is hands-on and covers Senior to Staff level. It's a full-time remote contractor role on Pacific time hours.

You'll report to the Head of Product Engineering and work closely with product. The team is building more with AI, and it's moving parts of its single large codebase into separate services while customers keep using the product. We prefer people based in Latin America whose day shares several hours with Pacific time.

Success means a feature you built is live and you're watching it in production. It also means you've fixed production data problems at the root cause, and your code reviews show in the work of the engineers around you.

You'll

  • Own features from the first product conversation through release and fixes after launch
  • Write short design notes and share them with the team before building
  • Fix late, repeated or cut-off mobile uploads at their root cause
  • Speed up queries over a dataset of 100M+ inspection photos
  • Build AI features on the voice-to-report tool, with a safe fallback for wrong output
  • Watch production after each release and fix what breaks
  • Help decide which parts of the monolith become separate services, and in what order
  • Review pull requests and mentor engineers, giving the reason for each comment

You Bring

  • Several years building and running a live product where mistakes cost customers
  • Full-stack experience with significant backend depth: services, data and APIs, plus React or Next.js and mobile work
  • A product mindset: you start from the customer's problem and ask product sharp questions
  • Features taken from rough idea to release, then watched in production
  • A production problem you debugged to its root cause and can walk through
  • AI tools in your engineering workflow every day, and AI-powered features you've shipped to real users
  • Clear English, written and spoken, for design notes and pull requests
  • Code review and mentoring of other engineers
  • Self-starting habits that suit a small, remote team

Bonus Points

  • Led a cross-team initiative or defined the architecture of a major system
  • Moved part of a monolith into services while customers kept using the product
  • Built offline capture or sync with retries and duplicate handling

What's Offered

  • What we'd estimate for a role like this: $5,000 to $8,500 USD a month, based on experience. Share the range that fits your level and we'll go from there.

Interview Process

1️⃣ First call: 30 minutes with us at atomic✳HR on what you have built, working terms and what you want next.
2️⃣ Interviews with the engineering team: conversations about systems you have owned, what broke in them, how you found out and what you changed afterwards.
3️⃣ Final conversation with the CEO: on how you would work with product and the team, and what you would want to take on first.
4️⃣ Identity verification: a check that you are the person on the profile, done before an offer is made.

The Senior Strategic Alliance Executive – AWS is Workiva's global lead for the AWS partnership. You will own the relationship end to end, including co-sell, AWS Marketplace, and joint go-to-market. You will set the global strategy, business plan, and executive relationships that turn the AWS alliance into a repeatable, scalable source of pipeline and revenue.


You will not do this alone. A dedicated team supports the AWS partnership at Workiva on the operational side, and regional resources support execution in the field. Your job is to set direction, align both teams to a single plan, and make sure global priorities show up in every region.


This role suits a seasoned alliance leader who knows how AWS works: how its field teams are incented, how co-sell opportunities move through ACE, and how deals are transacted through Marketplace. You will work inside Workiva and inside AWS to build trust, alignment, and accountability with AWS executives, Partner Development Managers, and account teams, and with the consulting and SI partners who help bring joint solutions to market. The goal is a partnership that delivers material impact for both AWS and Workiva.


How This Role Works


  • Global lead: You are the single accountable owner of the Workiva–AWS relationship worldwide and the primary point of contact for AWS global leadership.
  • Operational support team: A dedicated team handles day-to-day operational support for the AWS partnership. You will set their priorities and cadence and work with them to keep processes running smoothly.
  • Regional resources: Partner and sales resources in each region support local execution. You will align them to the global plan and equip them to engage their regional AWS counterparts.
  • Cross-functional partners: You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, RevOps, Finance, Legal, Product, and Services leadership.

What You'll Do


Own the global AWS relationship and strategy

  • Build and run the global joint business plan with AWS, including targets, co-sell priorities, target accounts and segments, and field enablement, and cascade it to regional teams
  • Lead through influence across the operational support team and regional resources, setting priorities, clarifying roles, and driving consistent execution across regions
  • Develop and sustain executive relationships across AWS leadership, partner management, sales, and marketing
  • Define joint value propositions and compelling joint offerings, working with Workiva's consulting and SI partners
  • Hold regular business reviews with AWS and Workiva leadership to track progress and secure investment

Drive co-sell and pipeline

  • Own the AWS co-sell pipeline end to end, including ACE opportunity submission, quality, and progression to closed-won
  • Activate and enable AWS field teams, including Partner Development Managers, Partner Sales Managers, and account executives, with content built around how they sell
  • Work with Workiva sellers and leaders to prioritize shared accounts, run joint account plans, and keep pipeline hygiene strong in Salesforce and Partner Central
  • Drive pipeline development and nurture across sourced, co-sell, and influenced opportunities

Scale AWS Marketplace as a route to market

  • Drive Marketplace as the preferred transaction path, including private offer strategy and execution, committed-spend (EDP) burn-down plays, and routing discipline so qualified deals close through Marketplace
  • Partner with Sales, RevOps, Finance, and Legal on private offer process, pricing and agreements, and listing readiness
  • Manage Workiva's AWS program standing, including ISV Accelerate participation, technical validation requirements, and tier or incentive eligibility

Run joint marketing and investment

  • Develop and execute the annual AWS co-marketing plan, including campaigns, field events, and executive engagements
  • Use AWS funding programs (such as MDF and co-op) strategically, for both ROI and compliance

Measure and report

  • Define and report on global and regional KPIs, including sourced and co-sell bookings, qualified pipeline, co-sell win rate, Marketplace bookings, and AWS field engagement
  • Give Workiva and AWS leadership clear, data-driven recommendations on where to invest and where to intervene

Recruit, enable, and activate

  • Support partner recruitment, activation, and enablement, and make sure delivery excellence follows the sale

What Success Looks Like


First 90 days: You've built relationships with key AWS and Workiva stakeholders, assessed the current state of co-sell and Marketplace, and delivered a global joint business plan with agreed targets.


First 12 months: A repeatable co-sell and Marketplace motion is in place, with measurable growth in sourced and co-sell pipeline and Marketplace-transacted bookings. AWS field teams know Workiva and bring us into target accounts. The operational support team and regional resources work to a single global plan, with clear roles and a regular operating rhythm.


What You'll Need


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of related experience in software and/or SaaS alliances, partnerships, or leadership
  • Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of knowledge and related career experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience managing an AWS alliance, either at an ISV or at AWS, including AWS co-sell and AWS Marketplace
  • Working knowledge of AWS partner mechanics, including Partner Central/ACE, private offers, and AWS partner funding programs
  • Experience leading a global partnership or alliance and driving results through teams you don't directly manage, including operational and regional resources
  • Proven track record of meeting and exceeding targets, driving revenue through direct and partner-influenced opportunities
  • Experience with ISV Accelerate and AWS partner program tiers or incentives

  • Experience aligning with AWS across multiple geographies and field organizations

Travel Requirement & Working Conditions

jobs.description:
InfoTrust is a global, privately-owned products and solutions company dedicated to unlocking the power of data to drive marketing performance and business growth. We specialize in digital analytics, media enablement, and privacy-centric solutions that help Fortune 100–500 companies and the world’s largest brands optimize their marketing strategies. Our culture is built on passion, ownership, diversity, trust, respect, and continuous growth—values that have earned us multiple “Best Places to Work” awards, including a Great Place to Work certification 7 years in a row.

About the role

InfoTrust is hiring a Senior UX Designer to own the user experience across our growing portfolio of enterprise SaaS products. Our products help organizations trust, verify and govern their marketing data, privacy and compliance. You'll be our product team's dedicated UX designer, responsible for how customers move through our products, from the first screen they see to the workflows they rely on every day.

Your job is to make sure the experience is designed with purpose, not left to whatever the build produces. You'll take a feature from a defined problem to a validated design: map the user journey, settle structure in wireframes, work out the look in mockups, and test how it feels in prototypes, working closely with engineering before the build Product Management decides what we build and why. You decide how it works for the user.

This is a hands-on, senior individual-contributor role, working closely day to day with Product Management and Engineering.

What you'll do

  • Own user journeys and flows: Map current and future journeys, define flows and decision points, and make sure each feature connects cleanly to what comes before and after it.
  • Own wireframes and mockups: Settle structure and navigation in wireframes, and appearance and layout in mockups built from our shared design system's components, so designs can be built as drawn.
  • Own prototypes for validation: Build interactive prototypes quickly with AI build tools so stakeholders and users can experience a design before it's built, then hand validated designs to engineering.
  • Own usability research: Plan and run usability tests and journey interviews with customers and internal consultants, and turn findings into design changes and clear input for Product Management.
  • Own interaction standards: Define and document how common elements behave (tables, forms, navigation, side panels vs. modals, errors and empty states) so engineering and the design system apply them consistently.
  • Partner across the team: Bring usability findings into product priorities, propose design system components when a journey needs them, review implemented work before release, and help sales, customer success and support understand what's changing.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of UX or product design experience, mostly on external-facing B2B or enterprise SaaS products
  • A portfolio of complex, data-heavy work (dashboards, configuration, multi-step workflows, role-based experiences) that shows your process from problem to validated design
  • End-to-end skills: journey mapping, information architecture, interaction design, wireframing and high-fidelity mockups
  • Hands-on prototyping experience, including AI-assisted prototyping
  • Experience planning and running usability research and turning findings into clear design decisions
  • Experience designing within a design system and defining interaction patterns others apply
  • Ability to work independently as a solo designer, set your own standards, and explain your decisions to leadership
  • A clear sense of where design ends and product definition begins
  • Strong communication and collaboration with product managers, engineers and non-technical stakeholders
  • Proficient with tools such as Claude Design, Figma, FigJam or Miro for prototyping; close equivalents welcome

Bonus: Experience with MarTech, analytics, privacy, data governance or compliance products, or with accessibility standards such as WCAG.

You'll love this role if you want to be the person who defines what good UX looks like here, enjoy making complex, data-heavy products feel simple, and would rather test with real users than debate opinions.

It may not be the right fit if you want to decide which features get built, prefer visual polish over interaction design, expect a design team around you, or would rather hand off a mockup and move on.

Why Work Here?

InfoTrust is becoming a product company, and the people who join now will shape what we build and how we build it. We’ve been named a Great Place to Work for 7 years running, and our team members are deeply connected to our core values:

  • Earn Trust: Deliver on what you promise.
  • Be Respectful: Don’t be an a**hole.
  • Promote Diversity: Seek understanding and be inclusive.
  • Take Ownership: There is no “they.” Take initiative.
  • Grow Every Day: Learn and apply.
  • Contribute With Passion: Desire to do good. Give to grow.

Through the InfoTrust Foundation, a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, we give back to the communities where our team members live and work.

Benefits for US-based team members include health, vision and dental insurance with employer-sponsored premiums, a short-term incentive plan, unlimited PTO, a generous parental leave program, a 401(k) with company match and more.

Portfolio Revenue Analyst - Restaurants & Bars (Tokyo Corporate Office, Full Remote)

Role Purpose

This role supports the Portfolio Revenue Managers (PRMs) in driving R&B revenue across key outlets within the region by producing data outputs, updating the Revenue Performance Tool (RPT) and Power BI, and preparing RevGEN materials.

Key Accountabilities

  • Lead R&B Revenue Services and revenue strategy across EAPAC for a portfolio of hotels, restaurants, bars, spas and other ancillary revenue streams.
    • Directly manage selected complex or high-profile hotel assignments and act as the senior R&B revenue partner to hotel leadership.
    • Use demand, capacity, pricing, menu mix, promotions and customer data to identify practical revenue and profitability opportunities.
    • Lead key performance, forecast, budget and strategy reviews with hotel and regional stakeholders.
    • Partner with F&B, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Sales and Digital teams to turn recommendations into action.

Service Growth and Stakeholder Engagement:
• Expand the R&B Revenue Services footprint by identifying and converting new hotel opportunities.
• Build compelling business cases and engage GMs, owners and commercial leaders to demonstrate the value of the service.
• Support hotel onboarding and ensure a smooth transition into the Revenue Services operating model.

Leadership and Team Development:

  • Provide leadership, coaching and technical guidance to PRM R&B colleagues and supporting team members.
    • Act as the escalation point for complex performance, stakeholder, data-quality and implementation issues.
    • Support recruitment, onboarding, training, talent development and succession planning for R&B revenue roles.
    • Build strong relationships with Hotel GMs, F&B leaders, regional commercial teams and owners.

Efficiency, Data and Innovation:

  • Continuously improve ways of working, reporting and team routines to increase productivity and service consistency.
    • Ensure reliable data, clear performance reporting and disciplined follow-up of revenue initiatives.
    • Use automation, AI and analytics to simplify recurring work, improve insight quality and allow the team to focus on higher-value activities.

Key Skills & Experiences

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Hospitality, Revenue Management, Business or a related field.
    • 10+ years of progressive hospitality, revenue management, commercial strategy or F&B leadership experience.
    • Experience leading complex R&B strategies in a hotel, cluster, portfolio or regional environment.
    • Proven ability to coach teams, influence senior stakeholders and build support for new commercial services.

Technical Skills and Knowledge:

  • Strong knowledge of R&B revenue management, forecasting, capacity optimization, pricing, menu engineering and profitability.
    • Advanced analytical, financial and commercial judgement.
    • Strong executive communication, influencing, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills.
    • Advanced Excel and presentation skills; knowledge of POS, reservation, reporting, AI and analytics platforms is advantageous.
    • Ability to simplify processes, improve productivity, lead projects and work effectively across cultures and functions.

deine mission:

Hast du Lust, mit uns gemeinsam die Nr. 1 im Balkonkraftwerk Space zu werden und unser Team auf neue Höhen zu katapultieren? Dabei bist du auf der Suche nach neuen Herausforderungen und legst Wert auf ein motiviertes Team mit richtig Feuer unterm Hintern?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Solakon schafft die Möglichkeit für jede und jeden, die eigenen Stromkosten, den Stromverbrauch und die Stromquelle selbst zu bestimmen und in die Hand zu nehmen. Und all das mit “Balkonkraftwerken” für den privaten Haushalt – und da das Geschäft boomt, sind wir auf der Suche nach motivierten neuen Teammitgliedern.

Egal ob Cold Calling, Direktvertrieb oder klassischer Telefonvertrieb, du weißt wie man verkauft und Kunden an eine Marke bindet. Das klingt nach deinem Skillset? Dann bewirb dich jetzt und baue unser Vertriebsteam von 0 auf 100% in einem der schnellst wachsenden Unternehmen Deutschlands auf.

Immer mehr Menschen interessieren sich für Balkonkraftwerke und Stromspeicher, viele davon zum ersten Mal. Bevor sie kaufen, wollen sie gut beraten werden. Unser Telefonteam bei unserem Partner im Kosovo kümmert sich heute schon um Service und Kaufberatung. Daraus entsteht jetzt ein eigenes Sales-Team mit zunächst 5 bis 10 Sales Agents und Potenzial für mehr. Du baust dieses Team auf, machst es stark und verantwortest seine Ergebnisse. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserer Geschäftsführung und unserem Customer Success Team zusammen.

das sind deine aufgaben:

  • Du baust dein Team von null auf: Gemeinsam mit unserem Partner im Kosovo findest du passende Sales Mitarbeiter und stellst ein Team zusammen, das verkaufen will
  • Du machst aus Beratern Verkäufer: Du schulst die Agents, coachst sie mit Gesprächsanalysen und direktem Feedback und trainierst Einwände in Rollenspielen, bis der Abschluss sitzt
  • Du schreibst unser Sales Playbook: Von der Bedarfsanalyse über die passende Lösung bis zum Abschluss entwickelst du unsere Gesprächsleitfäden selbst, testest sie in der Praxis und verbesserst sie laufend anhand der Ergebnisse
  • Du verantwortest die Zahlen: Abschlussquote, Umsatz und Gesprächsqualität. Du definierst die Projektziele gemeinsam mit unserem Partner, misst die Ergebnisse und drehst an den richtigen Stellschrauben
  • Du prägst, wie Solakon verkauft: Unsere Kampagnen bringen Anfragen, du sorgst dafür, dass daraus Umsatz wird. Dafür arbeitest du eng mit Geschäftsführung, Marketing und Customer Success zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen ein

  • Du bist dort, wo es zählt: Rund eine Woche im Monat bist du beim Sales-Team im Kosovo, für Trainings, Recruiting und die Abstimmung mit unserem Partner

das bringst du mit:

  • Du bist eine Verkaufsmaschine: Du hast mehrere Jahre am Telefon oder im Direktvertrieb verkauft und Zahlen geliefert. Ob mit Studium, Ausbildung oder als Quereinsteiger ist uns egal. Entscheidend ist, dass du abschließt
  • Du machst andere besser: Du hast schon Kollegen eingearbeitet, gecoacht oder ein Team angeleitet und weißt, wie man Verkaufen beibringt
  • Zahlen treiben dich an: Du weißt jederzeit, wo du mit deinem Team stehst, und willst jeden Monat besser werden
  • Du baust lieber auf, als zu verwalten: Du übernimmst Verantwortung, ohne dass jemand danach fragt, und willst Ergebnisse, die deine Handschrift tragen
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch ist für dich Standard: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch, denn das Team berät unsere Kunden und Kundinnen in Deutschland
  • Reisebereitschaft gehört für dich dazu: Eine Woche im Monat im Kosovo ist für dich Teil des Jobs, kein Hindernis
  • Großes Plus: Du hast schon Photovoltaik, Balkonkraftwerke, Stromspeicher oder Energie verkauft. Wenn nicht: Das Produktwissen bringen wir dir bei

was wir dir bieten:

  • Aufbau statt Verwaltung: Du startest bei null und baust ein Team auf, das deine Handschrift trägt
  • Volle Verantwortung, kurze Wege: Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung, dadurch fallen Entscheidungen sehr schnell
  • Wachstum, das man spürt:Als FOCUS Wachstumschampion 2026 wachsen wir schnell. Durch das, was du aufbaust, wachsen wir gemeinsam weiter
  • Attraktives Gehalt: Wir bieten dir eine attraktive Vergütung, die Details besprechen wir im persönlichen Gespräch. Dazu Corporate Benefits, Wellpass und regelmäßige Teamevents
  • Flexibler Arbeitsort: Du arbeitest remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder in unserem Büro in Schwäbisch Hall, mit neuester Apple-Technik

Job Summary and Responsibilities

This system-level role is responsible for the management and oversight of facility payor enrollments, including governmental (e.g., Medicare, Medicaid) health plans. Responsibilities include the review, analysis, coordination, and submission of enrollment data required for all CommonSpirit Health providers and facilities.While enrollment requirements vary across payors, this role ensures standardized, accurate, and timely enrollment processes across government entities.

This position focuses primarily on facility-level enrollments; however, it may support individual provider enrollments when necessary to ensure operational continuity and revenue integrity.

  • Provide oversight and execution of facility payor enrollments across governmental payor, including Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care/health plans.
  • Coordinate and complete end-to-end enrollment processes, including data collection, application completion, submission (manual and electronic), and follow-up for both government payors.
  • Partner with facility leadership, operational teams, third-party vendors, and payor representatives to collect, validate, and confirm accuracy of enrollment information to meet submission timelines and requirements.
  • Submit completed applications to designated Authorized/Delegated Officials for review and approval in accordance with internal governance and payor requirements.
  • Collaborate with governmental contractors to resolve enrollment requirements, deficiencies, and requests for additional information.
  • Gain and maintain proficiency in government enrollment systems (e.g., PECOS, PAVE) and credentialing platforms to manage enrollment workflows.

Job Requirements

Required

  • Bachelors Other Bachelor Admin degree in Finance, Accounting or Finance concentration preferred but not required
  • (Four to Six) 4-6 years Minimum of five (5) years of current progressive experience in a healthcare environment, with government enrollments background.

Where You’ll Work

Inspired by faith. Driven by innovation. Powered by humankindness. CommonSpirit Health is building a healthier future for all through its integrated health services. As one of the nation’s largest nonprofit Catholic healthcare organizations, CommonSpirit Health delivers more than 20 million patient encounters annually through more than 2,300 clinics, care sites and 137 hospital-based locations, in addition to its home-based services and virtual care offerings. CommonSpirit has more than 157,000 employees, 45,000 nurses and 25,000 physicians and advanced practice providers across 24 states and contributes more than $4.2 billion annually in charity care, community benefits and unreimbursed government programs. Together with our patients, physicians, partners, and communities, we are creating a more just, equitable, and innovative healthcare delivery system.

Job Description

Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

Owens & Minor is looking for a Senior SOC Analyst to investigate and respond to cyber threats. This position is the Level 2 escalation point for SOC Analysts and is responsible for in-depth investigation of escalated alerts, determining whether activity constitutes an incident, performing initial containment, and handing off confirmed incidents to Incident Response with complete context. This is a 24x7 shift environment and may require first, second, and third shift availability on weekdays, weekends, and holidays.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Investigate alerts escalated by SOC Analysts and determine scope, impact, and whether they constitute an incident
  • Perform initial containment actions (e.g., host isolation, account disablement, blocking indicators) following documented procedures
  • Escalate confirmed and high-severity incidents to Incident Response with complete evidence, timeline, and context
  • Review the quality and accuracy of SOC Analyst triage and escalations, and provide feedback
  • Identify false positives and noisy detections and recommend tuning to Detection Engineering
  • Generate scheduled and ad-hoc reports on investigations, trends, and SOC activity

SUPPLEMENTAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Performs additional duties as directed.
  • Effectively accomplishes set goals while primarily working in a remote capacity.
  • Collaborate with peers, team leads, and other security teams on investigations and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor SOC Analysts and Junior SOC Analysts on investigation techniques and tools.
  • Act as shift point of contact in the absence of the SOC Lead when required.

Qualifications

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • 4-6 years of experience in Information Technology or Information Security
  • At least 2 years of experience in a Security Operations Center or security monitoring role

KNOWLEDGE SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Strong understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and its use in investigations
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, ports, and protocols (DNS, HTTP/S, SMB, SMTP, TLS) and network traffic analysis
  • Strong understanding of Windows and Linux/Unix platforms, Active Directory, process execution, auditing, and logging
  • Strong understanding of SIEM log analysis and queries, and of EDR detections, process trees, and telemetry
  • Experience with Rapid7 InsightIDR (SIEM) and CrowdStrike Falcon (EDR) is preferred
  • Strong understanding of techniques to investigate phishing, credential theft, malware, ransomware, and suspicious user activity
  • Ability to analyze email headers, URLs, and attachments, and to use sandboxes and threat intelligence sources
  • Understanding of the incident response lifecycle (NIST SP 800-61)
  • Ability to prioritize multiple active investigations and make sound decisions under pressure
  • Strong analytical and critical observation skills
  • Strong written and oral communication skills, including clear incident documentation
  • Scripting skills (Python, PowerShell, Bash) are a plus

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform in-depth investigations across SIEM, EDR, email, identity, network, and cloud data sources
  • Build incident timelines and document findings, evidence, and actions in the case management system
  • Execute and improve playbooks and SOPs based on lessons learned
  • Perform threat-intelligence-driven searches for indicators of compromise across the environment
  • Support Incident Response during major incidents with investigation and containment tasks
  • Recommend detection improvements and automation opportunities
  • Stay informed about emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and industry trends, and share relevant updates with the team

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Work closely with team members, IT staff, and other departments to address security concerns.
  • Participate in SOC team meetings, training sessions, and exercises.
  • Desired certifications: CompTIA CySA+, GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), Blue Team Level 2 (BTL2), or CrowdStrike CCFR.

jobs.description:
Job Summary and Responsibilities

As our Revenue Cycle CDI Specialist, you will serve as a vital clinical partner dedicated to enhancing the accuracy and integrity of inpatient medical records. You will play a pivotal role in ensuring that provider documentation effectively captures the severity of illness, expected risk of mortality, and complexity of care for every patient. By bridging the gap between clinical teams, quality departments, and coding professionals, you will drive excellence in DRG assignment and support the overall financial health of CommonSpirit Health through compliant, high-quality documentation practices.

Every day you will conduct thorough medical record reviews for your assigned patient population, performing initial evaluations within 24–48 hours of admission and executing systematic follow-ups to maintain precise working DRG assignments. You will utilize your clinical expertise to formulate compliant provider queries that clarify missing or conflicting information while adhering to strict AHIMA and ACDIS guidelines. Additionally, you will serve as a front-line educator, providing guidance to physicians, nursing staff, and allied health practitioners to ensure continuous improvement in clinical documentation standards.

To be successful in this role, you will need a deep understanding of Official Coding and Reporting Guidelines, AHA Coding Clinics, and current CMS directives. You must be a proactive collaborator who excels at building professional relationships with HIM coding teams and providing constructive feedback to providers. Your ability to translate complex clinical data into actionable documentation, combined with your comfort in presenting to diverse groups and troubleshooting technical issues in a remote environment, will be key to your success and to the achievement of our enterprise-wide clinical documentation goals.

  • Perform timely initial and follow-up medical record reviews to ensure accurate DRG assignment, risk of mortality, and severity of illness.
  • Author and manage compliant provider queries to resolve documentation gaps, adhering to national AHIMA and ACDIS standards.
  • Educate multi-disciplinary care teams on documentation best practices to ensure clear and comprehensive clinical representation.
  • Collaborate closely with HIM Coding Professionals to facilitate seamless documentation-to-coding workflows and DRG reconciliation.
  • Maintain expert-level knowledge of evolving coding guidelines, CMS directives, and industry-wide CDI trends.
  • Demonstrate strong oral communication and presentation skills to lead educational sessions and engage effectively with clinical leadership.

Job Requirements

Required

  • Bachelor of Nursing and/or Bachelor’s degree in Nursing, or HIM
  • Two (2) years’ acute care hospital clinical CDI experience
  • Two (2) years’ experience inpatient coding auditor
  • Registered Nurse:XX (RN:XX)

Preferred

  • CAC experience (Computer Assistant Coding)
  • Experience with various encoder and EMR systems (Optum eCAC, Solventum, EPIC, Cerner, Meditech)
  • Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT)
  • Clinical Documentation Improvement Professional (CDIP)
  • Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)

Where You’ll Work

Inspired by faith. Driven by innovation. Powered by humankindness. CommonSpirit Health is building a healthier future for all through its integrated health services. As one of the nation’s largest nonprofit Catholic healthcare organizations, CommonSpirit Health delivers more than 20 million patient encounters annually through more than 2,300 clinics, care sites and 137 hospital-based locations, in addition to its home-based services and virtual care offerings. CommonSpirit has more than 157,000 employees, 45,000 nurses and 25,000 physicians and advanced practice providers across 24 states and contributes more than $4.2 billion annually in charity care, community benefits and unreimbursed government programs. Together with our patients, physicians, partners, and communities, we are creating a more just, equitable, and innovative healthcare delivery system.

jobs.excerpt: L’école d’art appliqué EDAA, établissement privé d’enseignement à distance, crée une nouvelle formation complète en motion design.
jobs.description:
L’école d’art appliqué EDAA, établissement privé d’enseignement à distance, crée une nouvelle formation complète en motion design.

Notre ambition : permettre aux élèves d’apprendre à concevoir et à réaliser des projets animés, en comprenant les choix créatifs, les étapes de fabrication et les exigences d’une commande professionnelle.

Nous recherchons un ou une motion designer senior pour concevoir la direction artistique et la narration des projets de référence de la formation et transmettre sa démarche à des débutants.

🚀Vos missions

En collaboration avec le coordinateur pédagogique, vous construisez les supports qui permettront aux élèves de passer d’un message à un récit visuel, puis à un projet prêt à être animé.

Vous serez chargé de :

  • Vous appuyer sur un spot et une affiche existants pour en expliquer la conception, les choix graphiques et la construction narrative.

  • Piloter la direction artistique et la narration d’un générique et d’une vidéo explicative, en collaboration avec l’animateur ou l’animatrice.

  • Concevoir les moodboards, croquis, storyboards, images clés et animatiques nécessaires à ces projets.

  • Produire les illustrations et supports visuels, puis livrer des fichiers Photoshop ou Illustrator en calques, organisés pour leur reprise en animation.

  • Rédiger les études de cas et relire les contenus de cours relevant de votre expertise pour en valider la justesse et la clarté.

  • Enregistrer des démonstrations de création commentées, en expliquant vos choix, vos essais et vos ajustements.

  • Concevoir les exercices et devoirs de graphisme et de narration, leurs références de correction et leurs critères d’évaluation. Définir avec l’animateur ou l’animatrice les critères des projets communs.

  • Apporter des exemples professionnels commentés : devis, plannings, retours client et présentation d’un portfolio.

Profil et compétences recherchés

Vous avez porté la direction artistique de projets de commande, en studio, en agence ou en indépendant. Vous savez préciser votre contribution personnelle, du brief à la présentation au client et aux ajustements de livraison.

Vous savez traduire un message en récit visuel et proposer plusieurs interprétations créatives. Vous maîtrisez le passage du moodboard au storyboard, aux images clés et à l’animatique. Une expérience de la vidéo explicative, du générique ou de l’identité animée est particulièrement pertinente.

Vous maîtrisez la composition et l’illustration pour l’animation : hiérarchie visuelle, typographie, couleur, silhouettes, personnages simples et décors. Vous savez préparer des fichiers sources exploitables par un animateur.

Vous savez estimer un projet, expliquer un arbitrage artistique et rendre votre démarche accessible à un débutant, à l’écrit comme lors d’une démonstration commentée. Une expérience de tutorat, de formation ou de présentation de projets est appréciée.

L’EDAA intègre les outils d’intelligence artificielle lorsque leur usage est pertinent. Nous souhaitons pouvoir échanger sur votre pratique ou votre position à leur égard, leurs apports, leurs limites et leur place dans l’apprentissage de la création.

Modalités

  • Statut : freelance / indépendant.

  • Format : 100 % à distance, avec des points de cadrage et de suivi réguliers.

  • Livrables : supports écrits et visuels, sources éditables, rushs commentés organisés par chapitre et rendus de référence.

  • Production vidéo : vous assurez la captation de votre écran et de votre voix. L’EDAA prend en charge le montage et l’habillage des vidéos et peut mettre les présentations à la charte de l’école.

  • Volume, calendrier et rémunération : à définir selon le périmètre de la mission. Vous devez être disponible rapidement.

Pour candidater

Merci de nous transmettre votre portfolio, en précisant votre rôle sur les projets présentés, vos disponibilités et, si vous en disposez, un exemple de démonstration ou de contenu pédagogique.

L’entretien permettra d’échanger sur votre démarche créative, vos conditions d’enregistrement et les ressources que vous pourriez mettre à disposition des élèves.

Vous souhaitez transmettre votre expérience et contribuer à la création d’une formation.

jobs.excerpt: A Smollan Digital Commerce é uma unidade especializada em acelerar crescimento e rentabilidade nos canais digitais, conectando estratégia, execução e tecnologia para operações D2C, B2B, marketplaces e retail media.
jobs.description:
A Smollan Digital Commerce é uma unidade especializada em acelerar crescimento e rentabilidade nos canais digitais, conectando estratégia, execução e tecnologia para operações D2C, B2B, marketplaces e retail media. Com atuação integrada, foco em performance e decisões orientadas por dados, apoiamos marcas a escalar sua presença digital com consistência e excelência operacional.

Parte do grupo Smollan, presente em mais de 65 países e com mais de 85 mil colaboradores, combinamos alcance global com expertise local para entregar soluções completas de digital commerce. Nosso diferencial está na conexão entre o físico e o digital, tornando a jornada omnichannel mais eficiente e gerando resultados concretos para os nossos clientes.

Buscamos um(a) arquiteto(a) com profundidade em integração, mensageria e APIs para redesenhar a camada que conecta o Adobe Commerce a mais de 130 distribuidores, SAPBTP e parceiros de pagamento, crédito e catálogo.

Missão do cargo

Desenhar e governar a arquitetura em torno do Adobe Commerce e ser o interlocutor técnico da liderança de tecnologia nas decisões de solução. No discovery, responde pelaleitura técnica da camada de integração e pelo desenho da arquitetura alvo.

Responsabilidades

  • Mapear a arquitetura de integração ponta a ponta e identificar as dependênciascríticas.
  • Analisar o comportamento das filas, a duplicidade de processamento e os gargalos de capacidade.
  • Desenhar a camada de governança: controle de taxa (rate limiting), disjuntores (circuit breakers) e priorização por nível de serviço (SLA).
  • Especificar o identificador de correlação fim a fim e o produto de API com contratos próprios.
  • Definir o critério do que sai do core como serviço satélite.
  • Dimensionar cada frente do projeto em esforço e perfis.
  • Desenhar a camada de integração: SAP BTP, Solace e Backend For Frontend (BFF).
  • Definir contratos de API próprios, com versionamento e depreciação estruturada.
  • Definir a estratégia de controle de carga, limitação de taxa e disjuntores.
  • Definir a normalização e validação de SKUs e arquivos antes do processamento.
  • Desenhar os serviços satélites e manter o critério do que sai do core.
  • Especificar o identificador de correlação junto com as frentes de observabilidade e de mAdobe Commerce.
  • Identificar novos projetos a partir dos achados e dimensioná-los em perfis e esforço.
  • Apoiar a liderança técnica em decisões de solução, documentando-as (ex.: ADRs).
  • Experiência sólida como arquiteto(a) de soluções ou de integração, com histórico de
  • desenho de arquitetura alvo em ambientes complexos (referência: 5+ anos em TI, 3+ em arquitetura).
  • Arquitetura de integração e mensageria: filas, pub/sub, idempotência, deduplicação, retry, dead-letter queue e backpressure.
  • Padrões de resiliência: rate limiting, circuit breaker, bulkhead, priorização por SLA.
  • Desenho de APIs e contratos (REST, OpenAPI; GraphQL desejável), com versionamento, depreciação e governança de API como produto.
  • SAP BTP (Integration Suite / CPI, API Management) aplicado a integrações reais.
  • Comércio B2B em escala: múltiplos distribuidores, catálogo e preços por cliente, crédito, pedidos em volume.
  • Conhecimento do Adobe Commerce (Magento 2) como sistema: APIs, filas internas, indexação, limites de carga e pontos de extensão. Não precisa ser especialista, mas precisa entendê-lo bem para decidir o que sai dele.
  • Observabilidade distribuída: correlation ID, tracing e métricas de integração.
  • Capacidade de dimensionar projetos em esforço e perfis de equipe.
  • Experiência em interlocução com liderança técnica e de negócio.

Informações adicionais

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Solace PubSub+ ou brokers similares (Kafka, RabbitMQ, AzureService Bus).
  • Adobe Commerce Cloud: Fastly, PWA Studio, B2B module.
  • Padrão Backend For Frontend (BFF) e decomposição de monólitos em serviçossatélites.
  • Integração com PIM (Akeneo), gateways de pagamento () e plataformas decrédito.
  • Canais conversacionais (ex.: YALO / WhatsApp commerce).
  • OpenTelemetry, New Relic ou ferramentas equivalentes de APM.
  • Certificações: SAP BTP, Adobe Commerce Architect, TOGAF ou cloud (AWS / Azure /GCP).
  • Vivência em consultoria ou em projetos de diagnóstico e reestruturação.

Nossos benefícios:

💳 Cartão Flash: Saldo flexível para VA/VR e premiações.

🏋️ TotalPass: Acesso a academias e saúde mental.

🤝 Alle Zusammen: Bônus por indicação de novos talentos.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Alliance Executive
jobs.excerpt: Workiva is expanding its alliances with the world's leading consulting and systems integration firms, and this role is central to that growth.
jobs.description:
Workiva is expanding its alliances with the world's leading consulting and systems integration firms, and this role is central to that growth. The Senior Strategic Alliance Executive owns Workiva's relationships with a portfolio of strategic global GSI partners and is responsible for turning each one into a scalable engine for pipeline, bookings, and joint customer success.


You will build the strategy, joint business plans, and executive relationships that put Workiva at the center of each partner's finance transformation, sustainability, and risk and compliance work. You will work equally well with partners' senior leaders and field teams, and with Workiva's sellers, services, product, and marketing teams. The right person is a credible, relationship-driven alliance leader who understands how GSIs make decisions, how they're incented, and how to get a software vendor onto their priority list.


What You'll Do


Own the partner relationships and strategy

  • Develop and execute a joint business plan with each partner, including targets, priority practices and solutions, target accounts, and investment areas
  • Build and sustain executive relationships, and create extensive networks at both the field and executive levels
  • Own the governance rhythm for each partner, including quarterly business reviews and regular executive updates for Workiva and partner leadership
  • Evangelize Workiva within each partner's key practices, such as Finance Transformation, ESG and Sustainability, and Risk and Compliance
  • Prioritize your time and investment across partners based on opportunity and momentum

Drive pipeline and revenue

  • Source partner-led opportunities and drive partner-influenced pipeline, working with Workiva sellers to qualify, develop, and close
  • Lead and optimize sell-to, sell-with, and sell-through strategies
  • Conduct account mapping and whitespace analysis across partners' client bases and ours to find the right joint opportunities
  • Run joint opportunity reviews and customer engagements with partner teams and Workiva sales
  • Keep an accurate pipeline in CRM and report clearly on progress against targets

Build joint offerings and go-to-market

  • Co-develop joint value propositions and offerings with partners' practice leaders
  • Build the go-to-market plan with each partner, including joint marketing (content, webinars, events), reference architectures, and alignment of product and services
  • Work with Workiva Services, Product, and Customer Success so delivery quality supports repeat business

Enable and activate

  • Recruit, certify, and enable partner practitioners and sellers, and build delivery excellence across partners' teams
  • Coordinate with regional alliance and channel counterparts so partner priorities are supported across geographies

Measure and report

  • Define and report on alliance KPIs by partner, including partner-sourced and influenced pipeline, bookings, joint wins, certified practitioners, and partner engagement

What Success Looks Like


First 90 days: You have met the key partner and Workiva stakeholders, assessed the current state of each relationship, and aligned on joint business plans with agreed targets.


First 12 months: A repeatable motion is in place with each partner, including measurable growth in sourced and influenced pipeline and bookings, a growing base of certified practitioners, and an operating rhythm with executives on both sides.


What You'll Need


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of strategic partner, alliance, or channel experience in software or SaaS
  • Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of knowledge and related career experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing multiple strategic partner relationships at once
  • Prior experience managing and scaling partnerships with at least one global GSI or consulting firm, or experience working inside one
  • Proven success meeting and exceeding targets through partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue
  • Demonstrated ability to build and manage strategic partnerships across matrixed organizations
  • Strong executive-level communication and presentation skills
  • Familiarity with partners' practices in finance transformation, ESG and sustainability, or risk and compliance
  • Background in enterprise SaaS, ERP, or financial and compliance technology
  • Experience building joint offerings and go-to-market programs with GSIs
  • Understanding of the independence and compliance considerations that apply when working with professional services firms
  • Self-motivated, resourceful, and adaptable, with strong judgment and integrity
  • Inclusive and collaborative, driving teamwork and cross-team alignment

Travel Requirement & Working Conditions


  • Up to 30% travel for partner and customer meetings and events
  • Reliable internet access required for any period of time working remotely and not in a Workiva office
Workiva will not provide visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. on a permanent basis.

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ On Target Earnings (OTE) range in the US: 222,000.00 - 360,000.00 USD Annual

✅ Eligible for commission based on sales performance

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.

Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email .

Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.

Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.

jobs.title: Associate, Executive Leadership Programs
jobs.excerpt: About Metis Strategy Metis Strategy, a management and strategy consulting firm, focused on the intersection of business and technology, continues to grow and is looking for highly motivated individuals to join our San Francisco Bay Area team.
jobs.description:
About Metis Strategy

Metis Strategy, a management and strategy consulting firm, focused on the intersection of business and technology, continues to grow and is looking for highly motivated individuals to join our San Francisco Bay Area team. We are trusted advisors to Fortune 500 and Global 1000 companies, helping them meet their most critical business objectives through tailored engagements and deep professional relationships. We work across industries on topics related to business & digital strategy and navigating organizational change.

We are an entrepreneurial, fast-growing firm headquartered in the Washington, D.C. area with offices in the San Francisco Bay Area and Dallas, Texas. The firm’s presence from coast to coast allows us to serve clients throughout the United States and internationally. In our 20+ year history, we have established a track record of making lasting impacts on organizational performance and helping executives improve business outcomes. In a career with Metis Strategy you will experience high growth as you encounter new challenges with each client engagement; have a high degree of autonomy to craft the direction of your work; and become empowered to work directly with thought-leaders, C-level clients, and other decision-makers.

Responsibilities of an Associate

The Associate will work across our executive networks, Technology Leadership Institute, and Metis Strategy Summit, combining research, content development, participant engagement, and program execution.

Research, content development, and participant engagement

  • Conduct bespoke research for executives on topics they are actively working on, translating findings into concise, practical materials for a senior audience.
  • Facilitate connections across the Metis Strategy ecosystem by identifying members with complementary challenges, relevant experience, or shared priorities.
  • Build familiarity with members and participants over time, track their priorities and interests, and help identify opportunities for relevant content, connections, and engagement.
  • Review and synthesize notes, recordings, and materials from executive network meetings, leadership trainings, conferences, and other executive interactions into clear themes, questions, and insights.
  • Develop and organize materials for executive network meetings, including discussion guides, research briefs, agendas, and participant materials, working collaboratively with facilitators and program leads.
  • Draw on the firm's research, consulting engagements, and executive conversations to strengthen program content and participant deliverables, while routing relevant insights from executive settings back to teams across the firm.

Program development and execution

  • Contribute to Summit agenda development, including topic framing, session structure, speaker research, and recommendations about how executives should be grouped.
  • Draft and coordinate communications across the Summit cycle, from speaker outreach to attendee correspondence.
  • Develop session content, participant materials, and pre-work for the Technology Leadership Institute, our training program serving CIO direct reports, and support ongoing engagement with participants after the program concludes.
  • Help plan executive network meetings, including identifying discussion topics, shaping agendas, preparing facilitator materials, and coordinating participant needs.

Building and scaling the portfolio

  • These programs are meant to get bigger and better, and building them is part of the job. You will research prospective members, participants, speakers, and sponsors; develop materials that support growth conversations; test new program formats; and analyze participation, engagement, and feedback to identify what should change.
  • Approximately 30–35% of the role is operational, with that share increasing around major events. Responsibilities include speaker logistics, meeting and event preparation, and the creation of sponsorship materials. We expect you to bring rigor to this work while identifying repetitive tasks that can be automated using firm-supported AI tools.

Qualifications and Expectations

  • 2–6 years of post-undergraduate professional experience, ideally including substantive research, writing, or program work for senior executive audiences.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information technology, communications, or a related field
  • Demonstrated experience researching, writing about, or supporting work related to enterprise technology, digital strategy, AI, data, cybersecurity, or technology leadership for a senior audience.
  • Strong interest in technology leadership and genuine curiosity about how senior technology leaders think, decide, and prioritize.
  • Experience with C-level events is a plus
  • Strong proficiency with presentation and spreadsheet applications such as PowerPoint and Excel, as well as regular use of leading AI platforms such as Claude or ChatGPT. Experience with a CRM system and data visualization tools is a plus
  • Day-to-day, we work fully remotely, though occasional travel will be required. We also value time when we can get together as a team and host regular in-person offsites to maintain our collaborative culture
  • Work status: Eligibility to work in the U.S. without sponsorship is preferred

What We Look For

  • Leadership: Confidence balanced with humility, sound judgment, creativity, and empathy, with the maturity to work effectively alongside senior colleagues and executives.
  • Communication Skills: Ability to communicate complex ideas concisely, tailored appropriately for different audiences (executive to operational) and media (presentations, white papers, emails, etc.)
  • Problem Solving: Innovative problem-solving skills and entrepreneurial spirit, with the ability to turn ideas into action in pursuit of personal, team, and firm growth targets
  • Relationship Orientation: Willingness to learn from, and collaborate with, others to build strong relationships with clients and team members
  • Curiosity: Deep interest in enterprise technology and how senior leaders make decisions. We want someone who treats AI as a thought partner rather than a substitute for thinking and who can tell when its output is thin, wrong, or generic.

What Metis Strategy Has to Offer

Associates in this role gain exposure to senior technology leaders from Fortune 500 and Global 1000 companies through our executive networks, leadership programs, and Summits, while developing skills in research, writing, executive programming, and communication. Successful candidates will be motivated by the desire to make a difference by helping expand the Metis Strategy ecosystem, helping our clients achieve and maintain strategic and operational excellence, and continuously improving their own skill set.

This position is also eligible for bonus compensation. Additional benefits include but are not limited to:

  • comprehensive medical insurance, dental insurance, and vision insurance;
  • parental leave and family benefits;
  • retirement contributions;
  • stipend for continued learning;
  • paid time off, and more.

Compensation and benefits are competitive and will be commensurate with each candidate's qualifications and relevant work experience.

If you want to help design insightful experiences for technology leaders at some of the world’s biggest companies, you will enjoy being part of our team.
