We are seeking a Director of Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) Growth-E-Commerce to lead the strategy and execution of our direct-to-consumer business across current and future Shopify brand websites. This individual will be responsible for driving profitable revenue growth, expanding customer acquisition and improving customer retention across our D2C channels. The ideal candidate will bring a strong background in consumer products and hands-on experience growing ecommerce brands, with the ability to balance strategic direction with day-to-day operational execution.

This role will have significant ownership over the D2C business, including site performance, product assortment, digital marketing campaigns, CRM strategy, affiliate partnerships and conversion optimization. Working closely with marketing, analytics, operations and external agency partners, the Director will use data and customer insights to identify growth opportunities, improve profitability and deliver measurable results. This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded ecommerce leader who thrives on ownership, enjoys building and scaling digital businesses, and can translate strategy and analytics into meaningful business growth.

Responsibilities

  • Own the direct-to-consumer growth plan for our current and future Shopify brand sites and deliver the annual targets for sales, margin and customer acquisition.
  • Set and justify the D2C assortment: which products, bundles, pack sizes and accessories sell on each site, and when new items launch.
  • Run day-to-day Shopify operations: merchandising, navigation, checkout, site speed, tracking, and the app and plugin stack. Direct the agency and developer partners who support the sites.
  • Build the CRM and customer development strategy, including email and SMS lifecycle programs (welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, win-back), customer segmentation, and repeat-purchase and dealer reorder programs.
  • Plan and coordinate D2C campaigns, promotions and seasonal events with brand marketing, creative and paid media partners.
  • Work with analytics counterparts to run a post-mortem on every promotion and campaign. Measure lift, incremental sales and margin, and use the results to set the next calendar.
  • Manage the affiliate program: partner recruitment, commission structure, tracking and payout, and performance against target.
  • Run conversion testing on landing pages, product pages and checkout, and roll out what wins.
  • Report weekly on D2C traffic, conversion, order value, customer acquisition cost and lifetime value, and explain what moved and why.
  • Work with operations and customer service on fulfillment, shipping and returns policy, and replacement parts.
  • Manage the D2C budget and agency scopes, and hold partners to agreed results.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years in consumer products, including at least 2 years directly involved with the management of a D2C brand.
  • A record of growing D2C revenue profitably through acquisition, conversion and retention.
  • Experience running email and SMS lifecycle programs on Klaviyo or a similar platform.
  • Experience measuring promotions and campaigns for incremental sales, not only attributed sales.
  • Comfortable with GA4 and Shopify analytics; builds promotion business cases and reads a P&L in Excel.
  • Experience directing agencies, developers and affiliate networks against clear targets.
  • Clear writer who turns data into a recommendation leadership can act on.
  • Data-driven and comfortable performing analysis. Experienced with an interested in applications of AI.
  • Takes ownership: makes decisions with incomplete information and follows through.

Job Summary and Responsibilities

As our System Director, Physician Enterprise (PE) Revenue Cycle (RC) Epic Gold, you will serve as the strategic lead for physician professional billing technology, overseeing the end-to-end optimization of Epic RCM modules across a complex healthcare enterprise. You will be responsible for spearheading Epic Go-Lives, ensuring system stability, and driving the adoption of Epic Gold standards to maximize revenue capture and streamline financial workflows. By bridging the gap between clinical operations and IT infrastructure, you will ensure that all system configurations are aligned with organizational goals and regulatory compliance.

Every day you will lead and empower a high-performing team of Epic Program Managers, providing the mentorship and guidance necessary to navigate complex system implementations and operational challenges. You will facilitate cross-functional collaboration with department heads and executive stakeholders, acting as the primary escalation point for critical billing issues. Your daily focus will involve managing project timelines, monitoring operational readiness, and refining revenue cycle processes to improve both cash flow and the overall patient financial experience.

To be successful in this role, you will leverage your deep expertise in Epic modules—such as Resolute Professional Billing, Cadence, and Prelude—to drive continuous improvement and system-wide standardization. You will possess strong project management capabilities, a proven ability to lead large-scale clinical information system deployments, and the leadership skills to cultivate an inclusive, responsive governance culture. Your analytical mindset and commitment to performance metrics will be essential as you guide the Physician Enterprise toward sustainable, high-efficiency revenue cycle operations.

Job Requirements

Key Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or 4 years of equivalent experience, with the requirement to obtain Epic Certification within 90 days of hire.
  • Expertise in Epic Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) modules, including Resolute Professional Billing, Cadence, and Prelude.
  • Proven track record of managing large-scale Epic Go-Lives and post-live system optimizations within a physician enterprise.
  • Strong leadership experience in directing teams, managing performance, and fostering a culture of continuous process improvement.
  • Ability to develop and enforce robust governance frameworks to ensure system standardization and regulatory compliance.
  • Strategic capability to align technical Epic system capabilities with financial objectives to reduce denials and accelerate cash flow.

Where You’ll Work

Inspired by faith. Driven by innovation. Powered by humankindness. CommonSpirit Health is building a healthier future for all through its integrated health services. As one of the nation’s largest nonprofit Catholic healthcare organizations, CommonSpirit Health delivers more than 20 million patient encounters annually through more than 2,300 clinics, care sites and 137 hospital-based locations, in addition to its home-based services and virtual care offerings. CommonSpirit has more than 157,000 employees, 45,000 nurses and 25,000 physicians and advanced practice providers across 24 states and contributes more than $4.2 billion annually in charity care, community benefits and unreimbursed government programs. Together with our patients, physicians, partners, and communities, we are creating a more just, equitable, and innovative healthcare delivery system.

The Sr. Specialist, Advanced Analytics is an experienced individual contributor. You will draw on diverse data sources and select the analytical approaches best suited to each business question—including descriptive, statistical, predictive, and what-if analyses—to understand customer contacts, evaluate digital performance, and identify opportunities to deliver measurable business value. You will partner with product managers, business stakeholders, and related teams to analyze digital journeys, campaign performance, and customer behavior; taking a creative, proactive approach to uncovering defects and friction points and improvement opportunities. You will build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports tailored to different audiences and support ad hoc analytics requests. Strong communication skills are essential.

You will work with moderate autonomy and periodic review as part of a small team with a broad scope. You may lead smaller initiatives or own components of larger, cross-functional projects. Success requires close attention to detail, disciplined prioritization, and the ability to shift between business areas and analytical tasks while maintaining accuracy and follow-through. You will balance complex analysis with hands-on team support, including request tracking, recurring reporting, and follow-up on open tasks, while collaborating across teams to align priorities and move work forward.

Here’s what you’ll do:

Advanced Analytics

  • Use SQL, Python, Databricks, Snowflake, and Excel to access, combine, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources, selecting the data and methods best suited to each question.
  • Apply descriptive, statistical, predictive, and what-if analyses to evaluate digital journeys, campaign performance, customer behavior, and contact patterns.
  • Design and evaluate A/B tests, distinguish normal variation from meaningful changes, and assess the business significance of results.
  • Investigate defects and unexpected performance changes, and support rapid issue response with root cause analysis and impact estimates.
  • Document analytical methods, assumptions, data limitations, and validation results to support reliable decisions.

Business Partnership and Opportunity Analysis

  • Work directly with product managers to understand business goals, evaluate customer journeys, and translate questions into analytical plans and actionable roadmaps.
  • Define success metrics, establish baselines, forecast expected improvements, and connect project outcomes to business cases and measurable financial benefits.
  • Provide analysis and recommendations that support prioritization, go/no-go decisions, and assessment of results after launch.

Reporting, Automation, and Team Support

Who We Are:

We’re Cart.com, one of the fastest growing commerce enablement companies in the world. We provide the digital and physical infrastructure that empowers thousands of leading B2C, B2B and public sector organizations to unify commerce operations from product discovery to product delivery.


We’re building toward a world where commerce has no bounds. Our enterprise-grade software, services and logistics infrastructure, including our own network of omnichannel fulfillment and distribution centers, enable merchants to navigate an increasingly complex operating landscape and drive efficient growth.


Our goal is to be the global backbone of commerce. To achieve it, we’re looking for entrepreneurial, innovative and determined teammates who are eager to help our growing base of customers simplify their commerce operations and seamlessly reach their own customers, wherever they are. Sound like you? We’d love to hear from you.


Cart.com Fast Facts:

  • 6,000+ customers worldwide
  • 1,600+ employees globally
  • 17 warehouses nationwide, totaling over 10 million square feet of space
  • Headquartered in Houston, TX with international offices in Mexico and Poland
  • undefined

Our values:

Cart.com is building a company that is committed to living out these 6 core values:

  • Be brand obsessed: Our lives are shaped by the brands we interact with daily. We obsess over the brands we serve, and about the things they care about.
  • Think beyond the box: “We’ve always done it that way” is not a phrase uttered often at our office. We create creative solutions to complex problems.
  • Don’t give up: We learn from our challenges and see them for what they are; great building blocks to an amazing brand story.
  • Speak up: We communicate clearly and directly because we care deeply. Communication is the bedrock of our community.
  • Work together: We’ve built a team that prides itself on diversity of thought and background. Collaboration is better with contrast.
  • Remember to be human: We work hard, but we leave room for the people, places and things that we love.

AI is part of how we work, it’s not doing the hiring.

We'll use AI in parts of our process and we think you should feel free to use it too — for research, prep, whatever helps. But our interviews exist to meet you, not your best AI-assisted draft. Real people make every call here. Any questions about how this works, just ask.

The Role:

The Organic Social & Influencer Manager will own the strategy and day-to-day execution of organic social and influencer programs across a portfolio of agency clients, building communities, creator partnerships, and content that drive measurable brand and business results.


This role sits at the intersection of social strategy, creator relations, and client service, turning platform trends and audience insights into always-on content and influencer campaigns that perform.

What You’ll Do:

Organic Social Strategy & Content

  • Develop platform-specific organic social strategies for clients across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, Pinterest, and emerging channels, aligned with brand positioning and business goals.
  • Build and manage monthly content calendars, partnering with creative and design teams to brief, review, and approve assets.
  • Write and edit captions, hooks, and copy that fit each brand’s voice and each platform’s norms.
  • Monitor trends, cultural moments, and platform updates, and turn them into timely, on-brand content ideas.
  • Oversee community management, including engagement guidelines, response workflows, and escalation protocols.
  • undefined

Influencer & Creator Partnerships

  • Plan and execute influencer campaigns end to end: strategy, creator sourcing and vetting, outreach, negotiation, contracting, briefing, content approval, and payment.
  • Build and maintain a network of creators across tiers (nano to macro) and verticals relevant to client brands.
  • Ensure all creator content meets FTC disclosure requirements and client brand-safety standards.
  • Partner with paid media teams to identify top-performing organic and creator content for whitelisting, Spark Ads, and paid amplification.
  • Manage influencer budgets, deliverables, and timelines across multiple concurrent campaigns.

Measurement & Reporting

  • Define KPIs and track performance across reach, engagement, follower growth, sentiment, traffic, and conversions.
  • Build monthly and campaign-level reports that turn data into clear insights and recommendations for clients.
  • Design and run tests on content formats, posting cadence, and creator mix to continuously improve results.
  • Create and present campaign retrospectives for clients, identifying winning and losing elements and what’s next.

Client & Team Collaboration

  • Serve as the organic social and influencer point of contact for clients, presenting strategies and building trusted relationships.
  • Collaborate with creative, paid media, and account teams to deliver cohesive, integrated campaigns.
  • Help identify opportunities to use AI and social tools to increase efficiency, content volume, and insight quality.

Who You Are:

  • Working knowledge of FTC endorsement guidelines and brand-safety best practices.
  • Excellent written communication, copywriting, and presentation skills.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with e-commerce or DTC brands, TikTok Shop or affiliate programs, or creator whitelisting and paid social amplification.

jobs.excerpt: 📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden De organisatie realiseert infrastructuurprojecten voor de inzameling en zuivering van huishoudelijk afvalwater en optimaliseert bestaande netwerken en installaties.
jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

De organisatie realiseert infrastructuurprojecten voor de inzameling en zuivering van huishoudelijk afvalwater en optimaliseert bestaande netwerken en installaties. In deze omgeving komen gegevensbescherming, cyberweerbaarheid en de continuïteit van een essentiële dienst samen.

Over de job

Als DPO maak je deel uit van de compliance dienst. Je werkt nauw samen met de Compliance Manager en het CISO-team en krijgt ondersteuning van een deeltijdse Privacy Officer. Je bewaakt onafhankelijk dat persoonsgegevens rechtmatig, veilig en aantoonbaar worden verwerkt.

Je geeft advies, controleert de naleving en bent het aanspreekpunt voor de Gegevensbeschermingsautoriteit (GBA), de Vlaamse Toezichtcommissie (VTC) en betrokkenen. Je adviezen zijn beslissingsklaar: beknopt, onderbouwd en voorzien van een duidelijk voorstel met een afgebakende scope.

De maturiteit op het vlak van gegevensbescherming is de voorbije jaren sterk toegenomen. Je helpt de organisatie om deze werking verder uit te bouwen zonder medewerkers onnodig te belasten.

Als DPO ben je een partner voor operationele en ondersteunende departementen. Je bent aanspreekbaar voor medewerkers en bouwt proactief een intern netwerk uit om risico's rond gegevensbescherming tijdig te identificeren.

Daarnaast werk je aan een vertrouwensband met de verschillende stakeholders. Je brengt tegenstrijdige belangen en bezorgdheden samen en zoekt mee naar een pragmatische oplossing.

De rol start op twee dagen per week, in samenwerking met de huidige DPO. Na de overgangsperiode wordt dit uitgebreid naar drie dagen per week.

Kerntaken

  • DPIA en risicobeoordeling: je voert gegevensbeschermingseffectbeoordelingen (DPIA's) uit of begeleidt ze van scoping tot restrisico en voorstel van beslissing. Je beoordeelt nieuwe toepassingen, leveranciers en AI-functies vóór ingebruikname en formuleert de nodige scope, restricties en voorwaarden.
  • Rapportering aan het hoogste management: je brengt dossiers helder en beslissingsklaar voor het directiecomité en de raad van bestuur. Je maakt duidelijk wat het risico en het advies zijn en welke beslissing nodig is. Je rapporteert periodiek over naleving, incidenten en openstaande acties.
  • Datalekken: je leidt de afhandeling van datalekken, van triage en risicobeoordeling tot melding aan de GBA binnen 72 uur, communicatie met betrokkenen en lessons learned. Je houdt het incidentenregister bij en koppelt terug naar het NIS2-incidentproces.
  • Verwerkingsregister en contracten: je houdt het register van verwerkingsactiviteiten actueel. Je beoordeelt verwerkersovereenkomsten, subverwerkers, doorgiften buiten de EER, waaronder DPF, SCC's en TIA, en bewaartermijnen.
  • Operationele OT-omgeving: je kent de bijzonderheden van procesautomatisering, sensoren, toegangscontrole en camerabewaking op installaties. Je beoordeelt de verwerkingen die binnen deze omgeving plaatsvinden.
  • Overheidspartners: je begeleidt gegevensuitwisselingen met federale en Vlaamse overheidsinstanties, gemeenten en rioolbeheerders, inclusief protocollen en adviezen van de VTC.
  • Rechten van betrokkenen: je bent het aanspreekpunt voor verzoeken en klachten van betrokkenen en bewaakt de termijnen en kwaliteit van de antwoorden.
  • Bewustmaking en controle: je organiseert opleidingen en sensibilisering, voert interne controles en audits uit en volgt rechtspraak en richtsnoeren van de GBA, het EDPB en het HvJ-EU op. Je vertaalt deze naar de praktijk van de organisatie.

📝 Jouw profiel

Kennis en ervaring

  • Juridische en technische kennis: je hebt grondige kennis van de AVG (GDPR), de Belgische Kaderwet van 30 juli 2018, de Camerawet en de richtsnoeren van de GBA en het EDPB. Je beschikt over voldoende technisch inzicht in IT en OT om risico's zelfstandig in te schatten en op gelijke voet met architecten en securityverantwoordelijken te overleggen.
  • DPIA-ervaring: je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het uitvoeren en beoordelen van DPIA's, inclusief de inschatting van restrisico's en het formuleren van een voorstel van beslissing.
  • Kader voor kritieke diensten: je kent NIS2, de Belgische wet van 26 april 2024, de CER-richtlijn en de AI-verordening. Je begrijpt de raakvlakken met gegevensbescherming op het vlak van incidentmelding, leveranciersbeheer, risicobeheer en AI-governance.
  • Communicatie op het hoogste niveau: je vertaalt complexe dossiers naar een kort en helder advies voor het directiecomité en de raad van bestuur. Je schrijft vlot en precies Nederlands en werkt in het Engels met internationale leveranciers.
  • Incidentbeheer: je houdt het hoofd koel bij een datalek, neemt de regie en bewaakt de termijnen. Je kunt een incident tegelijk juridisch, technisch en communicatief inschatten.
  • Onafhankelijkheid en standvastigheid: je durft een negatief advies te geven en te onderbouwen, zonder de werking van de organisatie uit het oog te verliezen. Je zoekt naar een oplossing die het risico beheersbaar maakt in plaats van een project onnodig te blokkeren.
  • Ervaring: je hebt minstens vijf jaar relevante ervaring in gegevensbescherming, compliance of informatiebeveiliging, waarvan een deel als DPO of in een vergelijkbare adviesrol.
  • Opleiding: je hebt een masterdiploma in rechten, informatiemanagement, IT of een aanverwante richting, of gelijkwaardige ervaring.

Vaardigheden

  • Communicatievaardigheid: je past je communicatiestijl aan verschillende niveaus binnen de organisatie aan, van technisch medewerker tot directie, en vergroot zo het bewustzijn en begrip rond gegevensbescherming en privacy.
  • Stakeholdermanagement: je hebt oog voor de bezorgdheden van werknemers, vakbonden en directie en zoekt mee naar oplossingen die verschillende standpunten met elkaar verzoenen.
  • Analytisch vermogen: je analyseert privacy- en conformiteitsrisico's, brengt de impact ervan in kaart en vertaalt je bevindingen naar duidelijke prioriteiten en beslissingen.
  • Pragmatische aanpak: je werkt risico-gebaseerd en maakt een onderbouwde afweging tussen conformiteit en de kostprijs of werklast van maatregelen.
  • Coaching en verbindend werken: je begeleidt de Privacy Officer in haar groeitraject naar meer zelfstandigheid en helpt een efficiënte privacydienst uit te bouwen.

Pluspunten

  • Ervaring met het meldingsplatform van de GBA: je hebt ervaring met datalekmeldingen en de verdere opvolging ervan door de GBA.
  • Ervaring in de publieke sector: ervaring met Vlaamse overheidsinstanties is een pluspunt. Kennis van de VTC, het Bestuursdecreet, protocollen voor gegevensuitwisseling en de Vlaamse e-governmentpraktijk, waaronder Digitaal Vlaanderen en MAGDA, is een troef.
  • Ervaring met WPO: je hebt ervaring met de Wet Private Opsporing en het beoordelen van interne onderzoekslijnen.
  • Leveranciersbeoordeling en whitelisting: je hebt ervaring met cloud- en AI-toepassingen, DPA-review, subverwerkers, doorgiftemechanismen en certificeringen zoals ISO 27001, ISO 42001 en SOC 2.
  • AI-governance: je hebt ervaring met AI-inventarissen, risicoclassificatie, FRIA en samenwerking met leveranciers over training en retentie van data.
  • Certificering: CIPP/E, CIPM, een erkend DPO-certificaat of ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor is een pluspunt.

⚠️ Deze functie wordt aangeboden als een deeltijdse freelance rol (40%).

Position Overview

The position is responsible for implementing and supporting enterprise DevSecOps capabilities across on-premises and Microsoft Azure environments. This role partners closely with Solutions Architecture, Cyber Security, Infrastructure, and Application Engineering teams to deliver secure, scalable, automated, and maintainable solutions. This position is responsible for the implementation, support and continuous improvement of DevSecOps platforms, automation frameworks, application security capabilities, cloud technologies, and engineering best practices that enable secure software delivery and operational excellence."

In addition to hands-on engineering responsibilities, this position provides technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to software and DevSecOps engineers while driving continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle.

Major Activities (Typical Duties/Responsibilities)

  • Collaborate in the design, implementation, support, and continuous improvement of enterprise DevSecOps platforms and services.
  • Implement and maintain self-service platform capabilities, developer enablement tooling, and reusable deployment patterns that improve developer productivity and operational consistency.
  • Collaborate with Cyber Security teams to integrate security controls, policy enforcement, risk management, and compliance requirements into automated development and deployment workflows.
  • Provide technical guidance and architectural recommendations for cloud modernization, application delivery, infrastructure automation, and secure platform design initiatives.
  • Partner with development, infrastructure, and platform teams to design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting application and infrastructure deployments in hybrid and Azure cloud environments.
  • Contribute to the implementation and enhancement of application security capabilities, including SAST, SCA, DAST, vulnerability management, secrets management, and software supply chain security.
  • Work with engineering teams to develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Configuration as Code (CaC), and automation solutions using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Bicep/ARM, and PowerShell.
  • Support the deployment and operation of containerized and cloud-native applications through collaboration with application and infrastructure teams.
  • Participate in the development and adoption of engineering standards, reusable deployment patterns, and secure software development practices.
  • Collaborate closely with architecture, security, infrastructure, and development teams to implement technical solutions aligned with organizational standards and objectives.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues spanning applications, infrastructure, networking, identity, security, and cloud services.
  • Contribute to the evaluation of emerging technologies and recommend opportunities to improve developer experience, security, reliability, and operational efficiency.
  • Share technical knowledge through mentoring, documentation, training, and collaboration across engineering teams.
  • Perform other duties as appropriate and as assigned.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

  • Significant experience implementing, supporting and leading enterprise DevSecOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering, software delivery, or infrastructure automation initiatives.
  • Experience leading complex technical initiatives involving multiple systems, technologies, and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-scale technical initiatives involving cross-functional teams, complex system integrations, and competing business priorities.
  • Strong knowledge of software development practices, secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) principles, CI/CD, automation, cloud technologies, and application security.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and mentoring skills.
  • Good interpersonal skills: ability to work effectively and cooperatively with all levels of management and staff, affiliated-company employees as well as outside business associates; exhibits a professional manner in dealing with others.
  • Work well under pressure and independently prioritize workload, while working on multiple projects.
  • Ability to research, organize and analyze technical information with particular attention to accuracy and detail.
  • High degree of sensitivity regarding confidential information.

Physical Abilities

  • Sufficient fine motor skills for the use of computers, calculators with an ability to withstand repetitive keyboarding for extended periods of time.
  • Visual and communications ability adequate to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Ability to sit and work at a computer workstation for extended periods.
  • Ability to reach below shoulder height with regular frequency (desk position) and at or above shoulder height on occasion.
  • Ability to travel by vehicle or aircraft, and ability to safely operate a motor vehicle.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field and 8 or more years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education, certifications, training, and experience.
  • Must pass pre-employment background and drug screening.
  • Must have identification compliant with the Real ID Act at time of hire.
  • Must be able to obtain Department of Energy PIV badge.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Enterprise.
  • Relevant certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-204, AZ-400, AZ-500, or equivalent industry certifications.
  • Experience implementing application security programs, including SAST, SCA, DAST, SBOM, secrets scanning, and supply chain security.
  • Experience with Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Bicep/ARM, or similar automation technologies.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container-based application delivery.
  • Experience supporting regulated, government, critical infrastructure, energy, utility, defense, or high-compliance environments.
  • Knowledge of identity and access management, observability, monitoring, vulnerability management, and compliance frameworks.

Technical Delivery Manager – Provider Module

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Technical Delivery Manager to lead the end-to-end technology delivery and product lifecycle of our Provider Module built on Microsoft Power Platform. The Provider Module will support core healthcare provider-management capabilities such as provider onboarding, enrollment, demographic and practice information, affiliations, locations, specialties, network participation, status management, and data maintenance. The Technical Delivery Manager will be accountable for translating the Provider product roadmap into scalable Power Platform solutions using Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages where applicable, and Azure integration services. This role sits at the intersection of Product Management, Provider Operations, Power Platform Engineering, Architecture, QA, DevOps, Security, Compliance, Data, Integration, and Production Support. The successful candidate should combine strong technical delivery leadership with hands-on understanding of Power Platform architecture and healthcare provider data processes.

Responsibilities

Provider Module Product Delivery

  • Own technology delivery across the complete lifecycle of the Provider Module, including discovery, requirements, architecture, configuration/development, integration, testing, deployment, production support, and continuous enhancement.

  • Partner with Product Owners and Provider Operations to convert the product roadmap into prioritized features, epics, user stories, technical enablers, and release plans.

  • Manage delivery across multiple Power Platform development teams, integration teams, QA resources, architects, vendors, and downstream application teams.

  • Establish measurable delivery plans covering milestones, dependencies, risks, release readiness, technical debt, and production stabilization.

  • Ensure business requirements are implemented as reusable product capabilities, rather than creating one-off workflow customizations for individual teams.

Provider Domain Capabilities

  • Lead technology delivery for capabilities including:

    • New provider onboarding and enrollment

    • Individual and organizational provider management

    • Provider demographic information

    • NPI, TIN, taxonomy and specialty management

    • Service locations and practice locations

    • Provider-to-organization relationships and affiliations

    • Provider network participation

    • Provider status and lifecycle management

    • Provider change and maintenance requests

    • Provider validation and data-quality rules

    • Enrollment workflow and status tracking

    • Credentialing and contracting integration points

    • Provider directory and downstream data distribution

    • Audit history and operational reporting

    • Ensure the product can support complex provider relationships while maintaining a reliable and auditable provider source of truth.

Microsoft Power Platform Responsibilities - Power Apps & Dataverse

  • Lead delivery of the Provider Module using Power Apps and Microsoft Dataverse, with appropriate use of model-driven apps and custom extensions.

  • Drive design of the Dataverse data model for entities such as:

    • Provider

    • Organization

    • Practice

    • Location

    • Specialty

    • Taxonomy

    • Network

    • Affiliation

    • Enrollment

    • Credentialing status

  • Ensure relationships, alternate keys, duplicate detection, validation rules, business rules, and security models appropriately support provider-data requirements.

  • Prevent excessive customization and ensure teams use native Power Platform capabilities where they provide a sustainable solution.

  • Partner with architecture teams to determine when requirements should be implemented using configuration, Power Automate, plugins/custom code, Azure Functions, or external services.

Workflow & Automation

  • Lead implementation of provider workflows using Power Automate, Dataverse business processes, and appropriate Azure services.

  • Drive automation for activities such as provider onboarding, enrollment reviews, approvals, data validation, exception handling, notifications, and downstream updates.

  • Improve straight-through processing while reducing manual touches and operational work queues.

  • Ensure automation includes appropriate retry, error-handling, monitoring, and support mechanisms.

Integration Architecture

  • Coordinate Provider Module integrations with enterprise systems such as:

    • Credentialing

    • Contracting

    • Network Management

    • Claims

    • Provider directories

    • CRM/contact management

    • Enterprise provider master

    • Document-management systems

    • External healthcare/provider data sources

  • Drive integration using appropriate technologies including Dataverse APIs, REST APIs, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, API Management, and data pipelines.

  • Partner with architects to avoid introducing point-to-point integrations that increase long-term Provider Module complexity.

Power Platform ALM & DevOps

  • Establish disciplined Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) for Power Platform solutions.

  • Manage environments across Development, Test/QA, UAT, Pre-Production, and Production.

  • Ensure appropriate use of managed and unmanaged solutions, solution layering, connection references, environment variables, and deployment configuration.

  • Drive automated CI/CD using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions with Power Platform tooling.

  • Establish source-control, branching, deployment, rollback, and release-governance practices.

  • Coordinate release calendars and ensure production deployments have clear implementation, validation, and rollback plans.

  • Maintain traceability between business requirements, user stories, solution changes, testing, and deployments.

Platform Governance & Architecture

  • Partner with the Power Platform Center of Excellence, enterprise architects, and security teams to establish technical guardrails.

  • Ensure adherence to Power Platform environment strategy, Data Loss Prevention policies, connector governance, security roles, service accounts, application users, and API/integration standards.

  • Monitor platform capacity and performance, including Dataverse storage, API usage, automation volumes, integration throughput, and solution performance.

  • Proactively manage Power Platform technical debt and avoid uncontrolled proliferation of flows, connectors, customizations, and unmanaged dependencies.

  • Ensure architecture remains supportable as Provider Module transaction volumes and functionality grow.

Security, Privacy & Compliance

  • Ensure provider information is protected using appropriate Dataverse role-based security, business units/teams, field-level controls, auditing, and access-management patterns.

  • Partner with enterprise security and compliance teams to satisfy applicable healthcare, privacy, retention, and audit requirements.

  • Ensure all key provider changes are appropriately traceable for operational and compliance investigations.

  • Incorporate HIPAA, CMS, payer, state, and organizational requirements where applicable to Provider Module functionality.

Quality & Testing

  • Establish a comprehensive quality strategy covering:

  • Unit/component testing

  • Power Automate workflow testing

  • Dataverse validation

  • Integration/API testing

  • Regression testing

  • Performance testing

  • Security testing

  • User Acceptance Testing

  • Establish objective Go/No-Go criteria for each release.

  • Drive automated regression testing where practical.

  • Monitor escaped defects and recurring incidents and use the results to improve engineering practices.

Production Operations

  • Own technology readiness for production releases and post-production stabilization.

  • Establish monitoring for critical Provider Module integrations, Power Automate flows, APIs, scheduled processes, and business-critical transactions.

  • Partner with Production Support teams on incident management, root-cause analysis, and problem management.

  • Establish meaningful SLAs/SLOs for critical product capabilities.

  • Drive permanent corrective actions for recurring defects rather than relying on manual operational workarounds.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Serve as the primary technology delivery leader for the Provider Module.

  • Provide clear reporting to Product, Operations, Technology, and executive stakeholders covering:

  • Roadmap delivery

  • Release status

  • Risks and dependencies

  • Defect trends

  • Platform health

  • Production stability

  • Technical debt

  • Capacity/performance

  • Manage external Power Platform partners and vendors when applicable.

  • Facilitate technical and business decisions where requirements conflict with platform standards, architecture, security, timeline, or cost objectives.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in application development, technical delivery, engineering management, or technical program management.

  • 3+ years of experience delivering enterprise solutions on Microsoft Power Platform.

  • Demonstrated experience with:

  • Microsoft Power Apps

  • Microsoft Dataverse

  • Power Automate

  • Model-driven applications

  • Dataverse security model

  • Power Platform solutions and ALM

  • Enterprise integration/API patterns

  • Experience managing end-to-end SDLC from product requirements through production operations.

  • Experience leading cross-functional engineering, architecture, QA, integration, DevOps, and support teams.

  • Experience with Agile delivery and tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira.

  • Strong stakeholder and executive communication skills.

  • Ability to challenge solution designs and delivery estimates while working collaboratively with architects and engineering leads.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Healthcare payer experience, particularly Provider Enrollment, Provider Data Management, Credentialing, Contracting, Network Management, or Provider Directory solutions.

  • Understanding of provider-data concepts including NPI, TIN, taxonomy, specialty, locations, affiliations, networks, CAQH, and CMS-related provider processes.

  • Experience with Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management, Azure DevOps, and Microsoft Entra ID.

  • Experience implementing enterprise Dataverse data models and high-volume integrations.

  • Familiarity with Power Platform Center of Excellence and governance practices.

  • Experience modernizing legacy provider systems onto Power Platform/Azure.

  • Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, SAFe, Scrum, or PMP certifications are advantageous.

Flexible Working

At Conduent, we want you to be yourself. We recognize that everyone is different and that how people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.
In this role, you can expect the following working conditions:

Remote work: Enjoy the convenience of working from home and maximize your time by unplugging at the end of your workday.

Working For You

Perks and rewards designed for you:

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Our health and welfare benefits can be tailored to fit you and your family's needs and start on the first day of employment.
  • Retirement Savings: We will support you as you save for your future.

Career Growth Opportunities: We help you thrive, so together, we can grow. We provide opportunities to advance your career with a vast portfolio of businesses and a global footprint.

  • Paid time off: We provide attractive paid time off packages designed for you to enjoy your life away from work.

Join Us

At Conduent, we are one team, one mission. We understand that our success is directly related to the success of our associates. We strive to create a culture where you can:

Bring your authentic self to work

Grow and thrive, both personally and professionally
Make a difference with our clients, in our communities, and with the millions of people we support

When you join Conduent, you are engaged in creating the future - both our company’s and your own. With more than 60,000 associates across 24 countries, we will provide you the opportunity to grow with a team of people who will challenge and inspire you to be the best!

Job Description

A bit more about this role:


As a Bilingual Community Guide, you will play a vital role in helping members overcome barriers to social, financial, and healtahcare access. When challenges like food insecurity, unstable housing, or utility costs arise, cross-functional teams refer members to us for comprehensive support. As a Community Guide, you will connect members with financial assistance and social services in a single, supportive conversation. Reporting to a Community Guide Supervisor, you will use consultative problem-solving and growing expertise in state and federal programs to help members navigate complex systems and improve their health. This role is ideal for those dedicated to assisting members as they navigate complex healthcare networks, community initiatives, and support resources.


Your responsibilities and impact will include:

  • Outreach to members via phone and SMS to build connections, share helpful programs, navigate any hesitation, and discover underlying needs to find the right solutions in English and Spanish.
  • Assist eligible members with applying for and enrolling in financial assistance and social support programs, while connecting them with community services to ensure their overall needs are met.
  • Guide members through application renewals and clarify complex paperwork or benefit updates to maintain or regain their coverage.
  • Utilize internal resource directories to quickly connect members with key services (but not limited to) such as transportation, food and utility assistance, and medication savings.
  • Hit team goals and quality metrics while handling both outbound outreach and incoming member callbacks with care.
  • Step in quickly when urgent situations arise, following safety protocols and escalating complex cases (like APS referrals and behavioral health concerns) promptly.
  • Maintain accurate notes and keep up with quality standards, even when call volumes are high.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, medical staff, and community partners to share insights and suggest process improvements.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 2+ years of customer- or member-facing experience in a high-volume call center environment focused on consultative problem-solving.
  • Clear, empathetic communication, with the ability to influence decisions, navigate resistance, de-escalate frustrated callers, and handle emotionally sensitive conversations.
  • Strong, independent judgment to navigate multi-step challenges creatively, address core barriers, and escalate complex issues appropriately.
  • Great organizational skills with a keen eye for detail, easily juggling multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A growth mindset: you seek feedback, learn new tools (including AI) quickly, and adapt as programs and policies change.

Overview

BPAS is a national provider of retirement plan administration, employee benefit solutions, and fiduciary and trust services. For more than 50 years, we’ve redefined what it means to be a benefits partner. One partner. Smarter benefits. Better results.


Responsibilities

The Chief Control Officer would be accountable for building and leading the first-line risk and control function within BPAS. This includes the first line ownership of the business risk and control self-assessment process, control inventory, issue management lifecycle, governance reporting, escalation routines, vendor risk oversight, data and privacy control alignment, and business-level implementation of enterprise risk policies across all of BPAS business segments, including NRS/GTC, Hand Benefit & Trust .

The role would also act as a trusted advisor to business leadership on the risk implications of new products, services, technology implementations, strategic initiatives, platform changes, vendor arrangements, and transformation efforts.

Essential Duties:

First-Line Risk and Control Ownership

  • Own and maintain the benefits administration risk and control self-assessment process, ensuring risks are appropriately identified, rated, and mapped to controls.
  • Maintain an accurate risk and control inventory aligned with the enterprise risk framework.
  • Ensure key controls are designed appropriately and operating effectively across operational, compliance, technology, third-party/vendor, and conduct risk areas.
  • Drive timely identification, escalation, and remediation of control gaps, issues, events, and near misses.

Enterprise Risk Framework Execution

  • Serve as the business owner for executing the enterprise risk management framework within BPAS.
  • Implement enterprise expectations related to operational risk, compliance risk, third-party risk, technology/cyber risk, and business continuity.
  • Partner with second-line Risk and Compliance teams to interpret new or updated enterprise policies and regulatory requirements and apply them in a practical, business-specific manner.

Governance, Reporting, and Escalation

  • Prepare and present risk and control reporting to business leadership, enterprise risk committees, and applicable governance forums.
  • Own the issue management lifecycle for the business, including identification, root cause analysis, corrective action planning, validation, and closure.
  • Escalate material risks, control breaks, and emerging risks to senior business leadership and enterprise risk partners in a timely manner.
  • Support regulatory exam readiness and respond to regulatory or audit inquiries pertaining to the business.

Risk Culture and Business Partnership

  • Foster a strong risk culture within BPAS by embedding risk ownership and accountability into day-to-day business operations.
  • Advise business leadership on risk considerations related to products, services, technology, and strategic initiatives.
  • Work closely with Internal Audit, Compliance, Legal, and Enterprise Risk on exams, audits, independent testing, and related business responses.

Third-Party and Vendor Risk Oversight

  • Oversee third-party and vendor risk management for the business, given the vendor-intensive nature of benefits administration.
  • Ensure appropriate due diligence, ongoing monitoring, and contractual risk controls for critical vendors, including recordkeeping platforms, third-party administrators, and data exchange providers.

Data, Privacy, and Technology Risk

  • Help ensure controls around sensitive data, including PII, PHI, and financial account data, meet enterprise and regulatory standards.
  • Partner with Technology Risk and Cybersecurity on control requirements for platforms supporting Benefits Administration.

Team Leadership

  • Build and lead a business-embedded control and risk team, potentially including resources focused on control testing, issue management, and reporting analysis.
  • Develop talent and establish clear roles and responsibilities across the three lines of defense model.

Qualifications

Education, Training, Experience, and Skill Requirements:

  • 12 to 15 or more years of progressive experience in risk management, controls, audit, or compliance within financial services or a regulated industry.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • Relevant certifications such as CRCM, CERP, CIA, CRMA, CAMS, CFA Charter holder or similar risk/compliance credentials are a plus.

Compensation: Commensurate with experience plus potential for annual merit increase. In addition to your competitive salary, you will be rewarded benefits including: 11 paid holidays, paid vacation, Medical, Vision & Dental insurance, 401K with generous match, Pension, Tuition Reimbursement, Banking discounts and the list goes on!

jobs.description:
Remote (US-based, Pacific hours) · Full-time, embedded with a client team · $125,000 to $145,000 annually, DOE

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

About Red Door Collaborative

Red Door Collaborative is a creative agency serving enterprise tech organizations and SMBs with visual design, content, motion, and video work. We're a small, human-centered team: highly collaborative, quietly intense, and genuinely good at what we do. We're also evolving. AI is reshaping our industry, and we're leaning into it as a tool that enhances our work rather than replaces the people doing it.

We're rooted in SoCal and the PNW, but we're a fully remote team of creatives. We work Pacific hours and meet in person rarely. This is a real remote role, not a "remote for now" situation. This role requires someone who can lead programs from a distance, working directly with senior stakeholders over Microsoft Teams and keeping a client team aligned and moving without being in the same room.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Project Marketing Manager to join our embedded team supporting the small and medium business marketing organization of a Fortune 100 enterprise cloud and AI company. You'll be a Red Door employee, working day to day inside the client's marketing team.

This is an ownership role. You'll own marketing programs end to end, from planning through results, and work directly with the team's senior stakeholders to set priorities, report progress, and get decisions made. The client team's leadership sets the goals; you decide how each program gets there.

You'll report to our Senior Account Manager. We're also hiring a Project Marketing Manager for this team. If your experience is mostly in executing programs that others have planned, that posting is likely the better fit.

What You'll Do

  • Program ownership: Own marketing programs end to end: the plan, the workback schedule, execution, and results. Decide how the work gets done and who does what.
  • Senior stakeholder partnership: Work directly with the team's senior leaders. Bring them the status, risks, and recommendations they need, and drive decisions to a close.
  • Go-to-market and rhythm of business: Own go-to-market tracking and the team's operating cadence across your programs, and improve them over time rather than just running them.
  • Leadership communication: Build and present PowerPoint decks for senior leadership reviews. Turn program data into a clear story with a recommendation.

Who You Are

  • Enterprise marketing experience: You have 7+ years of professional marketing experience with enterprise organizations, including owning marketing programs end to end. Agency or vendor-side experience embedded with an enterprise client counts.
  • Senior stakeholder experience: You've worked directly with senior leaders: presenting to them, pushing back when needed, and getting decisions made.
  • PowerPoint and deck building: You build and present decks that senior leaders rely on, and you can shape scattered inputs into a clear, well-designed story.
  • Judgment and autonomy: You turn a goal into a plan without being told how, and you know which calls to make yourself and which to bring to leadership.
  • AI-forward: Red Door is an AI-forward agency. You understand the value AI brings to marketing work, you already use it in your own work, and you go looking for new and better ways to put it to use.

Before You Apply

Consider the following before applying:

  • If your experience is mostly in executing programs that others have planned…
  • If presenting to senior leaders and pushing for decisions feels more draining than energizing…
  • If your marketing experience is mostly outside of enterprise organizations…
  • If you'd rather have a defined process handed to you than build and improve one yourself…

Then this probably isn't the right role for you.

To Apply

In your cover letter, tell us about a program you owned end to end: what you were asked to deliver, the call you made that mattered most, and how you brought senior stakeholders along. We're more interested in your judgment than in the results slide.

During the interview process, we may ask you to walk us through a program you've run, with any confidential details removed. Finalists will be asked to provide references from people they've worked with directly.

Compensation & Benefits

This is a salaried, exempt position with an annual salary of $125,000 to $145,000, depending on experience.

We offer a full benefits package: PTO (80 hours in your first year, increasing with years of service), paid holidays (11 per year), health coverage (medical, dental, vision, plus HSA/FSA options), 401(k) with match, life and disability insurance, a charitable matching program, and stipends to support your remote setup and ongoing work-from-home costs.

Equal Opportunity

Red Door Collaborative is committed to building an inclusive team where everyone is valued and respected. We don't discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. We don't just welcome diverse perspectives; we actively seek them out. People from different cultures and experiences, solving problems together, is how we do our best work.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Junior DevOps Engineer

Gun StoreMaster

THE COMPANY

Gun StoreMaster, developed by Three Circle Software, LLC, provides cloud-based ATF compliance and firearm inventory management software for Federal Firearms Licensees (FFLs). Our platform helps firearm retailers, manufacturers, gunsmiths, and other FFLs simplify complex regulatory workflows, including electronic acquisition and disposition records, Form 4473 processing, reporting, inventory management, transfers, and related compliance tasks. Our goal is simple: make compliance accurate, secure, and easy to use so customers can spend less time on administrative work and more time running their businesses. Gun StoreMaster is developed in Austin, Texas, and operates within an organization committed to security, availability, processing integrity, and confidentiality.

POSITION

We are seeking a Junior DevOps Engineer who will report to the Director of R&D and help maintain the uptime, performance, and security of Gun StoreMaster. Our platform runs on Windows servers hosted in AWS. You will manage servers, apply patches, maintain configurations, monitor system health, and assess resource sizing, with guidance from the Director of R&D. You will also use AI tools such as Claude Code within Visual Studio Code (VS Code) to build functioning CI/CD pipelines and automate routine operations. Supporting our migration from AWS CodeCommit to GitHub is one part of this broader role.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage and maintain Windows servers hosted in AWS, including server provisioning, application services, access permissions, network settings, and environment configurations. Keep systems consistent and document approved changes.
  • Monitor server and application uptime, performance, logs, and alerts using AWS CloudWatch or other approved tools. Maintain useful dashboards and alerting, identify problems early, and verify that services remain healthy.
  • Plan, apply, and verify Windows Server patches and security updates. Coordinate maintenance windows and required restarts with the team, check application health afterward, and address failed updates.
  • Review CPU, memory, storage, and other resource usage to identify capacity or performance issues. Recommend and implement approved server sizing and configuration changes that support reliability and control AWS costs.
  • Investigate outages, slowdowns, failed services, and deployment issues. Help restore service, escalate incidents promptly when needed, and work with the development team to identify causes and prevent repeat failures.
  • Maintain and verify server backup configurations, assist with restore tests, and keep recovery procedures current so the team can recover systems and data when needed.
  • Use Claude Code within VS Code and other approved AI tools to develop PowerShell scripts, troubleshoot infrastructure issues, and automate server administration and maintenance. Review and test generated changes before use.
  • Build, test, and maintain GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines that build applications, run automated tests, package versioned artifacts, and deploy to AWS-hosted Windows servers. Include secure credential handling, deployment approvals, and rollback procedures.
  • Support migration of repositories from AWS CodeCommit to GitHub, preserving history, branches, and tags. Help configure repository permissions, branch protection, and required checks, and validate affected build and deployment workflows.
  • Partner with developers and QA to improve environment consistency, reduce manual release and maintenance tasks, and address infrastructure or configuration problems that affect software delivery.
  • Keep server inventories, configuration records, operational runbooks, and deployment and recovery documentation current. Communicate maintenance plans, incidents, and outstanding issues to the Director of R&D and team.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Internships, coursework, and personal projects are welcome evidence of your skills.
  • Foundational knowledge of Git, including repositories, commits, branches, merges, and pull requests. Familiarity with GitHub is preferred.
  • Basic understanding of CI/CD, automated testing, build artifacts, and deployment workflows. Be prepared to discuss a pipeline or automation project you have built or contributed to.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code in VS Code, or comparable tools, and a willingness to adopt our workflow. Ability to review, test, and troubleshoot AI-generated code.
  • Some experience writing PowerShell or similar scripts, plus the ability to read and edit YAML configuration. You should be comfortable using a terminal and investigating error messages.
  • Basic familiarity with Windows Server and AWS concepts such as compute instances, access permissions, storage, and monitoring. Practical experience in a lab, personal project, or work environment is relevant.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, attention to detail, and a methodical approach to troubleshooting. Ability to work with a remote team, communicate progress, and raise blockers early.
  • Exposure to GitHub Actions, infrastructure as code, IIS, or .NET build tooling is a plus. A willingness to learn our application environment and the needs of a regulated SaaS business is essential.

Business Unit:

Gun StoreMaster

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

Number of Openings Available:

1

Worker Type:

Regular

More About Jonas Software:

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

jobs.excerpt: Overview About Certara Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development.
jobs.description:
Overview

About Certara

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.

Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.

The Certara Quantitative Systems Pharmacology (QSP) group is a global organization focused on the impactful application of QSP and mechanistic PKPD modeling and simulation in drug discovery and development. We are leading several first-of-its-kind QSP Consortia with more than 10 global pharmaceutical companies and have a rapidly expanding consultancy portfolio. Our QSP scientists work in close collaboration with other Certara staff and clients to generate and use state-of-the-art mechanistic models for decision making in pharmaceutical R&D. The models are designed in close dialogue with clients and developed with a view to creating user-friendly tools that will inform drug development programs from discovery to regulatory filing. We have unique capability to seamlessly integrate bespoke QSP models into the Simcyp® physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) platform. Besides our well-established leadership in applied QSP approaches in Immunology and Immuno-Oncology, we are now also the leading provider of QSP approaches in neuro-degenerative diseases through Certara’s recent acquisition of the In Silico Biosciences modelling platform.

We are seeking highly motivated and talented Associated Principal Scientist, who share our passion for using quantitative approaches to understand and impact complex drug discovery and development questions.


Responsibilities

Technical

  • Postdoctoral experience in systems modelling for drug discovery/ development teams.
  • PhD (or equivalent) in life sciences, engineering, computer sciences, mathematics physics or equivalent.
  • Good understanding of PKPD, pharmacology and biology and its application in drug discovery and development.
  • Very familiar and outstanding hands-on expertise with Matlab, Neuron or other similar modelling software.
  • Strong publication record (commensurate with level of experience).

Team working

  • Excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Skilled and experienced at facilitating a multi-disciplinary team to work together on a complex project.
  • Ability to communicate with all stakeholders clearly and efficiently.
  • Organised and with track record of delivering quality results on time

Personal

  • Ability to work virtually with project teams across different locations and time zones.
  • Leads by example.
  • Self-reliant.

Other skills

  • Highly computer literate and familiar with modern IT and communications technology.
  • Good presentation skills.
  • Combines scientific excellence with ability to make impact in drug discovery and development programs.
  • Ability to manage multiple client project timelines and deliverables simultaneously

Role (depending on experience)

  • Overall responsibility for project delivery of quality QSP solutions on time.
  • Provide hands-on technical support for model building when required.
  • Work with clients to ensure they receive the expected added value.
  • Work with the consortium/ consulting teams to ensure optimal deployment of resources.
  • Work with Certara QSP line management to deliver optimum solutions.
  • Provide general expert technical input across Certara QSP portfolio.
  • Mentor other Certara QSP staff.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years Postdoctoral experience in systems modelling for drug discovery/ development teams.
  • PhD (or equivalent) in life sciences, engineering, computer sciences, mathematics physics or equivalent.
  • Good understanding of PKPD, pharmacology and biology and its application in drug discovery and development.
  • Very familiar and outstanding hands-on expertise with Matlab, Neuron or other similar modelling software.
  • Strong publication record (commensurate with level of experience).

Serving as the technical backbone of the escalation team, the Escalation Architect partners with Escalation Managers, Technical Support, Product, Engineering, Cloud, and other specialist teams to establish technical clarity, identify root causes, and drive lasting resolutions. This role owns the technical strategy and diagnostic direction of critical escalations while maintaining technical credibility with customers, internal stakeholders, and executive audiences.


Your Day-to-Day

  • Serve as the senior technical authority for complex, priority-one, severity-one, and strategically critical customer escalations.
  • Establish and lead the technical investigation strategy from initial triage and stabilization through hypothesis development, evidence gathering, root-cause identification, and corrective action.
  • Lead cross-functional technical response teams across Technical Support, Product, Engineering, Cloud, and other specialist functions.
  • Identify technical dependencies and failure domains and develop appropriate workarounds, recovery options, and resolution paths.
  • Validate technical findings and conclusions before they are communicated as commitments to customers or executive stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across enterprise software, distributed application architectures, cloud-hosted, SaaS, and hybrid environments.
  • Investigate issues involving networking, DNS, TCP/IP, proxies, firewalls, connectivity, identity, authentication, authorization, databases, APIs, third-party integrations, virtualization, containers, performance, scalability, availability, and reliability.
  • Translate customer-reported symptoms into clear, actionable engineering problems.
  • Provide Engineering with detailed reproduction steps, diagnostic evidence, logs, business impact, and evidence-based hypotheses.
  • Partner directly with Product and Engineering teams to accelerate defect investigation and resolution.
  • Confirm that fixes, workarounds, and recovery paths are effective before an escalation is closed.
  • Assess customer architectures when environment design or system configuration contributes to an escalation.
  • Identify architectural risks, system dependencies, and technical debt revealed through escalation investigations.
  • Analyze interactions among Bentley applications, customer infrastructure, cloud services, and third-party systems.
  • Engage Solution Architects, Product Architects, and other technical leaders to support longer-term architectural improvements.
  • Participate in live customer escalation bridges and technical workshops when senior technical authority is required.
  • Support Escalation Managers in developing precise, evidence-based technical narratives for customer leadership and executive audiences.
  • Clearly communicate what is known, what remains unknown, the evidence supporting the current hypothesis, and the next steps in the investigation.
  • Identify recurring technical patterns across escalations and communicate supportability risks and product improvement opportunities to Product and Engineering.
  • Contribute to post-incident reviews, postmortems, and root-cause analyses designed to prevent repeat incidents.
  • Transform escalation findings into reusable technical documentation, troubleshooting guidance, and escalation playbooks.
  • Mentor Senior and Principal Technical Support Engineers through complex investigations.
  • Coach technical teams in structured troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and evidence-based escalation practices.

What You Bring to the Team

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated professional experience.
  • More than 10 years of experience in enterprise technical support, escalation engineering, production support, systems engineering, software engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Demonstrated experience owning complex or business-critical technical escalations.
  • Strong troubleshooting experience across multiple technical areas, such as: Windows and Linux operating systems. Enterprise networking. Cloud and hybrid environments. Databases and data-layer dependencies. APIs and system integrations. Virtualized environments. Containers and Kubernetes. Enterprise software applications.
  • Experience performing root-cause analysis using logs, system data, and other diagnostic evidence.
  • Understanding of the software development lifecycle and software defect-resolution processes.
  • Ability to lead complex, cross-functional technical investigations without formal authority over participating teams.
  • Ability to translate complex technical information for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop concise, evidence-based technical narratives for leadership and executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to work effectively during high-pressure, business-critical customer situations.
  • Strong judgment and attention to detail when validating technical findings and recommending corrective actions.
  • This role may require limited travel for customer meetings, escalation workshops, or internal collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SaaS, cloud-hosted, or hybrid enterprise applications.
  • Experience working with Microsoft Azure or another major public-cloud platform.
  • Networking certification, such as CCNA or CCNP, or equivalent demonstrated networking expertise.
  • Microsoft Azure certification, such as AZ-900 or AZ-104, or equivalent demonstrated cloud expertise.
  • Experience with ITIL or other IT service-management practices.
  • Experience using observability and diagnostic tools such as Wireshark, HTTP Archive file analysis, Grafana, or comparable platforms.
  • Programming or scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, Java, C, C++, JavaScript, or similar languages.
  • Experience creating technical playbooks, troubleshooting documentation, or reusable knowledge content.
This is a Home-based role.

What We Offer:

  • Step into a collaborative work environment where ideas flourish, and teamwork propels us forward towards shared success.
  • An attractive salary and benefits package.
  • Bentley Impact Day: take a day off from work to volunteer with an organization of your choice.
  • Celebrate milestone achievements and moments that matter through our colleague recognition award programs and our Bentley Achievers platform.
  • A commitment to inclusion, belonging and colleague wellbeing through global initiatives and resource groups.
  • Be part of a company committed to making a real difference by advancing the world’s infrastructure for better quality of life, where your contributions help build a more sustainable, connected, and resilient world. Discover our latest user success stories for an insight into our global impact.

Who We Are:


Bentley Systems (Nasdaq: BSY) is the infrastructure engineering software company. We provide innovative software to advance the world’s infrastructure – sustaining both the global economy and environment. Our industry-leading software solutions are used by professionals, and organizations of every size, for the design, construction, and operations of roads and bridges, rail and transit, water and wastewater, public works and utilities, buildings and campuses, mining, and industrial facilities. Our offerings, powered by the iTwin Platform for infrastructure digital twins, include MicroStation and Bentley Open applications for modeling and simulation, Seequent’s software for geoprofessionals, and Bentley Infrastructure Cloud encompassing ProjectWise for project delivery, SYNCHRO for construction management, and AssetWise for asset operations. Bentley Systems’ 5,200 colleagues generate annual revenues of more than $1 billion in 194 countries.
