jobs.description:
Domaine is a global connected commerce and transformation partner for ambitious and beloved brands. We are the world’s largest independent Shopify partner. We are also a growing team of strategists, designers, engineers and specialists who help brands decide where to invest, build what comes next, and run it at scale across platforms, channels and AI.

Domaine organizes its client work in Portfolios: small, cross-functional teams that own a group of client relationships and the results behind them, supported by specialist craft teams across experience design, engineering, delivery and consulting. The Client Partner leads a Portfolio as its Field CEO. This role owns a Portfolio of enterprise and growth-stage brands, with full accountability for its revenue, margin, growth and retention, and leads the Portfolio by working with Delivery and Technical Partners drawn from Domaine's craft-led teams.

The Client Partner runs the Portfolio as a business within the business and reports to the President. They diagnose what clients need, assemble the right Domaine capabilities around it, and build the plan and the trust to see it funded and delivered. For them, a launch is where the relationship starts. They work in lockstep with Domaine’s craft, consulting and sales leaders.

Domaine’s mission is to be the best connected commerce partner in the world. This role advances it by turning client relationships into long-term, growing partnerships: every client in the Portfolio has a plan tied to their goals, sees the value Domaine delivers against it, and trusts Domaine with what comes next.

TRAITS

  • You’re consultative and AI-first. You bring clients a point of view on where to invest, use AI to run account planning, forecasting and reporting, and know how to sell AI-enabled services.
  • You think in revenue, margin and client lifetime value, and you can tell a one-time expansion from growth that lasts.
  • When a client outcome or the economics behind it slips, you treat it as yours to fix.
  • You lead through influence. Specialists commit to your plans, and the people around you raise their standard.
  • You’re fluent across digital commerce and credible with clients on work that goes well beyond their platform.
  • You turn a good engagement into a repeatable, growing one.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Portfolio Ownership and Commercial Performance

  • Own the Portfolio’s annual revenue, margin and growth plan and forecast, and run to it month by month.
  • Make pricing and commercial calls within Domaine’s rate card and deal guardrails, and build a clear business case when a deal needs to go outside them.
  • Own commercial terms, renewals and change orders, and protect margin against scope creep, overruns and collections risk.
  • Deliver forecasts leadership can plan around, and call Portfolio risk early, with a recommendation for what to do about it.

Client Leadership and Growth

  • Own the account plan for every client in the Portfolio, tied to their stated business goals.
  • Be the senior Domaine executive in every client relationship, and build multi-threaded executive relationships so no account depends on one person, on either side.
  • Run quarterly business reviews and growth planning sessions with Domaine’s consulting leaders as forward-looking conversations that turn roadmaps into qualified pipeline.
  • Drive expansion into new services, platforms and programs, evolving accounts from single-service delivery to multi-service relationships.
  • Act on at-risk accounts before they become escalations, and lead escalations end to end, owning the client conversation while delivery leaders resolve the work.
  • Join late-stage pursuits alongside Domaine’s sales team, and take ownership of new clients at contract signature.

Solution Shaping and Outcomes

  • Define the client problem and the outcome Domaine is committing to.
  • Shape multi-discipline solutions with experience design, engineering, delivery and consulting leaders, and decide what goes in front of the client.
  • Lead the Portfolio’s shift from time-and-materials toward fixed-fee and outcome-based commercial models, with change control that protects both the client and Domaine.
  • Feed client demand and feedback back into Domaine’s offerings, estimates and methods.

Portfolio and People Leadership

  • Lead the Portfolio with Delivery and Technical Partners. Set priorities and run the operating rhythm, including account reviews and monthly Portfolio reviews.
  • Give performance input on specialist team members working in the Portfolio.
  • Hire, lead and develop the Engagement Managers who report to the Client Partner, and grow future Client Partners.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years in an agency, digital consultancy or professional services firm, including 5+ years owning a book of business with direct revenue and margin accountability, most recently at $10M+.
  • Track record of growing enterprise accounts by expanding them into new services.
  • Command of services economics, including rate, realization, utilization, fixed-fee risk, change control and gross margin, with experience pricing and protecting fixed-fee work.
  • Enough delivery depth to shape a complex program and to spot an unrealistic scope or a troubled engagement early.
  • Senior client presence with CEOs, CDOs and heads of ecommerce at enterprise brands.
  • Experience selling and shaping multi-discipline solutions.
  • Fluency in the commerce ecosystem and the surrounding partner, app and enterprise systems landscape, within and beyond Shopify.
  • Experience using AI to run accounts and selling AI-enabled services.
  • Experience leading people, including senior talent influenced without direct authority.
  • Enterprise commerce experience and time in a partner-led, Portfolio or matrixed client model preferred.

About Evo

For more than 20 years, the Evolution Championship Series (Evo) has produced the largest and longest-running fighting game tournament conventions in the world. Our events are gathering points where players, fans, publishers, developers, creators, and brands come together to celebrate fighting games and the communities that make them thrive.

Beyond our flagship live events, Evo continues to expand how we create, celebrate, and grow fighting game fandom around the world.

Role Overview

As the Head of Commerce, you will serve as the business leader and commercial engine responsible for scaling Evo’s direct-to-consumer and membership revenue streams. You will hold full revenue and cost accountability across global ecommerce, merchandise, pop-up and fan membership models while managing specialized consumer-product IP licensing.

This is a commercial leadership and operational role at scale: you will design multi-year revenue roadmaps for your vertical, manage global apparel and merchandise strategy, supply chains, direct digital storefront operations, and architect on-site retail environments across all global tour stops (e.g., Las Vegas, Japan, France, Latin America). You will build the data-driven systems, sourcing pipelines, and partner frameworks required to monetize Evo’s cultural brand equity and bring fans what they want.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned commercial leader with a proven track record of building lifestyle merchandise lines, ecommerce, live-event merchandising businesses, combining financial rigor, consumer product expertise and a deep intuition for community culture and brand authenticity.

You will report to RTS’s Chief Operating Officer (COO).

Global Consumer Product Strategy & Commercial Vision
  • Define and execute the multi-year strategy to transform Evo’s merchandise footprint from event-souvenir apparel to match a premier, year-round global lifestyle brand that resonates across Evo’s consumers

Global Merchandise & Supply Chain Operations

Global Retail Footprint & Experiential Pop-Up Presence

Trade Data Analysis and Insights

Introduction to Eficode

We’re building the future of software development – driving innovation across Cloud, DevOps, Agile, Service Management, and AI-powered transformation. Our mission is to help organizations evolve into truly software-driven enterprises, empowering them to deliver faster, smarter, and more sustainably. We believe in changing the world by sharing our expertise and enabling teams to work better through modern technology and intelligent automation.

With more than 600 experts across 10 countries, Eficode brings together people from across the Nordics, continental Europe, the UK and the Americas. We’re an Atlassian Platinum Partner, a two-time GitHub Partner of the Year in EMEA and an Azure Managed Service Provider.

Now, we’re looking for aSolutions Sales Architectto join our growing Sales team in Germany and help customers navigate the increasingly complex world of modern software development.

Role purpose

If you have a strong technical background but also enjoy the commercial side of technology, this could be a great opportunity.

Working closely with our Sales and Global Delivery teams across the Continental region (Germany, Switzerland, Netherlands), you’ll lead customer discovery, understand their challenges and connect them with the right combination of Eficode’s services, products and technology partners.

This is a broad presales role spanning DevOps, software development, platform engineering, cloud, developer tooling and AI. You’ll help shape complex solutions, bring in specialist expertise when needed, and support opportunities from early conversations through to a successful handover into Delivery.

As a new role within our growing Continental business, you’ll also have the opportunity to help shape how we approach presales in the region.

Role responsibilities

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Lead customer discoveryto understand challenges, priorities and desired outcomes.

  • Design and shape solutions across Eficode’s portfolio of products, licensing and services.

  • Bring together expertise across Sales, Delivery and our technology partners to ensure solutions are technically sound, commercially viable and deliverable.

  • Partner with Sales to win and grow opportunities, supporting proposals, presentations, commercial discussions, upsell and cross-sell.

  • Present compelling solution narrativesto senior technical and business stakeholders, clearly communicating value, approach and expected outcomes.

  • Ensure a smooth transition into Delivery, with clear alignment on scope, outcomes, commercials, risks, dependencies and customer expectations.

  • Use delivery feedback and lessons learned to continually improve propositions, solution approaches and estimating.

  • Contribute to commercial targets including pipeline progression, conversion, margin and successful sales outcomes.

  • Help strengthen our presales capability by coaching Sales colleagues and developing reusable tools, approaches and materials.

How you will work

This role brings Sales, Solution Specialists and Delivery together to create solutions customers value and Eficode can successfully deliver.

  • Collaborative: Work across Sales, Delivery and specialist teams, bringing in the right expertise at the right time.

  • Customer & outcome-focused: Keep customer challenges, goals and measures of success at the heart of every solution.

  • Commercially minded:Balance customer value with Eficode’s commercial goals, ensuring solutions are viable, realistic and deliverable.

  • Constructively challenging: Ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and make risks visible early.

  • Continuous improvement: Use feedback from sales and delivery to strengthen our solutions, estimating and ways of working.

Role requirements

You’ll make a great match for this role if you have:

  • 6+ years of experiencein technical presales, solutions architecture, sales engineering, technology consulting or a similar customer-facing technical role.

  • Broad knowledge of DevOps and the software development lifecycle, including areas such as platform engineering, cloud and developer tooling.

  • Experience shaping complex technology solutions and working alongside Sales throughout the opportunity lifecycle.

  • Experience selling consulting, transformation or managed services alongside technology products and licenses.

  • Strong customer discovery and consultative skills, with the ability to understand pain points and translate them into clear solution directions.

  • The confidence and credibility to present to and advise senior technical and business stakeholders.

  • An understanding of how AI is changing the software development lifecycle, including developer productivity, platform engineering and enterprise governance.

  • A commercial mindset, with an understanding of how technical decisions impact scope, risk and the wider opportunity.

  • Fluency in the German language is also a mandatory requirements.

Nice-to-haves

It would be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience with Atlassian, GitHub, GitLab or another DevOps/developer platform ecosystem.

  • Experience acting as a long-term technical advisor to large enterprise customers, including roadmap and expansion conversations.

  • Experience working across software vendors, consultancies and partner ecosystems.

  • Relevant vendor certifications, architecture credentials or technical education – although practical experience and capability matter more to us than a particular degree.

What’s in it for you?

  • The opportunity to play a key role in the growthof Eficode's business and help shape our presales capability in the continental region (Germany, Switzerland and Netherlands).

  • A broad presales roleworking across our portfolio, with exposure to DevOps, cloud, platform engineering, AI and leading technology partners.

Remuneration & Location

This role can be based anywhere in Germany, with full remote-working flexibility. Living near our Hamburg or Düsseldorf offices is a bonus, but there's no set office attendance requirement.

We offer a competitive market-rate base salary plus bonus opportunity, dependent on experience.

jobs.description:
Job Summary and Responsibilities

The Connection Center Virtual Registered Nurse (RN) is a vital member of the patient care team, responsible for delivering high-quality, patient-centered nursing care remotely through telephonic and video interactions. This role encompasses the full scope of the nursing process, including comprehensive virtual assessment, nursing diagnosis, symptom/problem identification, outcomes identification, planning, implementation of care, and evaluation. The Virtual RN leverages advanced clinical judgment and evidence-based protocols to provide health education, nursing advice, and facilitate timely access to healthcare services across diverse patient populations and geographical locations. Working collaboratively with interdisciplinary teams, the Virtual RN ensures adherence to professional standards of practice, regulatory guidelines, and organizational policies, while utilizing advanced technology to optimize patient outcomes and engagement.

Conduct comprehensive virtual nursing assessments through telephonic and secure video interactions, gathering detailed patient history, chief complaint, current symptoms, and pertinent medical information.

Apply the nursing process to analyze subjective and objective data; identify actual or potential health problems and determine appropriate urgency and disposition based on clinical judgment and approved evidence-based decision support tools/protocols.

Collaborate with patients, caregivers, and the healthcare team to identify measurable goals and establish patient-centered plans of care, including self-management strategies and red-flag indicators for seeking higher levels of care.

Implement care plans by providing clear, evidence-based nursing advice, health education, and symptom management guidance, covering immediate care, chronic disease management, and preventative health maintenance.

Instruct patients on the correct use of self-monitoring devices (e.g., pulse oximeters, blood pressure monitors, blood glucose monitors) and at-home treatments (e.g., wound care, breathing treatments).

Provide comprehensive medication management guidance, including recommending approved Over-the-Counter (OTC) medications following specific protocols and providing directions on dosage, frequency, and contraindications.

Perform both inbound and outbound communications with patients, pharmacies, providers, hospitals, and other healthcare entities to facilitate patient care, respond to inquiries, and provide information.

Communicate lab and diagnostic test results to patients following provider review, accurately evaluating and addressing patient questions.

Evaluate patient response to interventions and advice, assessing understanding and capability to follow instructions, and revising care plans as needed through shared decision-making.

Maintain accurate, comprehensive, and timely documentation of all patient encounters in the Electronic Health Record (EHR) and other systems, adhering to medical, legal, statistical, and departmental standards.

Utilize and skillfully navigate electronic decision support tools, EHR, internet navigation, and virtual communication platforms, often concurrently.

Facilitate patient access to primary care providers, specialists, healthcare facilities, and community resources.

Act as a patient and consumer advocate, resolving problems and communicating needs and concerns to appropriate resources and the care team.

Collaborate effectively with an interdisciplinary healthcare team to ensure coordinated and continuous patient care.

Mentor and provide leadership to support staff, fostering a collaborative and professional team environment.

Comply with all applicable laws, regulations, federal healthcare program requirements, and the specific state Board of Nursing rules where the patient is physically located during the encounter.

Participate actively in quality improvement outcomes measurement processes, data collection, and analysis.

Meet minimum established quality and productivity standards and adhere to workforce schedules to facilitate call center metrics.

Maintain patient confidentiality and uphold the highest ethical standards as defined by CommonSpirit Health's Ethical and Religious Directives and Standards of Conduct.

Adapt communication style to patients representing diverse personal, professional, cultural, and socioeconomic backgrounds.

Job Requirements

Satisfactory completion of a formal Registered Nurse program (e.g., Associate Degree in Nursing (ADN) or diploma from an accredited school of nursing) upon hire

and Minimum of three (3) years of clinical RN experience in an acute care or ambulatory care setting required

and

Bachelors Of Science Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) upon hire PreferredandPrevious triage experience (Urgent Care, Emergency Department nursing accepted)Preferred

Where You’ll Work

CommonSpirit Health was formed by the alignment of Catholic Health Initiatives (CHI) and Dignity Health. With more than 700 care sites across the U.S. & from clinics and hospitals to home-based care and virtual care services CommonSpirit is accessible to nearly one out of every four U.S. residents. Our world needs compassion like never before. Our communities need caring and our families need protection. With our combined resources CommonSpirit is committed to building healthy communities advocating for those who are poor and vulnerable and innovating how and where healing can happen both inside our hospitals and out in the community.

jobs.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

We are open to considering candidates at either the Associate Director or Director level, depending on their experience and expertise.


General Description:


The Scientific & Site Partnerships Lead (SSPL) serves as the principal Scientific interface between BeOne Global Clinical Operations and the external investigator and clinical research community across EMEA. The role is accountable for defining and executing the regional scientific site partnership strategy across the clinical development portfolio, strengthening relationships with Key Opinion Leaders, investigators, research networks, academic organizations and priority institutions. The role also serves as the scientific capability leader for GCO EMEA, ensuring that field and operational teams have the scientific, clinical and competitive knowledge required to conduct high-quality strategic feasibility, site identification, site selection, PSSV and study start-up activities.

The role acts as a senior scientific ambassador for the BeOne pipeline and clinical development strategy. It communicates the scientific rationale, development strategy, differentiation and future potential of molecules and programmes in a compliant and credible manner, while bringing external perspectives back into internal portfolio, protocol and execution decisions. The role translates scientific and clinical development strategy into practical operational guidance for CRAs, Clinical Site Managers, Feasibility Managers and Country Operations teams. Through structured capability building and scientific enablement, the role ensures consistent and credible engagement with investigators throughout the study lifecycle.

The SSPL develops and maintains a comprehensive understanding of disease biology, treatment pathways, standards of care, patient journeys, healthcare systems, competing clinical trials, competitor pipelines, anticipated regulatory approvals, treatment guideline changes and upcoming launches across EMEA

Essential Functions of the Job:

Scientific Field Excellence and Capability Building


  • Defines and leads the GCO EMEA scientific field excellence strategy.
  • Establishes a train-the-expert model, leveraging existing functional/global leads, for Clinical Site Managers, CRAs, Feasibility Managers and Country Operations teams.
  • Develops study-specific scientific readiness packages covering disease background, treatment landscape, protocol rationale, standard of care, competing trials and anticipated investigator questions.
  • Delivers scientific and competitive landscape training for field teams supporting strategic feasibility, PSSV, site selection and study start-up activities.
  • Establishes minimum scientific readiness standards for field-facing operational personnel.
  • Creates sustainable knowledge-sharing mechanisms across studies, therapeutic areas and countries.
  • Strategic investigator partnerships and site development: develops long-term partnerships with priority research institutions, investigator networks, and centers of excellence across EMEA.

Feasibility Responsibilities


  • Provides scientific oversight and challenge during country and site selection decisions, ensuring recommendations are supported by robust external intelligence, competitive analysis and deep understanding of local treatment practices.
  • Clinical trial strategy and feasibility: translating external scientific insights into strategic feasibility, country/site selection, and early study planning, including bringing investigator perspectives into protocol development discussions.
  • Partners with Global Feasibility, Clinical Development, Medical Affairs, Study Management, Country Operations and other functions to ensure strategic feasibility recommendations incorporate scientific interest, investigator interest, patient access pathways, competing studies, referral dynamics, anticipated treatment changes and operational deliverability

Competitive Intelligence


  • Maintains a structured competitive intelligence framework that evaluates competing studies, sponsor activity, emerging therapies, expected launches, treatment guideline changes and their potential impact on recruitment, retention, investigator interest and site capacity.
  • Provides regular competitive landscape briefings to GCO, Clinical Development and Medical Affairs leadership to support portfolio planning and study execution decisions.

Clinical Development and Medical Affairs Interface


  • Serves as the primary GCO scientific liaison to Clinical Development and Medical Affairs, translating scientific strategy and external insights into operational recommendations and ensuring GCO considerations are incorporated into protocol concepts, protocol design and study planning.

SIV Readiness


  • Supports study start-up and Site Initiation Visit readiness by ensuring GCO field teams understand the scientific rationale, treatment landscape, competitive environment, key protocol considerations and anticipated investigator concerns before site activation.
  • Develops study-specific readiness materials and investigator intelligence packages to support successful study launch and early enrolment performance.

The above list covers the primary responsibilities of the role. Additional activities may be adapted in line with business needs.

Success Criteria and Key Performance Indicators

Scientific Readiness

  • ≥90% of priority studies supported by scientific readiness packages before strategic feasibility activities.
  • ≥90% of targeted field personnel trained before first investigator-facing engagement.
  • Strategic Feasibility and Site Selection
  • Documented use of scientific and competitive intelligence in site and country selection decisions.
  • Improved enrollment performance of selected sites versus forecast.

SIV Readiness

  • ≥90% of priority studies supported by study readiness and investigator intelligence materials before SIV.
  • Reduction in recurring investigator questions and start-up clarification requests.

Competitive Intelligence

  • Competitive landscape assessments completed for all priority programs.
  • Timely communication of major scientific or market events affecting enrollment.

Cross-Functional Impact

  • Protocol recommendations adopted by Clinical Development teams.
  • External insights incorporated into portfolio and study strategy decisions.

Business Impact

  • Improved enrollment forecast accuracy.
  • Improved site productivity.
  • Improved strategic site retention.
  • Improved investigator satisfaction

Supervisory Responsibilities:


  • Provides visible senior leadership and enterprise-level direction for scientific site partnerships across EMEA.
  • Provides scientific mentoring and capability development for field-facing GCO personnel and contributes to the establishment of scientific partnerships excellence standards across the region.
  • May lead, supervise or provide functional direction to employees, contractors or matrixed resources, based on organizational design and business needs.
  • Creates an inclusive, accountable and high-performing environment, enabling teams and cross-functional partners to deliver shared strategic outcomes.

Education and Experience Required:


  • Advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, MD or equivalent) in a scientific, medical or healthcare discipline preferred. A Master's or Bachelor's degree with substantial relevant experience may be considered.
  • Typically 10+ years of progressive experience across clinical operations, clinical development, medical affairs, site engagement or relevant experience in a related pharmaceutical, biotechnology or CRO environment, with demonstrated regional or global leadership responsibilities.
  • Deep scientific and operational knowledge of oncology drug development and clinical trials is strongly preferred.

Computer Skills:


  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly PowerPoint, Excel and Word, and in collaboration, communication and project-management tools.
  • Experience with clinical intelligence, feasibility, trial-planning, stakeholder relationship management and performance data platforms.
  • Ability to adopt and promote digital, analytics and AI-enabled tools, including Copilot and SharePoint, while maintaining appropriate information governance.

Other Qualifications:


  • Demonstrated senior-level experience across clinical operations, clinical development, medical affairs, feasibility, investigator engagement, site partnerships or related areas in pharmaceutical, biotechnology or CRO settings.
  • Credible scientific presence and proven ability to present a clinical development pipeline and discuss molecule and programme strategy with senior investigators and scientific leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex scientific and clinical information into operationally actionable recommendations.
  • Deep knowledge of oncology drug development, clinical trial design and execution, ICH-GCP and relevant regulatory and compliance requirements.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the diversity of European healthcare and clinical research environments and the ability to translate country-level differences into strategic recommendations.
  • Established external network and a record of developing durable, mutually valuable relationships with KOLs, investigators, research institutions and networks.

  • Fluent written and spoken English. Additional European languages will be considered a strong asset.

jobs.description:
About The Landline Company

Landline is building infrastructure that lets passengers clear security and check in for their flight closer to home, before they ever reach the airport. We provide seamless ground connectivity on behalf of American Airlines, Air Canada, Jet Blue, Delta, and other major carriers, integrating booking, secure transport, and baggage handling into a single ticket across a growing North American network.

Backed by top-tier venture investors and partners like CLEAR, we've spent eight years making the travel day seamless for millions of passengers.

Job Summary

Our drivers and frontline teams run a live 24/7 operation across a growing North American network, and the tools in their hands have to work the first time, even for someone who got hired last week.

As a Software Engineer, you'll own that layer. That includes the driver app at the center of every trip, the handheld tools our station staff run their shifts on, and the connections back into the platform, from booking systems to the operations backend, that keep everyone in sync in real time.

Our operation runs inside the networks of major airline partners like American Airlines and Air Canada. You'll work at hub airports and partner stations, alongside their teams and ours, watching how the operation actually runs. When you find something slow, manual, or error-prone, you'll ship the fix and iterate on it in days rather than quarters.

We work on a modern, engineer-friendly stack and build agentic workflows into how we develop and how our tools run, and you'll have a real voice in where it goes next.

What You'll Do

  • Own the field software layer: the driver app and the handheld tools frontline staff use every shift for scanning, verification, photo capture, and real-time status.
  • Design flows that hold up in real field conditions, including offline use, glare, gloves, and one-handed operation.
  • Integrate device capabilities like camera, barcode/NFC scanning, and GPS so field events are verifiable and auditable without slowing anyone down.
  • Integrate IoT and vehicle telematics, working with platforms like Samsara, so vehicle, device, and operational data flow into one real-time picture of the operation.
  • Work across the platform when the problem calls for it, from booking flows to dispatch visibility to the operations backend, so field tools and core systems behave as one product.
  • Use and build agentic workflows. We rely on LLM-driven tooling in development and in production, and we want people who are excited to push that further.
  • Deploy forward: ride along with drivers,work stationshifts at partner hub airports, and ship the fix that week. Your users include our own teams and the airline partner staff we operate alongside.

What We're Looking For

  • You know how to build for spotty connectivity and make sync conflicts boring, with offline-first instincts.
  • Device and IoT integration experience with camera, barcode/NFC scanning, and GPS.
  • Experience with telematics/IoT platforms (Samsara or similar), rugged devices, or BLE sensors is a plus.
  • Modern web fluency in a Next.js/Vercel environment working across the stack when a feature needs it.
  • Agentic or automation experience is a plus, whether that's LLM-driven workflows, orchestration, or process automation that real users depend on.
  • Secure-by-design instincts as we operate in a security-regulated environment and build to federal-grade standards, so data integrity, least privilege, and auditability should come naturally to you.
  • Forward-deployed experience embedded with users or operations teams (as an FDE, in solutions engineering, or on internal tools in a physical-ops business) and you're at your best turning messy operational reality into shipped software.
  • Comfortable reaching into backend services or web frontends when the fix lives there, across the stack.
  • A travel or logistics startup background is a plus, and familiarity with regulated data environments will speed up your ramp.

Why Join

  • Impact — Ground-floor ownership of tools a live operation depends on every day
  • Proximity — You'll watch drivers use what you built the same week you shipped it
  • Culture — A small, ambitious team that values speed, creativity, autonomy, and bias for action

What We Offer

  • Global flight privileges through airline partners
  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment (with regular travel to stations in the USA and Canada, including Montréal, Boston, Denver, and Philadelphia)
  • Competitive salary, 401(k), and PTO
  • Medical, dental, vision, and company-paid life insurance
  • The opportunity to contribute to sustainable transportation and redefine how people travel

Location: Remote in a major metro area within the USA or Canada, with occasional travel to station locations in the USA and Canada

Time Zone: Standard business hours local time, targeting EST and CST

Pay Target:$120,000

Job Type: Full Time Salary, Exempt

Job Summary and Responsibilities

Individuals within the Information Technology and Digital Analyst job family serve a vital function as the key liaison between business and technology stakeholders, forging business ideas and processes into concrete requirements to support business operations across the entire CommonSpirit Health enterprise. Solutions must be developed at the best possible cost and align to CommonSpirit's ITD standards, and governance and controls.

To be successful, individuals must possess a combination of business, technical, and leadership skills. This requires an understanding of customers' business needs, processes, and functions. Individuals in this job family must possess the ability to quickly grasp business needs and assess impact to ITD operations and systems and are responsible for facilitating the technical requirements analysis process, developing strong working relationships with business partners, and building knowledge in assigned areas of technical expertise. Individuals working in this job family must possess the capacity to identify, analyze and drive problems to resolution. In addition, individuals working in this job family must possess excellent communication skills and the ability to influence others. They must also be able to quickly assess the impact of issues, metrics and dependencies to identify, prioritize and implement improvements.

As the Principal Analyst will be responsible for complete ownership of technical and process documentation that supports our organization and has an expert understanding of the technology/process for the assigned area of responsibility. An incumbent of this role is expected to be an expert in their field and a mentor for others. A person in this role will have responsibilities of educating cross-functional teams and will be expected to reflect our mission and goals at all times.

Essential Functions:

  • Provides advice, guidance, and support to help people to adopt and embed best-practice approaches to process management. Maintains procedures in the assigned area of responsibility. Reviews them regularly for effectiveness and efficiency. Manages and maintains process compliance in line with business and regulatory requirements involving knowledge of technical processes, tools and techniques. Identifies, assesses and communicates associated risks.
  • Leads focused technical analysis discussions, delivers supporting artifacts and drives review sessions for all necessary approvals.
  • Selects, acquires and integrates data for analysis. Develops data hypotheses and methods, trains and evaluates analytics models, shares insights and findings and continues to iterate with additional data.
  • Models and analyzes current state and future state processes; fosters understanding of how a project impacts current state.
  • Project assignments are complex projects or enterprise-wide assignments.
  • Works on one or more projects or process areas as an expert and provides direction where required.
  • Provides advice and guidance for effective use of measures and measurement. Establishes measurement objectives.
  • Seeks to identify repeatable issues or requests and perform continuous process improvement activities to ultimately improve customer satisfaction experience.
  • Develop knowledge and participate in transitions including training others.
  • Participate in release management functions which may include developing test plans, performing test plans, facilitating with end users for end user acceptance testing.
  • Effectively communication across teams and all levels of management. The incumbent will exercise expert business judgment, financial management knowledge, and effective leadership skills across the enterprise to identify, measure, and drive positive outcomes for the organization.

Remote eligible.

The job summary and responsibilities listed above are designed to indicate the general nature of the work performed within this job. They are not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all job responsibilities required of employees assigned to this job. Employees may be required to perform other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements

Requirements:

  • Bachelors in Computer Science, Technology, Medical, Business discipline or equivalent experience
  • 10 or more years of experience as a business, data, or technical analyst

Preferred experience:

  • Experience with and knowledge of IT Change Management principles, methodologies and tools.
  • At least 5 years of experience working in IT Change Management. IT Problem and IT Incident Management experience is also desired.
  • Experience using ServiceNow to manage changes.
  • ITIL training and certifications, COBIT, ITSM training.

Where You’ll Work

Inspired by faith. Driven by innovation. Powered by humankindness. CommonSpirit Health is building a healthier future for all through its integrated health services. As one of the nation’s largest nonprofit Catholic healthcare organizations, CommonSpirit Health delivers more than 20 million patient encounters annually through more than 2,300 clinics, care sites and 137 hospital-based locations, in addition to its home-based services and virtual care offerings. CommonSpirit has more than 157,000 employees, 45,000 nurses and 25,000 physicians and advanced practice providers across 24 states and contributes more than $4.2 billion annually in charity care, community benefits and unreimbursed government programs. Together with our patients, physicians, partners, and communities, we are creating a more just, equitable, and innovative healthcare delivery system.

Continuous protection. AI-powered Nonstop SecOps. That’s Ontinue.

We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build the systems, data and automation that turn buying signals into qualified pipeline. You'll be a strategic operator with engineering fluency, not someone who only configures tools.

Two GTM teams, each with its own stack and data, are becoming one. Your job is to build the shared foundation first, then the AI-powered plays that run on it. We run our SOC with AI agents and people in control, and we want to go to market the same way.

Build the foundation

Measure and maintain

Required

Preferred

A competitive salary and benefits package, the chance to build the GTM engine for a newly combined business, and direct access to Sales, Marketing, Product and RevOps leaders.

Come as you are! We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives, regardless of race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, disability or veteran status.

jobs.title: Medical Science Liaison
jobs.excerpt: Character Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company working to preserve vision in people with serious, progressive eye diseases.
jobs.description:
Character Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company working to preserve vision in people with serious, progressive eye diseases. Founded in 2018, the company has built the most advanced disease intelligence system for drug development in ophthalmology, starting with dry Age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD). This system fully integrates genomics with longitudinal clinical and imaging data to characterize the pathogenic drivers of disease progression.

Leveraging the insights from its disease intelligence system, Character is advancing two innovative, homegrown programs in Phase 1 studies while continuing to expand its discovery-stage pipeline. The company’s interdisciplinary team spans observational clinical research, data science and AI, drug discovery, clinical development, manufacturing, and commercialization. Character is well capitalized, having raised more than $110 million in Series B financing from leading healthcare and technology investors, and maintains a multi-target drug discovery collaboration with Bausch + Lomb.

Role: Medical Science Liaison

Reports to: Senior Medical Director

Department: Clinical Research

Team: Clinical Development

Level: 9

Location: Remote field-based (U.S.)

The Opportunity:
We’re looking for a Medical Science Liaison (MSL) to drive the success of Character’s later stage clinical trials in dry age-related macular degeneration (AMD). As the scientific bridge between Character and our investigators and clinical sites, you’ll build strong, trusted relationships with principal investigators (PIs), sub-investigators, study coordinators, and other site staff, and serve as a key scientific resource for our programs. Your primary focus is helping our sites stay engaged in their efforts to identify, enroll, and retain the right patients for our trials.

Working closely with Development Operations, you’ll support site activation, train and re-engage site teams on the protocol, build referral pathways into our sites, and resolve barriers to enrollment as they arise. Success in this role means our sites are engaged and well supported, enrollment stays on track, and our internal teams receive timely, actionable site insights that inform recruitment strategy and trial execution. This role is ideal for a relationship-driven, entrepreneurial MSL who thrives in a lean, fast-moving environment. This is a remote, field-based role reporting to the Senior Medical Director, with travel of up to 70%.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Site & Investigator Relationships
  • Site Partnerships: Build and maintain trusted relationships with PIs, sub-investigators, study coordinators, and site staff across Character’s trial sites
  • Investigator Mapping: Map retina specialists and other ophthalmologists who are participating in our studies, prioritizing high-potential investigators and referral sourcesthroughout the US
  • Scientific Support: Serve as a key field scientific resource for sites, answering questions on dry AMD disease biology, the investigational product, and the study protocol
  • Site & Investigator Education: Educate PIs, sub-investigators, and site staff on the mechanism of action, study protocol, eligibility criteria, dosing, and safety profile of the investigational product, at site initiation and on an ongoing basis
  • Site Readiness: Partner with Development Operations on site feasibility, selection, and activation, and support ongoing site readiness and protocol adherence

Patient Recruitment & Enrollment

  • Recruitment Strategy: Partner with Development Operations to develop and execute site-level recruitment and retention plans that keep enrollment on track
  • Enrollment Troubleshooting: Identify barriers to screening, enrollment, and retention at individual sites and work with site teams and internal colleagues on practical solutions
  • Site Prioritization: Follow along with enrollment progress across studies and focus field time on the sites with the greatest need and opportunity

Insights & Compliance

  • Site Insights: Gather actionable feedback from investigators and site staff on trial design, protocol feasibility, recruitment barriers, and unmet needs, and relay these insights to the Senior Medical Director, Development Operations, and Clinical Development teams
  • Participate in executing medical strategy and KOL interactions at medical conferences (e.g., staff medical booth, scientific session attendance, and KOL/HCP interactions)
  • Compliance: Adhere to all applicable legal, regulatory, and company guidelines governing interactions with healthcare professionals, and maintain accurate records of field activities

Skills and Qualifications:

You are a relationship-driven field medical professional with deep knowledge of retinal disease and a hands-on understanding of what it takes for a clinical trial site to succeed. You earn the trust of investigators and site staff by being responsive, scientifically credible, and genuinely useful, and you know how to turn those relationships into enrollment. You combine sound judgment with the autonomy to operate independently in the field, staying closely connected to Development Operations and Clinical Development colleagues.

You are energized by the opportunity to help deliver a clinical program and you thrive in a lean, dynamic environment where priorities evolve. Like us, you value integrity, individual accountability, team camaraderie, open communication, and a commitment to continuous learning.

  • Advanced scientific or clinical degree (PharmD, PhD, MD, OD, or equivalent) required
  • 3+ years of MSL experience in the biopharmaceutical industry
  • At least 2 years of retina experience within ophthalmology
  • Demonstrated experience supporting clinical trial sites; Phase 2 or later-stage trial experience strongly preferred
  • Track record of building strong relationships with PIs and site staff and improving enrollment at trial sites
  • Working knowledge of AMD, including dry AMD and geographic atrophy, current standards of care, and the evolving treatment landscape
  • Working knowledge of clinical trial operations and ICH-GCP
  • Established relationships with retina investigators and academic or community retina centers a plus
  • Ability to explain complex scientific and protocol information, including retinal imaging (e.g., OCT, fundus autofluorescence), clearly to investigators and site staff
  • Strong understanding of the regulatory and compliance requirements governing interactions with healthcare professionals (e.g., FDA, OIG, PhRMA Code)
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills
  • Self-directed and highly organized, with strong judgment in a remote, field-based setting
  • Ability to travel up to 70%, including overnight travel to trial sites, investigator meetings, and scientific congresses

Compensation & Benefits

The annual pay range for this full-time position is $200,000-$230,000 + equity + benefits
This salary range represents the expected base compensation for this role and may vary based on factors including experience, skills, and level.

Benefits include a competitive salary, strong equity incentives, medical, dental, vision, 401(k), an accrued paid time off policy. Character Biosciences is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States.

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. - VINELAND/VABS Administration Experience Required

jobs.excerpt: The Principal Network Engineer will own and evolve a multi-cloud network architecture with AWS (Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, AWS Network Firewall, VPC) and/or Azure (ExpressRoute, VNet peering, Azure Firewall), including consistent policy enforcement, hybrid connectivity, and centralized observability across both clouds.
jobs.description:
The Principal Network Engineer will own and evolve a multi-cloud network architecture with AWS (Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, AWS Network Firewall, VPC) and/or Azure (ExpressRoute, VNet peering, Azure Firewall), including consistent policy enforcement, hybrid connectivity, and centralized observability across both clouds. We value engineers who reason from first principles — understanding how routing, segmentation, DNS, and security controls behave differently across cloud providers — and can apply that knowledge to design consistent, scalable patterns regardless of underlying platform.

What makes this role unique: We value engineers who reason from first principles—understanding how routing, segmentation, DNS, and security controls behave differently across cloud providers—and can apply that knowledge to design consistent, scalable patterns regardless of underlying platform.

What You Will Be Doing

Cloud Architecture & Hybrid Connectivity

  • Design and operate hybrid network connectivity bridging on-premises infrastructure with AWS and Azure, including BGP route policy management, split-horizon DNS, consistent firewall policy enforcement, and failover validation across Direct Connect and ExpressRoute circuits
  • Lead network architecture initiatives including refresh projects, segmentation strategies, SD-WAN deployments, and cloud connectivity (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP)
  • Gather and analyze business requirements to design technology solutions that meet evolving business needs, including modifying existing systems or evaluating vendor solutions

Network Operations & Security

  • Operate and optimize Cisco (or equivalent) routing, switching, and wireless platforms, including campus core/distribution/access layers and wireless controllers
  • Implement and tune network security controls in partnership with the Security team—firewalls, VPN (remote access and site-to-site), NAC, and zero-trust network access
  • Troubleshoot complex, multi-domain network issues spanning routing, switching, wireless, DNS, firewalls, and cloud; drive root-cause analysis to permanent resolution

Observability, Automation & Infrastructure-as-Code

  • Build and maintain network observability using tools such as Datadog, Thousand Eyes, SolarWinds, or equivalent—including dashboards, alerting, and capacity planning
  • Develop automation and Infrastructure-as-Code (Python, Ansible, Terraform) to streamline configuration management, compliance, and change deployment
  • Author and maintain high-quality network documentation including diagrams, runbooks, standards, and as-built records

Team & Operational Excellence

  • Participate in an on-call rotation and lead major incident response when network issues impact the business
  • Prepare documentation for audits and participate in monthly releases and disaster recovery exercises
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the technical growth of the team

What We Require

  • 6+ years of progressive Enterprise Network Engineering experience
  • Bachelor's degree in IT-related field or equivalent professional experience

Hands-On Cloud Expertise (AWS & Axure)

  • Demonstrated practical experience with AWS Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, VPC, Network Firewall, Route 53, ALB/NLB, PrivateLink
  • Proven ability to design and deploy Terraform-managed Infrastructure-as-Code in AWS environments
  • Demonstrated practical experience with Azure ExpressRoute, VNet peering, Azure Firewall
  • Ability to architect and implement hybrid connectivity solutions in Azure

Network Fundamentals & Troubleshooting

  • Expert-level knowledge of routing and switching protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, VXLAN/EVPN, spanning tree, QoS)
  • Deep hands-on experience with Cisco ACI/IOS/IOS-XE/NX-OS and/or comparable platforms (Arista, Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet)
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex network issues using tools such as TCPDUMP, FW Monitor, Packet Capture, or Wireshark

Enterprise Wireless & Security

  • Strong experience with enterprise wireless (Cisco 9800 WLC, Meraki, Aruba, or equivalent), including RF design and troubleshooting
  • Working knowledge of next-generation firewalls and remote-access VPN technologies (Cisco ASA/Firepower, Palo Alto, Fortinet, AnyConnect, etc.)
  • Strong understanding of network security principles, segmentation, and zero-trust concepts

Automation & Infrastructure

  • Hands-on experience with network automation tools and scripting (Python, Ansible, Terraform, Git)
  • Demonstrated proficiency implementing observability tools (Datadog, ThousandEyes, or equivalent)

Communication & Availability

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to explain complex networking concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Participation in on-call rotation encompassing evenings and weekends (approximately every 6 weeks, scheduled in advance)

General Physical Demands

  • Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally to move objects.
  • Jobs are sedentary if traversing activities are required only occasionally.
  • May require occasional travel to support business operations, including in office meetings, collaboration, events, and other work related activities

What We Offer

To support your wellbeing, comprehensive benefits are offered. As an employee, you will have access to:

Employee benefits are designed to align with federal and state employment laws. Benefits may vary based on the state in which work is performed. Benefits for intern, part-time and seasonal employees may differ.

To support your financial wellbeing, we offer competitive pay as well as opportunities for incentive or commission compensation. We also conduct regular annual reviews with pay for performance considerations for base pay increases.

jobs.title: CRO & Product Experimentation Manager (m/w/d) - Remote (Deutschlandweit)
jobs.excerpt: Ein kleines Stück Papier mit Zahlen, die das Potenzial haben, ein Leben für immer zu verändern!
jobs.description:
Ein kleines Stück Papier mit Zahlen, die das Potenzial haben, ein Leben für immer zu verändern! Ok…ersetzten wir das Papier durch eine App und eine Person gegen 600.000+ Nutzer monatlich. This is our Business!

📌 Deine Mission

Als CRO & Product Experimentation Manager (m/w/d) machst du Experimentation zu einem wiederholbaren Wachstumsmotor für die Websites und Apps von NextLotto. Du baust eine strukturierte, KI-gestützte A/B-Test-Strategie mit Fokus auf CRO auf. Dazu gehört ein Prozess, der kontinuierlich Hypothesen generiert, priorisiert und validiert. Deine Arbeit steigert direkt die Conversion bei Registrierung, Verifizierung und Kauf – und damit den Umsatz – in einem regulierten Markt. Mit der Zeit entsteht unter deiner Leitung ein lebendiger Knowledge Hub, sodass jeder Test den nächsten noch klüger macht.

🎯 Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest den gesamten Experimentation-Lifecycle auf Web und App: Research, Hypothese, Testdesign, Umsetzung, QA, Launch, Analyse und Rollout-Entscheidung.

  • Du entwickelst und steuerst einen systematischen Hypothesenprozess, der auf Analytics, Funnel-Daten, Session-Insights, UX-Research und Kundenfeedback aufbaut.

  • Du priorisierst das Test-Backlog anhand eines klaren Frameworks (z. B. ICE/PIE) und sorgst für eine konstante Testfrequenz.

  • Du setzt KI im gesamten Workflow ein, z. B. um mit Claude Code für Testvarianten zu generieren, die per ABlyft ausgespielt werden, um Hypothesen zu formulieren oder Ergebnisse zusammenzufassen.

  • Du setzt Tests in ABlyft auf und führst sie durch, definierst Ziele, Zielgruppen und Stichprobengrößen und stellst die statistische Validität sicher.

  • Du analysierst Ergebnisse, teilst Learnings mit Product, Design und Marketing und bringst Gewinnervarianten in die Produkt-Roadmap.

  • Du stimmst laufende Tests mit anderen Bereichen wie Product und Marketing ab, um unerwartete Wechselwirkungen zu vermeiden.

  • Du baust einen CRO Knowledge Hub in Notion auf und pflegst ihn: Hypothesen, Testdokumentation, Ergebnisse und wiederverwendbare Learnings.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass jeder Test die regulatorischen Vorgaben einhält (Glücksspielregulierung, GlüStV, DSGVO, Spielerschutz).

🚀 Deine Kompetenzen (Hard Skills)

Must-have:

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in CRO, Growth oder Experimentation – mit nachweisbaren Tests, die Business-KPIs bewegt haben.

  • Fundiertes Wissen über A/B- und multivariate Tests: Hypothesendesign, Stichprobengröße, Signifikanz und typische Fallstricke (Peeking, SRM, Novelty-Effekte).

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit clientseitigen Testing-Tools (ABlyft, VWO, Optimizely, AB Tasty o. Ä.).

  • Nachweisbarer Einsatz von KI-Tools (z. B. Claude) im Arbeitsalltag, etwa um Frontend-Testcode zu generieren und anzupassen.

  • Starke Kenntnisse in Web- und Produktanalyse (GA4 o. Ä.), einschließlich Funnel-Analysen.

  • Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch.

Nice-to-have:

  • Solides Verständnis von HTML, CSS und JavaScript, um KI-generierten Variantencode zu prüfen, zu debuggen und zu testen.

  • Erfahrung mit App-Experimentation (iOS/Android, Feature Flags, Remote Config).

  • SQL- bzw. BigQuery-Kenntnisse für Ad-hoc-Analysen.

💡Deine Soft Skills

  • Hohe Ownership: Du treibst das CRO-Programm voran, von der Idee bis zum Rollout.

  • Datengetrieben und intellektuell ehrlich: Du akzeptierst auch verlorene Tests und teilst Learnings offen.

  • Strukturiert und prozessorientiert: Du baust Systeme statt nur einzelner Tests.

  • Neugierig und AI-native:Du suchst ständig nach Wegen, mit KI schneller zu arbeiten.

  • Starker Kommunikator: Du erklärst Ergebnisse verständlich für Design, Entwicklung und Management.

  • Teamorientiert, aber bereit, Meinungen mit Fakten zu hinterfragen.

🏆 Deine Ziele in dieser Rolle (Impact)

  • Du führst einen KI-gestützten Prozess für A/B-Tests ein, von der Hypothese bis zum Rollout, den das gesamte Team nutzen kann.

  • Du etablierst eine feste monatliche Testfrequenz auf Web und App.

  • Du erzielst eine messbare Steigerung der zentralen Conversion-Rates (z. B. Registrierung, Verifizierung, Erstkauf).

  • Du baust in Notion einen dokumentierten Knowledge Hub mit allen Tests, Ergebnissen und Learnings auf, der mit Product, Design und Marketing geteilt wird.

🎓 Dein Background – Ausbildung & Erfahrung

  • Studium in BWL, VWL, Psychologie, Statistik, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Fach – oder entsprechende Praxiserfahrung.

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in CRO, Growth Marketing, Product Analytics oder Experimentation, idealerweise im B2C-E-Commerce, im App-Umfeld oder im Online-Glücksspiel.

  • Erfahrung in einem schnelllebigen Digitalunternehmen; Erfahrung in einem regulierten Markt ist ein Plus.

Das Team

  • Ergebnisse erzielen – Übernimm Verantwortung für Problem, Ziel und Ergebnis durch Selbstorganisation und datenbasierte Entscheidungen.

You will work closely with the founders and with a forward-deployed engineer who builds the tools, integrations and prototypes that a live sales process needs, so your job is to win the room, work out what the customer actually needs, and direct that build until the deal closes.

jobs.description:
TASK SUMMARY

The No Surprises Act Arbitrator role is a 1099 position. Services are paid for on a per-case basis for contracting work completed.

The experienced Arbitrator makes the payment determination in the independent dispute resolution process between providers, facilities, providers of air ambulance services, out-of-network services, and excessive emergency room charges provided by group health plans, health insurance issuers, and Federal Employees Health Benefits (FEHB) Program carriers. The arbitrator makes the determinations based on the rules enacted under the No Surprises Act (NSA). The NSA process requires that the Entity determine a case's eligibility and whether any conflict of interest exists regarding the arbitrator selected for a particular dispute. The responsibilities of an arbitrator include analyzing information provided by the Parties to the dispute using knowledge of the NSA requirements and acceptable criteria under the NSA, and creating a report on the outcome of the arbitration process in accordance with the NSA requirements. There is no hearing component to these reviews; this is a strictly paper-based review process.

To be successful as an Arbitrator, you should have solid knowledge of healthcare-related payment determinations, sound organizational skills, and strong understanding of industry practices. Ultimately, a top-notch arbitrator must have the ability to remain neutral when analyzing the materials provided by the parties to the dispute and be able to write a concise decision in a short period of time. Prior experience with medical arbitration and/or dispute resolution is important. In the absence of No Surprises Act experience, preference will be given to arbitrators with AAA training and healthcare/insurance review experience.

Dane Street’s success relies on individual and team contributions every day. We care for our customers, each other, and Dane Street. It is the responsibility for all to maintain a positive working environment that promotes client satisfaction and results.

  • Reviewing materials related to the dispute and any potential data related to the issues in question.

  • Obtain Dane Street training for the program and complete process review.
  • Submit reporting on Dane Street’s portal and submit billing on the completed review.
  • Turn-around all reviews in 5 days or less.

About the Role

Our client is a well-established roofing contractor based in Colorado, USA, serving customers across the Colorado Front Range.

The business currently completes approximately three roofs per week and has the infrastructure to significantly increase its volume. They are looking for a highly organised, proactive and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to support the growing operation.

Despite the Administrative Assistant title, this is not a junior or passive role. The successful candidate will be expected to take ownership, work independently, follow projects through to completion, identify issues before they become problems and continuously look for ways to improve processes.

This is a phone-heavy and customer-facing position, with significant inbound and outbound communication. Native-level or near-native spoken English is essential.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Customer & Office Administration

  • Answer and return company phone calls.
  • Monitor and respond to company emails.
  • Communicate professionally with homeowners, vendors, subcontractors, insurance companies, inspectors and municipalities.
  • Maintain accurate customer and project records.
  • Manage tasks and projects within the CRM system.
  • Keep project notes, statuses, documents and follow-up tasks up to date.
  • Identify projects or tasks that appear stalled and take appropriate action.

Lead Follow-Up

  • Contact new leads promptly.
  • Follow up with leads who have not scheduled appointments.
  • Assist with inspection and appointment scheduling.
  • Document all lead communication and follow-up activity.
  • Ensure potential opportunities do not fall through the cracks.

Permits & Inspections

  • Apply for roofing and construction permits with cities and counties throughout Colorado.
  • Research municipality-specific permitting requirements.
  • Track permit applications through approval.
  • Record permit costs and upload permits to customer files.
  • Identify projects requiring mid-roof or specialist inspections.
  • Schedule required inspections.
  • Coordinate ladder sets where required.
  • Communicate inspection dates and requirements to homeowners.
  • Track inspections through final approval.

Permitting is a significant part of this position, and the successful candidate will need to manage different requirements and online portals across approximately 20 Colorado municipalities.

Insurance Supplements

  • Assist with submitting insurance supplements.
  • Maintain the Supplements in Progress tracker.
  • Track original insurance pricing, supplement status, approvals and increases.
  • Save supplement documentation to customer files.
  • Communicate supplement submissions and approvals to homeowners.
  • Follow supplements through to completion.
  • Ensure approved supplemental amounts are reflected correctly in final billing.

Invoicing & Accounts Receivable

  • Prepare down-payment invoices.
  • Review signed quotes and insurance estimates when preparing invoices.
  • Understand basic insurance terminology such as RCV and supplemental payments.
  • Prepare final invoices and incorporate applicable change orders.
  • Update invoices when insurance supplements are approved.
  • Monitor accounts receivable.
  • Contact customers regarding unpaid balances.
  • Document collection communication and follow up until outstanding balances are resolved.

Project Completion & Warranties

  • Prepare Certificates of Completion.
  • Send completion documentation to customers and insurance carriers where required.
  • Complete the company's 5-Year Hail & Wind Warranty process.
  • Identify applicable manufacturer warranties from signed contracts.
  • Register manufacturer warranties with relevant manufacturers.
  • Maintain accurate warranty documentation.
  • Notify homeowners once warranty registration has been completed.

CRM & File Management

  • Maintain complete and organised customer files.
  • Ensure CRM and Google Drive information remains consistent.
  • Upload permits, supplements, warranties, certificates, invoices and other project documentation.
  • Maintain consistent file naming and folder structures.
  • Identify and clean up duplicate, outdated or incorrectly stored documents.
  • Continually improve the organisation of digital files and records.

Process Improvement & Automation

The client is looking for someone who will improve the system rather than simply work within it.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Helping maintain and improve CRM workflows.
  • Reviewing task templates, project stages, forms and automations.
  • Identifying repetitive administrative tasks that could be automated.
  • Identifying process gaps that could lead to errors.
  • Creating and maintaining SOPs and checklists.
  • Assisting management with improving processes between sales, production, administration and accounting.

Compliance & Administration

  • Maintain subcontractor documentation and compliance packets.
  • Track W-9s, Certificates of Insurance, subcontractor agreements and other required paperwork.
  • Follow up on expired or missing documentation.
  • Maintain HR and company documentation.
  • Track contractor licences and registrations.
  • Ensure licence and registration renewals are completed before expiry.
  • Maintain insurance certificates and compliance documentation.
  • Maintain accurate vendor, municipality, inspector and manufacturer contact information.

Google & Marketing Support

Once core administrative responsibilities are under control, the successful candidate may also assist with:

  • Maintaining Google Business Profiles.
  • Uploading project photographs and before-and-after content.
  • Organising project photographs and marketing assets.
  • Creating before-and-after project videos using provided templates.
  • Organising marketing and social media assets.

Requirements

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Previous experience in an administrative, operations, customer service, coordination or similar role.
  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Strong telephone and customer communication skills.
  • Confidence making outbound calls.
  • Strong computer literacy.
  • Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • The ability to work independently and take ownership.
  • The ability to manage multiple tasks, projects and deadlines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • The ability to identify inefficiencies and suggest improvements.
  • Experience working with CRM systems is advantageous.
  • Strong Google Workspace/Google Drive skills.
  • The ability and willingness to work US Mountain Time hours.

Advantageous Experience

Experience in any of the following would be beneficial:

  • Roofing or construction administration.
  • Insurance administration or claims.
  • Permitting.
  • Accounts receivable or collections.
  • CRM administration.
  • Project coordination.
  • Compliance administration.
  • Process improvement.
  • SOP development.
  • Experience working with US-based companies.
  • Experience working US hours.

Working Hours

The position supports a US-based business and requires the candidate to work Mountain Time.

South African working hours: approximately 16:00–01:00 SAST.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is someone who:

  • Takes initiative rather than waiting to be instructed.
  • Is highly organised and detail-oriented.
  • Is confident speaking to customers and making outbound calls.
  • Can manage difficult conversations professionally.
  • Follows tasks through to completion.
  • Notices when something is falling through the cracks.
  • Can work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Enjoys improving processes and finding efficiencies.
  • Is comfortable learning new systems and technology.
  • Takes ownership and accountability for their work.

Key Consideration

This is not a quiet back-office administrative position. The role involves frequent phone communication, outbound lead follow-up, customer collections, permitting, insurance administration and ongoing coordination.

The successful candidate should be confident, proactive, highly organised and comfortable taking ownership of a broad range of responsibilities.

Job Summary:

As an AI Architect you will build AI-native products. You’ll lead cross-functional Innovation Delivery Squads—owning outcomes end-to-end across web, mobile, AI agents, and streaming backends. You’re a hands-on technical leader who can scope, architect, staff, and ship; then run the product safely at scale.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Stand up and run squads (Discovery → Prototype → Product → Platform & SRE).
  • Design and ship RAG/agent systems: pick models (e.g., Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google, or open-weights like Llama/Mistral), define tools/functions, and choose retrieval (default Postgres + pgvector, scale to Weaviate/Qdrant/Pinecone when needed).
  • Operate AI safely: evals & guardrails, structured outputs (JSON/Schema), PII redaction, refusal policies, cost/latency budgets, and LLM observability.
  • Own delivery outcomes: SLOs, quality, cost, velocity; release with feature flags and canaries.
  • Be client-facing: discovery, scoping, SoW, roadmap, QBRs.
  • Hire/coach Tech Leads, EMs, and PMs; level up practices.

Requirements

  • 8–12+ yrs engineering; 4+ yrs leading multi-team delivery; shipped production web/mobile systems at scale.
  • Shipped at least one production AI app using Claude/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral, backed by retrieval (pgvector or a vector DB) and a basic eval/guardrail pipeline.
  • Implemented orchestration (LangGraph/DSPy or Temporal for durable workflows), rerankers (e.g., Cohere/Jina/Voyage), and prompt/tool versioning.
  • Built with modern cloud + data: serverless/K8s, Terraform, OpenTelemetry, feature flags/experimentation.
  • Excellent client communication and commercial sense (SoWs, staffing, utilization).

Tech stack (you have hands on experience)

  • Models: Anthropic Claude; OpenAI; Google; open-weights (Llama, Mistral).
  • Orchestration & agents: LangGraph (or DSPy) for graphs; Temporal for durable, long-running tasks and SLAs.
  • Retrieval: Postgres + pgvector (default); Weaviate/Qdrant/Pinecone when scale/ops require; hybrid search with OpenSearch/Typesense.
  • Embeddings / rerankers: OpenAI/Voyage/E5/BGE; Cohere/Jina/Voyage rerank.
  • Guardrails & evals: JSON/Pydantic schemas, red-team sets, promptfoo/Ragas/DeepEval; content/PII filters.
  • Observability: OpenTelemetry traces incl. prompt/tool spans; Langfuse/Arize Phoenix (or equivalent) + Sentry/Grafana.
  • App & data: Next.js 15 (RSC), TypeScript/Go/Python; Postgres; Kafka/Redpanda/NATS; dbt/lakehouse optional.
  • Ops: Cloud Run/ECS/K8s; Terraform/OpenTofu; GitHub Actions; LaunchDarkly/Unleash; Statsig/GrowthBook.

The Risk Solutions Director is the company’s authoritative expert on clinical or program domains and is accountable for how that domain performs across the entire solution portfolio. This role focuses on the domain of Risk Adjustment across all lines of business.

The Risk Solution Director operates as a deep specialist across all segments and lines of business. This is not an SME support or technical advisory role. The Risk Solutions Director owns outcomes: domain-level product-market fit, the strength of the value narrative, and the clinical or programmatic integrity of what the company sells and delivers. It requires equal parts domain command, commercial orientation, and cross-functional influence.

Domain Strategy & Portfolio Authority

  • Drive the domain roadmap. Maintain a current, prioritized view of where the domain needs to go - capabilities, depth, competitive differentiation - and translate that into actionable product input.
  • Define what “good” looks like. Establish outcome standards, solution design principles, and minimum viable configurations for the domain
  • Identify and close portfolio gaps. Quantify capability shortfalls that limit commercial performance, build the investment case with ROI rationale, and drive prioritization decisions with leadership.
  • Own discovery, prioritization and scoping on customer feedback and requests provided via intake process, identifying thematic improvements and actioning on key requests within the domain – both customer-specific and global.

Cross-Segment Solution Design

  • Run domain-level pilots and validation. Lead incubation of new domain capabilities or modules, including design of the test, success criteria, and decision framework for productization.
  • Maintain cross-segment consistency. Ensure that domain solutions deployed across segments do not fragment into one-offs. Standardization of the domain layer is your accountability.

Market & Competitive Intelligence

  • Own the domain value narrative. Develop and maintain the authoritative story for the domain: buyer-ready proof points and competitive differentiation.
  • Own domain-level market intelligence. Track regulatory developments (e.g., ONC/CMS rule changes, CMMI program evolution), competitive moves, and buyer expectation shifts within your domain. Synthesize signal from noise and surface forward-looking implications, not just observations.

  • Influence without authority. Drive alignment across Product & Technology, Sales, Customer Success, and Services on domain-related decisions. Earn trust through clarity and credibility.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated ownership of a domain-level strategy or product area with measurable outcomes

Competencies:

Business Insight & Organizational Savvy
