Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications. welolifesciences.com

We are currently seeking experienced and highly skilled English to Canadian French linguists to join our dynamic Life Sciences program specializing in Pharmacovigilance. This is an exciting opportunity to work on vital medical and clinical content, contributing to global health and safety initiatives.

In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the accurate and timely delivery of translations under tight deadlines. Many assignments are time-sensitive, requiring quick turnarounds to meet client expectations while maintaining the highest standards of quality.

Join our global team and help us make a difference in global health by delivering high-quality translations that support critical medical research and patient safety.

Key Details About the Role

  • Translate documents from English (US) to French (Canada), with a focus on pharmacovigilance content.
  • Perform Translation, Copy Editing (CE), and Machine Translation Post Editing (MTPE) tasks as required, ensuring high-quality standards and consistency.
  • Translate specialized medical and pharmaceutical content, including Product Monographs, Clinical Study Documents, and Medical Information Letters.
  • Adhere to tight deadlines, especially for projects received during EU close-of-business hours, with delivery required for early morning.
  • Work within the client-provided XTM and Phrase (Memsource) CAT tools (licenses will be provided).
  • Maintain professionalism, responsiveness, and reliability to meet client expectations and ensure timely delivery of assignments.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in medical and pharmaceutical translation, particularly for pharmaceutical companies or life sciences translation agencies in Quebec or Canada.
  • Specific expertise in translating Product Monographs and Medical Information Letters.
  • Bachelor’s degree in translation or a bachelor’s degree in science (e.g., pharmacology, biology, biochemistry) combined with a translation degree from a Quebec or Canadian university.
  • Membership in a Professional Order (e.g., OTTIAQ) is highly preferred.
  • Fluency in English (source language) and native-level proficiency in French (Canada) (target language).
  • Availability during US time zone business hours (location can be any country).
  • Strong attention to detail, consistency, and commitment to meeting deadlines under time-sensitive conditions.
  • Familiarity with CAT tools, specifically XTM and Phrase (Memsource) (training provided if necessary).
  • Ability to handle sensitive and technical content with confidentiality and precision.

Bonus if You Have

  • Experience working with high-volume, time-critical translation projects.
  • Strong background in pharmacovigilance, medical, or pharmaceutical content.
  • Previous experience working in collaborative environments with strict client guidelines.
  • Positive track record of professionalism and reliability in previous roles.

Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.

With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually.
Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Director of Talent Acquisition to lead our Talent Acquisition function and own how we find, assess, and hire the people who will carry our next stage of growth. Reporting directly to the Chief People Officer, you will lead the recruiting team and partner directly with the executive team and business leaders to get the right people into the right roles. We are a high-growth, PE-backed technology company where quality, speed, accountability, and operating discipline matter. This is a hands-on recruiting leadership role for someone who can run a function, carry a search, work with hiring managers, and help us build.

What You'll Do

    Build the Talent Acquisition Engine

  • Own and evolve the enterprise talent acquisition strategy in partnership with the CPO and executive leadership team.
  • Define consistent hiring standards, structured assessment practices, and quality-of-hire expectations across the company.
  • Build hiring plans around the company's most critical capabilities and growth priorities.
  • Identify hiring and capability gaps early and drive action to close them.

    • Lead Talent Acquisition Day-to-Day

  • Own quality of hire end-to-end, partnering with business leaders on critical and executive searches.
  • Build strong pipelines for high-priority roles and ensure hiring managers make timely, well- informed decisions.
  • Use data, technology, AI, and automation to improve recruiting efficiency, pipeline visibility, and decision quality.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the recruiting team, setting clear priorities, capacity plans, performance expectations, and standards of work.

    • Be a Strategic Executive Partner

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the CPO, CEO, and executive leadership team on talent and organizational decisions.
  • Translate talent data into clear business insights, risks, and recommendations.
  • Deliver real-time market intelligence and compensation benchmarking to inform hiring decisions, workforce planning, and offer strategies.

What You Bring

    Required

  • 10-12+ years of progressive experience in Talent Acquisition or recruiting, including experience leading a talent acquisition team.
  • Experience in high-growth technology, SaaS, fintech, or similarly dynamic environments.
  • A demonstrated track record of building recruiting strategies, teams, processes, and programs that scale.
  • Deep hands-on recruiting and candidate assessment expertise, including executive and critical- role hiring.
  • A highly analytical, data-driven approach to talent decisions, with sound judgment and strong business orientation.
  • A bias toward action, with the ability to move between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
  • The ability to operate effectively in an environment where growth, efficiency, and accountability are equally important.
  • Strong executive presence and proven credibility with senior leaders.

    • Preferred

  • Experience operating in a PE-backed, private-equity, or highly performance-oriented environment.
  • Experience using AI and emerging technology to improve how candidates are identified, assessed, selected, and engaged.
  • Experience recruiting within both Canadian and US markets, including understanding differences in talent landscapes and recruitment strategies, is an asset.

Mission Summary:

The Data Platform team is the vital link between our company's expansive data and the engineering teams that rely on it. We architect and operate the core services and infrastructure necessary to transform petabytes of raw data each month into actionable insights for our Machine Learning and Autonomy engineers. This role is a key contributor across our core initiatives:

  • Data Processing: We are building state-of-the-art infrastructure to meet the demands of our rapidly scaling fleet and sophisticated ML engineering requirements. You will be responsible for ensuring that our core data pipelines are robustly engineered—meaning they are performant, user-friendly, and highly fault-tolerant.
  • Data Discovery: we are building a platform that combines cataloging data for search needs across our metadata stores, vector datastores, and various data warehouses to super charge our ML pipelines. You would be coming in and working with ML and autonomy stakeholders to build out this new discovery platform.
  • Data Lineage: we are getting started with building our data lineage system that will track the usage of all data at Motional. You would work with our stakeholders to ensure our system is widely adopted and address customer pain points.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Play a key role in designing and building the next generation of data infrastructure.
  • Build scalable backend services for data discovery and data lineage systems.
  • Write high quality, maintainable code to process petabytes of data
  • Lead and champion high-level system design and quality code reviews/technical contributions.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data processing and access with cloud ETL technology.

What We're Looking For:

  • 3+ years of professional experience as a data engineer or data pipeline engineer
  • BS or MS in Computer Science or related field
  • Strong development experience with Python and SQL.
  • Expertise with AWS services and solutions (EKS, Lambda, ETL)
  • Experience with distributed system design and development
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, continuous delivery environment

Bonus Points (not required):

  • Experience with Infrastructure Monitoring
  • Experience working in cross-functional development teams
  • Prior experience with agentic workflows is a plus.
  • Prior experience in autonomous vehicles (AV) is a plus.

We encourage a hybrid schedule with in-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors including but not limited to specific skills, experience and expertise, role location, certifications, licenses, and business needs. Our journey is always people first.

Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.

Higher purpose, greater impact.

We’re creating first-of-its-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. We are orchestrating the best high-performing team!

This role sits at the intersection of revenue growth, client success, and product feedback — one of the most visible, cross-functional seats in our commercial organization.

You'll be the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for key accounts, building deep relationships with C-level stakeholders. That level of trust takes genuine curiosity and a real technical understanding of your client's business — you'll act as the human dimension of the product, working closely with Sales, Product, and Finance to orchestrate the resolution of complex technical issues at the executive level.

This role will push you to think several moves ahead. You'll design your revenue approach based on segmentation across your portfolio (Tier 1 Strategic / Tier 2 Growth / Tier 3 Transactional), balancing high-spend accounts against high-growth ones. The payments landscape moves fast, and the best Senior KAMs at Yuno spot opportunities before clients ask for them, build quantified business cases with rigor, and hold themselves to a high bar on every renewal and every renegotiation.

If you're energized by building something meaningful with clients, thrive when no two days look the same, and want your work to shape Yuno's global expansion, this role is for you.

Your Contribution Will Be

  • Own strategic relationships with enterprise accounts, serving as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor to C-level stakeholders.

  • Design account strategies that move clients from growth to strategic tier, adjusting tactics based on portfolio segmentation (Tier 1 Strategic / Tier 2 Growth / Tier 3 Transactional).

  • Lead commercial negotiations on renewals, pricing, payment terms, and supply agreements, building quantified business cases through value-based negotiation.

  • Drive revenue expansion through upselling and cross-selling while building a portfolio-wide pipeline of high-quality opportunities.

  • Own monthly, quarterly, and annual forecasting and account planning, anticipating revenue risks and growth opportunities.

Skills You Need

  • Demonstrated expertise in value-based commercial negotiation, business case quantification, contract renewals, and account portfolio segmentation.

  • Strong command of forecasting, pipeline building, and managing complex account portfolios with strict attention to detail.

  • Ability to combine strategic empathy with technical understanding of payment infrastructure to resolve executive-level client issues.

  • High ownership mindset, with a track record of driving initiatives to completion in fast-paced, ambiguous startup environments.

jobs.excerpt: We are looking for a strategic and execution-focused Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market strategy for NMI's card-not-present (CNP) processing and Value Added Solutions (VAS) portfolio, the tools and services that power secure, high-converting online and card-not-present transactions for merchants, software platforms and partners across the United States.
jobs.description:
We are looking for a strategic and execution-focused Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market strategy for NMI's card-not-present (CNP) processing and Value Added Solutions (VAS) portfolio, the tools and services that power secure, high-converting online and card-not-present transactions for merchants, software platforms and partners across the United States.

NMI has evolved from a payment gateway into a full-service payment platform. Our CNP processing stack and VAS suite, including Customer Vault, Automatic Card Updater, Invoicing, ACH and fraud prevention tools, give merchants and partners a single, trusted path from sign up to pay out. This role supports that evolution, helping translate processing and VAS capabilities into messaging that speaks to the outcomes online merchants, marketplaces, subscription businesses and software platforms actually care about: conversion, fraud loss reduction, recurring revenue retention and total cost of acceptance.

You will lead market positioning, messaging, launches and enablement for NMI's CNP processing and VAS offerings, working closely with product, sales and channel teams to help make sure NMI is the preferred processing and VAS partner for every merchant and partner selling online.

This role calls for a solid understanding of how ecommerce merchants, subscription businesses and software platforms evaluate and adopt payment processing and value added services, and the ability to help translate technical capability (tokenization, network tokenization, recurring billing, customer vaulting, PCI scope reduction, fraud and chargeback tools) into outcome-led messaging that supports pipeline and adoption.

This role is also NMI's evangelist for CNP processing and VAS. You will present to sales teams and internal stakeholders, and help represent NMI at ecommerce and payments industry events. You will build AI tools into your everyday workflow as a core habit rather than an occasional add-on, and bring enough technical fluency across payment gateways, tokenization, APIs and PCI compliance to work credibly alongside engineers and technical buyers.

This is a remote, US-based role, with a strong preference for candidates in the Eastern or Central time zone.

About NMI

NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one-size-fits-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We're the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We're creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what's possible so they can think about what's next. But we're not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.

How We Work - Our Core Values

  • Be a Good Person, It's Simple. We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus
  • Align, Trust & Go. We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.
  • Raise the Bar. Good enough isn't enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own CNP Processing & VAS Go-to-Market Strategy — Lead positioning and messaging for NMI's card-not-present processing stack and Value Added Solutions, including tokenization and vaulting, recurring billing support, ACH, invoicing and fraud prevention tools.
  • Define clear, outcome-led value propositions for ecommerce merchants, subscription businesses, marketplaces and software platforms, grounded in conversion, revenue retention and fraud reduction rather than processing specifications alone.
  • Develop differentiated narratives that articulate why NMI is the processing and VAS partner of choice for online and card-not-present businesses, moving away from feature-and-spec language in favor of stories about merchant and partner success.
  • Partner with Product Management to influence roadmap decisions using merchant insight and competitive intelligence, driving adoption of NMI's CNP processing and VAS suite.
  • Drive Product Launches & Market Adoption — Support go-to-market execution for new processing capabilities, VAS features and integrations.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally across product, sales, corporate marketing and channel marketing on launch execution.
  • Create launch plans, enablement materials, customer-facing messaging and internal readiness programs for online merchants, subscription businesses and software platforms.
  • Support adoption and revenue generation by aligning messaging with onboarding, documentation and the merchant experience.
  • Build Understanding of the eCommerce & VAS Ecosystem — Develop working knowledge of buyer and operator personas within ecommerce, subscription/recurring billing and software platform segments.
  • Conduct market research on trends in online fraud, chargebacks, PCI compliance, checkout conversion and payment orchestration.
  • Monitor competitors and market dynamics to support NMI's differentiation strategy for CNP processing and VAS.
  • Translate research into actionable, solution-focused messaging and strategic recommendations.
  • Build Sales & Channel Enablement — Develop high-impact sales enablement tools, including pitch decks, battlecards, case studies, messaging frameworks, ROI narratives and use cases specific to CNP processing and VAS.
  • Help sales articulate the business value of NMI's processing and VAS suite in terms merchants and partners care about, not just technical capability.
  • Support lifecycle messaging that drives adoption, expansion and retention among merchants and partners.
  • Partner with channel marketing to equip ISOs, software providers and reseller partners with compelling, VAS-focused messaging they can use with confidence.
  • Support NMI's Evangelism — Present NMI's CNP processing and VAS solutions to sales teams and internal stakeholders, and support prospect and partner conversations.
  • Help represent NMI at ecommerce and payments industry events and conferences as opportunities arise.
  • Support analyst relationships and help build a credible, technical voice for NMI's CNP processing and VAS story.
  • Bring working technical fluency across payment gateways, tokenization, APIs and PCI compliance to work credibly with engineers, integrators and technical buyers.
  • Influence & Support Product & Business Strategy — Bring competitive insight and merchant research into product packaging, pricing and positioning discussions.
  • Help build business cases for new VAS opportunities and processing enhancements.
  • Drive alignment across product, engineering and commercial teams on processing and VAS priorities.
  • Contribute to Thought Leadership & Drive Solution Storytelling — Turn merchant and market insights into repeatable narratives and frameworks for internal and external use.
  • Partner with content and communications on thought leadership (whitepapers, points of view, benchmark reports, webinars) about how NMI's processing and VAS solutions help merchants succeed.
  • Contribute to company and industry initiatives (webinars, events, analysts, partners) relevant to ecommerce and CNP processing.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Five plus years of B2B product marketing experience in payments, fintech or a closely related ecommerce technology space. Payments or fintech experience is required.
  • Experience marketing, or supporting the marketing of, card-not-present payment processing, online payment gateways, tokenization/vaulting, recurring billing, fraud prevention or related payments or fintech value added services.
  • Ability to help translate technical processing and fraud/compliance capabilities into solution-forward, outcome-based messaging for non-technical merchants and buyers.
  • Experience supporting cross-functional product and feature launches.
  • Comfortable and effective presenting live to sales teams, prospects and internal/external stakeholders.
  • Ability to move a product's narrative from feature-and-spec-led to solution- and outcome-led, and to bring sales and channel teams along with that shift.
  • Uses AI tools as part of daily product marketing work (research, content, competitive analysis, enablement production).
  • Strong storytelling, messaging, speaking and content development skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or another related field.

Essential Skills and Experience:

  • Strategist - You combine classic strategic marketing skills with experience in multi-channel marketing/distribution, have perspective, and can see and discuss multiple aspects and impacts of issues and project them into the future.
  • Strong External and Internal Collaborator - You collaborate well cross-functionally with key internal partners, work effectively with external partners to identify potential joint marketing opportunities, and have a willingness to learn and grow.
  • Business Savvy - You possess a technical understanding of payment processing, tokenization, and fraud/compliance tools, have a solid degree of business acumen, and provide consistent, accurate information.
  • Master Communicator - You have the ability to distill complex and difficult information into easy-to-understand communications. In other words, you can easily "de-geek the speak" with your exceptional creative and communication skills.
  • Influencer - You build strong working relationships with peers, internal partners and external partners.
  • Flexible - You not only cope with change, you thrive on it and can shift gears comfortably.
  • Driven - You are results-oriented with a positive outlook and a clear focus on quality and business performance.
  • Solution Oriented - You have the ability to identify and creatively solve complex problems.
  • Personable - You are positive, energetic, and exude a strong sense of teamwork by working effectively, respectfully, and efficiently with all team members.
  • Courageous and Ethical - You possess professional courage, steadfastly persevere through challenges, are ambitious while humble, have high standards for ethics and integrity, and do the right things the right way.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience marketing into ecommerce, subscription/recurring billing, marketplace or software platform segments.
  • Familiarity with payment gateways, tokenization, PCI DSS compliance or fraud/chargeback management tools.
  • Experience working on cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience contributing to a product's shift from a technical, spec-driven story to a solution- and outcome-driven story.
  • Exposure to ISOs, resellers or channel partners.

Do you feel like you have a slightly out of the ordinary career path or history? We are open to all walks of life and very willing to hear your story. Please don't feel like this should be a barrier to securing a great career at NMI! We appreciate success can come in all shapes and sizes. Fill in the 'Additional Info' box on our application to tell us more about your path.

As well as being a part of something exciting everyday, you will also receive the following benefits:

  • A remote first culture!
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Personal growth and advancement opportunities

We work together. Your team and the people you will work with…

You’ll work closely with a small team of engineers, supporting both the technical direction and the people behind it. This role blends hands-on involvement with leadership, helping guide delivery while staying connected to the details when needed.

You’ll collaborate with product manager to shape priorities, balance new work with ongoing improvements, and keep the team focused and supported. You’ll also connect with other leaders across the organisation to share practices and help strengthen our engineering culture as we grow.

You set direction, ensure high standards in both delivery and quality, and balance short-term goals with long-term sustainability.   • Impact: Take an integral role in defining team goals and ensuring proposed work is aligned with them. You drive prioritisation within the team to best achieve goals. You push yourself and the team to achieve team goals.

  • Operational Excellence: Identify and put in place practices needed to ensure security and operational service level objectives (SLOs) are met. You coordinate with your squad — and others as needed — to ensure organisation-wide on-call coverage. You drive the squad to operational excellence, leading regular metrics reviews to ensure high coverage and performance

  • Planning & Delivery: Work with the Product Manager and team to set objectives and key results (OKRs) that align with company goals. You identify risks and blockers early and work with stakeholders to mitigate them. You measure team performance so that you can continually improve it. You communicate team progress against OKRs, key performance indicators (KPIs) and other milestones to relevant stakeholders. You co-lead annual and quarterly planning for your squad.

You collaborate effectively with cross-functional colleagues, such as UX and data. You co-lead your squad with your squad's Product Manager. You ensure team expenditures (both OpEx and CapEx) are in line with budgets

jobs.description:
As a Sr. Principal Engineer for k0rdent, you will set the technical direction across the entire k0rdent engineering department — spanning core k0rdent, AI Infrastructure, and AI Applications. You are the most senior individual contributor in the organization and the technical counterpart to the engineering leadership team. You will own end-to-end architectural coherence across these three areas, ensuring that the platform they collectively produce is greater than the sum of its parts: a unified, production-grade system for running modern and AI workloads on Kubernetes at enterprise and service provider scale.

This role is deeply technical and deliberately broad. You will write code, design systems, prototype the hardest problems, and resolve the architectural decisions. You will partner with the Director(s) of Engineering and Engineering Managers and across the department to translate product strategy into durable technical execution, and you will be the engineering organization's senior technical voice with customers, partners, and upstream communities.

Technical Leadership Scope:

Provide cross-departmental technical leadership without direct supervisory authority. Mentor and grow Staff and Principal engineers across all three pillars (Core k0rdent, AI Infrastructure, AI Apps), raise the technical bar through architecture and code review, and serve as the department's senior technical representative in cross-functional, customer, and external forums.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Own Cross-Departmental Technical Strategy: Define and evolve the multi-quarter technical roadmap for k0rdent as a whole. Ensure that decisions made in core k0rdent, AI Infrastructure, and AI Apps compose into a coherent platform rather than four parallel tracks. Identify the architectural bets that will let k0rdent scale across customers, clouds, hardware generations, and workload types, and drive consensus on which to make.

  • Architect Across Pillars: Lead the design of the highest-risk, cross-cutting components and contracts in the platform — the cluster and state management primitives in KCM/KSM, the GPU/accelerator and AI runtime layer in AI Infrastructure, the application and serving experience in AI Apps, and the telemetry, signal, and SLO surface in Observability. Own the interfaces and abstractions that connect them.

  • Set Engineering Standards: Establish department-wide patterns and quality bars — API design, testing strategy, observability requirements, performance, security, multi-tenancy, and operational readiness. Drive their adoption through example, review, and direct collaboration with Engineering Managers and tech leads.

  • Mentor and Grow Engineers: Coach Staff and Principal engineers across all four pillars and partner with Engineering Managers on technical career development throughout the department. Help calibrate and raise the bar for senior IC hiring.

  • Drive Alignment with the Broader Ecosystem: Partner with engineering leaders outside k0rdent and with upstream communities (Kubernetes, CNCF, OpenTelemetry, CNCF AI/ML projects, model-serving runtimes) to ensure k0rdent's decisions compose cleanly with the broader cloud-native landscape that customers run alongside it.

  • Inform Product and Business Strategy: Work directly with product management and executive leadership to translate customer problems into technical options, and surface the technical realities — risks, costs, time horizons — that should shape product decisions across the department.

  • Represent Mirantis Externally: Engage with customers on the deepest technical questions, contribute to upstream projects, and represent Mirantis in conferences, standards bodies, and technical publications.

Business Impact:

  • Architectural Coherence: Ensure that work done across engineering pillars adds up to one platform. This is the single largest source of leverage — and the largest source of risk — at this stage of k0rdent's growth.

  • Revenue Enablement: Unblock and accelerate revenue-driving capabilities by personally owning the cross-cutting technical risks that would otherwise stall product delivery or force costly rewrites.

  • Quality and Reliability: Establish the engineering standards and review practices that keep a platform spanning core orchestration, AI workloads, and observability production-ready.

  • Risk Mitigation: Identify and resolve architectural, security, scalability, and integration risks before they become customer-visible incidents or block strategic deals.

  • Talent Density: Raise the technical ceiling of the entire k0rdent engineering organization by mentoring senior ICs and shaping Staff- and Principal-level hiring.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Deep Technical Breadth: Expert-level proficiency across the surface area k0rdent covers — Kubernetes internals and cluster lifecycle, distributed systems, AI/ML workload runtimes (model serving, GPU scheduling, autoscaling under bursty inference traffic), and modern observability (metrics, logs, traces, SLOs). You don't need to be the deepest expert in all four, but you must be credible and effective in each.

  • Systems Architecture: Demonstrated ability to design large-scale, multi-tenant systems that span multiple subsystems and hold up under real production conditions, and to communicate those designs clearly in writing.

  • Technical Strategy: Ability to look two to three years ahead, identify the architectural decisions that matter most across a broad surface area, and sequence them against business reality.

  • Influence Without Authority: Track record of driving technical direction across multiple teams and organizations through clarity, credibility, and collaboration rather than reporting lines.

  • Mentorship: Demonstrated success developing senior engineers — Staff, Principal, and Tech Lead level — and raising the technical bar of an organization.

  • Communication: Ability to explain complex technical tradeoffs clearly to engineers, executives, customers, and the broader community, in both writing and conversation.

  • Business Judgment: Solid understanding of how engineering decisions translate into cost, revenue, and risk, and willingness to weight technical choices accordingly.

  • Decision-Making Under Uncertainty: Strong judgment in fast-moving domains where the technology — particularly AI infrastructure — is evolving as quickly as the product.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Effective partnership with product management, design, sales engineering, and customer-facing teams across a broad portfolio.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field or 10 years related experience.

  • At least five years in a technical leadership role preferred.

What does Mirantis offer you?

  • Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;
  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;
  • Professional development and training;
  • Attend conferences and working groups;
  • Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;
  • Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan.

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

Who You Are:

You are the Payroll Lead who owns end-to-end payroll operations for India and the UAE, bringing order, precision, and scale to how we pay our people. You will report to the Senior Manager, Global Payroll, who will provide direction and support as you work in close partnership with HR, Finance, and our external payroll service providers to run the function day to day. You are stepping into a role that’s ready to be transformed – stabilizing payroll operations and service-provider relationships so that every employee is paid accurately and on time, while driving real, measurable gains in operational efficiency. You see yourself as the primary champion for payroll and workforce compliance, holding every payroll cycle to the statutory standards of both geographies.

This is an individual contributor role currently, with no direct reports. Your impact comes from the depth of your expertise and the ownership you take of the function itself.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Payroll

  • Independently lead and govern end-to-end payroll for India and UAE employees, ensuring accuracy and timeliness across all monthly disbursements, including oversight of payroll inputs, processing, and final bank funding.
  • Validate attendance, leave, variable pay, incentives, reimbursements, and full-and-final settlement inputs against HRIS and finance records before each payroll run.
  • Perform rigorous reviews of payroll registers, variance reports, CTC, and reconciliation files to validate data integrity and ensure alignment with financial controls and internal audit standards.
  • Stabilize and optimize relationships with external payroll service providers by setting clear performance benchmarks and conducting regular audits to drive service excellence.
  • Transform the current payroll ecosystem by identifying process bottlenecks and implementing technology-driven solutions that increase automation and reduce manual intervention.

Compliance

  • Champion workforce compliance across teams by serving as the primary subject matter expert on Indian labour laws, Provident Fund, ESIC, Income Tax regulations, and Payroll SOX requirements.
  • Mitigate corporate risk by leading statutory filing activities and ensuring monthly, quarterly, and annual payroll-related returns are submitted accurately to government authorities.
  • Support internal, statutory, and external audits; prepare payroll-related MIS, accruals, and reconciliations for Finance; and maintain audit-ready documentation at all times.
  • Track changes in Indian and UAE labour law, tax regulations, and social security requirements, and proactively update processes and stakeholders.

Employee Support

  • Act as the first point of contact for payroll, tax, and benefits queries; ensure payslips, Form 16 / tax documents, and salary certificates are issued accurately and on time.
  • Work closely with HR, Finance, Legal, and Total Rewards teams on compensation changes, benefits and equity administration, and new market/entity payroll setup.

System Management

  • Own and administer Darwinbox as the system of record for payroll, ensuring data integrity and seamless flow between the HR and payroll modules.
  • Manage payroll-related configuration, user access, and integrations between Darwinbox and downstream finance/banking systems.
  • Troubleshoot system issues and liaise with the Darwinbox support/People Tech team on fixes, upgrades, and enhancements.
  • Drive automation of payroll workflows within Darwinbox to reduce manual intervention and improve turnaround time.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 8+ years of hands-on payroll experience, with proven ownership of end-to-end India payroll processing and statutory compliance.
  • Working knowledge of UAE/India payroll practices.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, HR, or a related field; a payroll or labour law certification (e.g., CPP or an India payroll compliance certification) is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience with payroll/HRIS platforms such as GreytHR, Keka, ADP, or SAP SuccessFactors.
  • Prior expertise with Darwinbox is an added advantage.
  • Strong Excel/data-reconciliation skills and comfort working with large employee datasets.
  • High attention to detail, strong ownership, and the ability to handle sensitive compensation data with discretion.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and deadlines across time zones (India and UAE).
  • Prior experience in a fast-paced, multi-entity, or global SaaS/tech environment is a plus.

jobs.title: Retirement Sales Activation Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.
jobs.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As a member of the onboarding team, you will support the setup and launch of our new clients' 401(k) plans here at Human Interest! You'll be on the front lines with our new clients, working with a wide variety of companies (anything from the local plumber to the nationwide robotics firm), helping them set up and launch their new 401(k) plans. You'll own keeping the sales activation process on-track while ensuring that customers are engaged and happy. Process-driven and people-focused - you are organized, friendly and flexible.

You will be accountable for hitting key performance metrics, identifying and escalating operational blockers to consistently launch a high volume of plans while delivering an exceptional customer experience. If you are energized by helping business owners meet their goals, being challenged with monthly targets, and fast-changing environments, this is the opportunity for you. We move at 24,791 mph - you should be ready to lead at speed.

What you get to do every day

  • Communicate extensively with our customers to identify their needs and help them establish their 401(k) plans
  • Educate, guide, and inform our newly signed customers about the choices they have to help their employees save for retirement
  • Meet monthly activation targets by closely working client pipelines, managing client timelines, objection handling to keep clients in the flow and ensuring adherence to process and talk tracks.
  • Actively follow onboarding workflows to increase velocity, remove bottlenecks, and drive operational excellence.
  • Partner cross-functionally with internal teams and Leadership to resolve customer escalations and continuously improve the sales activation experience.
  • Work cross-functionally within our organization (specifically with sales and account management) to make sure customer needs are met
  • Drive processes forward, managing internal and external stakeholders to keep our customers engaged, happy, and on-track
  • Identify potential areas for process improvement to help the team scale

What you bring to the role

  • Possess knowledge and experience with retirement plan design, particularly in 401(k) plans
  • 3+ years of customer implementation or sales experience in a SaaS environment or retirement industry
  • A “people person” who truly enjoys interacting with clients and can communicate difficult concepts fluidly
  • Energy and passion- the concept of onboarding 40-50+ customers a month excites you - velocity is everything!
  • A strong work ethic, proactively following up with our customers and keeping them on track
  • Excellent organizational skills, are able juggle multiple tasks with varying deadlines and stakeholders without dropping the ball
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

  • Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.
  • Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.
  • Autonomous and Accountable Teams: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!
  • An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.
  • Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

Compensation - At Human Interest, there are a number of factors that are used to determine the appropriate pay range for each position. We take into account the cost of labor for each position in various markets across the US. The base salary for this position spans $63,000- $65,000and represents the minimum in our lowest geographic region to a maximumin our highest geographic region. The salary that we offer to a new employee within this range is based on their location within the US, their relevant job-related skills, and experience. At Human Interest, base salary is one component of the overall Total Rewards package. Depending on the position, additional compensation components such as bonus, commission, and equity may be offered. This position will also offer a variable target of $30,000. All of our employees are offered a robust suite of physical, financial and mental wellness benefits.

Benefits -

  • A great 401(k) plan: Our own! Our 401(k) includes a dollar-for-dollar employer match up to 4% of compensation (immediately vested) and $0 plan fees
  • Top-of-the-line health plans, as well as dental and vision insurance
  • Competitive time off and parental leave
  • Addition Wealth: Unlimited access to digital tools, financial professionals, and a knowledge center to help you understand your equity and support your financial wellness
  • Lyra: Enhanced Mental Health Support for Employees and dependents
  • Carrot: Fertility healthcare and family forming benefits
  • Candidly: Student loan resource to help you and your family plan, borrow, and repay student debt
  • Monthly work-from-home stipend; quarterly lifestyle stipend
  • Engaging team-building experiences, ranging from virtual social events to team offsites, promoting collaboration and camaraderie.

We’re a great place to work (but don’t take our word for it)

Here’s a list of our awards and accolades:

  • Certified as a Great Place To Work® (2023-2025)
  • Fortune Best Place to Work in the Bay Area (2024)

This role combines exceptional inbound and outbound customer support with proactive outreach, onboarding, account and payment follow-up, event support, and relationship building.

This is not JUST support. You’ll very often pick up the phone, initiate conversations, follow up when necessary, discuss sensitive financial matters professionally, help resolve outstanding balances and identify appropriate opportunities to enhance the client experience.

The ideal candidate genuinely loves helping people and can balance empathy with accountability. You’re proactive, organized, comfortable having difficult conversations, and able to take ownership and think critically rather than relying solely on scripts.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for clients across phone, email, SMS, HubSpot, webinars, and in-person events, owning customer questions and issues from initial contact through resolution.
  • Lead client onboarding experiences one-on-one and through live virtual webinars, confidently engaging and presenting to groups of clients while guiding them through the onboarding of the company’s coaching programs, answering questions, and ensuring they are set up for a successful experience.
  • Conduct proactive outbound outreach for onboarding, engagement, event attendance, account maintenance, and other customer experience initiatives.
  • Manage accounts receivable and payment follow-up, including proactively and persistently pursuing outstanding balances up to approximately $10,000 and having direct, sensitive collections conversations.
  • Quarterly domestic and international travel that may require evening and weekend availability.
  • Identify appropriate opportunities to enhance the client experience, coordinate with internal teams, maintain accurate HubSpot records, and recommend improvements to customer processes, tools, and communications.

  • Must be willing and able to travel domestically and internationally approximately quarterly for live events, including evening/weekend availability, long 8-10 hour event days, and extended time on your feet.
  • Genuinely enjoys talking with customers and is comfortable spending significant time on the phone, including proactive outbound calling, repeated follow-up, and sensitive or challenging conversations.
  • Comfortable with direct accounts receivable and collections outreach, including discussing outstanding financial obligations, repeatedly following up on overdue balances, and confidently asking customers to take action while balancing empathy with accountability.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to engage customers one-on-one and in live virtual group settings, including webinars and onboarding sessions.
  • Strong critical thinking, empathy, organization, and sound judgment, with the ability to take ownership, solve problems independently, and know when to resolve an issue versus escalate it.
  • Resourceful and comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment where priorities, processes, systems, and working hours can change; must be flexible and able to operate effectively through ambiguity.

About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:
Our Customer Success team is made up of two distinct roles: Customer Success Managers and Account Managers. Customer Success Managers focus on driving product adoption and client outcomes, while Account Managers own and manage commercial relationships and identify growth opportunities. These teams partner to support a wide range of client personas from Fortune 5000 companies.

We act as consultative partners, helping clients solve challenges using our product and ensuring they have the data needed to make informed decisions. Our goal is to retain customers, maximize product usage, and grow relationships over time.

About the Role:
The Director, Account Management will lead a team of ~8-10 Account Managers, playing a critical role in driving renewals and expanding customer relationships. This leader will guide the team to exceed retention targets, uncover growth opportunities, and partner closely with Customer Success to deliver long-term client value. We’re looking for a data-driven leader with strong management experience who is eager to scale the Account Management function and drive AlphaSense’s continued success.

Who You Are:

  • Systems-Oriented: You’re a strategic thinker who excels at creating efficient, scalable processes.
  • Customer-Centric: You measure success by the success of your customers and inspire your team to do the same.

  • Ambitious & Curious: You approach challenges with curiosity and integrity, always striving to learn and grow.
  • Experienced Relationship Builder: You’re comfortable building relationships with senior clients and handling escalations, always valuing open, real conversations.

  • Have experience working seven-figure deals, strategic account servicing and renewal negotiations
  • Strong aptitude for learning, particularly in a technical SaaS environment
  • Experience operationalizing the customer journey
  • Confident, consultative, and client-facing professional with a proactive personality
  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial environment
  • Strong rapport-building skills and a positive, energetic attitude
  • Excellent oral, written, and presentation skills
  • Great time management skills, even under pressure
  • Willingness to travel as needed

  • Drive customer outcomes by improving renewal rates, reducing churn, and expanding revenue through deeper client relationships and product adoption.

Caliber is a strategic marketing and communications firm that helps companies tell their story and connect with key stakeholders. We partner with established industry leaders and rising entrepreneurial organizations within financial services, financial technology (fintech), insurance, insurance technology (insurtech), real estate, and property technology (proptech). Caliber has been recognized twice as one of Inc.’s Best Workplaces, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, a Ragan’s Workplace Wellness award winner and one of the America’s Fastest Growing Companies for the fourth year in a row by the Financial Times.

About the Role:

Caliber is looking to hire a PR enthusiast to join our team as a Senior Account Executive. Caliber Senior Account Executives play a key role in developing and executing on creative media relations strategies as the critical connector between our internal team and our clients. The annual salary range for this position is $65,000 to $90,000. In this role, you will be responsible for nurturing a strong journalist network to support our clients’ media goals in our industries of focus - financial services, fintech, insurtech and proptech.

Our team represents a talented and inclusive workforce. If you're looking to work with a supportive team of PR pros who value flexing their creative muscles while producing excellent work (and having fun at the same time) - check us out! The right candidate will thrive in a mid-sized agency environment where they will work as part of a growing and dynamic team. Candidates are expected to work both collaboratively supporting client accounts and independently, owning individual projects and assignments.

About your responsibilities:

Client Liaison: serve as the primary day-to-day contact for a group of clients, working with senior leadership within financial services and fintech companies to ensure proper coverage of client priorities, including:

  • Leading client calls and daily communication with clients via email and phone.
  • Drafting client press releases, corporate bios, media pitches, and other written materials, with stellar attention to detail.
  • Supporting the senior team on each of your accounts across a number of parameters including measurement of results, drafting of content and media list development.

jobs.description:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 40,000 students from 1,000+ universities, and our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. We've spent nearly a decade training the next generation of technical talent, and we just launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic, building one of the most ambitious AI workforce programs in the world.

We're now expanding into new markets and scaling our team so we can move at the speed AI is transforming the workforce. People joining CodePath now will have the opportunity to help architect the next frontier of our work.

We believe technical skill is the fastest way to turn raw talent into real opportunity. We train the engineers the AI era runs on, building toward millions of learners, hundreds of millions in revenue, and billions in economic impact. If you want to own something and be part of a 0-to-1 journey at an organization moving at the speed of AI, this is the place to build it.

About the Role

Location: Remote

Role Type: Full-Time

Reporting to: Chief Product Officer

Total Compensation:$200,000 - $232,000

Every CodePath learner engages our platform, whether they are a college CS student in a direct course, a student at a partner university, an alum sharpening their skills, or a working engineer retraining for the AI era. The Senior Product Manager, Learner Platform Experience owns this platform.

CodePath's courses work because they are intensive, industry-vetted, and human. The hard problem is scale. As we grow from tens of thousands of learners toward millions, the quality and effectiveness of the learner experience on the platform has to improve, not dilute. That demands an AI-First approach: clearly and thoughtfully identifying where AI can accelerate effectiveness, productivity, and scale, and where human connection and touchpoints are essential to maintain motivation, commitment, and progress. Getting that boundary right is the core judgment call of this job, and you will make it over and over.

The ownership lines are clear. Curriculum owns what we teach. The Learning team owns how it is taught, including the live classroom. You own the platform: everything a learner touches when they log in, from the course portal to asynchronous engagement between sessions to the touchpoints that keep them moving. You will collaborate closely with Learning so the platform powers great live delivery, but the platform experience is yours.

Success looks like measurable acceleration in the rate of learning, retention, and engagement, even as the number of students grows by an order of magnitude.

Two things make this role unlike most PM jobs

Learning rate is the scoreboard. Plenty of platforms can deliver content at scale. Almost none can prove their students learn faster because of them. You will be measured on outcomes, retention, and engagement, not feature velocity.

The ceiling is enormous. Every course CodePath delivers, direct or through partners, rides on the platform experience you build. As we scale to an order of magnitude of more students, your decisions compound across every learner we will ever serve.

What you'll do

  • Own the core learner platform experience across every segment: college CS students, alumni, working engineers, and students at partner institutions

  • Translate learning, retention, and engagement goals into a prioritized roadmap

  • Use AI across your entire workflow to compress weeks into days, raising the quality and the speed of what you ship

  • Own our AI-assisted learning experiences end to end, including taking the AI Tutor and AI Grader from prototype to product. These student-facing AI surfaces are yours, not shared

  • Decide where AI accelerates effectiveness, productivity, and scale, and where human connection is essential to maintain motivation, commitment, and progress

  • Collaborate with Curriculum, Learning, and Engineering: they own what is taught and how the classroom runs, you build the platform that powers live delivery and asynchronous engagement

  • Set a high bar for design quality and engaging interactions across every learner touchpoint

  • Define the metrics that prove learning rate, retention, and engagement are improving at scale, and design experiments, grounded in discovery with users, to test your biggest bets

Who you are

You are a PM who has owned products that learners or users depend on every day, and you know how to walk into something live and make it measurably better. You are deeply AI-Native and you believe great learning products are judged by what learners can do afterward.

Required

  • You have scaled a live product. You have inherited or grown something real users already depended on, raised its quality while usage multiplied, and you know the difference between launching and improving

    • Zero-to-one instincts still matter here: you will not inherit documentation, process, or a roadmap, so you know how to map what exists and chart the path forward yourself

  • AI is genuinely how you work. You can show how your workflow has changed: prototypes, requirements, and analyses you generate and pressure-test in hours, not months

  • You have built products where engagement and retention were the scoreboard, and you know how to design the loops, touchpoints, and interactions that move them

  • You hold strong opinions and you can defend them live. You bring clear, well-reasoned bets and stand behind them under pressure

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You can structure messy problems, build alignment across learning and technical teams, and drive execution with no playbook

  • You have strong analytical instincts. You define the metrics that matter and read the data to make the call

  • You write requirements engineers trust, and you can sell a product strategy to technical and non-technical audiences alike

Preferred

  • Fluency across the modern PM toolkit: product analytics (Mixpanel, Amplitude, Hex), prototyping and design (Figma, Framer), data querying (SQL), and AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar)

  • Background in edtech, learning platforms, or consumer education products, or deep working familiarity with learning science

  • Experience with AI tutoring, adaptive learning, or personalization systems

  • Founder experience or equivalent time building in a hyperscaling environment

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every qualification listed. Strong candidates often look different from what a job description imagines, and we would rather talk to someone exceptional who checks seven of nine boxes than miss them entirely.

Compensation

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position’s level, no matter where you live. For this role, we’re hiring for an Individual Contributor level position. Total compensation is $200,000 to $232,000.

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a 100% remote position—work from anywhere in the U.S.! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

jobs.excerpt: IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference.
jobs.description:
IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way: responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

Platform Engineering builds what the rest of IREN builds on. We own data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, and product engineering, the systems that turn a fleet of data centers and GPU clusters into a platform our customers and our own teams can move quickly on. Much of it is being built now, for the first time, so there is no legacy stack to maintain and no established playbook to follow.

We are hiring senior software engineers across Platform Engineering. This is an individual contributor role. Seniority here is measured by the scope of what you own and by how much better the engineers around you get, not by how many people report to you. At this level you own the design of whole systems, including the parts that cross team boundaries and the parts you will not build yourself.

The part of the role we weight most heavily is what you do for the engineers around you. We expect you to raise the standard of the people you work with, through design review and code review that teach rather than correct, through pairing, and through handing hard problems to engineers who are ready to stretch. We look for evidence of this during the interview, and we continue to assess it after you join.

Because Platform Engineering builds for other teams, the boundaries matter as much as the internals. You will own the interfaces between your systems and everyone else's, negotiate what those contracts guarantee, and manage versioning and compatibility when something has to change. That work is as much communication as design, so we expect you to write clearly and to be comfortable in a room where people disagree. We also expect depth: senior engineers here are the person the company asks about a particular domain, whether that is data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, or product engineering. Engineers at every level at IREN stay hands on, senior ones included.

Responsibilities

  • Own system design from end to end: the problem statement, architecture, interfaces, data model, and rollout, including the parts other engineers will build.
  • Coach and develop the engineers around you. Give review that teaches, pair on hard problems, and hand over work that stretches people rather than keeping it because you would finish it faster.
  • Own the API contracts between your systems and other teams: negotiate what they guarantee, version them, and manage the migration when they change.
  • Set technical direction for your area, and write it down so other teams can build against it without needing a meeting first.
  • Break large, ambiguous problems into work that a team can sequence, estimate, and deliver.
  • Lead delivery across team boundaries, including the coordination and follow up that this actually requires.
  • Stay hands on. Write and review code, and carry the pager for what you own.
  • Own operations for your systems: monitoring, on-call, incident response, and the follow up that stops the same incident recurring.
  • Be the person the company can ask about your domain, and make what you know available to others rather than holding it.
  • Raise the standard through the systems around the code: CI/CD, observability, testing practice, and documentation.

Requirements

  • 6 or more years of professional software engineering experience, including several years operating in production what you built.
  • A record of owning system level design rather than components alone. You have been the person accountable for how a whole system fits together.
  • Deep experience with distributed systems, including failure modes you have personally debugged rather than only read about.
  • Demonstrated coaching. Be ready to name engineers who grew because of how you worked with them, and to say what actually changed.
  • Experience owning APIs that other teams depend on, including versioning and breaking change migrations.
  • Excellent communication, particularly in writing. You can write a design document another team can act on without a meeting.
  • Depth in at least one domain relevant to this team: data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, or product engineering.
  • Experience leading delivery across more than one team, without formal authority over the people involved.
  • Strong fundamentals, and the judgement to recognize when the simple answer is the right one.
Nice to have:
  • Experience as a formal tech lead, or in a staff level role.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, and infrastructure as code (AWS, Azure, or GCP; Kubernetes; Terraform).
  • Experience with high volume data pipelines, streaming systems, or telemetry and time series data.
  • Experience putting machine learning or LLM systems into production.
  • Experience working close to physical infrastructure, where the software must account for hardware that fails.

Benefits

At IREN, we offer a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary, annual performance incentives, and opportunities to build long-term wealth through equity programs. These offerings are part of our broader Total Rewards package, thoughtfully designed to support your health, well-being, and long-term success.
Compensation
  • The expected base salary for this role USD $152,000 – $228,000/annum.
    • Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, qualifications, and market data for the region.
  • Total Compensation package may be inclusive of annual incentive bonus, equity (long-term incentive).
  • Relocation or Living-out-allowance / per diem (as appliable and based on successful candidate circumstances)
Health & Wellness
  • 100% company paid health insurance premiums (medical, dental, and vision) for employees, 75% company paid coverage for dependents
  • Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Voluntary life, critical illness, and accident coverage available
  • Health Savings Accounts (HSA) – when combined with the High Deductible Health Plan
  • Employee Assistance Program and wellness resources
Retirement & Financial Wealth
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Access to financial planning and legal services
Time Off & Leave Programs
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays
Growth & Development
  • Internal skills training and advancement pathways
  • Professional development to support certifications, continuing education, or role related training
Community & Culture
  • Company events and team-building activities
We value diverse perspectives and believe that skills can be developed. If you’re passionate about this role, we want to hear from you — whether you meet every criteria or not. Your unique experiences might be exactly what we need!

They emerge from synthesizing multiple forms of evidence into judgements that initially appear impossible to make, but become irrefutable once the underlying economics, signals and market dynamics are understood.

This role is for the persistently curious, energized by discovering what others have yet to see, connecting seemingly unrelated signals and transforming emerging insights into market-shaping research. Through research, client engagement, media interactions and keynote

presentations, you will influence executive and industry thinking as

a definitive authority on Tech Market Economic trends.

We’re focused on helping people with diabetes manage their health with life-changing products that provide accurate data to drive better-informed decisions. We’re revolutionizing the way people monitor their glucose levels with our new sensing technology. As Manager, Market Access, you will lead and execute Western Canada's market access and stakeholder engagement strategy, translating regional priorities into impactful initiatives that influence policy, build trusted relationships with key external stakeholders, improve patient access to innovative technologies, and support Abbott Diabetes Care's business objectives.

Drive market access strategies that advance the Diabetes Division's business objectives across Canada by:

  • Work closely with global market access colleagues to provide policy makers with customized and relevant clinical and HEOR information and submissions that result in successful reimbursement strategies for Abbott products.
  • Collaborate with ADC Market Access colleagues globally, sharing best practices and key learnings across countries.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant filed such as Public Policy, HTA, Clinical Epidemiology, Health Economics, Political Science, Communications, Business Administration or Healthcare Management.
  • Master’s Degree or PhD (preferred): Public Policy, Health Economics, Clinical Epidemiology, HTA, Business Administration (MBA), or a healthcare-related field to demonstrate deeper understanding of both public and policy and the healthcare landscape.
  • Additional Certifications (optional but beneficial): Professional certifications in stakeholder management, public affairs, or government relations.
  • Minimum five plus years of experience.
  • Proven track record in market access, stakeholder relations, government relations, public affairs, or external affairs within the healthcare, medical device, or pharmaceutical industry.
  • Candidates should have demonstrated success in working with key external stakeholders like government officials, HTA bodies, healthcare professionals and patient associations groups.
  • Strong understanding of public policy, HTA, and regulatory environments. Experience engaging with government policy makers and advocacy organizations is critical.
  • Strategic relationship-building: significant experience in building and maintaining long term professional relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders.
  • Ability to work under pressure and act with urgency: demonstrated success in working in fast-paced environments as responding to urgent matters and managing evolving priorities are crucial.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills, with a proven track record of developing tactical plans, creating executive-ready materials, delivering clear and compelling messages, and building alignment across internal and external audiences, including senior leaders.
  • Project management and resource oversight: experience in managing external agencies or consultants, budgets, and multistakeholder projects, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.
  • Healthcare industry knowledge: familiarity with the healthcare ecosystem at a national or provincial level, particularly with payers, healthcare providers, reimbursement, and market access frameworks. Previous experience working within a pharmaceutical, medical device or biotechnology company is highly preferred.
  • Proven proactive work ethic: highly motivated self-starter with experience working in roles that require a high level of proactivity, providing regular updates and ensuring alignment with the organization’s objectives without needing to be asked.
  • PC literate including Word, PowerPoint, Excel skills.
  • Working knowledge of statistics.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (~25%+).
  • This position supports Western Canada.
  • Proven leadership skills.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $120,000.00 to $168,000.00 CAD. The salary range provided applies to Canada only and does not apply to any other locations outside of Canada.

Location: Canada (Remote)
