Who are we?

Incubeta is a global marketing partner helping ambitious brands drive profitable growth. We bring media, creative, data, and technology together into one integrated solution, working with CMOs and senior business leaders who want clarity, accountability, and measurable business impact.

In the Americas, we are entering an important growth phase. We already have strong capability, proven solutions, and differentiated intellectual property in place. What we are building now is greater enterprise momentum.

To accelerate that trajectory, we are hiring a Principal, Enterprise Growth to drive enterprise pipeline creation and new client acquisition at scale across North America. This is a leadership-level individual contributor role focused on one core outcome: getting Incubeta in the room, opening new revenue streams, and converting complex enterprise opportunity into sustained growth.

This is not a traditional sales management position. It is a mandate to build senior-level access, shape high-value commercial opportunities, and establish Incubeta as a credible growth partner for large, complex organisations.

We are looking for someone who can create real market pull, operate confidently at C-suite level, and translate our integrated capabilities into compelling commercial opportunities.

About the role

This is a senior individual contributor role with a singular mandate: generate and convert enterprise-level new client revenue at scale.

You will own North America net new revenue performance and personally drive the enterprise pipeline required to achieve it. This is not a role for someone who waits for RFPs to appear. It is a senior revenue operator role focused on high-value opportunity creation, strategic pursuit, and commercial conversion.

Your remit includes:

  • Owning annual net new revenue targets exceeding $10M and maintaining disciplined oversight of pipeline health, deal velocity, forecast accuracy, and conversion quality.
  • Personally originating, qualifying, and advancing complex enterprise opportunities from first conversation through contract execution.
  • Building senior-level access with CMOs, Chief Marketing Officers, senior marketing leaders, transformation stakeholders, procurement leaders, consultants, and executive buyers.
  • Securing and leading C-suite discussions that uncover strategic business priorities and position Incubeta as a credible growth partner.
  • Using your understanding of media agency and media AOR buying processes to influence opportunities early, shape the brief, and position Incubeta before an RFP is issued.
  • Building relationships across the new business consultancy, pitch consultant, agency search, and media intermediary ecosystem.
  • Structuring and negotiating high-value agreements, including scope architecture, pricing strategy, performance metrics, procurement, and legal terms.
  • Navigating complex procurement, legal, and executive decision-making processes with commercial confidence and persistence.
  • Building a focused territory and account-based pursuit strategy across North America.
  • Positioning Incubeta’s integrated media, creative, data, and technology capabilities around clear client outcomes rather than isolated services.
  • Developing compelling value propositions, pursuit strategies, proposals, and executive presentations for complex enterprise opportunities.
  • Partnering closely with the broader sales, marketing, strategy, media, creative, data, technology, and delivery teams to ensure alignment and coordinated pursuit strategy.
  • Working alongside Finance to protect margin integrity while driving ambitious revenue growth.
  • Leveraging existing infrastructure, including HubSpot, internal sales processes, and SDR/outbound support, without becoming dependent on it.
  • Maintaining strong CRM discipline across qualification, opportunity stages, next steps, close plans, forecasting, and commercial documentation.
  • Travelling across North America as needed to build relationships, progress opportunities, and strengthen market presence.

This role requires someone who is comfortable operating independently, thrives in enterprise selling environments, and can create immediate market momentum without relying on large internal infrastructure.

What you need to be successful

This role requires proven enterprise credibility, strong commercial discipline, and the ability to create opportunity through influence, access, and persistence.

To succeed, you will bring:

  • A strong track record within a media agency, media AOR, integrated marketing agency, creative agency, marketing services business, consultancy, or adjacent professional services environment.
  • Direct experience originating and closing enterprise-scale engagements, ideally in the $5M to $15M range.
  • Experience selling media, integrated marketing, digital transformation, data, technology, creative, or related services to large and complex organisations.
  • Clear evidence that you have carried your own quota, owned your own pipeline, and built new business yourself rather than relying heavily on inherited opportunities or inbound RFPs.
  • A strong understanding of how media agencies, creative agencies, in-house teams, marketing operations functions, and procurement teams work, including stakeholder dynamics, budget ownership, internal politics, and transformation priorities.
  • Experience with agency reviews, media AOR appointments, retained and project-based scopes, account transitions, pitch processes, and senior stakeholder decision-making.
  • A genuine hunter mentality with a multi-channel approach to new business development, including thoughtful outbound, relationship-led networking, referrals, industry influence, and differentiated market access strategies.
  • An established network of senior industry relationships that you can activate over time, including CMOs, senior marketing leaders, procurement stakeholders, transformation leaders, consultants, and agency decision-makers.
  • Meaningful exposure to the new business consultancy and pitch consultant ecosystem, or the credibility to build those relationships quickly.
  • Strong CRM discipline, including comfort managing pipeline stages, forecast accuracy, qualification rigor, sales hygiene, close plans, and next steps end to end.
  • Commercial sophistication in navigating procurement processes, shaping RFP strategy rather than responding reactively, and structuring agreements that balance financial discipline with long-term partnership value.
  • Confidence discussing the commercial implications of AI-driven marketing evolution, including automation, personalisation at scale, creative intelligence, media effectiveness, and the integration of brand and performance.
  • Experience helping clients navigate structural change, whether through operating model redesign, technology implementation, agency transformation, or broader marketing capability transformation.
  • The ability to translate complex capabilities into a clear, differentiated, and commercially compelling client proposition.
  • A high level of personal credibility, curiosity, preparation, listening skill, resilience, and sound judgement in senior client conversations.

This is a role for a senior operator who has repeatedly created, shaped, and closed large, complex enterprise deals and understands what it takes to create and convert opportunity at scale.

What success looks like

In the first 12 months, success in this role will be defined by tangible enterprise momentum and revenue impact.

  • A qualified enterprise pipeline that materially exceeds annual net new revenue targets, with clear visibility across stage progression and forecast accuracy
  • $5M to $10M+ in net new revenue secured or in late-stage negotiation, with disciplined margin protection and commercially sound deal structures
  • Consistent inclusion in high-value enterprise pitch engagements, including consultant-led reviews and direct C-suite introductions
  • Demonstrable improvement in deal velocity and conversion quality, with a focus on fewer, higher-value opportunities rather than volume activity
  • Established executive-level relationships within priority enterprise accounts that position Incubeta as a credible long-term growth partner
  • A repeatable enterprise pursuit model in place, including qualification criteria, commercial frameworks, and structured negotiation approach

Success will not be measured by activity, meetings, or RFP volume. It will be measured by enterprise pipeline strength, revenue conversion, and the quality of the commercial opportunities secured.

Traild: Who are we? 

Traild is a high-growth SaaS company redefining how finance teams operate, combining AI, automation, and payments infrastructure to power the future of B2B finance.

Every year, businesses lose billions to fraud, errors, and mistakes. Traild exists to solve this at scale, helping finance teams move faster, stay in control, and operate with confidence.

With rapid customer growth, global expansion across APAC, North America and EMEA, and continued investment in product innovation, we are at a defining stage of our journey.

This is an opportunity to help shape the next category leader in finance automation, control and security, building technology that transforms how businesses manage, move, and protect money. At the core of this is a powerful AI-driven platform, enabling finance teams to deploy intelligent agents that do the work, surface risk in real time, and continuously improve how financial operations run.

Traild is building the infrastructure behind modern finance, protecting and powering meaningful volumes of the world’s B2B transactions.

If you’re excited by high growth, real ownership, and building something that matters, Traild is the place to do the most impactful work of your career.

Hear how Traild customers speak about us here.

The Role

    As Traild accelerates its expansion across North America, we are looking for an Enterprise Customer Onboarding Manager to own the full implementation journey for our most complex, high-stakes enterprise clients. This is a newly dedicated enterprise-focused role, created because enterprise implementations demand a different level of rigor, stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination than mid-market work. You will sit within the Customer Success team and collaborate daily with Solutions Engineering, Tech and Product to get clients live and, more importantly, to ensure they adopt Traild in a way that delivers lasting value. This is a senior individual contributor role where you will come in as the first Enterprise Customer Onboarding Manager in the region, with real ownership from day one.

Key Responsibilities

    • Drive enterprise implementations ($100K+ ACV) from scoping through to go-live and beyond, maintaining momentum across long and complex project timelines with multiple concurrent accounts
    • Own the end-to-end client journey from onboarding through to successful adoption, ensuring customers achieve measurable value
    • Provide user training, technical support and troubleshooting throughout implementation and beyond
    • Partner closely with Solutions Engineering, Tech and Product daily to work through client-specific issues, surface product feedback and keep implementations moving without unnecessary delays
    • Build trusted relationships with enterprise stakeholders and decision-makers, managing expectations clearly and maintaining CSAT above 90% across your portfolio
    • Own your personal KPIs including go-live targets, adoption outcomes and client health metrics, and contribute actively to internal documentation and process improvement
    • Drive momentum in complex or ambiguous customer environments, keeping implementations on track without needing to escalate

Who You Are

    You are an experienced implementation professional who has worked directly with enterprise clients in a B2B SaaS environment and knows what it takes to get complex projects across the line without losing sight of the longer-term adoption outcome. You bring a confident, consultative approach and thrive in fast-moving environments where you need to problem-solve, prioritise and own your outcomes with limited hand-holding.

    Must have

    • Strong project management skills — owning scoping, timelines, risk management and driving outcomes independently
    • Solid technical aptitude, comfortable working across integrations, workflows, and partnering directly with Engineering and Product teams
    • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, especially with senior and executive-level stakeholders
    • Comfortable operating in a startup or scale-up environment where processes are still being built and the pace of change is high
    • Strong collaborator with an attitude embracing growth, hands-on execution, adaptability, and the scale-up spirit

      • Nice to have

      • 5–7 years of direct enterprise-level implementation experience in a B2B SaaS environment, with a strong preference for AP, accounting or fintech software
      • Familiarity with ERP or payment related platforms, particularly IFS, Acumatica, NetSuite, SAP B1 or SYSPRO
        • We know great implementation people come from all sorts of backgrounds. If you have transferable skills from other project management, onboarding, consulting or delivery roles, we'd still like to hear from you, please apply and use the relevant/transferable skills question in the application to tell us how your experience maps to this role.

Salary Range

    The base salary range for this position is:

  • U.S. Candidates: $90,000 - $120,000 USD per year
  • Canadian Candidates: $90,000 - $120,000 CAD per year

    • Compensation is determined based on experience, education, and geographic location. The final offer may vary within the stated range to reflect the candidate’s qualifications and market conditions in their area.

The Perks of Working at Traild  

  • Flexibility: we offer a range of remote, hybrid and flexible working options. 

  • Global team: we are growing across APAC, NA and EMEA and have team all across the world. 

  • We are growing at an exponential rate, this is an opportunity to get involved with a true rocketship with all the excitement and opportunities that comes with it 

  • Our team genuinely loves working at Traild: our eNPS score is 68, where anything above 50 is considered world-class.

jobs.description:
About Kadince

Kadince (pronounced cadence) is a fully remote American software company founded in 2013. In a nutshell, we build tools to help financial institutions track and manage the good they do in their communities.

Why We’re Looking for Contractors

As our customer base grows, so does our team. We’re committed to delivering top-notch software quality and ensuring every feature release goes smoothly. To keep up with the growing demand and maintain our high standards, we’re looking for experienced Quality Assurance Engineers in Brazil who can help us scale QA efforts, maintain product integrity, and contribute to a collaborative dev environment.

Who We Want to Hire

To be a QA contractor at Kadince, you should have 5+ years of experience in software development or QA engineering. You know how to plan and execute test strategies, create and maintain robust test suites, perform root cause analysis, and communicate your findings clearly. You don’t just test software—you improve it.

You’re great at spotting issues, solving problems, and helping developers build better code. Your detail-oriented nature, curiosity, and passion for quality assurance set you apart.

Since you’ll be collaborating with our US-based development team, strong English communication skills are important. We’ll occasionally have meetings to align on progress, share feedback, or collaborate in real time.

Let’s Geek Out

If you’re geeky like our QA team (hopefully you are), you’ll probably want to know more about our stack and workflow.

Technologies & Tools

  • Frontend/Backend: Ruby on Rails, React, GraphQL, Postgres, Redis
  • Testing: Cypress, Minitest
  • DevOps: Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, CircleCI
  • Collaboration & QA Tools: Jira, Rubymine, Sentry

You’ll be using these tools to build, execute, and automate tests while helping us maintain and improve QA documentation and practices.

Our Core Values

Our values aren’t just nice words on a wall (we don’t have one). They drive how we work and who we hire:

  • Integrity – We’re honest with ourselves and others.
  • People – We understand that people are the foundation of Kadince.
  • Care – We do our best work with purpose and intention.
  • Remarkability – We provide standout experiences.
  • Growth – We accept yesterday and improve today.

Even as a contractor, you’ll be expected to uphold these values in your work and interactions.

What You’d Work On

As a QA contractor, you’ll work alongside our development and product teams on:

  • Planning, executing, and automating manual and regression tests
  • Writing test cases and acceptance criteria
  • Identifying, triaging, and tracking bugs
  • Monitoring releases using tools like Sentry and Slack
  • Collaborating on documentation and QA process improvements
  • Mentoring junior team members (as needed)

You’ll receive assignments, collaborate through Slack and Jira, and give feedback directly to your Kadince point of contact. We’re open to your ideas—your voice matters.

Flexibility

This is a fully remote contractor role with flexible hours. You’ll need to coordinate occasionally with our US-based team, but we value asynchronous work and understand time zone differences. You’ll be free to manage your schedule as long as you deliver consistent, high-quality results.

Compensation

Kadince offers competitive USD-based compensation, above typical rates in the Brazilian market. Here’s what you can expect based on your experience and skills:

  • Tier 2: Mid Level (2–5 years): $5–$10/hour
  • Tier 3: Senior Level (5+ years): $10–$20/hour

Compensation depends on experience, technical ability, and English communication. Exceptional performance may lead to higher rates over time.

How to Apply

If you’re excited to work with Kadince, we want to hear from you. When applying, send us:

  • A PDF resume
  • A brief cover letter (max 300 words) explaining why you’d be a great fit

Show us that you’ve taken the time to understand who we are. (Seriously, if you don’t know our name during the interview… that’s a red flag.)

This position is open to candidates living in Brazil.

Salary: $5 - $20 / hour

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager - North America
jobs.excerpt: Traild: Who are we?  Traild is a high-growth SaaS company redefining how finance teams operate, combining AI, automation, and payments infrastructure to power the future of B2B finance.
jobs.description:
Traild: Who are we? 

Traild is a high-growth SaaS company redefining how finance teams operate, combining AI, automation, and payments infrastructure to power the future of B2B finance.

Every year, businesses lose billions to fraud, errors, and mistakes. Traild exists to solve this at scale, helping finance teams move faster, stay in control, and operate with confidence.

With rapid customer growth, global expansion across APAC, North America and EMEA, and continued investment in product innovation, we are at a defining stage of our journey.

This is an opportunity to help shape the next category leader in finance automation, control and security, building technology that transforms how businesses manage, move, and protect money. At the core of this is a powerful AI-driven platform, enabling finance teams to deploy intelligent agents that do the work, surface risk in real time, and continuously improve how financial operations run.

Traild is building the infrastructure behind modern finance, protecting and powering meaningful volumes of the world’s B2B transactions.

If you’re excited by high growth, real ownership, and building something that matters, Traild is the place to do the most impactful work of your career.

Hear how Traild customers speak about us here.

The role

    Traild is hiring a Field Marketing Manager to own how we show up in market across North America. This is a high-impact role that asks for strategy and execution in equal measure, inside a distributed global marketing team, reporting to the Head of Marketing in Australia.

    You will own the NAM (North America) event calendar end to end, 70+ events a year: ERP user groups, industry conferences, channel roadshows, and customer and prospect dinners, plus the follow-up that turns all of it into pipeline. A good share of that is run with our ERP partners, so co-marketing with platforms, resellers, and implementation partners comes with the territory.

    Creativity is a real requirement here. We want to stand out in a crowded hall and build enough momentum that people go out of their way to stop by and find out what Traild does. You will be trusted to come up with the idea, not just run the one you were handed.

    The role spans everything from ideating a booth activation and coordinating logistics for a multi-state calendar to getting a platinum VAR to commit to a joint roadshow next quarter. If you thrive on ownership and move fast without dropping details, this role was built for you. You should know your goals, understand how your work lands on the organization's revenue, and be able to tell us what a program did for the business rather than how many you ran.

What you'll own

  • Plan and execute Traild's NAM event calendar end to end, covering ERP user groups, industry conferences, and channel roadshows, from sponsorship selection and booth design through lead capture, follow-up, and post-event pipeline reporting
  • Build the field playbook for each event: pre-show outreach, meeting booking targets for NAM sales, on-site activation, and a follow-up sequence that runs on time rather than a week late
  • Bring new ideas to the calendar, including booth concepts, activations, event formats, and invitations that earn attention in a crowded room, and test them rather than repeating last year's plan
  • Run smaller-format field programs that give sales reasons to get in a room with buyers, including regional customer dinners, executive roundtables, lunch and learns, and co-hosted local sessions
  • Own webinars as a field channel, from initial planning and speaker preparation through promotion, day-of execution, and performance analytics covering attendance, conversion, and influenced pipeline
  • Partner with NAM sales leadership on regional demand plans, so event and field investment is aimed at the accounts, industries, and territories the team is actually working
  • Run NAM co-marketing with ERP platforms, resellers, and implementation partners, including joint events, co-branded activations, and partner onboarding campaigns that generate partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline
  • Build relationships with partner marketing contacts at priority NAM ERP platforms and VARs, securing co-marketing commitments and running activations that benefit both sides rather than asking for one-off favors
  • Maintain a partner and field toolkit of pitch decks, social assets, email templates, and value proposition materials that partners and reps can pick up and use independently, and keep it current as the product and messaging evolve
  • Deliver internal enablement for NAM sales and channel reps alongside Content and Product Marketing, so current materials are easy to find and reps are not building their own
  • Track and report on event and channel performance against revenue outcomes, use that data to recommend where to invest and what to cut, and communicate results clearly to NAM sales leadership and the wider marketing team

Who You Are

    You are a B2B marketer who has built things from scratch in a fast-moving environment, can hold an entire event together without a logistics team behind you, and knows how to earn commitment from partners who have no obligation to say yes.

    • 3 to 7 years of B2B Event or Field marketing experience in SaaS or tech
    • Demonstrated ownership of events end to end
    • Comfortable operating at volume, with a calendar of 70 or more events a year running in parallel at different stages, and a system for keeping every one of them on track
    • Strong commercial acumen - knows the revenue / pipeline numbers generated and can report on ROI
    • A creative streak you can point to, whether a booth concept, an activation, an event format, or an invitation that worked because it was different, and you can explain the thinking behind it
    • Experience building relationships partners, VARs, or implementation partners, including convincing partners to commit resources to joint activity
    • Strong project management and attention to detail, comfortable running multiple programs and vendors across time zones without missing deadlines or waiting to be told what is next
    • Clear, compelling communicator who can develop messaging and materials for both internal teams and external partner and customer audiences
    • Working knowledge of HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRM and marketing automation platforms
    • Experience at a Series A to Series C SaaS company where the marketing team was small and individuals built programs themselves rather than directing others to execute them is a strong advantage
    • Knowledge of the finance or accounting software landscape is a plus

Salary Range and Description

    The base salary range for this position is:

    • U.S. Candidates: USD $120,000 - $160,000 per year

    • Canadian Candidates: CAD $120,000 - $160,000 per year

      • Compensation is determined based on years of experience, education, and geographic location. The final offer may vary within the stated range to reflect the candidate’s qualifications and market conditions in their area.

The Perks of Working at Traild  

  • Flexibility: we offer a range of remote, hybrid and flexible working options. 

  • Global team: we are growing across APAC, NA and EMEA and have team all across the world. 

  • We are growing at an exponential rate, this is an opportunity to get involved with a true rocketship with all the excitement and opportunities that comes with it 

  • Our team genuinely loves working at Traild: our eNPS score is 68, where anything above 50 is considered world-class.

Please note that the final applicants for this job will be asked to consent in writing to a police check / criminal background check to the extent permitted by law in your jurisdiction of employment. Please note that Traild is an E-Verify employer.

jobs.description:
About Kadince

Kadince (pronounced cadence) is a fully remote American software company founded in 2013. In a nutshell, we build tools to help financial institutions track and manage the good they do in their communities.

Why We’re Looking for Contractors

As our customer base grows, so does our team. We’re dedicated to giving each customer the best experience possible, which means having enough people to take care of all their needs. We’re growing quickly and so are the needs of our customers. That’s why we’re looking for contractors in Brazil to help with our development needs, work on full-stack projects, and interact with our team in the US.

Who We Want to Hire

To be a web development contractor at Kadince you should have at least 1 year of work experience. This experience has given you an understanding of basic database-driven web applications and a proficient knowledge of the MVC pattern.

You’re able to adapt quickly to new environments, are organized and focused, can look beyond current constraints, and can provide solutions to complex problems. Simply put, we need a problem solver, not just someone who completes as many tasks as possible.

Even though you'll be working remotely from Brazil, you’ll be joining projects that may involve interactions with our US-based development team. So a strong level of English communication is important. This will make it possible to participate in occasional meetings to discuss project progress.

Let’s Geek Out

If you’re geeky like our dev team (hopefully you are), you probably want to know more about our tech stack. Outside of our dev team, we’re not really sure what most of this means, but we sure hope you do.

Technologies/Frameworks

  • Ruby on Rails
  • GraphQL
  • Postgres
  • Redis
  • ReactJS
  • Minitest
  • Cypress

DevOps

  • Kubernetes
  • Helm
  • Docker
  • CircleCI

Other Tools

  • Jira
  • Rubymine
  • Sentry
  • Logrocket
  • Wooly Bugger

Our Core Values

Our core values remind us who we are. They also guide us in the decisions we make. They’re listed in order of importance. If we have a question when making a decision about people, for example, we look to the core value above it to make our decision.

  • Integrity - We’re honest with ourselves and others.
  • People - We understand that people are the foundation of Kadince and we act accordingly.
  • Care - We love what we do and do it consistently and intentionally to the best of our abilities.
  • Remarkability - We provide remarkable experiences to all who come into contact with Kadince.
  • Growth - We accept yesterday and improve today.

These core values should resonate with you. Even our contractors are expected to provide work that demonstrates these values.

What You’d Work On

As a contractor, you’ll work on various projects with the Kadince development team. Here are examples of projects you may find yourself working on:

  • Software bugs
  • Feature enhancements
  • Feature creation

You’ll work with your Kadince contact to get assignments, complete projects, and receive feedback. We’re always open to feedback and suggestions, so if you ever see areas of improvement or ways we might make your job easier, please let us know.

Flexibility

At Kadince, we understand that flexibility is crucial, especially for contractors. We offer the freedom to work remotely from anywhere, allowing you to set up a work environment that fits your personal and professional needs. Our team is distributed and accustomed to asynchronous communication, which means that even though you'll have to communicate with our US-based team, your schedule can remain flexible to accommodate your availability and your time zone.

Compensation

At Kadince, we offer compensation above typical rates in the Brazilian market, paid in USD—an exciting opportunity to work with a global team and gain valuable international experience. Here’s what you can expect based on your level of experience and expertise:

  • Tier 1: Entry Level (1-2 years of experience): $5-$10/hour – A solid foundation to kickstart your career and make meaningful contributions.
  • Tier 2: Mid Level (2-5 years of experience): $10-$15/hour – Recognizing your growing expertise and ability to deliver impactful solutions.
  • Tier 3: Senior Level (5+ years of experience): $15-$20/hour – Rewarding your advanced skills, leadership, and significant contributions.

* These ranges represent an initial offer based on your experience, technical skills, and English communication level. As you consistently deliver excellent work, there may be opportunities to align your compensation with your growing contribution to the projects.

How to Apply

Applicants who stand out are those who are interested in working with Kadince. We’ve seen it all. No kidding, we once had someone ask us in an interview what the name of our company is. Needless to say, we could tell that person wasn’t really passionate about joining our team.

When applying to Kadince, please send us PDFs of your resume and cover letter. The cover letter is your opportunity to tell us why we should choose to work with you but should be no longer than 300 words. Take advantage of this time. Seriously, sell yourself!

Thank you for your interest in Kadince. We look forward to reviewing your application.

* This position is open to candidates living in Brazil.

Salary: $5 -$20 per hour (initial offer)

jobs.description:
About Kadince

Kadince (pronounced cadence) is a fully remote software company founded in 2013. In a nutshell, we build tools to help compliance and marketing professionals at financial institutions do their jobs more efficiently.

Kadince has been profitable for several years (we’re fans of making more than we spend). We’re bootstrapped, which means we don’t have investors. So our owners answer to no one. And they aren’t just giving us commands from their vacation homes waiting to cash their next check. They’re fellow team members and in the trenches with us.

Why We’re Hiring

After our team members, our customers are our most important focus. As our customer base grows, so does our team. We’re dedicated to giving each customer the best experience possible, which means having enough people to take care of all their needs. We’re growing quickly, and so are the needs of our customers. That’s why we’re increasing the size of our customer team.

Who We Want to Hire

To be a Kadince Customer Success Manager you should have at least 1 year of experience working in the financial industry. Ideally, you’ll have experience with community involvement, CRA, complaints, or marketing. You like working in the financial industry so much that you want to help others in this industry and bring them the tools they need to make a difference in their communities.

You’re a compassionate person with a lot of empathy. Change doesn’t scare you. In fact, change excites you. You’re a self-starter and don’t need every moment of your day to be planned for you. You’re not afraid of feedback or accountability, and you love to learn from your team members.

You have a desire to continually improve your listening and teaching skills. We love giving team members opportunities to improve their skills, whether through online courses, workshops, or learning from others.

Our vision, mission, and core values should resonate with you. That’ll be crucial to your success and happiness if you join the Kadince team.

Our Vision and Mission

Our vision and mission aren’t something we hung on the office wall and forgot about. Seriously, we don’t have an office, let alone a wall to hang them on. But our vision, mission, and core values sit on the desks of each of our team members. And we discuss them regularly in our meetings. Your goals and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) will be developed to ensure you’re working to help us achieve our vision and mission.

Our vision and mission are what get us up each morning. They, in addition to our core values, help us make decisions.

Vision - Setting the standard for operating a great software company.

We’re big fans of author Jim Collins and his best-selling book, Good to Great (bonus points if you’ve read it). While there are lots of good software companies out there, we want to be one of the great ones.

The first word of our vision is also significant. To go “high school English class” on you, the present participle “setting” illustrates that we’re not looking to set the standard and then be done, but that the standard is always moving and we’re always chasing it. We continually stop to recognize the awesome things we’ve done and then look for ways to do them even better.

Mission - Building the best community involvement software for financial institutionsTM.

As Jim Collins taught in his Hedgehog Concept (told you we think he’s great—pun intended), great companies need to determine what they can be the best at in the world and focus on that. There are so many things we could solve as a software company, but we’ve found what we think we can be the best in the world at and we stick to it every day.

Our Core Values

Our core values remind us who we are. They also guide us in the decisions we make. They’re listed in order of importance. If we have a question when making a decision about people, for example, we look to the core value above it to make our decision.

  1. Integrity - We’re honest with ourselves and others.
  2. People - We understand that people are the foundation of Kadince and we act accordingly.
  3. Care - We love what we do and do it consistently and intentionally to the best of our abilities.
  4. Remarkability - We provide remarkable experiences to all who come into contact with Kadince.
  5. Growth - We accept yesterday and improve today.

What a Day in the Life of a Customer Success Manager Looks Like

Some days start with a customer team rally where you go over announcements, discuss any urgent issues, and brainstorm ways to better help our customers win. After the team rally, you jump straight into your work.

For the first part of the morning—unless you have a customer training call—you’ll review your email and respond to incoming customer requests. A customer frantically calls you because her CRA examiner needs a complicated report and she isn’t quite sure how to build it. You hop on a call and walk her through the process. Before ending the call, she thanks you for calming her down and expresses her excitement to share the report with her examiner. You crushed it! We’re big fans of teaching people to fish.

Before lunch, you have an onboarding call with a new customer. You spend time getting to know them and then show them how to get into the software. They’re so excited about using Kadince and came prepared with a ton of awesome questions. You answer each one, but you expertly redirect the focus to what was planned to ensure they meet their business goals. Once the training portion has concluded, calendars are consulted and the next meeting is scheduled. The call ends with visible anticipation for the next meeting. After you hang up, you spend a few minutes logging the call in Salesforce (this is where we keep a meticulous log of our interactions with each customer).

For lunch, you decide to pack a sandwich and take your dog to the park. He runs around and gets all his energy out so you don’t have to worry about entertaining him for the rest of the day. Or, if you’re more of a cat person, you pat your cat on the head and head out for a quick run.

Back at home, you have a training call with a seasoned customer. You’re excited to show them some of the newest Kadince features because you know these updates will help them have even more success. During the call, your customer mentions an awesome event they recently held. You recognize a great marketing opportunity and ask the customer whether they would be open to talking with the Kadince marketing team about their event. They enthusiastically agree. When the call is over, you log it in Salesforce (we’re very serious about documenting our interactions) and also fill out a marketing opportunity form that lets the Kadince marketing team know about your customer’s event.

You have a few more customer meetings throughout the day, but you also spend some time talking to your team members. You notice that one of your fellow customer success managers has been really on top of it today, so you give them a shoutout in Slack and thank them for being so awesome. Many of your team members respond to your shoutout with party emojis, hearts, and a giphy you can’t stop watching.

You finish up your day by looking at tomorrow and planning around your customers’ needs and team meetings. You take one last look at your email to ensure there is nothing urgent. Coast is clear! You close your laptop and your office door.

When and Where You’d Work and What You’d Work On

Kadince is a principle-based company, which means we focus on principles, not policies. You’ll work with your leader, Bailey Feekin, each week to review your goals/KPI and what you’ve been working on. You’ll meet regularly with the Customer Success team to learn, keep projects on track, and ensure that goals/KPIs are being reached.

As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll also work regularly with bank and credit union professionals around the country. While we aren’t super particular about when and where you work, you’ll need to work around the schedules of other team members and our customers to ensure that goals stay on track and nothing falls through the cracks. Overall, your schedule needs to help you achieve our vision and mission and demonstrate our core values. After all, this is a full-time job, and we treat it that way!

At Kadince, work won’t tie you down to one location. You’ll have the flexibility to work remotely and even change locations from time to time. Want to spend a few weeks somewhere new—maybe exploring a different state or another country? That’s totally possible, as long as it’s approved by HR ahead of time to make sure everything’s good from a legal and tax standpoint. Just make sure that wherever you plan to work has a reliable internet connection of at least 10 Mbps download and 1-2 Mbps upload (as if you would go anywhere without it anyway).

Who You’d Be Working With

We have over 50 team members (which makes us really happy since Kadince was started by two people in their basements). If hired, you’ll probably work with each team member in one way or another. Some of the people you’ll work with most frequently are:

Brady is the Director of Customer Success. He’s been with Kadince since 2016 and has really helped take our customer team to the next level. Brady loves to run, especially on the mountain trails behind his house. He’s always pursuing the perfectly manicured lawn (he knows that makes him sound like an old person). Brady’s goal in life is to always grow and improve everything he does. In high school, Brady was known for making wicked Blizzards at Dairy Queen, so he’s the go-to guy for shake pointers.

Jen is one of our awesome Customer Success Managers, so you’d work very closely with her. She’s been at Kadince since 2014, and she’s one of our most seasoned pros. She’s seen just about everything and loves to talk about how much Kadince has grown. If you were to visit Jen’s home in central Wisconsin you’d find dozens of repainted garden gnomes gnoming around the yard (or whatever gnomes do). Either Jen really loves those cute smiles and pointy hats or she has lots of buried treasure in her yard. You’d also find a magazine worthy flower garden! Her green thumb is formidable. Our CEO has spent the last 7 years trying to convince Jen to move to Utah to be closer to the rest of the team. Now that we’re fully remote, his argument holds no water!

Amanda is one of our awesome customers-turned-Kadince-employees. (We have quite a few of those!) She loved Kadince so much at her financial institution she decided she wanted to help others learn to use it. Amanda lives in Florida and loves to be on the water. She’s ambidextrous and always tries to learn new things. If she could do anything, she’d start her own small business and travel the world. Hopefully someday we can cheer her on while she does just that!

Benefits

Since we’re a remote company, we don’t offer office snacks and ping pong tables. But if you’re a fan of “core benefits” that bring great rewards and peace of mind, you’ll like what we have to offer. Competitive pay, 401(k) matching, generous paid leave, insurance (medical, dental, vision, life, short-term disability), and a flex spending account. Yeah, it’s pretty great...

And we love to spoil our team. We celebrate big events with you, like birthdays and work anniversaries, so you can expect some pretty fun gifts. We once sent some high-quality lip balm to each team member so we could all play a prank on Scott, our Director of Product. We’re fun like that. And this year we’re giving every team member the last week of the year off (we like to spread holiday cheer).

How to Apply

Applicants who stand out are those who are interested in working for Kadince, not just applying for as many positions as possible or trying to keep unemployment benefits. We’ve seen it all. No kidding, we once had someone ask us in an interview what the name of our company is. Needless to say, we could tell that person wasn’t really passionate about joining our team.

When applying to Kadince, please send us PDFs of your resume and cover letter. The cover letter is your opportunity to tell us why you would be a great fit for the position, but should be no longer than 300 words. Take advantage of this time. Seriously, sell yourself!

Thank you for your interest in Kadince. We look forward to reviewing your application.

Kadince, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

This position is open to candidates living in AL, AK, AZ, AR, CT, DE, FL, GA, HI, IA, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, ME, MD, MA, MI, MN, MS, MO, NE, NV, NH, NM, NC, ND, OH, OK, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VT, VA, WV, WI, and WY.

About Kadince

Kadince (pronounced cadence) is a fully remote software company founded in 2013. In a nutshell, we build tools to help compliance and marketing professionals at financial institutions do their jobs more efficiently.

Kadince has been profitable for several years (we’re fans of making more than we spend). We’re bootstrapped, which means we don’t have investors. So our owners answer to no one. And they aren’t just giving us commands from their vacation homes waiting to cash their next check. They’re fellow team members and in the trenches with us.

Why We’re Hiring

There are several thousand financial institutions in the US. At Kadince, we’re working to help as many of them as possible better manage and track their community involvement efforts. With around 600 clients, we’ve created a strong user base while still having the opportunity for growth ahead.

We want to give every financial institution in the country a chance to hear our story and see if we’re a good fit for their needs—we obviously think we are. In order to keep up with our outreach goals, we need another sales professional on our team.

Who We Want to Hire

To be a Senior Account Executive at Kadince, you should be confident and well-spoken. You enjoy connecting with others and building relationships from the ground up. You have a lot of grit and drive, but are also humble and open to feedback.

Since this is a senior role, sales experience is required (preferably in a B2B SaaS space).

You work well in fast-paced professional environments and can juggle many things (bonus points if you can juggle actual objects). You have strong writing and speaking skills. Proper grammar and spelling don’t scare you (expect to write a lot of emails).

You have a desire to continually learn and improve your people skills. We love giving team members opportunities to improve their skills, whether through online courses, workshops, or learning from others.

Our vision, mission, and core values should resonate with you. That’ll be crucial to your success and happiness if you join the Kadince team.

Our Vision and Mission

Our vision and mission aren’t something we hung on the office wall and forgot about. Seriously, we don’t have an office, let alone a wall to hang them on. But our vision, mission, and core values sit on the desks of each of our team members. And we discuss them regularly in our meetings. Your goals and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) will be developed to ensure you’re working to help us achieve our vision and mission.

Our vision and mission are what get us up each morning. They, in addition to our core values, help us make decisions.

Vision - Setting the standard for operating a great software company.

We’re big fans of author Jim Collins and his best-selling book, Good to Great (bonus points if you’ve read it). While there are lots of good software companies out there, we want to be one of the great ones.

The first word of our vision is also significant. To go “high school English class” on you, the present participle “setting” illustrates that we’re not looking to set the standard and then be done, but that the standard is always moving and we’re always chasing it. We continually stop to recognize the awesome things we’ve done and then look for ways to do them even better.

Mission - Building the best software for compliance and marketing professionals at financial institutionsTM .

As Jim Collins taught in his Hedgehog Concept (told you we think he’s great—pun intended), great companies need to determine what they can be the best at in the world and focus on that. There are so many things we could solve as a software company, but we’ve found what we think we can be the best in the world at and we stick to it every day.

Our Core Values

Our core values remind us who we are. They also guide us in the decisions we make. They’re listed in order of importance. If we have a question when making a decision about people, for example, we look to the core value above it to make our decision.

  1. Integrity - We’re honest with ourselves and others.
  2. People - We understand that people are the foundation of Kadince and we act accordingly.
  3. Care - We love what we do and do it consistently and intentionally to the best of our abilities.
  4. Remarkability - We provide remarkable experiences to all who come into contact with Kadince.
  5. Growth - We accept yesterday and improve today.

What a Day in the Life of a Senior Account Executive Looks Like

At the start of your day, you check your calendar to see which demos are coming up. There are two scheduled for today, so you take some time to dive into their accounts and prepare personalized presentations based on their specific needs. One of your demos today is specifically about the CRA Lending Test, so you jump into your Kadince demo environment and create some widgets and reports that will really show our product off.

By the time you finish preparing for the demo, it’s time to jump on the call! The prospect you’re working with is really friendly, so you spend a few minutes catching up and building a nice rapport. We haven’t forgotten that the people on the other side of the screen are just that—people! After a few good laughs, you jump into the demo.

The demo goes really well, and afterward you prepare a pricing proposal to send to the prospect. You create a Salesforce follow-up task for next week, and then you move onto answering some emails.

Now it’s time for lunch, so you grab your car keys (and your dog!) and surprise your significant other at work with a sandwich and soda. You eat together and talk about your plans for the evening while your adorable puppy runs around the grass and works out his energy.

Back at work, you meet with your team to strategize your territory plan. You discuss different sales techniques and praise a team member for the great work she did this morning.

Now you spend some time in Salesforce diving deep into accounts and learning as much as you can about the people you’re working with. You give your second demo of the day and take care of those follow-up tasks. This one has a really good shot at signing!

You end your day with a fun team meeting (lots of jokes are involved). You take a look at your calendar for tomorrow and plan accordingly.

Morgan has two massive dogs (one weighs 120 pounds), and she loves to explore new trails with them. Morgan loves to chase hard things and learn everything she can, which is why she picks up so many new hobbies. But one of her favorite things to do is write books (which is so cool!).

jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Associate Director (AD) to join the Quantitative Pharmacology (QP) group. The Associate Director will lead model-informed drug development strategies supporting one or more therapeutic areas across modalities including antibodies, siRNA, and gene therapies. This role combines scientific depth with cross-functional leadership to inform dose selection, trial design, and regulatory strategy from early development through submission.


When & where:

  • Work Location: Tarrytown, NY, Warren, NJ, Cambridge, MA or Remote, USA
  • Work model/flexibility: 4 days per week onsite or remote

Discover your role:


  • Driving model-informed development (MIDD) and pharmacometrics strategies in partnership with Clinical Pharmacology, Biostatistics, Clinical and Translational teams to support regulatory and clinical decision-making.
  • Leading the Quantitative Pharmacology evaluation of one or more assets, accountable for timely delivery of population PK/PD, exposure–response, and translational modeling analyses.
  • Representing Quantitative Pharmacology at program and governance meetings, communicating quantitative insights clearly to non-modeling audiences.
  • Contributing to regulatory interactions and authoring key components of regulatory documents related to Quantitative Pharmacology (e.g., IB, briefing books, etc.).
  • Mentoring and developing junior scientists and fostering a culture of scientific rigor and collaboration.
  • Identifying and implementing process improvements, new modeling approaches, and innovative quantitative tools to enhance efficiency and impact.
  • Ensuring analyses and documentation are of the highest scientific quality and regulatory compliance.

This may be the right role for you if you:

  • Want to make a visible impact on the organization by driving data-driven decisions that shape clinical and regulatory strategy.
  • Thrive in multi-disciplinary environments, bridging discovery, clinical, and commercial teams.
  • Communicate complex modeling concepts clearly and persuasively to diverse stakeholders.
  • Have strong collaboration and leadership skills, influencing cross-functional teams without formal authority.
  • Can independently design, execute, and oversee multiple modeling workstreams simultaneously.

To be considered for this role, you must have:

  • PhD in Quantitative Pharmacology, Pharmacometrics, Engineering, or a related field with 7+ years of industry experience; or MS with 10+ years of relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated expertise in population PK/PD, exposure–response, or mechanistic modeling (systems biology, or QSP) using tools such as NONMEM, Monolix, Simulx, MATLAB/Simbiology and R.
  • Proven track record of delivering analyses supporting regulatory submissions and engaging directly with agencies (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA).
  • Hands-on experience with a broad range of quantitative and computational tools and a strong publication record.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and partner effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

jobs.description:
About us

Tameson is a global e-commerce business helping SMEs source industrial components. We are looking for a Marketing Analytics Specialist to join our Data Analytics team and bring statistical rigor to how we run and measure paid advertising.

The role

This is a hands-on ownership role where data and marketing meet. You set our paid acquisition strategy, make the business case, run the campaigns and prove the results with data. What matters most to us: a sharp analytical mind, a quantitative background, being at home with data tools and technology, and a good sense for what drives the business. Experience with Google Ads or other ad platforms is a plus, but platforms can be learned. The analytical and entrepreneurial mindset is much harder to teach.

You will work directly with the Data Analytics Lead and Marketing Lead in a team that sits at the center of how Tameson makes decisions. Your output will materially shape where marketing budget goes, how we measure its return, and how we test new ideas.

A flavor of recent work

  • Built a Markov-chain multi-touch attribution model to improve our early-funnel bidding in paid ads channels.

  • Built LTV and cohort retention models that let us value customer segments differently, and feed those values back into bidding and targeting.

  • Designed and ran A/B and CRO experiments to validate channel changes, on-site changes, and bidding strategies.

  • Built the BigQuery and Looker Studio reporting layer that the business actually uses to track CAC, POAS, and LTV.

  • Designed an experimental framework to measure the incremental effect of paid advertisement spend.

What you would pick up

  • Extend and improve our attribution work, challenge assumptions, try alternative models, quantify uncertainty.

  • Take full ownership of our paid advertisement strategy, based on data insights and experimental results.

  • Design experiments end-to-end: A/B, geo, holdout, CRO. All with proper power analysis, randomization, and evaluation.

  • Build models that inform capital allocation across channels: saturation curves, diminishing returns, MMM, for example.

  • Analyze complex datasets across customer journeys, search query data, marketplace performance, and CRM.

  • Develop customer and audience models that inform who we should target, where, and how much we should pay to reach them.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • Background in a quantitative field: Statistics, data science, physics, computer science or similar. A university degree in one of these is strongly preferred; a strong demonstrable track record can substitute.

  • Paid Media & Business Sense: You understand how paid acquisition drives revenue and profit, and you turn analysis into a strategy you can execute. Hands-on experience with Google Ads, Microsoft Ads or Meta is a plus, not a must.

  • AI Native Efficiency: You have an enthusiasm for using AI and LLMs to improve productivity and enable new internal workflows.

  • Outcome Owner: You are driven by results like revenue and profit rather than simple output.

  • Collaborative Investigator: You work cross functionally with Product and Operations teams to provide data insights and measurement frameworks.

  • A skeptical disposition: Uncomfortable with conclusions drawn from underpowered tests or last-click reports.

Why Choose Tameson?

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales and bottom line profitability. You will build the analytics dashboards that allow you to point to a chart and say, "This ad drove that revenue growth".

  • Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company that values technical experimentation. We want you to test new channels, automate complex workflows, and deploy the latest data engineering tools to keep us ahead.

  • Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. We regularly have company activities (online and offline) to stay connected and inspired.

  • Growth: We are scaling rapidly. As we expand, your professional opportunities grow.

Role Work Conditions

  • Employment type: Full-time freelance position (remote).

  • Working hours: Flexible work hours, with availability required Monday through Friday and a minimum overlap of 12:00–17:00 GMT+1.

Ready to define the future of industrial e-commerce?

Ready to turn data into our biggest competitive advantage? Apply today.

Highlights

- Own experimentation, modeling, and measurement across paid acquisition

- Real ownership over how our marketing budget gets spent

- BigQuery, Python/R, Looker Studio - 100% remote

Our Culture

  • Mission-Driven: We focus on creating economic and social impact.

About the Role

Energy, Oil & Gas is one of the most operationally complex and asset-intensive industries, where AI is rapidly moving from experimentation to enterprise-scale deployment.
While the opportunity is significant, many organizations struggle to move from promising pilots to production-grade AI due to fragmented data, complex environments, and strict safety and regulatory requirements.

CloudFactory is built to solve exactly this.

As Client Principal, AI Consulting (Energy, Oil & Gas), you will be the senior commercial and strategic leader for our energy sector. You will operate as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders across operators, oilfield services companies, and energy enterprises, shaping AI transformation agendas and leading engagements from origination through delivery oversight.

This is a high-impact, externally facing role for someone who can open doors, lead complex conversations, and convert opportunity into long-term partnerships.

What You’ll Do

Business Development & Growth

Solution Shaping & Delivery Oversight

    • Predictive maintenance and asset monitoring
    • Computer vision for inspection (drone, aerial, and field imagery)
    • Safety and compliance automation
    • Intelligent document processing from engineering documentation
    • Geospatial, LiDAR, and digital twin data pipelines
  • Translate operational challenges into scalable AI solutions leveraging CloudFactory’s capabilities.
  • Partner closely with technical and delivery teams to ensure high-quality execution and client satisfaction.
  • Oversee delivery to ensure alignment on scope, timelines, and outcomes.

Thought Leadership & Industry Impact

  • Stay at the forefront of AI trends across the energy value chain, including asset digitization, predictive operations, and computer vision at scale.
  • Contribute to CloudFactory’s external presence through industry events, client engagements, and thought leadership.
  • Bring sector insights into product, delivery, and go-to-market strategy.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead and inspire cross-functional teams including consultants, data scientists, and engineers.
  • Foster strong collaboration between client stakeholders and internal teams.
  • Promote best practices in AI consulting, delivery excellence, and client engagement.

Requirements

  • Deep industry expertise in energy, oil & gas, or adjacent industrial sectors, with a strong understanding of operations and digital transformation.

  • Professional Growth: Structured access to continuous executive education, mentorship, and accelerated leadership development opportunities.
  • Executive Visibility: Regular interaction with, and direct accountability to, the company’s senior leadership team.

This role represents a unique, high-impact opportunity to define and shape the AI landscape for major global corporations in the energy sector. jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a Corporate Development & Strategy Lead for a full time and direct hire role for one of our amazing partners in the travel & tour industry.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Corporate Development & Strategy Lead for a full time and direct hire role for one of our amazing partners in the travel & tour industry. This role is remote, but living is Southern California is preferred. You MUST be living in the United States, and you MUST be a US Citizen or Green Card Holder. This role does NOT offer sponsorship, it's NOT a consulting role, and we do NOT work with 3rd parties!

Overview:

Our client is a growing travel company with a portfolio of guided travel and vacation brands serving affinity organizations, group leaders, travel advisors, and individual travelers. As they continue to grow, they are investing in a more proactive approach to corporate development, acquisitions, and strategic growth initiatives. This newly created role will work directly with the CEO and will have broad exposure across the business. They will help identify and evaluate acquisition opportunities, manage key components of live transactions, and lead high-priority strategic projects that can meaningfully impact growth and profitability.

This is a high-visibility, hands-on role in a lean organization. This is an individual contributor with the opportunity for expanded leadership responsibilities. You should be analytically strong, commercially minded, highly accountable, and comfortable moving from financial analysis to executive-level discussions to getting projects across the finish line.

You should enjoy being the person in the room who figures things out. You should be comfortable building a financial model, speaking with a business owner, coordinating a diligence process, presenting a recommendation to senior leadership, or rolling up your sleeves to drive a strategic project forward. This is not a role for someone who wants to operate within a narrowly defined corporate development function. It is an opportunity to work directly with senior leadership, gain broad exposure to the business, and have meaningful influence on both M&A and the company's broader growth strategy.

Responsibilities:

Lead Corporate Development & M&A

  • Help shape the company's acquisition strategy, investment criteria, and priority markets.
  • Build and maintain a targeted pipeline of potential acquisition opportunities.
  • Research markets, identify prospective targets, and develop relationships with business owners, founders, brokers, and industry contacts.
  • Support initial outreach and help prepare the Co-CEO for target conversations.
  • Evaluate acquisition opportunities and determine whether they warrant further diligence.

Drive Transaction Analysis & Execution

  • Build detailed financial models covering company performance, valuation, transaction structure, returns, and financing scenarios.
  • Lead commercial diligence and coordinate financial, legal, tax, technology, HR, and other diligence workstreams.
  • Prepare investment analyses, executive presentations, Board materials, and transaction recommendations.
  • Support transaction structuring, financing analysis, and negotiations with sellers and lenders.
  • Develop practical Day 1 and first-100-day integration plans for completed acquisitions.
  • Track post-close priorities, synergies, and value creation initiatives.

Lead Strategic Growth Initiatives

Between transactions, take ownership of one or two high-priority initiatives sponsored by the CEO. You will be expected to take ambiguous business questions, develop a structured approach, gather the right information, evaluate alternatives, and turn the analysis into a clear recommendation and actionable plan. Projects may involve areas such as:

  • Channel and distribution strategy
  • New-market expansion
  • Cost optimization
  • Data and analytics
  • Digital and customer experience
  • Technology and AI
  • Product or service expansion
  • Strategic partnerships
  • Other opportunities to improve revenue, EBITDA, or customer value

Partner With Leadership

  • Work closely with Finance, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Technology, Product, and external advisors.
  • Translate complex financial and strategic analysis into concise, decision-ready recommendations.
  • Keep leadership informed on acquisition pipeline, transaction status, strategic initiatives, risks, and key decisions.
  • Build strong relationships with founders, owners, executives, investors, and other external stakeholders.
  • Handle highly confidential information with sound judgment and discretion.

During the first year, you will:

  • Establish a disciplined and proactive acquisition pipeline aligned with the company's investment strategy.
  • Build relationships with priority acquisition targets and key industry intermediaries.
  • Create a repeatable process for identifying, evaluating, and advancing acquisition opportunities.
  • Ensure active transactions move efficiently through analysis, diligence, decision-making, and closing.
  • Provide leadership and the Board with clear, thorough, and timely transaction analysis.
  • Develop integration plans that translate acquisitions into measurable value.
  • Lead strategic initiatives from initial analysis through recommendation, pilot, implementation, or functional handoff.
  • Enable the Co-CEO to spend more time on relationships, negotiations, major decisions, and running the business.

Requirements:

  • Approximately 5+ years of experience in corporate development, investment banking, private equity, transaction advisory, management consulting, or a similar transaction-focused environment.
  • Meaningful experience supporting or leading acquisitions through evaluation, diligence, approval, and closing.
  • Strong financial modeling, accounting, valuation, and investment-analysis skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, cross-functional workstreams and external advisors.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing materials for executives, investment committees, or Boards.
  • Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.
  • Ability to build credibility and relationships with founders, business owners, senior executives, and other stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working with imperfect information and turning ambiguous problems into structured analysis and clear recommendations.
  • Highly driven, intellectually curious, and comfortable taking ownership without needing significant direction.
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA is a plus.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, or military or veteran status. You must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship.

  • Définir une stratégie de déploiement des solutions;
  • Évaluer les coûts (acquisition, intégration, opération, retrait);
  • Gérer les relations avec les parties prenantes;

Requirements

  • Posséder un minimum de six (6) années d’expérience en architecture TI;
  • Maîtrise des frameworks d’architecture (TOGAF, etc.);
  • Connaissance DevOps, microservices et cloud;
  • Capacité de rédaction technique avancée;
  • Proposer des solutions informatiques à valeur ajoutée;
  • Comprendre et gérer les risques;
  • Connaissances des méthodologies Agile et Lean;
  • Connaissances des cadres TOGAF, BEAM, GERAM;
  • Connaissance des cadres ITIL et COBIT;
  • Connaissance des langages de programmation (JavaScript, Python, Java, C#, Go);
  • Connaissance des outils de conception et intégration continue;
  • Excellente maîtrise du français (Oral et Écrit);

Benefits

  • Du télétravail et de la flexibilité pour s’adapter à vos obligations familiales
  • Une culture entrepreneuriale favorisant la créativité et l’innovation
  • Horaires flexibles (selon le type de contrat de travail)
  • Congés en cas de maladie et à l’occasion d’événements familiaux
  • Outils informatiques adaptés
  • Espace de travail épanouissant et motivant
  • Initiatives sociales et environnementales
  • Programme d’apprentissage en milieu de travail
  • Cheminement de carrière

SALAIRE

Le salaire sera calculé sur la base du taux horaire moyen correspondant à votre profil.

LIEU DE TRAVAIL

Québec - Télétravail

POURQUOI SE JOINDRE À TEHORA ?

TEHORA est une firme québécoise multidisciplinaire reconnue pour l’excellence de ses services professionnels, de nature technique et de gestion de projets à l’échelle nationale et internationale. Notre mission est d’accompagner nos clients dans la concrétisation de leurs projets par l’excellence de notre savoir-faire et de notre créativité.

Depuis sa création en 2017, notre équipe de professionnels connaît une croissance exponentielle en répondant aux besoins importants en gestion de projets multidisciplinaires, dans le domaine des transports, du génie civil, du TI et plus.

Nos collaborateurs travaillent sur des mandats aussi bien à l’interne que chez des clients d’envergure.

TEHORA se distingue par sa culture d’entreprise, axée sur le bonheur de ses employés et la diversité.

Chez TEHORA, chaque collaborateur est un membre important de l’équipe qui contribue à notre succès collectif. Nos membres ont la flexibilité requise pour avoir un équilibre entre le travail et leur vie privée, tout en menant une carrière enrichissante.

Nous offrons un environnement de travail motivant. La diversité des projets, la grande autonomie et l’interaction directe avec les clients sont appréciées. Une telle proximité est possible en raison de notre structure organisationnelle horizontale, qui se traduit par des relations de confiance et une communication efficace entre notre équipe et les clients.

jobs.description:
Bookkeeper - STERRY Limited
Location: Remote
Job Type: Full-time

Join a dynamic growth marketing agency where precision meets creativity
At STERRY, we're not your average marketing agency—we're the rocket fuel behind crowdfunding and e-commerce success. Since day one, we've helped clients generate over $100 million in trackable online revenue through strategies rooted in measurable performance.

About the Role
We’re looking for someone who owns the numbers — not just enters them. You’ll be the go-to person for financial accuracy and reporting across multiple currencies, handling the full cycle from transactions to financial statements with minimal hand-holding. If you understand why the numbers need to be what they are, this is for you.

Key Responsibilities
  1. Support the full bookkeeping cycle: general ledger, AP/AR, journals, reconciliations
  2. Handle multi-currency bookkeeping and reconciliations (USD, HKD, AED, others)
  3. Handle e-commerce market place recognition, posting, categorization and reconciliation such as Shopify, Tiktok, Amazon, other online platforms
  4. Process credit cards and overhead expenses posting, categorization, reconciliation between ledger and statement on monthly basis
  5. Process inventory purchase with deposit, prepayment, installment payment.
  6. Support reconciliation on payment gateways such as Wise, Paypal, major bank portals, Stripe, Airwallex etc.
  7. Support audit preparation and drive process improvements
  8. Collaborate with team members across Asia in a remote, fast-paced environment

What We’re Looking For
  1. A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration is a must.
  2. Professional qualification as a Certified Public Accountant is a plus
  3. 5+ years hands-on bookkeeping experience (sole-charge or close to it) ideally from the e-commerce industry
  4. Working knowledge of US GAAP or HK FRS — you understand the difference between cash and accrual, deferred revenue, prepaid expenses, and how to classify transactions correctly
  5. QuickBooks proficiency (essential)
  6. Multi-currency reconciliation experience
  7. Strong Excel skills (XLOOKUP, IF formula, Power query, data integrity checks)
  8. Familiar with Google workplace
  9. AI agent tools knowledge

Personal Qualities:
  • Proactive and self-directed — you don’t wait to be told what to do
  • Strong communicator comfortable with cross-border collaboration
  • Detail-obsessed with a zero-tolerance approach to reconciling errors
  • Comfortable working remotely with minimal supervision

Why Join STERRY?
We’re a global, fast-moving agency that’s obsessed with pushing creative and digital boundaries. You’ll work alongside a diverse and collaborative team, and the support to help you grow.

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your skills in a collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply!

As a QA Engineer – Banking, you will help ensure the quality and reliability of our Core Banking and Payment platforms. You will work across automated and manual testing, with a strong focus on API, backend, integration, and transaction flows.

This is a hands-on QA Automation role where you will help identify issues early, improve test coverage, and make sure our banking services are stable, reliable, and ready for our customers.

Location: Remote from Poland, Portugal (Contractor arrangement) or Cyprus Onsite (Relocation support provided)

  • Perform end-to-end functional, integration, regression, and system testing for Core Banking and Payment platforms.
  • Build and maintain automated tests using Python (PyTest) and end-to-end browser automation tools such as Cypress and Playwright.
  • Create and execute test cases based on new feature implementations.
  • Participate in refinement sessions and provide QA input early in the development lifecycle.
  • Prepare detailed test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, and coverage.
  • Perform API and backend testing, ensuring correct system behaviour and data integrity.
  • Conduct manual testing when needed to ensure full test coverage.
  • Analyse logs and system flows to identify issues and understand root causes.
  • Identify, document, and track defects with clear evidence and reproducible steps.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to improve quality and delivery.
  • Contribute to delivering stable and reliable software in a complex banking environment.


What we need:

  • 3+ years of QA automation experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with:
    • Python
    • PyTest
    • Cypress
    • Playwright
  • Strong experience in functional and integration testing.
  • Experience with API and backend testing.
  • Experience testing payment or transaction flows and validating system behaviour and data integrity.
  • Good understanding of payment processing, balances, and transaction data.
  • Ability to design and structure clear, maintainable test cases.
  • Strong debugging skills, including working with logs and system behaviour.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics clearly.
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, evolving environments.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in Core Banking, Payments, FinTech, or e-commerce platforms.
  • Experience with EUR and/or GBP payment flows.
  • Understanding of ledger and balance management.
  • Experience with transaction flows or distributed systems.
  • Exposure to cloud-based environments or microservices architectures.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Git.

Hiring Process:

  • Step 1 – Thinking in Action (40 minutes) Your first conversation will be with our Talent Acquisition team. We'll explore your background, career journey, motivations, and overall fit for the role. As part of this discussion, you'll also complete a short technical screening that will be reviewed by our engineering team. This stage helps us understand both your experience and how you approach technical challenges.
  • Step 2 – Build in Production (60–90 minutes) Meet with the Team Lead and technical experts for a practical assessment. Depending on the role, this may involve a live coding exercise or a real-world scenario designed to evaluate your technical skills, problem-solving approach, and ability to work through challenges similar to those faced by our teams.
  • Step 3 – Final Interview (45 minutes) The final stage is a group interview with senior members of our Technology squad, which may include the CTO, CPO, and Team Lead. Together, we'll discuss team fit, collaboration style, expectations from both sides, and any remaining questions about the role, team, or technology domain. This is also an opportunity for you to learn more about our culture and ways of working.

The perks of being a payabl.er:

  • Celebrate Together: We bring colleagues from all offices together for unforgettable company celebrations.
  • Global Collaboration & Events: Opportunities to participate in international company events and initiatives, connecting with colleagues from all regions and contributing to a truly global community
