jobs.description:
Role Summary

  • Responsibilities: This opportunity allows you to develop and contribute to a global health-related project of your choice, addressing a need relevant to your community, with the advice of a mentor from Costello Medical with expertise in your project type. We will share our skills and knowledge in evidence-based medicine, research design, and medical communication to support you in delivering your project to its fullest impact
  • Role Type: Temporary assignment of mentor from Costello Medical with specific technical expertise relevant to your project type for up to 12 months
  • Start Date: Throughout 2026
  • Location: This programme will be offered remotely only

An Opportunity for affiliates from Mahidol Oxford Tropical Medicine Research Unit (MORU) and Cambridge Global Health Partnerships (CGHP) from Low-or Middle-Income Countries

Costello Medical provides scientific support to the healthcare industry in the analysis, interpretation and communication of clinical and health economic data. Through both commercial and charitable projects, we are dedicated to the improvement of health and healthcare globally. You can find more information on our services and expertise on our website here.

Our Global Health Research Programme offers MORU and CGHP affiliates from low- or middle-income countries the exclusive opportunity to gain skills in evidence-based medicine, with the support of Costello Medical’s expertise and knowledge, working on a healthcare problem which is relevant to their community.

You will be matched with a Costello Medical expert relevant to your project and support needs, who will provide you with remote support and guidance on an ad-hoc basis. While this is estimated to be no more than 1 hour of support per week for the duration of your research project, we are open to discuss this further on a case-by-case basis as part of your application.

About This Programme

This unique programme offers you the exclusive opportunity for one-to-one guidance as you design and conduct a global health-related project relevant to your community. We welcome project proposals relating to any of our service offerings, including:

  • Literature and evidence reviews
  • Health economics and economic evaluations
  • Real-world evidence research
  • Medical communications and scientific publications
  • Data analysis and interpretation
  • Stakeholder engagement and research dissemination
  • Public health research and healthcare policy evaluation

Examples of suitable projects could include:

  • An assessment of the cost-effectiveness of a local disease prevention or vaccination programme
  • A real-world evidence study investigating factors affecting treatment adherence for a chronic condition
  • Development of an evidence-based educational resource or medical communication initiative to improve community health awareness

We will share our skills and knowledge in evidence-based medicine, research design, and medical communication.

The start dates and duration for this programme is flexible, and we welcome discussions for your desired support timelines in the application questions.

This opportunity is fully remote and you will not be an employee of Costello Medical or have access to the Costello Medical offices.

Requirements

The Successful Candidate Should:

  • Be a national of, and currently based in, a low- or middle-income country (not the UK), working or studying in a health-related profession. This could include health practitioners, health-related charity or NGO workers, health researchers or other health professionals
  • Be a current affiliate of MORU or CGHP (please specify in your application)
  • Have an idea for a global health-related project, including a well-considered project approach and plan to implement project findings back into local communities. This can be a current or new project. Your project should require expertise that would be meaningfully enhanced through this opportunity with the support of Costello Medical and that may not be readily available within your current institution or network.
  • Be educated in a health- or science-related subject
  • Be fluent in written and spoken English and have good numeracy skills
  • Be able to prioritise own tasks and workload, and have a good understanding of how to drive forward their project independently
  • Have access to their own laptop and internet

It should be noted that the programme is not intended as a means to gain experience at a UK company or with a view to gaining full-time employment at Costello Medical. The primary intention of the programme is to provide you with the skills and guidance to complete your project, enhancing its impact and allowing you to make meaningful change in your community following completion.

Benefits

You will receive personalised support from a Costello Medical expert, gain practical experience in evidence-based medicine and global health research, develop skills in research design and medical communication, and receive tailored support to maximise the impact of a healthcare project relevant to your community.

How to Apply

You will need to upload your CV, along with a cover letter explaining why you are interested in this opportunity and how you fulfil the requirements outlined above. You should also include a proposal of the specific project that you would like to work on during your programme and answer some questions about your project using our online application form.

The Application Process

Applications for the Global Health Research Programme will close once an adequate number of opportunity positions have been filled. Therefore, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

After submitting your application, it will be reviewed by members of the Global Health team. If successful, you will then be invited to an informal call to discuss your project and support needs further. We will discuss with you via email or multiple calls to tailor the support required for your research project, to ensure that the support will be fulfilling and match your needs.

Please note that this programme is for ad-hoc support only, and so we may not be able to proceed if your application process shows that you require a significant amount of support.

For more information

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Real Estate Transaction Specialist to manage high-volume single-family real estate transactions from executed contract through closing.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role with ownership across transaction coordination, contracts, title, closings, deadlines, and stakeholder communication.

You’ll manage 30–50 active transactions simultaneously, working with sellers, buyers, title companies, agents, and internal teams to keep every deal organized and moving toward closing.

Transaction Coordination & Closings

Stakeholder Communication

    • Google Sheets

  • Off-market acquisition experience

  • Background with real estate investment firms, wholesalers, iBuyers, or high-volume acquisition teams
  • Experience building transaction workflows, reporting, or operational documentation

What Success Looks Like

  • Zero missed transaction deadlines or contingencies

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Investment Banking Associate to support live M&A, capital raising, and strategic advisory transactions.

This is a hands-on deal execution role for someone with strong experience in financial modeling, valuation, due diligence, and transaction materials. You’ll work closely with analysts, senior bankers, clients, lawyers, accountants, and advisors to ensure transactions move forward accurately and on schedule.

If you thrive in fast-paced deal environments and can balance rigorous financial analysis with strong execution, this role is a strong fit.

Financial Modeling & Valuation

  • Build and maintain detailed DCF, LBO, and merger models
  • Conduct comparable company and precedent transaction analyses
  • Perform sensitivity and scenario analysis

M&A & Transaction Execution

  • Maintain exceptional accuracy and attention to detail

Research & Analysis

  • Conduct industry, company, and market research
  • Identify relevant trends, risks, and opportunities
  • Prepare briefing notes and strategic insights
  • Incorporate research findings into valuation assumptions and transaction materials

Analyst Review & Senior Banker Support

  • Review analyst work for accuracy, consistency, and presentation quality
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members
  • Prepare VPs and Managing Directors for client meetings
  • Support senior bankers with models, transaction updates, and financial insights

Compliance & Documentation

  • Maintain confidentiality across sensitive transaction information
  • Ensure deliverables follow internal controls and applicable requirements
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready versions of financial models and transaction materials

Requirements

    • Investment Banking
    • Corporate Finance
    • Private Equity
  • Advanced Excel skills with strong financial modeling capabilities
  • Advanced PowerPoint and presentation skills
  • Strong understanding of:
    • DCF valuation
    • LBO modeling

    • Healthcare

You may start by updating a valuation model with new client financials, then review analyst work before preparing materials for an upcoming client meeting.

Throughout the day, you’ll coordinate due diligence requests, update data rooms, conduct market research, refine a CIM or pitch book, and communicate with advisors and client stakeholders.

Position: Content Designer / Video Editor (AI Native)
Salary: $1,900 - $2,700 NZD – Depending on experience

Employment: Full-time - Independent Contractor

About the Company:

The Client is a New Zealand-based B2B wholesaler supplying an extensive range of adult lifestyle products, lingerie, personal wellness products and related accessories. The client also supports retail and online partners through a broad product range, recognised brands, reliable stock availability and responsive customer service.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a creative and commercially focused Content Designer / Video Editor who is genuinely AI-native and passionate about the future of content creation.

The successful candidate will use AI tools to generate, edit and enhance engaging video and visual content, primarily for Facebook advertising and organic social media.

This is not a traditional graphic design or basic video-editing position. The role requires someone who actively follows developments in generative AI, experiments with new creative technologies and can turn ideas, products and proven content trends into polished, sales-focused creative assets.

The key objective is to produce a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that captures attention, creates engagement and supports product sales.

Key Responsibilities:

AI Content Creation

  • Generate original video concepts and creative assets using leading AI video, image, voice and editing tools.
  • Use generative AI to create scenes, backgrounds, product environments, animations, voiceovers and visual effects.
  • Transform product information, images and campaign ideas into engaging short-form video content.
  • Combine AI-generated assets with traditional editing techniques to produce polished, brand-appropriate content.
  • Experiment with new workflows and emerging AI capabilities to improve creative quality, production speed and output.
  • Maintain consistency in visual quality, tone and brand presentation across all content.

Video Editing & Production

  • Edit short-form videos for Facebook advertisements and organic social media channels.
  • Produce strong opening hooks, clear product messaging and effective calls to action.
  • Add captions, transitions, music, voiceovers, motion graphics and visual effects where appropriate.
  • Reformat and adapt content for different placements, dimensions and audience segments.
  • Create multiple creative variations for testing, including alternative hooks, visuals, scripts and calls to action.
  • Ensure all final content is technically accurate, polished and ready for publication.

Content Research & Creative Strategy

  • Monitor current AI-content developments, social media formats, advertising trends and creative techniques.
  • Research successful content within relevant retail, ecommerce, personal wellness and lifestyle categories.
  • Identify high-performing creative approaches that can be ethically adapted to the client’ products and audiences.
  • Build and maintain a library of creative references, hooks, concepts and emerging content formats.
  • Contribute fresh campaign and content ideas designed to increase engagement and generate sales.
  • Recommend practical opportunities to use AI to improve creative output and production efficiency.

Advertising & Social Media Content

  • Prioritise creative production for Facebook advertising and social media rather than general website design.
  • Develop content that captures attention quickly and communicates a clear product benefit or campaign message.
  • Work with the business to understand priority products, promotions, customer segments and sales objectives.
  • Review available performance feedback and use it to improve future creative assets.
  • Refresh and iterate advertisements to reduce creative fatigue.
  • Ensure content is suitable for the intended audience, platform and placement.

Brand, Platform & Content Compliance

  • Produce professional content appropriate for an adult lifestyle and personal wellness brand.
  • Develop creative ways to promote products without relying on unnecessarily explicit imagery or language.
  • Apply sound judgement when presenting sensitive or mature products.
  • Understand and follow Meta and other social media platforms’ advertising and community requirements.
  • Adapt concepts and visuals to reduce the risk of advertisement rejection or account restrictions.
  • Check product claims, pricing and promotional information carefully before content is published.
  • Maintain confidentiality when handling campaign plans, customer information and unreleased products.

Tools & Systems

The successful candidate should be confident using a combination of AI and traditional creative tools, which may include:

  • AI video-generation platforms such as Runway, Kling, Veo, Sora or comparable tools
  • AI image-generation and enhancement platforms
  • Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or DaVinci Resolve
  • Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or Canva
  • AI voiceover, audio-generation and captioning tools
  • Meta advertising and social media content platforms
  • Cloud-based file-management and collaboration systems

Candidates are not expected to have used every listed platform. However, they must demonstrate strong capability across relevant tools and the ability to learn emerging platforms quickly.

Requirements

  • At least two years of professional content creation, video editing or digital design experience, supported by strong hands-on capability with current AI creative tools.
  • Demonstrated experience generating video or visual content using AI-powered platforms.
  • A strong portfolio containing relevant video, advertising and AI-generated creative work.
  • Strong understanding of short-form video structure, opening hooks, pacing, storytelling and calls to action.
  • Ability to turn a basic brief or product idea into a complete creative concept.
  • Strong video-editing skills and a high standard of visual presentation.
  • Good written English and the ability to develop concise, engaging on-screen copy.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding that content must support engagement and sales outcomes.
  • Strong research skills and an active interest in new AI tools, creative techniques and social media trends.
  • Ability to manage multiple creative requests, meet deadlines and respond constructively to feedback.
  • Mature and professional attitude toward working with adult lifestyle and personal wellness products.
  • Reliable internet connection and a professional home-office environment.
  • Ability to work with the New Zealand team during agreed business hours.

Highly Desirable

  • Previous experience creating content for ecommerce, consumer product or retail brands.
  • Experience producing and iterating creative assets for Meta advertising campaigns.
  • Knowledge of advertising-platform requirements relating to adult, wellness or other sensitive product categories.
  • Experience with product animation, AI avatars, synthetic voiceovers or advanced motion graphics.
  • Understanding of creative testing, advertising performance and conversion-focused design.
  • Experience developing repeatable AI workflows, prompt libraries or content-production systems.

Benefits

  • What We Offer
    • Competitive, market-rate compensation based in the Philippines.
    • NZ Working Hours (Dayshift)

jobs.description:
Our client is an award-winning Australian finance brokerage specializing in tailored commercial, equipment, and residential lending solutions. Led by seasoned ex-banking professionals, the firm connects clients with optimal financial strategies across a panel of over 60 premier bank and non-bank lenders.

As a Senior Credit Analyst, you will serve as the backbone of the loan processing operation, autonomously running serviceability models, structuring complex deals, and preparing comprehensive application packs. This remote role is pivotal to accelerating deal velocity and maintaining exceptional quality standards across the firm's expanding residential portfolio.

Requirements

  • Financial Profile & Risk Analysis: Evaluate client income, liabilities, credit profiles, and borrowing capacity to assess overall deal feasibility and flag potential risks early in the process.
  • Serviceability Modeling: Perform precise serviceability calculations across multiple major Australian banks and non-bank lenders to identify optimal deal structures and product choices.
  • Deal Structuring & Optimization: Match clients—including first home buyers, PAYG, casual, and self-employed applicants—with appropriate lenders, government schemes (e.g., HGS/FHLDS), and LMI waiver options.
  • Application Preparation & Lodgement: Build complete, submission-ready loan application packs and execute lodgements seamlessly via ApplyOnline or Simpology.
  • Pipeline & CRM Management: Maintain an active pipeline of 10–20 concurrent deals in MyCRM, ensuring meticulous record-keeping, status tracking, and compliance notes (Fact Finds, Needs Analysis, and Credit Justifications).
  • Conditional Approval Management: Track lender conditions actively, gather outstanding documentation, and drive applications through to full approval and settlement.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Draft professional credit narratives and communicate effectively with lenders, conveyancers, real estate agents, and clients to resolve queries and progress files.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience: 4–5 years of direct experience in Australian mortgage broking support, bank credit assessment, or lending operations.
  • Platform Expertise: Proven hands-on experience using MyCRM (mandatory requirement) alongside lodgement platforms such as ApplyOnline or Simpology.
  • Regulatory & Framework Knowledge: Strong operational knowledge of APRA lending guidelines, Household Expenditure Measure (HEM) benchmarks, and Responsible Lending Obligations.
  • Government Schemes & Incentives: Thorough understanding of First Home Owner Grants, LMI waivers, and Australian Government Home Guarantee Schemes.
  • Autonomy & Communication: Excellent written English skills with the demonstrated ability to craft coherent credit notes and work independently in a remote environment.

DESIRED (NOT REQUIRED):

  • Broader Lending Exposure: Prior exposure to commercial finance, equipment loans, or self-employed financial statement analysis.
  • Advanced CRM & Workflow Tools: Experience managing deal automation workflows or custom dashboards within Australian broking software systems.
  • Stakeholder Management: Experience directly coaching or guiding first-time home buyers through the end-to-end loan application journey.

This role reports to the Cybersecurity Manager and will play a critical part in responding to cybersecurity incidents across the enterprise.

  • Serve as a primary responder to security incidents, including the monitoring, triaging, and investigation of security alerts in a timely manner.

jobs.description:
ECP is a market-leading SaaS solution that enables senior living communities to better care for their residents. Used in more than 8,000 communities nationwide, our mission is to build world-class software that improves quality of life for seniors and drives clinical, business, compliance, and operational performance for our customers.

ECP Insights is our customer-facing reporting and analytics product. It gives senior living operators visibility across their portfolio and the reporting they need to run their business, from clinical care to occupancy to billing.

We are looking for a Data Analyst to build it. Some of what you build will be standard reporting that ships to every customer. Some will begin as a request from a single customer. In both cases you will build for reuse, so that work done for one operator can extend to others when it makes sense.

The work is primarily in Databricks, using SQL and Python or PySpark. Some reporting also requires querying our production databases directly.

You will work with customers directly, and the expectation is product discovery rather than intake. Understand the need behind the request, propose a better approach when there is one, and shape what we build instead of only executing what is asked.

Insights is a new product and this role carries real influence over its direction. You will join a small team and report to our VP of Data.

Responsibilities

  • Own client-facing analyses and dashboards end to end, from the initial conversation with the customer through delivery.
  • Run discovery with customers. Understand the underlying need, propose an approach, and define what will be built.
  • Use client input to prioritize what we build next across the reporting roadmap.
  • Design for reuse. Build standard reporting that serves all customers, and build client-specific work so it can extend to others when the need is shared.
  • Write SQL and Python or PySpark against large, multi-tenant datasets in Databricks.
  • Contribute dbt models alongside our data engineering team when the transformation belongs upstream.
  • Explain coverage, limitations, and methodology to customers.
  • Own the accuracy of what ships.
  • Work with product, data engineering, and customer-facing teams to turn recurring requests into product.
  • Handle protected health information in line with HIPAA and our security requirements.

What This Role Requires from You

  • You do discovery well. You find the need behind a request and propose a better approach when there is one.
  • You move quickly and design for reuse at the same time.
  • You get real leverage out of AI tooling and keep pushing on what it can take off your plate.
  • You are comfortable telling a customer that an approach will not work, and explaining why.
  • You ship in increments rather than waiting for a complete solution.
  • You verify your results before a customer sees them.
  • You want a role that is both technical and customer-facing.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree
  • You have independently built and shipped analyses or reporting against large, complex datasets using SQL and Python or PySpark.
  • You already use AI coding tools in your day to day work, for example Claude Code or Cursor. This is how we work and we expect the same here.
  • Strong SQL, including joins, window functions, and query performance on large tables.
  • Working knowledge of Databricks, or strong experience on a comparable platform such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Spark elsewhere.
  • Experience presenting your own work to people who did not build it, ideally external customers.
  • A track record of owning work end to end.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with dbt
  • Building reporting that serves many customers on shared infrastructure, rather than for a single internal audience
  • Experience in healthcare, senior living, or another environment where the data is regulated
  • BI and dashboarding tools

We are looking for a passionate and skilled AI Engineer to build next-generation applications. You will play a key role in developing, deploying, and optimizing state-of-the-art Al models to power intelligent solutions that impact millions of users. This role heavily focuses on generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and integrating sophisticated agentic workflows into production environments.

○ Experience in developing and fine-tuning deep learning models using TensorFlow or PyTorch.

○ Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for deploying ML models.

○ Strong problem-solving abilities and analytical mindset.

○ Excellent communication skills to convey complex ideas effectively.

○ Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

Preferred Qualifications

The incumbent is primarily responsible for determination of valuation risk by providing expert knowledge in assessing, validating, and responding to results of proprietary appraisal review tool(s) and taking action to remediate any valuation risks identified by the tool or discovered independently by the Analyst.   • Lead senior conversations with MGA underwriting and product leaders
  • Partner with forward deployed engineers and the MGA to encode coverages, rating logic, rules, and workflows into an agentic underwriting system
  • Own UAT: readiness criteria, issue triage, rule/form/rate validation, stakeholder sign-off, and training so MGA underwriters can run the product and system with confidence
  • Maintain a relentless bias for execution and measurable Member value in risk selection and launch outcomes

What success looks like

  • Agentic MGA programs launch with underwriting integrity intact so questions, forms, rates, and rules reflect how risk should be selected
  • Member MGAs adopt the new underwriting and risk selection model with confidence,
  • Programs get simpler and sharper over time: rules, rates, and forms improve from implementation, portfolio, and loss experience, not only from process tweaks
  • Each launch raises the bar for the next with clearer appetite, fewer weak rules, faster path from UW judgment to a working agentic system

What you will bring

  • 8 to 12 years of relevant P&C insurance and technology experience
  • A track record leading complex, cross-functional implementation, or transformation programs
  • Credibility with insurance professionals and confidence leading senior client conversations
  • Technical fluency and experience partnering closely with underwriting and engineering teams
  • Exceptional prioritization, structured problem solving, follow-through, and bias for execution
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a willingness to unblock yourself and your team
  • Bachelor’s degree required

Why this role matters

The Agentic MGA Forward Deployed Underwriter will help prove what is possible when insurance expertise, technology, and agentic AI come together. Your work will shape how Accelerant grows, how our Member MGAs operate, and how the insurance industry evolves.

jobs.excerpt: Kline + Company is a global market research and advisory firm with core competencies in the Energy, Chemicals, and Beauty sectors.
jobs.description:
Kline + Company is a global market research and advisory firm with core competencies in the Energy, Chemicals, and Beauty sectors. For more than 65 years, Kline continues to empower clients to make informed decisions that drive business growth with an unparalleled depth of industry expertise, extensive research capabilities and data driven insights.

In a fast-changing and uncertain world, the right insights make the difference between seizing an opportunity and missing it entirely. Kline Energy helps energy and mobility clients across the world win in the market through timely market research and advisory services following an agile, client-first organization.

Kline recognizes the power of knowledge to anticipate change, unlock value and drive growth. As a Senior Analyst, you will combine strong analytical skills and a strategic mindset with real-world perspectives driven by an understanding of client issues and broader marketplace drivers. An Analyst’s primary responsibility will be to analyze global markets, develop competitive and technical information, and build solid analysis and insights for client engagements, using secondary and primary research methods.

Job Description:

As an integral part of the global project team within Kline’s Energy Practice, the Senior Analyst will be expected to utilize the best-suited tools to research key markets and develop strategic recommendations for global clients, including:

  • Demonstrating strong experience in conducting comprehensive secondary (public and paid databases) and primary research on various industries, macro developments, and regions
  • Developing and analyzing data: Expert knowledge of Microsoft Office Professional Suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint, is essential
  • Preparing written reports or presentations
  • Summarizing project information for clear presentation of results and conclusions to clients
  • Engaging with clients and delivering presentations
  • Maintaining a fundamental working knowledge of the basic Kline databases and reports
  • Working constructively with other team members and the project supervisor to meet project goals

Senior Analysts must also have the skills necessary to effectively and efficiently search and analyze secondary sources, such as:

● Business databases

● Engineering/Technical databases

  • Government agency records, including environmental, labor, tax sources
  • Trade and industry media, and industry reports
  • Other industry/public information sources

Job Requirements:

In addition, at least 4+ years of pertinent industry experience in consulting, market research and/or competitive intelligence, or strategic marketing, with excellent analytical, communication, and presentation skills, is essential. Candidates should have strong quantitative, analytical, and conceptual problem-solving skills, combined with outstanding business acumen.

This position is currently home-office/remote-based. Kline + Company offers a competitive compensation and benefits package in a supportive work environment.

jobs.title: QA Engineer: AI-Assisted Testing
jobs.excerpt: Join ECFX, a company transforming how the legal industry works through technology.
jobs.description:
Join ECFX, a company transforming how the legal industry works through technology. Every day our platform pulls court notices and legal documents from hundreds of court portals and e-filing systems, categorizes them with AI, and delivers them into our customers' document and case management systems. When something is late, dropped, or misfiled, a law firm can miss a deadline.

We're looking for a hands-on QA Engineer who loves finding what others miss, and who uses AI to do it faster and deeper. Our engineers build with AI coding agents, so changes arrive quickly and in volume. You'll be the person who works out what could break and tests it thoroughly by hand, using AI as your co-pilot for test design, test data, investigation, and reporting. This is a testing role first. If you also enjoy building automation, there's room to use AI to create targeted automated checks where they pay off. You will have a real say in how we build, test, and ship software.

What You'll Engage In

  • Test Smarter with AI: Use AI tools (such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, or ChatGPT) to read tickets, merge requests, and code diffs; map out risks and edge cases; draft test charters and checklists; and decide where to focus. You bring the judgment about what matters.
  • Explore and Uncover: Run risk-based exploratory, functional, and regression testing across our Vue dashboard, admin tools, email notifications, and integrations. Find defects before customers do.
  • Validate What Matters Most: Make sure documents are retrieved, parsed, categorized, stored, and delivered correctly across many external sources: court portals, 2FA/OTP logins, and integrations such as Clio, Filevine, iManage, and NetDocuments. Hunt for silent failures, where a document is dropped but the run reports success.
  • Test Below the UI: Much of our work has no screen to click. Verify backend and platform changes by hand, using API calls, SQL queries, logs, and dashboards (Grafana/Loki, Sentry), with AI helping you write the queries and make sense of the output.
  • Build Realistic Test Scenarios: Use AI to generate test data, sample court notice emails, and edge-case documents, and drive our simulators and test environments to reproduce hard-to-reach situations.
  • Test Our AI Features: Evaluate our AI document categorization and our LLM-facing tools (an MCP server used by AI assistants). Build sample sets, check accuracy and consistency, try to break them with unusual or hostile inputs, and flag when a model or prompt change makes results worse.
  • Guard Security and Access: Check logins (password, SAML SSO, OAuth), user roles and permissions, and that one firm can never see another firm's data. Verify security fixes without breaking what already works.
  • Reproduce and Triage: Investigate customer-reported and production issues, reproduce them reliably, and write bug reports clear enough that an engineer, or an AI agent, can act on them right away.
  • Automate Where It Pays Off (Optional): If automation is in your toolkit, use AI to create focused automated checks, such as Playwright scripts or API checks, for high-risk flows you find yourself retesting.
  • Agile Collaboration: Work with engineers and product managers in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. Help write testable acceptance criteria and raise quality risks early

What You're Likely to Bring

Professional Experience: 3 to 7 years in software quality assurance for web or SaaS applications, with deep experience in exploratory and manual testing of complex, data-heavy systems.

AI Fluency

  • ·You use AI assistants in your testing every day and can give concrete examples: generating test ideas and edge cases, building test data, writing SQL or log queries, summarizing logs or diffs, reproducing bugs, and drafting clear reports.
  • Skill at prompting and giving context, such as feeding in the ticket, the diff, and the acceptance criteria to get useful output instead of generic answers.
  • Healthy skepticism. You verify what AI tells you, recognize when it is confidently wrong, and never let it replace your own judgment about risk.
  • An understanding of how to test systems that don't always give the same answer, such as AI features, by using repeated trials, sample sets, and "is this answer right?" checks rather than exact matches.
  • Careful handling of data. You use synthetic or masked data with AI tools and never paste customer or court data into unapproved services.

Technical Proficiency

· Comfort with the command line, Git, and reading logs. Some experience with Docker or Kubernetes (such as port-forwarding or checking pod logs) is a plus.

· Experience with defect tracking and test management in Jira.

How You Work

  • Analytical Mindset: Sharp attention to detail, curiosity, and a methodical approach to breaking software and finding root causes.
  • Communication Excellence: Strong written and verbal communication for bug reports, test notes, and status updates. Your reports are precise enough that another person, or an AI agent, can pick them up and act.
  • Ownership: When something seems "untestable," you find a way, whether that's a query, a log search, a simulator, or a question to the right engineer, rather than skipping it.

Requirements

  • Experience writing or maintaining automated tests (for example Playwright, Selenium, or API test scripts), including building them with AI and reviewing and fixing what it produces.
  • Experience testing AI or LLM features, such as checking classification accuracy, spotting hallucinations, or testing for prompt injection.
  • SQL skills for checking data in PostgreSQL.
  • Experience testing APIs directly with tools like Postman, curl, or Bruno, and an understanding of HTTP, REST, and JSON.
  • Experience with web security testing, including authentication and sessions, roles and permissions, OAuth2/SAML, CSRF, and XSS.
  • Experience using AI browser tools (for example Playwright MCP or browser agents) to speed up exploratory testing.
  • Experience testing integrations with third-party systems, email-driven workflows, or browser automation against external sites.
  • Experience with accessibility testing (WCAG 2.2 AA).
  • Knowledge of the legal domain, especially court e-filing, docketing, or legal document management.
  • ISTQB or a similar QA certification.
  • An understanding of or experience with the Lean Startup approach.

Why QA Engineers Like It Here

  • Modern Tooling: Company-provided AI tools, with clear guidelines for using them safely.
  • Real Impact: You'll shape how we test in an AI-assisted team, not follow a fixed script.
  • AI in Production: Hands-on work testing real AI features used by law firms every day.

Benefits

  • Remote Flexibility: A fully remote role open to every US time zone, Hawaii included.
  • Work-Life Harmony: Flexible working hours and a supportive approach to getting work done.
  • Comprehensive Coverage: A range of insurance options covering health, dental, vision, and life.
  • Discretionary Time Off: We know a healthy work-life balance matters. Our discretionary time off (DTO) policy means that, on top of scheduled vacations and holidays, employees can take unplanned time off when needed, with supervisor approval. Life happens, and we trust our team to manage their time well.
  • Employee Stock Options: The opportunity to participate in the company stock option plan.

JOB OVERVIEW

Early Clinical Development is a core, complex focus at IQVIA, requiring deep expertise and integrated data-driven strategies. The Therapeutic Strategy Leader (TSL) serves as the scientific and strategic lead responsible for designing differentiated development strategies for sponsors from First-in-Human (FIH), dose-finding, biomarker development, through Phase IIa studies. The role combines therapeutic expertise, clinical development knowledge, operational strategy, and business development support.

The ideal candidate is an experienced, consultative leader responsible for driving early engagement and proposals aligned with client needs in collaboration with the business development and other stakeholders. TSL will serve as a therapeutic and operational strategy expert throughout the new business and program/project delivery lifecycle to increase IQVIAs therapeutic market share with early engagement and innovative strategic responses to proposals.

This pivotal role represents and demonstrates IQVIA’s credibility with clients, furthering the R&DS business by designing market-leading solutions to secure new projects. Drawing on dedicated proposal development, technical and scientific support, the TSL will be expected to lead cross-functional teams in designing such solutions and ensuring projects are set up to be successful from proposal development through to award. The TSL will take ownership of high-level client relationships for the specified engagements in close collaboration with the sales and account team, with ultimate responsibility for securing business, client satisfaction, project margin, and differentiating IQVIA.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Business Growth and Client Engagement:


  • Leverage IQVIA medical, scientific, operational and data science experts to determine the optimal solution, project design and lead a cross-functional team in proposal development through to award.
  • Assigned to take ownership of developing client-centric solutions, designing both strategic and methodological approaches to ensure that IQVIA secures client projects.
  • Champion and advocate the IQVIA Connected Intelligence solutions and include existing and new innovative solutions as applicable and appropriate through the sales process. This may include, but is not limited to, stand-alone programs and projects, requests for information (RFI), capabilities, and early engagement.

Strategy Development:


  • As a leader of the pre-award strategy team, TSL is accountable and responsible for creation of innovative, effective, and compelling therapeutic and operational strategies that client differentiates IQVIA from its competitors.
  • Work with key internal stakeholders and pre/post-award teams to analyze information and data that enables development of efficient and feasible delivery solutions. This may include, but is not limited to, protocol feasibility and risk management, assessment and management of the competitive landscape, optimal country and site distributions, site and patient recruitment strategies, monitoring and vendor strategies.
  • Actively support Sales in the preparation and conduct of client and bid defense meetings e.g. training and preparation of the assigned project team; provide specific content; ensure presentation focus and content effectively conveys project strategy and critical win themes. Attend and present at client meetings, or bid defense meetings, as required, (based on the strategy for selling the opportunity).
  • Recommend site, country, and patient recruitment strategies appropriate for early-phase studies.
  • Leverage ECD networks, Phase I units, specialist investigators, and therapeutic expertise to improve execution.

Strategy Translation and Post Award Support


  • Translate the sold strategy to the delivery team and be an available resource for the delivery team when changes to strategy are required.
  • Provide post award strategy guidance and support to delivery teams if in-flight studies require changes to strategy

REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES


  • Remain up to date with knowledge and information that supports effectiveness as a Therapeutic Strategy Lead e.g. understanding IQVIA’ services, tools and product offerings, status and trends in early clinical development, innovations and advances in clinical trial methodology, and business intelligence.
  • Broad protocol and therapeutic knowledge.
  • Comprehensive global knowledge, awareness, and practical understanding of the biopharma industry, drug development lifecycle and operational clinical trial delivery.
  • Robust and current knowledge of scientific, clinical, regulatory, commercial and competitive landscape in applicable therapeutic areas.
  • Strong leadership skills, critical thinking, ability to work with minimal supervision, and lead a virtual team in a matrix organization.
  • Flexible and able to work in situations where specifications may or may not be well defined and willing to support work in other therapeutic areas when required.
  • Confident and capable in the use of technology, applications, and other media e.g. databases and internet to research new opportunities, maintain currency of therapeutic and operational knowledge, and competitive landscape.

MINIMUM REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE


  • Bachelor's Degree in life sciences, advanced degree preferred, with extensive knowledge of Internal Medicine diseases.
  • 10 years and above global clinical research experience, including hands on Phase I operational delivery and/or drug development experience.
  • Proven track record in operational delivery and/or drug development; or equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
  • Must have extensive experience with Clinical Operations and Clinical Project Management.
  • Experience in early clinical development is required, including—but not limited to—areas such first-in-human, dose-finding, healthy-volunteers and in patient Phase I studies.

jobs.excerpt: Success requires deep knowledge of our systems and processes today, along with strong experience across the full-stack Microsoft development ecosystem, healthcare EDI, SQL Server, APIs, and distributed application design.
jobs.description:
Success requires deep knowledge of our systems and processes today, along with strong experience across the full-stack Microsoft development ecosystem, healthcare EDI, SQL Server, APIs, and distributed application design. But just as important is the ability to look beyond what’s already built and help design the systems and processes of tomorrow. You’ll be a voice that explains complex technical choices clearly, an architect who raises the bar for our systems, and a mentor who helps our engineering team do the same.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, integrate, and support end-to-end healthcare applications across intuitive, accessible user interfaces, APIs, business services, integrations, and SQL Server data layers using C#, .NET Framework/.NET, ASP.NET, Web API, and modern front-end technologies.
  • Build and evolve secure, reliable, and scalable APIs and microservices that support healthcare operations, data exchange, and system interoperability.
  • Design, optimize, and support SQL Server databases, data models, queries, and stored procedures to improve performance, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Develop and maintain integrations for healthcare EDI and X12 transactions, including 275, 278, 834, 837, 835, 999, and TA1, using standards such as REST/JSON and SOAP/XML where appropriate.
  • Analyze legacy applications, workflows, database structures, and integrations to uncover business logic, document the current state, and determine what should be modernized, refactored, or replaced.
  • Work directly with stakeholders to translate business requirements, operational rules, and system dependencies into practical technical designs, architectural decisions, and well-defined development plans.
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines and deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot applications across Azure and hybrid environments to make builds, testing, deployments, and production support faster and more reliable.
  • Improve solution quality through code reviews, automated testing, performance tuning, secure coding, technical documentation, and effective defect resolution.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to improve developer productivity, code quality, and delivery velocity.
  • Mentor other developers, contribute to architecture and technology-roadmap decisions, and help establish pragmatic.
  • Partner with product, QA, and business teams throughout delivery to align technical decisions, priorities, and expectations with business outcomes.

Why this Role Matters:

Healthcare platforms carry years of operational knowledge, client requirements, and regulatory obligations. Modernizing them well means preserving the business logic that still matters while simplifying what no longer serves the organization. This role helps turn that understanding into secure, reliable, and maintainable applications, user experiences, services, integrations, and data solutions.

When this work is done well, our teams can deliver capabilities faster, integrations and operations become more reliable, and the systems supporting specialty care become more secure, resilient, and adaptable. That gives Emboss Specialty a stronger technology foundation while improving the experience of the members, providers, clients, and internal teams who depend on it every day. Together, those outcomes help make specialty healthcare work better for everyone.

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of professional experience in application development, including senior-level ownership of complex healthcare solutions.
  • Deep proficiency across the Microsoft development stack, including C#, .NET Framework/.NET, ASP.NET, Web API or MVC, Visual Studio, and SQL Server.
  • Strong experience designing RESTful services, APIs, microservices, and distributed architectures, with a solid understanding of security, resiliency, scalability, and asynchronous processing.
  • Proven ability to design, deploy, and support applications and services across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud architectures, including secure integration, configuration, monitoring, resiliency, and production troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on healthcare EDI experience, including X12 transaction processing, with depth in transactions such as 275, 278, 834, 837, 835, 999, and TA1.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing and reverse-engineering legacy applications, extracting embedded business logic, and turning that understanding into practical modernization strategies.
  • Strong SQL Server skills, including T-SQL, data and schema design, stored procedures, query optimization, and performance tuning.
  • A track record of collaborating across technical and nontechnical teams, explaining architectural decisions clearly, mentoring developers, and leading complex work with a high degree of autonomy.
  • Additional experience that may add value includes modern front-end and UI development; payer or health-plan solutions; workflow automation; business-rules engines; FHIR-based APIs; ETL and data mapping; authentication and authorization models; and HIPAA considerations.

The Language You'll Speak:

You will not need to know every platform or transaction on day one, but you should be comfortable learning and working across new technical and healthcare.

  • Microsoft development: C#, .NET Framework/.NET, ASP.NET, Web API, MVC, Visual Studio, SQL Server, T-SQL, Azure DevOps, and Git.
  • Architecture and integration: REST/JSON, SOAP/XML, APIs, microservices, distributed systems, CI/CD, application resiliency, authentication, authorization, and secure coding.
  • Healthcare interoperability: EDI, X12, 275, 278, 834, 837, 835, 999, TA1, FHIR, HIPAA, CMS guidelines, and health-plan specifications.
  • User-interface development: JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS, responsive design, accessibility, component-based development, and common browser and web-application patterns.
  • Legacy modernization: reverse engineering, current-state documentation, business-rule discovery, refactoring, performance tuning, data mapping, and cloud design.

Your Success Metrics:

Success in this role will be measured by the answers to a few practical questions:

  • Are the applications and services you own becoming more reliable, secure, performant, and maintainable?
  • Are we modernizing legacy systems in a way that preserves critical business logic while reducing complexity and technical risk?
  • Are our APIs, microservices, databases, and healthcare integrations easier to understand, test, deploy, monitor, and support?
  • Are software changes moving through development, review, testing, and deployment with greater consistency and fewer avoidable defects?
  • Are engineering standards, technical documentation, and architectural decisions becoming clearer and more useful to the broader team?
  • Are other developers becoming more effective because of the guidance, reviews, and examples this role provides?
  • Are business, product, QA, and engineering teams more aligned because technical tradeoffs and delivery expectations are communicated clearly?

Location:

  • Position is remote and the location of candidate is flexible within the U.S.

  • Lead the technical design, delivery and long-term evolution of storefronts, APIs, microservices and integrations on Adobe Commerce, Shopify, Next.js, Contentful and PIM systems.

  • Write production code, mostly on the hardest parts, and review the code of others.

  • Set and keep standards for testing, code review and CI/CD in GitHub Actions, Jenkins and Azure DevOps.

  • Own API design (REST, GraphQL or gRPC), data flow and state management between frontends, backend services and third-party systems such as ERP, payments and order management.

  • Join client meetings to explain trade-offs, run technical workshops and help with estimates.

  • Keep an eye on technical debt, upgrades and code we inherit from other vendors, look for ways to make our delivery smoother, and try new tools, including cloud services and AI assistants, where they help the team.

  • Work closely with product managers, UX/UI designers, DevOps and solution architects to agree on what is feasible, set clear milestones and keep the scope realistic.

What we look for
Core technical expertise:

  • 7+ years of fullstack web development, including 2+ years leading engineers or technical delivery.

  • Delivered production commerce or content platforms for clients, including at least one platform migration, upgrade or takeover of existing code.

  • Advanced JavaScript/TypeScript with React and Next.js. Vue is a plus.

  • Strong backend experience in PHP and/or Node.js, .NET or Python. PHP is a must if you will lead Adobe Commerce work.

  • Hands-on work with at least two of Adobe Commerce, Shopify, Contentful or a PIM.

  • Solid SQL (MySQL/MariaDB or PostgreSQL) with good data modelling and query tuning, plus Redis and a search engine such as OpenSearch or Algolia.

  • Experience building APIs (REST or GraphQL) and connecting systems such as ERP, payments and order management.

  • Docker and Kubernetes, in the cloud or on-premises; CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, Jenkins or Azure DevOps; working experience with at least one of AWS, GCP or Azure.

  • Automated testing across the stack (for example Jest, Playwright, Cypress or PHPUnit).

  • A good grasp of distributed systems: microservices, message and event patterns, caching, authentication and authorization, and how an API changes over its lifetime.

Leadership and delivery

  • A record of mentoring engineers, running code reviews and helping a team agree on technical decisions.

  • Practical judgment: you balance clean architecture with deadlines, scope and maintainability, and you explain the trade-offs clearly to clients and to colleagues who are not engineers.

Nice to have

  • Adobe Commerce certification, or Shopify Plus or Hydrogen experience.

  • Headless or composable commerce setups, including Hyvä and commercetools.

  • Terraform, Helm, and monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Application Insights or OpenTelemetry.

  • Experience with estimates, RFPs and client workshops.

  • Everyday use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor, with clear rules for reviewing generated code and handling client data.

  • AI in the delivery process: pull request summaries, test generation and incident triage, always with a person approving.

  • Building AI features for stores, such as search, product data enrichment in a PIM, or draft content in Contentful.

What we value

  • Clean architecture, good performance and software that stays reliable.

  • Practical decisions that balance the ideal design with client timelines and business goals.

  • Curiosity about new commerce and frontend technologies.

How we work

  • Fully remote within Latin America.

  • Collaborative, multicultural teams across time zones.

  • A culture of ownership, open communication and continuous professional growth.

CallRevu is the leading communication intelligence platform built for automotive retail- empowering dealerships to take control of every conversation, from the first ring to the final result.

Founded in a dealership in 2008, CallRevu was created by the industry, for the industry. We deliver the tools dealerships need to drive revenue, improve operations, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

Why This Role

This is a senior individual contributor seat on the team that builds and operates the telephony services powering CallRevu’s hosted phone system and conversational intelligence platform. This is critical, high-throughput infrastructure: when it’s healthy, customers never think about it; when it isn’t, every customer feels it immediately.

We are looking for a senior Python backend engineer with deep telephony experience who is comfortable operating across the SIP stack, Kamailio routing, and Linux production systems. This person will help maintain and modernize our voice stack, improve reliability, and make sound build-vs-buy decisions while owning a critical platform end to end.

Essential Functions

Core Voice Platform Responsibilities (Kamailio SBC + Python call routing)

  • Operate, maintain, and enhance the Kamailio-based SBC.
  • Contribute to the development and operation of the Python/Asterisk call-routing layer that drives call flow, recording, and transcription.
  • Play a key role in complex telephony initiatives across both layers, from design through production, with minimal oversight.
  • Make safe changes to call-flow logic across routing modes and application modules.

Python Backend Engineering

  • Build and maintain high-concurrency Python services and worker processes.
  • Build and harden API integrations across mixed protocols, including REST, and vendor SDKs
  • Integrate with Asterisk via AMI and AGI for call control and event handling.

Signaling, Media, and Voice Quality

  • Diagnose and resolve SIP signaling issues involving registration, routing, NAT, and carrier or endpoint interoperability.
  • Troubleshoot RTP/SRTP, codec negotiation, DTMF, jitter, packet loss, and one-way audio issues.
  • Use tools such as sngrep, Wireshark, tcpdump, and Homer/sipcapture to root-cause incidents quickly.
  • Improve real-time transcription and audio-streaming pipelines.
  • Monitor and improve call-quality metrics such as MOS, ASR, ACD, and PDD.

Reliability, Security, and Operations

  • Operate Linux production systems with confidence
  • Build security hygiene into feature delivery
  • Design for high availability and graceful degradation
  • Participate in a L3 on-call rotation

Modernization and Technical Strategy

A key part of this role is helping modernize the voice stack:

  • Assess what is working, what is fragile, what is expensive to operate, and what is slowing the roadmap.
  • Create a clear plan for refactoring, migration to newer technologies, and practical build-vs-buy decisions.
  • Modernize legacy Python patterns without downtime.

Technical Leadership and Collaboration

  • Maintain a high standard for the telephony codebase through code reviews, design discussions, and the quality of the work delivered.
  • Partner with product, support, and hosted phones teams on capacity planning, customer escalations, and roadmap trade-offs.
  • Communicate technical risk, status, and decisions clearly to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience also qualifies.
  • 6+ years of production Python backend experience, including long-running services and worker processes.
  • Hands-on Asterisk experience with AMI/AGI, dial plans, call origination, and SIP troubleshooting.
  • Production Kamailio experience with routing logic, registrar/proxy behavior, and SBC operations.
  • Deep SIP knowledge, including registration, dialog state, routing, NAT traversal, and transports.
  • Linux production operations experience, including service management, logs, and safe rollout/rollback.
  • Track record operating critical voice or real-time systems in production, including on-call support.

Preferred

  • Experience with NetSapiens or similar hosted phone systems.
  • .NET / C# experience, particularly where voice services interface with the broader CallRevu platform.

Mindset and Operating Style

  • Treats telephony infrastructure with the seriousness it deserves, with a bias toward stability, observability, and reversible change.
  • Calm under fire during voice incidents; structured in root-cause analysis and unwilling to leave the problem half-solved.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; can explain a tricky SIP or queue issue to a non-telephony engineer or to a support lead without losing them.

UI

Application support

AI & Data Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a polyglot engineer who is comfortable across the data stack. This is someone who can build AI-powered tools and data infrastructure that make our platform smarter, our people more effective, and our operations more scalable.

This is not a research role. You'll build real systems that people use every day — Slack bots that investigate production incidents, data pipelines that surface anomalies before clients notice them, and AI agents that turn hours of manual trawling into seconds of guided investigation. You'll work across the full stack: Python and TypeScript for AI tooling and integrations, Go for backend services, and SQL for data analysis and pipeline work.

The person we're looking for ships working software, cares about making people's lives easier, and is energised by the pace of the AI landscape. You don't need to have built LLM applications before — but you should be curious, practical, and comfortable learning fast.

You'll work closely with our TechOps, Connectivity, and Data teams to understand their workflows, pain points, and knowledge gaps — then build the tools and infrastructure that solve them. This is a high-leverage role: the systems you build will multiply the effectiveness of every engineer and operator in the company.

What You'll Work On

  • AI-powered investigation tools — Slack-based bots and agents that automatically analyse support tickets, query production logs, and surface relevant context for incident response

  • MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers — authenticated access to ClickHouse, Kubernetes, Atlassian, and GitHub, enabling AI agents to interact with real systems safely

  • Data infrastructure — ClickHouse analytics pipelines, real-time anomaly detection, and platform health monitoring (our "Radar" initiative)

  • AI agent development — constrained, repeatable diagnosis agents that follow investigation playbooks, produce structured outputs, and operate with appropriate guardrails

  • Knowledge engineering — building and curating the corpus that makes our AI tools accurate: documentation, training material, structured metadata, and feedback loops

  • Internal tooling — full-stack applications that bridge the gap between data, AI, and the people who need answers

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong Python — your primary language for AI tooling, data pipelines, and backend services

  • Systems design – you have extensive experience building data-intensive systems. You can consider tradeoffs and manage system complexity

  • TypeScript / JavaScript — for Slack integrations, web interfaces, and full-stack tooling

  • Go experience is a bonus — we use Go extensively for backend services and CLI tooling

  • SQL — comfortable writing analytical queries against large datasets (ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, or similar)

  • Familiarity with LLM APIs and tooling — Claude, OpenAI, or similar; prompt engineering, function calling, tool use

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS — your tools will run in production infrastructure

  • Git and Linux fundamentals

  • Experience in financial services is a plus but not essential — domain knowledge can be learned; engineering instinct cannot

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate quickly, you get things in front of users, you improve based on feedback

  • You bridge domains. You're comfortable moving between AI, data, infrastructure, and product. You don't wait for someone else to define the interface — you go and understand the problem yourself

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You monitor it, you fix it, you make it better

  • You write things down. Documentation is how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. Good documentation also makes our AI tools better — every well-written page becomes training material

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication is essential

  • You embrace AI as a tool. You use AI to amplify your own productivity — and you build tools that do the same for others

What You Get

  • Growth — this role sits at the intersection of AI, data, and platform engineering. As the company scales, so does the opportunity. This is a new pod with an exciting remit

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Greenfield AI work — you're not maintaining legacy systems; you're building the next generation of intelligent tooling for a trading platform

  • Real impact — the tools you build will be used daily by engineers, operators, and eventually clients. This is not a side project

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our people

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition

Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Technical Interview with a member of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session. ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Leadership Conversation with our CTO

Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

About Abridge

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

The Role

Help secure the systems bringing AI into healthcare. We're looking for a Senior Infrastructure Security Engineer who wants to build, move quickly, and deliver improvements across engineering at Abridge.

You'll own security for a product area or engineering function, working directly with the engineers building Abridge's ML systems, data platforms, and product features. You'll help shape designs and build solutions that protect patient data in production. Your work could help launch a new capability securely, strengthen how teams access data, or give engineers across the company better security tools.

You'll thrive here if you take initiative, enjoy learning unfamiliar systems, and turn open-ended problems into shipped improvements.

What You’ll Do

  • Own security for an engineering domain: Become the security owner for a product area or engineering function. Develop an understanding of its systems, data flows, and risks. Work with engineering partners to set priorities and deliver improvements.

  • Build security into infrastructure: Implement cloud access controls, reusable infrastructure modules, and automated checks that make secure choices easier.

  • Help launch secure product features: Partner with engineers during design and implementation. Identify risks early, propose practical solutions, and help carry them through release.

  • Secure ML and data workflows: Work with ML and data engineers to protect how sensitive data moves through pipelines, services, and storage systems.

  • Turn recurring problems into tools: Write and maintain software that reduces manual security work and helps engineering teams resolve issues faster.

  • Deliver and improve: Break larger projects into useful releases, verify results in production, and follow through on adoption and operational needs.

What You’ll Bring

  • Production engineering experience: You've built or operated cloud infrastructure, services, or data systems. You understand identity, networking, and the operational effects of your changes.

  • Strong coding skills: You can write, test, debug, and maintain software in a general-purpose language. Python experience is helpful.

  • Infrastructure as code experience: You've used Terraform or similar tools to implement and review production changes.

  • Ownership and independence: You've taken projects from an unclear problem to a working solution. You seek context, make decisions, raise blockers, and follow through.

  • Practical security judgment: You can reason about access boundaries and data flows, assess risks, and choose controls that support reliable product delivery.

  • Effective engineering partnerships: You enjoy working directly with engineers, learning how their systems work, and finding solutions they can adopt.

  • Enthusiasm for execution: You look for opportunities to make progress, keep scope manageable, and ship improvements while developing longer-term solutions.

We welcome candidates from infrastructure security, platform engineering, SRE, and software engineering backgrounds who can demonstrate relevant security work.

Bonus Points If…

  • You have worked on ML infrastructure, data platforms, or data-intensive products.

  • You have experience with cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS, container orchestration such as Kubernetes, or CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions.

  • You have experience with cloud IAM, secrets management, or software supply chain security.

  • You have built internal tools or reusable controls used by multiple engineering teams.

  • You have protected sensitive data in healthcare or another regulated environment.

This is a hybrid role that requires working from our San Francisco or New York City office at least three days per week.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.
