jobs.description:
Who We Are

Imprint is on a mission to make every customer a regular.

You know how it feels when you walk into your favorite coffee shop and they know your name and start prepping your usual? Imprint makes it possible for the largest brands to create that experience at scale.

We bring payments, loyalty, and customer intelligence together in one platform, so brands can recognize and reward customers as individuals and keep them coming back. With the power of our technology and data, brands create financial products that their customers’ use everyday, earning more of their spend and increasing loyalty. Customers are rewarded with money and time saved, and surprised and delighted with a more unique, tailored experience.

We first proved our business in co-brand credit cards. For decades, the same few banks dominated the industry, building brands’ programs on mainframes older than the internet. We took a different approach, rebuilding the technology from the ground up. Today, Imprint has more than two million members, with partners like Shell, Kroger, H-E-B, and representing half a trillion dollars in total US consumer spend. Now, we’re growing our partnerships, bringing on more members, and expanding beyond credit cards so that brands offer more ways to pay and be rewarded to recognize their customers as individuals no matter their income or preferences.

Better yet, we’re doing it differently with a lean team of the most talented people on earth. Historically, companies scaled by adding people. Imprint is taking on our opportunity with a small team of exceptional people, with the best AI and technology dramatically amplifying what each person can accomplish. That means you’ll learn faster here than you could anywhere else. You’ll be one of the few people building an entirely new technology with the ownership and trust to shape what Imprint becomes. You’ll work alongside people who make you sharper everyday, armed with tools that turn your best ideas into reality faster than you thought possible. This is a rare chance to do the most important work of your career and to help prove that a small team can build what’s never been done before, inside industries that haven’t changed in decades.

Role Summary

As a Treasury Analytics Manager, you will own the build-out and automation of Imprint's treasury modeling capabilities. This is a high-impact individual contributor role at the intersection of financial modeling, data engineering, and balance sheet strategy.

You will serve as the core analytical engine for Treasury: migrating manual models into scalable, automated infrastructure, building new analytical capabilities from the ground up, and partnering closely with Capital Markets, FP&A, and Accounting to support Imprint's liquidity and funding strategy.

This role requires someone who thrives with autonomy, moves fast, and can translate complex analytical work into clear, actionable insight for cross-functional stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • Migrated the daily cash flow model from Excel to Python and GitHub, with automated refresh replacing manual updates

  • Automated the monthly cash sources and uses analysis via GitHub

  • Delivered version 1 of an interest rate sensitivity model — the foundational layer for managing balance sheet interest rate risk

  • Established strong working relationships with Capital Markets, FP&A, and Accounting counterparts

  • Demonstrated the ability to operate with significant autonomy and communicate complex modeling work clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Responsibilities

  • Own the migration of existing treasury models from Excel into Python and GitHub, enabling automated reporting and reduced manual refresh cycles

  • Build new treasury models from the ground up, starting with an interest rate sensitivity model

  • Maintain and continuously improve Imprint's daily cash flow model and cash sources and uses analysis

  • Partner with Capital Markets on liquidity and funding planning models

  • Collaborate with FP&A on feedback loops between the corporate model and treasury cash flow and interest rate sensitivity models

  • Coordinate with Accounting on money movement and cash reconciliation, with a view toward migrating operational workflows into Treasury over time

  • Communicate analytical findings and model outputs clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders

  • Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency and rigor of treasury reporting and modeling infrastructure

Qualifications

Required

  • Demonstrated experience building and automating financial models in Python and GitHub

  • Strong Excel proficiency

  • Background in treasury, liquidity, or funding analytics within consumer credit or fintech (e.g., credit card, unsecured consumer, installment loans, student loans)

  • Proven ability to operate with autonomy and manage multiple modeling workstreams without close supervision

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with capital markets, FP&A, or accounting teams

  • Ability to communicate complex analytical work clearly to non-technical audiences

Nice to Have

  • Capital markets background, particularly in liquidity and funding for consumer credit

  • Familiarity with Bloomberg or similar market data platforms

  • Experience at a fintech, consumer credit company, or financial institution with meaningful modeling ownership (not just reporting support)

  • Track record of building scalable financial infrastructure in a small or high-growth team environment

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation and equity

  • Medical plan options fully paid by Imprint, including coverage for your dependents

  • 100% company-paid dental and vision plan options

  • Mental health support through Spring Health, plus a confidential Employee Assistance Program

  • Healthcare navigation through Rightway, plus HSA, FSA and commuter benefits

  • Flexible paid time off

  • 20 weeks of paid parental leave for primary caregivers and 8 weeks for all new parents

  • The latest tools and technology, including AI, so you can do your best work

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About the Role Join a data and infrastructure team building a platform that turns information from multiple sources into reliable company intelligence.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Join a data and infrastructure team building a platform that turns information from multiple sources into reliable company intelligence. You will own the platform from architecture and ingestion through production operations, enabling trusted data for downstream products.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build a multi-source platform for concurrent ingestion, event-driven processing, and orchestrated batch workflows.

  • Ingest data from provider APIs, webhooks, files, and web scraping with rate limiting and robust failure handling.

  • Orchestrate scheduled workflows and historical backfills using tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect.

  • Build messaging and task queue systems with retries, dead-letter queues, and controlled replay.

  • Store original payloads in cloud storage and transform data with dbt into raw, standardized, and curated layers.

  • Implement idempotent upserts, data contracts, automated validation, pipeline tests, and monitoring for freshness and failures.

  • Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas and loading patterns, and integrate data enrichment and structured extraction.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 5 years building and operating production data platforms, with ownership from architecture through deployment and ongoing operation.

  • Production experience with workflow orchestration, including dependencies, retries, and recovery. Airflow is preferred; Dagster, Prefect, Temporal, or comparable tools are relevant.

  • Hands-on production experience with dbt and Google Cloud Platform.

  • Strong Python skills, including asynchronous HTTP and concurrent processing with asyncio, aiohttp, or HTTPX.

  • Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including data modeling, query optimization, and incremental loading.

  • Experience with event-driven systems, messaging or task queues, asynchronous processing, and failure recovery.

  • Experience building data contracts, raw and curated storage with retention policies, automated testing, and operational monitoring.

  • Experience building ingestion pipelines from multiple sources. Web scraping, entity resolution, LLM-based extraction, and early-stage team experience are helpful.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $100,000 to $140,000 annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Fully remote in Iceland.

Compensation Range: $100K - $140K

jobs.excerpt: About us Jerry. ai is a profitable, Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding.
jobs.description:
About us

Jerry.ai is a profitable, Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. We’re building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with the car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat) and accelerating our growth.

About the team

The Business Operations & Analytics team is the strategic and analytical horsepower behind our relentless growth in a highly competitive market and despite headwinds. They’re primarily ex-BCG, McKinsey, and Bain consultants. Every product vertical or critical initiative has a Business Operations & Analytics team member embedded — they own data analysis, insights & strategy, and drive our teams towards our next goal: reach 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

In 2026, we launched 5 new products — home insurance, property tax, motorcycle insurance, car repair shop bids, and roadside assistance. We’re adding 1-2 BizOps and Analytics team members to drive impact in one of these key areas:

  • Growth — paid and organic marketing, market expansion, supply and distribution partnerships

  • Product — building 0-1 products, scaling existing products

Note: Our priority is finding the right people, we are flexible on job leveling/title.

About the role

You'll be embedded in a product team or a business unit that sits across products, and own the following:

  • Strategy: Define what business questions we should answer. Develop a hypothesis and next steps, prioritize, and create solutions with cross-functional partners.

  • Data and insights: Define metrics, build reports, run analyses, design experiments, and surface data insights that move your team's key metrics.

  • Build: Scope, validate and pursue new levers to accelerate our business. This could be building new products, testing new growth channels, launching new partnerships, or finding new ways to apply AI/automation.

  • Drive outcomes: Bring recommendations to your counterparts in product, growth, finance or operations, tell them what's happening and why, and what next steps should be.

Why you will (or won't) like working here

  • No corporate fluff: We’re a team of insatiable learners and overachievers who care deeply about solving interesting problems and making a real impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or layers of approvals.

  • No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.

  • Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.

Who you are

  • Structured thinker: You break ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses before touching data. You're analytically strong (comfortable with SQL or Python) but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"

  • Direct communicator: You can walk a skeptical stakeholder through a complex finding and get buy-in quickly. You write clearly, speak precisely, and don't bury the lede.

  • Owner/driver: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane. You’re a driver, not a passenger.

What you bring

  • 6+ years of experience in management/strategy consulting, venture capital, or high-growth startup environment.

  • Strong analytical skills; ability to pull, structure, and interpret data independently.

  • Track record of owning ambiguous problems and delivering impact.

  • Clear, persuasive communicator who can influence decisions at the leadership level.

Our tools

SQL (Clickhouse), Metabase, Python, Jupyter Hub, GitHub.

Not necessary to have experience with the specific tech listed above. Thinking ability matters more to us than technical proficiency with any particular tool/language.

Compensation

This position offers base salary and stock options. The base salary for this position within New York and San Francisco is $200,000—$230,000 USD, but we can be flexible based on your prior experience, leveling and location. We also offer comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with 4% employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others.

Location

We support remote work from AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, and Ontario, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in New York City, Palo Alto, Chicago, and Toronto. We also spend a week together as a company twice a year.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

Please note: Jerry.ai is only able to hire full-time salaried employees who currently reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MA, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, or Ontario, Canada, and full-time hourly employees who currently reside in AZ, FL, GA, NV, NY, NC, TN, TX, UT, or VA. Unfortunately, we cannot accept applications from candidates residing elsewhere at this time.

Jerry.ai is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy, reproductive health decisions or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other characteristics protected by applicable local, state or federal laws.

Jerry.ai is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed on this job posting, determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base salary, the compensation may include opportunities for equity grants.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package to regular employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others. Equity opportunities may also be part of your total rewards package. Part-time, contract, or freelance roles may not be eligible for certain benefits.

About Jerry.ai

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We started with car insurance in 2019, became one of the top 3 brokers in the U.S., then added driving insights, diagnostics, and a repair marketplace. We've reached 5M+ customers, raised $240M+, and achieved profitability in 2024. We're now expanding into home, motorcycle, RV, and beyond.

Led by serial entrepreneurs and backed by Y Combinator, our team comprises talented and big-hearted leaders from places like Nvidia, Meta, Amazon, BCG, McKinsey, Bain, and GEICO. Our culture is the #1 reason people join Jerry and stay — we are a small and mighty team of competitive but kind people who think and act like owners, care deeply about the quality and impact of our work, and are relentless in our pursuit of learning and mastery over our craft.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

We support remote work for most roles, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in Palo Alto, New York City, Chicago, and Toronto.
